chapters.title: Chapter 551 - 542: Azi
paragraphs: Although these businesses ultimately failed to cooperate with Ding Ling,
their frenzied advertisements still had a certain effect.

Especially fashion brands like V, Martial Hero World, and Ice and Snow King’s World that chose to strongly associate themselves with Ding Ling from the start, successfully directed a wave of traffic to themselves.
Since they were the first to unabashedly court Ding Ling, they naturally left a strong impression on the players, thus successfully taking advantage of this initial wave.
It attracted imitators.
Unfortunately, the effects were not as good as before.
But it cannot be denied that these businesses’ frenzied advertising
has made Ding Ling increasingly popular and sought after!
His fanbase continues to grow.
He now has quite a few ardent fans even in the Celestial Dragon World.
Especially some female fans asking for his phone number and contact information in public is a common occurrence.
What is their intention?
The meaning is clear.
Ding Ling is accustomed to this and is not surprised.
On this day,
he soared in the void, gliding on the breeze over a wild mountain range, when he suddenly heard screams and cries.
Curious, Ding Ling instinctively glanced in the direction of the sound.
At this glance, he paused and couldn’t help but turn around and head down.
He had just seen Ding Chunqiu’s figure!
Ding Chunqiu was extremely good at escaping.
Even under nationwide efforts to capture him,
he still managed to get away.

Of course, as a universally detested character, he naturally didn’t dare go to crowded places. If he did, players and natives would report him! This has happened more than once, and players naturally received some ’cultivation technique’ rewards.
Ding Ling doesn’t lack cultivation techniques.
In order to capture Ding Chunqiu,
he promised to reward anyone who provides information with a basic martial arts internal power technique and anyone who captures Ding Chunqiu with a first-class martial arts internal power technique.
Players were understandably ecstatic and eagerly participated.
Ding Chunqiu’s location was discovered numerous times due to players’ enthusiastic support.
But this guy is like a viper; regular warriors can’t capture him. A careless mistake, and they’d be poisoned and killed, which happened quite often.
In recent months,
due to the effort to capture Ding Chunqiu, the Great Ming Kingdom has lost probably over a thousand warriors to poison and battle.
That’s how troublesome this guy is.
Now that Ding Ling has encountered him here, how could he let this venomous snake go?
"Master, look, I’ve returned the Divine Wood King Tripod to you; just let me go. I feel so terrible. Master..."
The person crying out was a young girl.
She was petite and exquisite, with skin like jade, dressed in purple attire, looking quite elegant.
But at the moment, she was rolling on the ground, occasionally scratching her face and body, with large dark eyes full of resentment and pain.
Beside the purple-clad girl stood a young girl dressed in red, beautiful like a flower, with a lively spirit, constantly glancing towards Ding Chunqiu, saying:
"Please spare Azi, I’ll do anything you want!"
"You said it yourself."
Ding Chunqiu glanced up and down at the red-clad girl, saying with a half-smile:

"If you really agree to be with me, I wouldn’t mind sparing Azi this time. But this little girl Azi is truly mischievous and cunning; I’m afraid she might slip away again and steal my Divine Wood King Tripod, causing me to suffer the onset of severe poisoning.
She made me suffer for so long. How could I not let her taste the agony of poison corroding the heart?
Once she gets through this moment, I’ll detoxify her, and then both sisters can accompany me."
The red-clad girl smiled ingratiatingly:
"Azi is still young, just let me be the one to accompany you."
"Stop with the nonsense."
Just as Ding Chunqiu was about to act, he suddenly caught sight of a figure descending like lightning from the sky in his peripheral vision.
Instinctively, he looked over.

At this sight, he was so shocked that six of his seven souls escaped, letting out a cry and immediately disregarding Azi and the red-clad girl, channeling his full power, activating his breathing technique, boosting his fusion Qi tenfold, and whoosh!
His body shot out like an arrow from a bowstring, covering dozens of meters in an instant, reaching over a hundred meters away within moments—the speed so fast, it reached his lifetime maximum!
"What happened?!"
The red-clad girl was astonished.
Azi was startled by Ding Chunqiu’s yell, momentarily stopping her cries and looking towards the direction of the sound. Upon seeing, both inhaled sharply.
It turned out a figure was flying down from the void.
This person was tall, handsome,
full of nobility, power, and sage-like aura, looking exceptionally extraordinary, like a celestial god.
He only glanced at Azi and the red-clad girl.
The two girls felt as if struck by lightning, with a tingling scalp and hearts uncontrollably racing.
They couldn’t quite describe the feeling clearly,
but undeniably, with just a glance, they formed an extremely deep impression of this extraordinary-looking man, which they might never forget in their lifetime.
Boom!
Of course, this man was Ding Ling. He flew past without touching the ground, chasing after Ding Chunqiu like the wind.
His speed was unparalleled, like lightning, arriving behind Ding Chunqiu in the blink of an eye, executing the Dragon Capturing Skill, grabbing at the air.
Bam!
Ding Chunqiu was caught, thrown back heavily. A resounding noise followed as Ding Chunqiu was tossed tens of meters away, crashing to the ground, dizzy.
Ding Ling had no interest in wasting words with Ding Chunqiu and directly pointed a Canhe Finger at him.
Puff!
It struck Ding Chunqiu’s heart.

Just as the fight started, as Ding Chunqiu was about to plead for mercy, he felt a pain in his heart, and the next instant, his strength rapidly drained, with his Transformation Technique beginning to swiftly rebound on himself.
"My heart vein has been struck..."

The intense pain in his heart forced him to kneel as if he pushed Gold Mountain and toppled Jade Pillar, looking at Ding Ling, trying to utter a plea for help, but his vision was dark and his throat ached, unable to speak.
"Why am I so unlucky!"
"Escaping to this desolate mountain wilderness, only to encounter Ding Ling, such a killer!"
"Have I been cursed for eight generations?! Even if my ancestors’ graves emitted smoke, it shouldn’t bring such misfortune upon me! Yet I just so happened to meet him in this damned place!"
Ding Chunqiu’s vision increasingly blurred and darkened, his consciousness scattering into a muddled haze.
In his dim awareness, he seemed to dream of returning to his youthful, confident days.

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - 543: Azhu
paragraphs: Alas, everything was irretrievable.
Ding Chunqiu sighed deeply, filled with regret and remorse. Had he known this would be the outcome.
He shouldn’t have fled in the first place when he was in Western Xia; surrendering directly to Ding Ling wouldn’t have been all that bad.
Instead, he repeatedly opposed the soldiers of Western Xia and later continued to go against the Great Ming Kingdom. If Ding Ling encountered him, would he not kill him? Who else would he kill?
The problem is...
He just happened to encounter Ding Ling, this emperor of the Great Ming Kingdom.
Is that emperor so idle?
Doesn’t he manage court affairs?
Doesn’t he handle state matters?
Why does he wander into this desolate wilderness?!
Ding Chunqiu passed on with a heart full of sorrow, frustration, entanglement, regret, and remorse.
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: You have intimidated Ding Chunqiu.]

[Note: Over the past few months, despite facing many hardships and troubles, Ding Chunqiu also encountered numerous opportunities, broke through his innate shackles, greatly advanced his martial arts, and even captured Azi, regaining the Divine Wood King Tripod. He thought his luck was turning around, but unexpectedly met you. Under your hand, he didn’t have a chance to resist and was swiftly killed! He was extremely shocked and frustrated!]
Ding Chunqiu also acquired an E-level Achievement Medal here.
Ding Ling, somewhat surprised, casually employed the Dragon Capturing Skill, flipping Ding Chunqiu’s position, uncovered his collar, and grabbed a wooden tripod out of thin air.
Examining it closely.
The wooden tripod was six inches tall, with a deep yellow hue.
The carving on the wooden tripod was exceedingly delicate, with thin red streaks appearing amidst the grain.
Sensing it carefully.
Ding Ling discovered that the wood of the Divine Wood King Tripod was extraordinarily special, seemingly forged from some kind of thousand-year cold wood, previously unseen or unheard of.

"This cold wood is inherently strange; if incense is burned upon it, it will attract countless poisonous creatures to gather. Needless to say, this thousand-year cold wood definitely has the effect of nurturing poison creatures. Indeed, the longer a poison creature stays on this cold wood, the more likely it is to grow smoothly."
Ding Ling did not know what other uses this thousand-year cold wood might have besides attracting poisonous creatures.
But he knew that this cold wood was undoubtedly a treasure, so he casually placed it into his storage pouch.
At this moment.
Ding Ling finally had a moment to look at the two other women.
These two women.
One seemed to be called Azi.
Ding Ling, possessing exceptional hearing, naturally heard their general conversation from a distance.
As for the other, if he guessed correctly, she should be...
"Azhu greets Your Majesty!"
Before Ding Ling could speak, the woman in red pulled Azi, kneeling before Ding Ling, paying deep homage:
"Long live Your Majesty, long live Your Majesty."
Azi rolled her eyes but followed suit, imitating the formality.
"Rise."
Ding Ling waved his hand.
He did not expect to encounter the sisters Azhu and Azi here.
It seems players have relentlessly leaked information.
Azhu found her birth mother.
Then went to find Azi.

It’s just that Azi, with her quirky and cunning nature, was in no way inferior to Azhu. Coupled with her shrewdness and ruthlessness, it was very likely that Azhu couldn’t handle Azi, which is quite normal.
But this had nothing to do with Ding Ling.
No matter what the future held for the sisters, Ding Ling had no intention of getting involved. He merely said to rise and then employed Soaring in the Void, ready to float away into the sky.
Seeing this, Azhu quickly cried out loudly:
"Your Majesty, please wait!"
"What is it?"
Standing upon the wind, Ding Ling hovered unsteadily, seemingly ready to drift away like the child of the wind, leaving Azhu and Azi secretly astonished, envious, and full of admiration.

Azhu knew Ding Ling because once, when she was within the Song realm, she saw Ding Ling from afar, waging war. She witnessed Ding Ling’s might firsthand, which left her heart trembling and full of fear!
Since childhood, she has admired Murong Fu.
But compared to Ding Ling, Murong Fu was merely a small witch facing a great witch, nothing at all.
Originally, she was somewhat afraid of Ding Ling.
After all, who in the Jianghu didn’t know that Ding Ling had bloodied the Four Great Manors beneath Canhe Manor?
She thought Ding Ling would be extremely fierce and bloodthirsty.

Only now, having seen him, she instinctively wants to overturn her previous notions, as Ding Ling, refined and courteous, exudes an extraordinary aura. Seeing him up close makes her instinctively have a good impression.
Azhu always admired heroic men.
Ding Ling’s impressive, formidable aura was so intense it almost seemed to condense into water.

With her heart pounding under such close appreciation, Azhu naturally felt compelled, and at this moment, when Ding Ling was about to leave, she instinctively called out to him. Yet, after calling him, she felt somewhat anxious. Seeing Ding Ling remained gracious, her heart calmed down, and she respectfully said:

"Your Majesty, my sister Azi is deeply poisoned. I heard from others that Your Majesty is unrivaled in the world, possessing god-like medical skills. I believe detoxifying her would not be a difficult task for you."
She knelt down and kowtowed to Ding Ling with Azi:
"Begging Your Majesty’s great mercy.
Azi, feeling unwell all over, also kowtowed, repeatedly chanting, ’Your Majesty’s great mercy, Your Majesty’s great mercy,’ without saying anything else.
Both girls’ voices were charming and melodious.
Hearing this, Ding Ling said:
"Alright, you can stop kowtowing."
He took out a strange flower he had obtained from the Wuliang Mountain Pool, pinched off a leaf, and gave it to Azi for her to swallow.
Azi obediently swallowed it.
She knew that if Ding Ling wanted to kill her, it would have been as easy as a wave of his hand; there was no reason he’d needlessly poison her.
If it were someone else, she wouldn’t have behaved so obediently.

Facing Ding Ling, she instinctively felt vulnerable, despite her usual rebellious nature, fearlessly challenging everything and everyone. Now she was watchfully docile, eyes lowered in submission before Ding Ling.
Poof!
After consuming the leaf, Azi couldn’t help but spit out a jet of black blood shortly after.
As soon as this blood was expelled.
Azi immediately felt the relief from pain, exuberantly overjoyed, and expressed endless gratitude to Ding Ling.
Azhu also expressed her gratitude alongside.
Ding Ling smiled, glanced deeply at Azhu, then soared away, vanishing within just a few breaths of time.
Indeed, Ding Ling had a favorable impression of Azhu, yet was unwilling to engage much with Azi.
This type of ruthless, rebellious young girl was not someone he wished to provoke.
"Just left like that?"
Azi felt her heart fluttering, gaze lingering longingly in the direction where Ding Ling had flown:
"This emperor is truly captivating. I wonder if his harem still needs a concubine. If they do, I’d like to give it a try..."
"Hey!"
Hearing Azi’s words, Azhu immediately snapped out from her daze, interrupting her thought:
"What are you thinking about! If Your Majesty heard this, it would be unacceptable."
"He can hear it just fine."
Seeing Ding Ling gone, Azi wasn’t afraid anymore. She played with her braid and pouted:
"I was just about to tell him face to face, asking him to take me into the harem as a concubine."
"You’ve got no shame."
"What’s there to be ashamed of?"
Azi glared:
"Dare you say you have no interest in His Majesty?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - 544: Sea of Books
paragraphs: This time it was Azhu’s turn to blush.
Ding Ling’s charisma was unprecedentedly high.
He was the most charming man Azhu had ever seen in her life.
Moreover, Ding Ling had too many auras surrounding him!
He was the current emperor of the Great Ming Kingdom!
Simply an unapproachable, absolutely top-notch high branch!
Then think about the life-saving grace just now.
Ding Ling departed gracefully without expecting any reward, a carefree attitude in stark contrast to Ding Chunqiu.
Ding Ling appeared exceedingly magnificent, tall, sacred, and bright!
Having suffered too much humiliation and hardship under Ding Chunqiu, suddenly encountering someone like Ding Ling.
She moved from the most desperate and dark realm to the brightest realm.
The intense emotions in her heart were imaginable.

Azhu was just like this. After experiencing such a disaster, the two sisters were rescued by such a great man as Ding Ling. Naturally, they secretly developed a fondness for Ding Ling. At this moment, her feelings were exposed by Azi, and she shyly said:
"I don’t deserve him!"
"Who deserves him then?"
Azi retorted:
"What role are Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing? You know perfectly well. Do they deserve Your Majesty? Yet they became empresses and consorts. If they can, why can’t I?"
"Oh dear."
Azhu stamped her foot and said:
"I’m not talking to you anymore. A girl should be more reserved. Talking about such things is truly indecorous."
"Tch."
Azi scoffed:
"I don’t care about propriety or anything. If His Majesty is willing to accept me, I’m willing to go back to the palace with him now."
Azhu was helpless against Azi and could only say:
"Let’s go back to Dali."
"I’m not going to see that Duan Zhengchun!"
"You have to call him father!"
"Humph. I don’t have such a father!"
"You!"
"What about you? If you want to call him, then call him. Don’t drag me into it."
Azi retorted against Azhu, then turned around and left.
"Where are you going?"
"None of your business!"
Ding Ling swept through Tubo, and on his way back, dealt with Ding Chunqiu, thus the return journey was smooth.
Back in Luoyang.
Ding Ling began handing various major affairs over to some famous ministers to handle.
And to attract more talents.
Ding Ling once again organized the imperial examination.
People from Tubo, Western Xia, Great Song, and Great Liao could participate, as long as they got through the final palace examination and became the champion scholar, their future would be limitless.
Upon hearing this, talented individuals from the Four Kingdoms were excited and overjoyed.
Ding Ling’s martial arts, knowledge, versatility, and character had already been recognized by many of noble purity.

Because Ding Ling was not very keen on wealth and power, except for needing some secret manuals and great medicine, he knew how to delegate power, allowing his subordinates to work freely without imposing too many constraints, enabling them to fully utilize their abilities.
He was generous with wealth and resources.
It was precisely because of such actions based solely on talent that Ding Ling was loved by some upright individuals, who voluntarily spread his fame, one person telling ten, ten telling a hundred.
In some high-level or academic circles, Ding Ling’s reputation was naturally quite commendable.
In this regard.
Ding Ling remained oblivious.
He wasn’t planning to stay in this world for long.
His unification of Jiuzhou was merely for collecting secret manuals and great medicine.
As he issued his commands.
Secret manuals from all over Jiuzhou, within the Four Kingdoms, were continuously being transported to Luoyang.
Upon returning to Luoyang, after handling some national affairs, Ding Ling entered the Imperial Study to read.
Here, secret manuals were delivered daily.
Secret manuals read by Ding Ling were transported to the Royal Library afterward.
And to facilitate his reading.
The Imperial Study was filled with bookshelves!
After renovation, the Imperial Study had become extremely large! Now, filled with bookshelves, it was densely packed with books at first glance.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but be delighted, thinking:
’At this rate, the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace will surely advance quickly.’
He began to read.
These secret manuals originated from all directions, copied manuals from major sects, aristocratic families, royal families, and so on.
Ding Ling stated he only required copies and would even allow the contributing families and sects to enter the Royal Library for reading.
The higher the level of contributed secret manuals.
The higher the level of secret manuals accessible in the Royal Library.
And to encourage more people to contribute secret manuals.
Ding Ling even placed the Nine Yin Scripture and Flying Bear Breathing Technique inside.
In his opinion.
Many people knew the Nine Yin Scripture, so placing it inside was fine. He was about to ascend to a higher world, and a mere Nine Yin Scripture was nothing to him.
One must give to receive.
With one Nine Yin Scripture plus some other first-class top secret manuals, exchanging for more top secret manuals was naturally worth it.
Ding Ling’s goal was to manifest the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.

As long as the Martial Arts Melting Furnace could forge a secret tome that distilled the essence of all major secret manuals, then it could be imagined that secret manuals like the Nine Yin Scripture would be easily surpassed by it.
It was precisely because of this far-reaching vision that Ding Ling decisively adopted this method.
When this method was first announced, sects, families, and others didn’t believe it.
But when the scouts they sent really obtained the opportunity to view equivalent secret manuals from the Royal Library, they were thrilled.
Having the chance to witness Ding Ling’s Martial Arts Secret Manual.
How many people dreamed of this?

Moreover, aside from gaining the chance to view the Royal Library, Ding Ling also promised that for each manual contributed, they could copy the same number of equivalent grade secret manuals from the Royal Library, and not only that, but they would also receive wealth, official ranks, land, and other rewards.
Ding Ling was striving to quickly collect secret manuals.
He gave his all.
Of course.
To ensure the orderly collection and fulfillment of these secret manuals, he also dispatched some highly intelligent literati to help ’fill in gaps.’
With those famed individuals assisting, some oversights were corrected, so Ding Ling didn’t worry too much.
He only needed to read in the Imperial Study every day.
Rustle!
Batch after batch of secret manuals reached full level.
Astronomy, geography, music, chess, calligraphy, painting, medical dao, array dao, Mo Family, Confucian School, Daoist Family, Buddhist study, and so on were all included.
Ding Ling was deeply absorbed in reading.
He read for days and nights.
Only after finishing all the secret manuals in the Imperial Study did he exhale deeply.
[Wisdom +0.8]
Finished reading the classics of Daoist Family, Confucian School, Mo Family, Logician School, Strategist School, and others, the growth in wisdom was quite substantial.
Ding Ling could feel the enhancement in memory, analytical abilities, and more.
Much of his buried past memories surged up once more at this moment.
[Buddha Qi +2 paths]
After finishing Buddhist study.
The Buddha Qi in his mind increased by two paths.
Ding Ling merely activated the Buddha Qi slightly, and the evil qi within his body dissipated immediately, with the additional two paths expelling it even faster.
His whole body felt comfortable beyond words.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body progress: 18%]
From 15% it increased to 18%.
Most of these secret manuals were ordinary, with few containing martial arts secrets, and the first-class ones extremely rare.
Thus, it ultimately only raised by 3 percentage points.

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - 545: Competing for Favor
paragraphs: "But this is just the first batch. There will be a second batch, and a third batch in the future."
Ding Ling nodded secretly.
A command was given.
Immediately someone moved the Secret Manuals he had read to the Royal Library.
Then, an endless stream of new Secret Manuals was moved to the Imperial Study.
They wanted to pile them up again.
This should take some time.
Ding Ling is not in a hurry.
This is gathering the strength of the ’Four Kingdoms’ to transport Secret Manuals to him, which is much more convenient than finding them himself.
One can only say.
Doing something with the strength of a nation is truly delightful and satisfying.
Ding Ling was very pleased.
Although he could defeat nations alone.
But wanting to collect Secret Manuals from each household? How long would that take?
And the others might not even give them.
But now he is the Emperor!
And he stated that he only needed copies, offering rewards aplenty!
Who dares not to give face to the Emperor while mixing in the officialdom?!
As for some Secret Manuals scattered among the people?
Naturally, someone would pay a high price to purchase them, and then come to Ding Ling to exchange for benefits.
Ding Ling encourages this.
Among the people, there are many masters, and many scattered Secret Manuals, skills, and abilities.
If these people can acquire Secret Manuals from these individuals, it’s their skill, and Ding Ling naturally encourages it as long as it’s not against the law.
With the unification of the four kingdoms.
Ding Ling’s plans for rule of law naturally advanced.
The Jianghu remains the Jianghu, but blatant wanton slaughter has lessened.
The Jianghu folks now fear provoking or angering Ding Ling the Martial Arts Venerable, the legend of Jianghu!
Ding Ling rose from the Jianghu, fought his way to become the Emperor of the Four Kingdoms!
Unprecedented!
They are both amazed, worshipful, and fearful, especially after some rebellious figures received their deserved ends, naturally they are more wary, cautious, and careful.
This is another great benefit for the common people, and more people support Ding Ling.
Some individuals even proactively contribute copies of Secret Manuals.
He who wins the people, wins the world.
Such has been the case since ancient times.
As for the entrenched aristocratic families showing defiance?
Ding Ling can break through both the Royal Family and Imperial City, who truly dares to stand up and say no?
Time flows like water.
One day.

The Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum from Lingjiu Palace at Illusory Peak of Tian Mountain brought half of the "Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme" to see Ding Ling.
They were worn and weary.
Heaven knows how much hardship they endured along the way.
Eating in the wind, sleeping in the dew, braving the elements, crossing mountains, no need to say.
Finally reaching the Western Xia Imperial City, they were told Ding Ling had gone to Luoyang.
So, again they had to embark on a thousand-mile trek to Luoyang!
Since it was their first time in the Central Plains, unfamiliar with the terrain, they suffered greatly.
Although Lingjiu Palace was significant in the past, subjugating Thirty-Six Caves and Seventy-two Island Masters, a rebellion cost Lingjiu Palace decades of effort almost overnight!
Years of arrangement in various parts of Central Plains almost dispersed.
Not many spies or personnel were left.
It’s precisely because of the difficulty in maintaining contact with these spies.
The Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum had such a painstaking journey.
Countless times they got lost, took detours, clashed with numerous bold marauders, and so on, let’s not mention.
In short, the four beautiful girls, once with jade-like complexion and distinguished looks, now appeared quite jaded.
Ding Ling chatted with them for a while.

The four women saw that Ding Ling was unexpectedly amiable and immediately breathed a sigh of relief, and since they came from among the people, knowing Ding Ling’s great reputation, their attitude towards him subtly changed.

Originally quite respectful and fearful of Ding Ling, the four women at this moment seemed to let down their guard, or rather, were here with the intention to please and cooperate, thus they affectionately called Ding Ling "Your Majesty" with charm and delight.
Li Qinglu, who was serving tea to Ding Ling beside them, couldn’t stand it.
She only felt that the four women who looked perfectly pleasing at first now looked like fox spirits!
"In a few days, I will make a trip to Illusory Peak."
Ding Ling finally said.
The Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum rejoiced and hurriedly said:
"Can Your Majesty take us back with you?"
The four women frowned:
"From Luoyang to Tian Mountain is too far, relying on us walking, it’s impossible to make it in less than half a month!"
Though they are familiar with the return journey now, and won’t take pointless detours again.
But being able to return within half a month is good.

After all, on this journey, dining in the wind and sleeping in the dew, needing to eat, rest, and so forth, plus climbing mountains and crossing streams, the road is difficult, consuming significant time, energy, and effort, naturally.
"Okay."
"Thank you, Your Majesty!"
The Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum bowed in jubilation.
"Qinglu, arrange accommodation and meals for them."
Ding Ling instructed.
"Certainly, Your Majesty."
Li Qinglu replied with a smile, stood up, and said:
"You all, follow me."
After she became the Imperial Consort.
In hopes of quickly bearing a son.
She frequently visited Ding Ling.
Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing also visited often but were never as precise. Every time Ding Ling returned to the palace, she’d promptly find him.
In this regard,
Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing were always a step behind. Thus, puzzled, they also began assigning palace maids to keep track of Ding Ling’s return, reporting immediately.
Despite this effort,
they were still half a step or a full step behind Li Qinglu.
This left the two of them distressed and worried.
Upon hearing reports that Li Qinglu had left the Imperial Study, the two were overjoyed, quickly tidied up, and went to find Ding Ling.
When they reached the Imperial Study, they saw Ding Ling reading.
One silently placed prepared pastries beside Ding Ling, while the other held washed fruit to Ding Ling’s mouth:
"Your Majesty, take a break, have some food.
"Alright."
Seeing Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing arrive, Ding Ling put down the book:
"Then let’s take a break."
The two were delighted.
Immediately, they accompanied Ding Ling for a chat.
They rarely gathered or parted.
Though Ding Ling had become Emperor, if not dealing with state affairs and selecting officials, he was lost in the sea of books, hard to gather truly.
However, lately, with Ding Ling often in the Imperial Study, the women frequently came to accompany him.
It gave Ding Ling a taste of the ancients’ ’corrupted’ ’fallen life’.
Fortunately, Ding Ling’s goal was clear, only for immortality and invincibility.
Thus, he was not concerned about having more women.
The three women in the palace
were sufficient for him.
Many ministers repeatedly advised him to hold a selection, to fill the harem, but Ding Ling refused.
Therefore,
Mu Wanqing, Zhong Ling, and Li Qinglu were naturally overjoyed, and their recognition and admiration for Ding Ling heightened drastically.
In their view,
Having only three women in the Emperor’s harem is rare and uncommon.
How many Emperors in history?
Are always with three palaces, six courtyards, seventy-two concubines.
In this regard, Ding Ling is exceptionally wise and virtuous as a monarch; how could they not be satisfied?
Therefore,
They sought ways to be good to Ding Ling.
And hoped to bear heirs for him sooner.
Yet they were unaware that Ding Ling had no desire for offspring, and could not have children regardless.
Ding Ling went to Celestial Mountain Piaomiao Peak, Lingjiu Palace.
Having obtained the complete version of "Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme," he bid farewell to Heavenly Mountain Granny and left.
The Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum watched Ding Ling’s departing figure, unable to recover for a long time.

They thought of Ding Ling carrying them on this journey, rushing like the wind and electricity, flying hundreds of miles at once, lightly tapping on tree tops, then borrowing force to soar another hundreds of miles.
Repeating this several times.
Thus he carried them back to Lingjiu Palace, the speed initially eliciting screams from them, and now, recalling, the four women blushed, feeling shy and embarrassed.
"What is it?"
Heavenly Mountain Granny glanced sideways.
Such expressions from the four were rare.
The four didn’t hide it from her and revealed the reason.
Heavenly Mountain Granny was moved, further confirming Ding Ling had indeed learned the art of Soaring in the Void.
"Truly impressive. Had I known, I would have asked him for guidance."
Heavenly Mountain Granny regretted and fretted, but Ding Ling had already flown away, making it impossible to call him back.
"When you have the chance, visit Luoyang."
Heavenly Mountain Granny thus remarked.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 - 546: Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Venerable Skill Full Level
paragraphs: The Four Swordswomen of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum were ecstatic upon hearing the news.
The four women had been interacting closely with Ding Ling along the journey, inexplicably feeling a strong affection for him. Meeting Ding Ling again naturally filled them with heartfelt excitement.

The Heavenly Mountain Granny understood this and fell into contemplation, thinking: The martial might of the Great Ming Kingdom has grown so strong that all nations must retreat before it. I’ve heard that even small countries like Dali have submitted to the Great Ming Kingdom. Sooner or later, my Western Realm will also be conquered and governed by the Great Ming Kingdom. I must prepare for the future.

Although the Heavenly Mountain Granny’s temperament was violent, eccentric, and stubborn, her talent, vision, and wisdom were exceptional. Previously, her eyes were clouded by hatred, but now, following the passing of Wuya Zi and Li Qiushui, her mindset began to subtly change.
Especially after several encounters with Ding Ling.
She was deeply moved.
There was a strong sense of being pushed forward by the waves of the Yangtze River, with the front wave dying on the beach!

She knew her era had passed, and previously, she expanded her forces merely for self-protection, to fend off Li Qiushui’s attacks. But now that Li Qiushui has died, and Ding Ling has agreed to cooperate with her.
She naturally no longer needs to expand her forces aggressively.
Of course, she also knew that no matter how much she expanded her forces, she would end up crushed by Ding Ling and his Great Ming Kingdom.
For the future and long-term consideration of Lingjiu Palace.
She must deepen her relationship with Ding Ling. But how to deepen it?
The Heavenly Mountain Granny looked at Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum and asked them their feelings and thoughts about Ding Ling.
The four of them unabashedly expressed their admiration and adoration for Ding Ling.
Looking like little fans.

The Heavenly Mountain Granny’s face fell, instinctively ready to lose her temper, but considering Ding Ling’s charm and demeanor, she let it go. She thought of how she was once infatuated with her junior brother Wuya Zi, and Ding Ling’s charm surpassed even that of her junior brother, which naturally attracted Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum.
"Since that’s the case. Let it take its course."
Yet, the Heavenly Mountain Granny had an idea.
After returning to Luoyang, Ding Ling continued to immerse himself in the sea of books.
Of course.
He also read the secret manual given to him by the Heavenly Mountain Granny.
After one reading.
[Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Venerable Skill Full Level]
Once Ding Ling reached full level in this martial art, he instantly comprehended and penetrated its mysterious essence.
This was indeed a Pure Yang Supreme Skill!
Not inferior at all to the Nine Yang Divine Skill.
Its most unique aspect is that it can keep one’s youthful appearance forever!
Once Ding Ling reached full level in this Divine Skill, it meant that his appearance and body would forever remain fixed in their youth, never aging with time.
"Amazing."
Ding Ling was pleasantly surprised.
Everyone fears getting older.
And Ding Ling was no exception.
Now, this Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Venerable Skill could keep him forever youthful; it truly was a Supreme Technique!

"The only two flaws in this martial art might be that it isn’t suitable for women to cultivate and that without reaching Great Success, one might automatically revert to childhood. Only when one reaches Full Level Great Perfection and has innate mastery, can they freely control the Qi Force of this cultivation technique throughout their body, thereby automatically maintaining a youthful appearance and physique."
At this moment, Ding Ling profoundly understood why the Heavenly Mountain Granny faced so many ups and downs while cultivating this martial art.

The Heavenly Mountain Granny had exceptional talent; she cultivated this Pure Yang Supreme Skill with a woman’s body and succeeded. Yet, when nearing Great Success, she fell victim to sabotage, causing her to revert to her form at six years old, thus perpetually appearing as a little girl!
Moreover, she needed to absorb blood for her constant return to youth.

Perhaps it was due to her feminine innate Yin body, which required a supplement of Yang Qi when cultivating such a Pure Yang Supreme Skill; otherwise, she could easily go mad, suffer counteract from this skill, and lose all her cultivation to nothing.
"But I am male, so I don’t have such concerns."

Once Ding Ling reached full level in the Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Venerable Skill, he felt an extremely special Supreme Qi constantly revolving around his body, allowing him to maintain his body in optimal vitality.
"This Qi..."
Ding Ling sensed deeply, quite moved.
It was indeed an exceedingly special Qi, resembling Longevity Qi?
In the Three Kingdoms era, he was blessed by Celestial Might.
Life force was boundless; he had experienced this feeling once before.
Experiencing it again now naturally felt familiar.

"Unexpectedly, once the Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Venerable Skill reached full level, it would spontaneously generate a Supreme Qi similar to Longevity Qi. No wonder it can keep one youthful forever. Such a skill, when cultivated to great perfection, is almost approaching Immortal Dao Skill."
Ding Ling praised internally.
Truly worthy of the Carefree Sect!
Whether it’s the North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, or Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme Skill, they are all Supreme Skills.
Now he has integrated all three.
All three Qi Forces are within his body.
In essence, a subtle transformation had happened, making his body and True Qi more perfect, truly fulfilling!
"Let’s continue reading."
Ding Ling had already finished the second batch of books.
[Wisdom +0.5]
There were quite a few similar books.
The effect of wisdom enhancement would naturally weaken.
[Buddha Qi +1 thread]
[Vast Righteous Qi +1 thread]
Buddhist Study increased Buddha Qi.
Confucianism increased Vast Qi.
Vast Qi was the hardest to grow.
He had read many Confucian Classics, famous classics, and so much more, it seemed inadequate to describe them as piles.
However, he only cultivated one pure thread of Vast Righteous Qi.
Along with this newly cultivated thread, he only had two threads.
Though Vast Righteous Qi was little, it could protect the body, preventing Blood Evil from invading the heart.
Ding Ling, as usual, placed this Vast Righteous Qi deeply into his heart, defending the heart gate from intrusion by evil beings.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body Progress: 21%]
It had increased from 18% to 21%.
The second batch of secret manuals consisted of nine-tenths ordinary manuals, so theoretically, the Furnace Body progress should decrease, given that there are many similar books.
But with the additions from Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Venerable Skill and other secret manuals, it eventually rose by 3 percentage points.
"Continue with the third batch."
Ding Ling buried himself in the third batch of books.
After a few days, he finished reading the dense collection of books and secret manuals.
[Wisdom +0.3]
[Buddha Qi +1]
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body Progress: 23%]
Finished reading the third batch.
At Ding Ling’s command.
Immediately someone came in to carry away the read books and secret manuals, starting to bring in the fourth batch continuously.
But filling the entire Imperial Study’s bookshelves might take two to three days.
Ding Ling didn’t wait idly.
Instead, he dealt with some accumulated court affairs, interviewed several ministers, encouraging them to be proactive in doing their jobs.

These famous figures were historically recognized clean officials, and with Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill full level, having directly interacted with them, he knew they were loyal ministers dedicated to the country and the people.
Therefore, he trusted them greatly.
He handed various important matters to them, only managing the general direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - 547: The Duan Zhengchun Family
paragraphs: Otherwise, he would have to manage everything himself.
Wouldn’t he be exhausted to death?
That’s secondary.
The primary reason is that his purpose is to see the Secret Manual; how could he truly immerse himself in governing the country?
After all, he is someone who will soon ascend.
How can he be bogged down in governance?
After clarifying the major issues and indicating the general direction, Ding Ling gracefully soared out of the Imperial Palace.
The ministers saw this and felt quite helpless.
An emperor like Ding Ling, throughout the world and combing through ancient history, seems to be the only one.
He is either on his way to conquer other countries,
or lost in the sea of books, unable to extricate himself.
Or he’s simply missing, flown off to who knows where.
Faced with such an invincible yet unwilling-to-work all-powerful emperor, they could only strive and work harder.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane World experts: 113/20.]
Previously it was 28.
Later, under the guise of sparring, he defeated Xiaoo Yuanshan and others.
And successively defeated or killed Murong Bo, Ding Chunqiu, sixteen first-class experts from the Great Song Imperial Palace, and six first-class experts including the Chief Eunuch.
The Great Song soldiers had 14 first-class experts.
The Great Liao had a total of 35 first-class experts defeated.
These first-class experts, although most barely touched the edge of first-class, were no different from ordinary soldiers to Ding Ling, as fragile as paper.
Yet they were indeed first-class experts, for touching the edge still counts.
Additionally, the Tubo had 11 first-class experts.
Adding them up, there were 113 in total. Far exceeding the mission target, under the glory of achievement, this time the Glory Medal would be plentiful.
[3: You must let your title of World’s Number One reverberate throughout the entire Plane World. 100%/100%.]
With the unification of the Four Kingdoms.
Ding Ling’s name as the Martial Arts Myth resounded throughout the entire Plane World!
The progress naturally surged all the way to 100%.
"Now only task 2 remains unfinished."
Ding Ling prepared to visit the Shaolin Temple to spar with the Sweeping Monk and complete task 2 first.
Flying from Luoyang to Mount Songh Shaolin Temple was not far.
And this journey,
Due to its extremely unique geographic location, had become the most active road for players.
Ding Ling soared through the sky.
The players saw him, naturally couldn’t help but scream, shouting Ding Ling’s name or calling out ’idol’ was not uncommon.
Ding Ling just pretended not to hear, swiftly flew past, and in a few blinks of an eye, disappeared into the distance.
"Wasn’t that the Emperor of the Great Ming, Ding Ling, flying just now?!"
A middle-aged man with a commanding presence, thick eyebrows and big eyes, exuded a kingly demeanor, looked up at the direction where Ding Ling disappeared and asked in amazement.
"Indeed."
Standing beside the middle-aged man was the handsome young scholar, Duan Yu, who also looked on with admiration and longing:
"He is Brother Ding."
"I never thought his power would be so profound and fantastic to such an outrageous degree. No wonder he can singlehandedly overthrow four major countries."
The middle-aged man was Duan Zhengchun, and on his left stood Duan Yu, Wang Yuyan, Azhu, Azi, Ruan Xingzhwuu, while on his right stood Gan Baobao, Qin Hongmian, Dao Baifeng.
Behind them were the Four Great Guards, Chuu Wanli, Guu Duchen, Fu Sigu, Zhu Danchen.
The Four Great Guards, whether elegant, mighty, graceful, or handsome, were also full of amazement at the moment, whispering and discussing, filled with awe of Ding Ling in their conversation.
Gan Baobao, Qin Hongmian, one graceful and charming like a peach and plum; the other extraordinary in temperament, beautiful without being coquettish, can be said to each have their unique beauty.
They are the mothers of Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing, respectively.
At this moment, hearing everyone talking about Ding Ling.
They couldn’t help but feel proud and honored, yet also felt heartache and bitterness, a mix of emotions, experiencing an extreme fluctuation of mood.

Pride and honor naturally because their daughters are now Empresses and Imperial Consorts, elevated and matched with a good man, naturally counting Ding Ling as a true family member to them, hearing Ding Ling being praised by so many, naturally made them feel proud and honored.
After all, this is their daughters’ husband! Their son-in-law!
With such a son-in-law, what more could one ask for?!
The bitterness is due to Duan Zhengchun not having Ding Ling’s immense capability, not to mention falling far short in terms of responsibility!
Ding Ling dared to be fully responsible for their daughters, and even gave them the status of high-standing Empress and Imperial Consort!
And Duan Zhengchun?!
In comparison,
Duan Zhengchun was utterly outmatched, crushed to the dust by Ding Ling.
Gan Baobao and Qin Hongmian naturally had mixed feelings, but couldn’t deny that what they most want now is to see their daughters, to ask them face-to-face how they are really doing.
"We’re almost at Luoyang. Let’s go."
Duan Zhengchun glanced around, saw the expressions of Gan Baobao and others, and couldn’t help but feel a headache.
Especially when seeing Dao Baifeng glare at him coldly, his heart skipped a beat, smiling wryly.
He was also puzzled.
How did Ding Ling manage to win over such outstanding women like Mu Wanqing, Zhong Ling, and Li Qinglu?
He wanted to seek the True Scripture from this son-in-law!!
Due to the players’ rampant leaks,
The identities of Mu Wanqing, Zhong Ling, and others were naturally already revealed.
And with the Dali Kingdom submitting to the Great Ming Kingdom.
Thus came about the Duan family’s collective move to Luoyang to settle.
After Duan Zhengchun, there was also the Dali Kingdom’s Emperor Baoding, Duan Zhengming, and his family.
As for Duan Yu’s matters?
Naturally, it was also long revealed, but Dao Baifeng refused to admit it, and although Duan Zhengchun had suspicions, he couldn’t delve too deep.

Actually, Dao Baifeng was also dreading, feeling regretful and remorseful, but given the situation, for the sake of Duan Yu’s future, she naturally could only deny it, otherwise, not to mention her own reputation would be ruined, Duan Yu’s status as a successor would also be in jeopardy.
Clip-clop!
Duan Zhengchun’s group continued on their journey.
Azi, Azhu, and Ruan Xingzhwuu were chattering together.
Eventually, Azi was persuaded by Azhu, and went with her mother Ruan Xingzhwuu to Luoyang.

She was extremely unruly, but thinking of Ding Ling’s prowess, she also became quite obedient, not daring to act recklessly in Luoyang’s realm, Azhu warned her multiple times, though she verbally expressed disdain, she internally understood the terrifying laws of the Great Ming Kingdom, where many people from Jianghu who committed crimes were executed publicly.
This included some princes and nobles.
Azi, though of noble status now, also knew the Duan family had surrendered to the Great Ming Kingdom, nearly indistinguishable from prisoners under the Great Song’s emperor.
The only difference being Duan Zhengchun’s daughter married Ding Ling, with Duan Zhengchun leaping to become the Imperial Father-in-law of the Great Ming Kingdom!
The status remained exceptional, no one dared truly offend Duan Zhengchun.
Azi saw the ’prisoners’ receiving such grand treatment due to the ’Imperial Father-in-law’ status, her eyes couldn’t help but start to whirl around.
Azhu saw through Azi’s intentions at a glance, but under so many eyes, it was not fitting to quarrel, only thinking to advise Azi properly later.
But how could Azi be one to heed advice?
Already entertaining a vague notion, seeing Duan Zhengchun’s renewed prestige naturally stirred up all sorts of devious thoughts.
She was a stubborn person, once having an idea, even eight oxen couldn’t pull her back, Azhu saw this, sensing something amiss, decided to keep a close eye on Azi.
Thus, regardless of where Azi went, Azhu followed.
Azi, feeling impatient, glared frequently and harshly at Azhu.
Azhu just laughed gracefully, ignoring it.
"Look, what’s that?"
Azi pointed behind Azhu.
Azhu shook her head:
"Don’t try to trick me again. That old trick worked once, you think you can fool me with it multiple times?"
"Tsk."
Azi waved her hand:
"Follow if you like."
The two girls wandered around Luoyang before rejoining the main group.
On the same day,
They went to the Palace,
And met Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing.
The two women, having become Empress and Imperial Consort, had changed in temperament from before, becoming more dignified, poised, and grand.
Duan Yu noticed this, unable to hold back, said:
"It seems like the two younger sisters are living well here."
’Yes.’
Zhong Ling smiled faintly, revealing dimples on her cheeks:
"His Majesty treats me and Sister Mu very well indeed."

Eventually, Azi was persuaded by Azhu, and went with her mother Ruan Xingzhwuu to Luoyang.

She was extremely unruly, but thinking of Ding Ling’s prowess, she also became quite obedient, not daring to act recklessly in Luoyang’s realm, Azhu warned her multiple times, though she verbally expressed disdain, she internally understood the terrifying laws of the Great Ming Kingdom, where many people from Jianghu who committed crimes were executed publicly.
This included some princes and nobles.
Azi, though of noble status now, also knew the Duan family had surrendered to the Great Ming Kingdom, nearly indistinguishable from prisoners under the Great Song’s emperor.
The only difference being Duan Zhengchun’s daughter married Ding Ling, with Duan Zhengchun leaping to become the Imperial Father-in-law of the Great Ming Kingdom!
The status remained exceptional, no one dared truly offend Duan Zhengchun.
Azi saw the ’prisoners’ receiving such grand treatment due to the ’Imperial Father-in-law’ status, her eyes couldn’t help but start to whirl around.
Azhu saw through Azi’s intentions at a glance, but under so many eyes, it was not fitting to quarrel, only thinking to advise Azi properly later.
But how could Azi be one to heed advice?
Already entertaining a vague notion, seeing Duan Zhengchun’s renewed prestige naturally stirred up all sorts of devious thoughts.
She was a stubborn person, once having an idea, even eight oxen couldn’t pull her back, Azhu saw this, sensing something amiss, decided to keep a close eye on Azi.
Thus, regardless of where Azi went, Azhu followed.
Azi, feeling impatient, glared frequently and harshly at Azhu.
Azhu just laughed gracefully, ignoring it.
"Look, what’s that?"
Azi pointed behind Azhu.
Azhu shook her head:
"Don’t try to trick me again.
That old trick worked once, you think you can fool me with it multiple times?"
"Tsk."
Azi waved her hand:
"Follow if you like."
The two girls wandered around Luoyang before rejoining the main group.
On the same day,
They went to the Palace,
And met Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing.
The two women, having become Empress and Imperial Consort, had changed in temperament from before, becoming more dignified, poised, and grand.
Duan Yu noticed this, unable to hold back, said:
"It seems like the two younger sisters are living well here."
’Yes.’
Zhong Ling smiled faintly, revealing dimples on her cheeks:
"His Majesty treats me and Sister Mu very well indeed."

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - 548: Arhat Divine Skill Full Level
paragraphs: Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian, being mothers, stepped forward to communicate with Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing.
Upon learning that Ding Ling indeed treated the two well, showing a great sense of responsibility and duty,
Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian were immensely pleased.
Their fondness and approval of Ding Ling soared.
They glanced around, not seeing Li Qinglu, and curiously asked about her.
Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing exchanged a peculiar look at Wang Yuyan in the crowd and whispered a few words to Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian, startling them:
"Really?"
"Absolutely."
Zhong Ling whispered:
"That’s why Li Qinglu was unwilling to come out and meet you both."
"Truly, the Great Thousand Worlds are full of wonders. Though their parents are different, they look identical. It’s astonishing."
Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian were amazed but didn’t dwell further on the matter.
Their primary concern was their daughters and son-in-law.
They couldn’t help but chat animatedly with the two girls once more.
Duan Zhengchun sat nearby, feeling somewhat uneasy under the gaze of Ruan Xingzhu and others, his desire to see his son-in-law growing stronger.
However, upon seeing Wang Yuyan, he couldn’t help but sigh inwardly, as if doused with cold water, immediately dampening his eagerness.
As Ding Ling roamed the Jianghu, decisive in his actions, many of his deeds were widely told across the martial world.
Some storytellers even began crafting tales with Ding Ling as the protagonist.
Duan Zhengchun had heard tales several times during his journey north from Dali Kingdom about the incidents concerning the Gusu Murong Family on Lake Tai, so he was naturally aware.
Li Qingluo brought it upon herself, there was no doubt about that.

However, whenever Duan Zhengchun thought about it, he couldn’t shake off a certain heaviness in his heart. He knew Li Qingluo’s personality well; he had been scared away by her forceful, sharp, and ruthless nature.
Later, he had speculated that Li Qingluo would be fine if she never encountered a ruthless person.
But if she did meet one,
her fate would definitely not be good.
Sure enough, encountering a strong, invincible, decisive son-in-law like Ding Ling, Li Qingluo indeed met her demise.
With this,
after sighing, Duan Zhengchun couldn’t help but move aside to comfort Wang Yuyan.
After all, she was his biological daughter.
How could he ignore her?
Duan Yu looked on with a bitter expression.
Although the Alien claimed he was the son of Duan Yanqing, the most notorious of the Four Great Evils, Dao Baifeng vehemently declared that the Alien was spouting nonsense!
Duan Yu naturally believed his mother.
But because of this, he couldn’t marry Wang Yuyan, so how could he be happy?
He felt despondent every day, but whenever he saw Wang Yuyan, he couldn’t resist approaching her; she was his Immortal Sister, how could he truly let go?!
Duan Zhengchun arrived in Luoyang.
The family was reuniting with Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing.
Ding Ling was unaware.
Even if he knew, he wouldn’t care much.
He valued Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling the most.
As long as Duan Zhengchun and the others didn’t provoke him, they could coexist peacefully; if they did provoke him, Ding Ling wouldn’t hesitate to act.
He had no emotional ties to Duan Zhengchun, so he naturally wouldn’t focus too much on or care for him.
Swoosh!
Ding Ling had reached Shaolin Temple by now.
He didn’t present any formalities, flying directly to Shaolin Temple, heading to the Scripture Pavilion.
Where was the Scripture Pavilion?
Ding Ling, with his keen eyesight and speed, circled Shaolin Temple and soon found it.
At this moment, Ding Ling stood before the entrance of the Scripture Pavilion.
Looking at this three-storied building, with eaves elegantly upturned, resembling the Phoenix Pavilion and Dragon Tower, it was extremely exquisite and beautiful.
It was evident that Shaolin Temple had invested thought into constructing the Scripture Pavilion, its unique and exquisite design making it one of a kind.
Ding Ling found it hard not to notice.
He stepped forward two steps.
A monk happened to come out of the Scripture Pavilion at this time; upon seeing him, he stretched out his hand to stop Ding Ling, saying:
"This is the secret area of the Shaolin Scripture Pavilion, no outsiders are allowed. If the benefactor is here to offer incense and worship Buddha, you may proceed to the main hall."
"I’m not here to offer incense and worship Buddha."
"Then, what is the benefactor here for?"
Ding Ling didn’t bother to explain much, nor did he intentionally make things difficult for the old monk; he just said lightly:
"You can report to the Abbot that Ding Ling, Emperor of the Great Ming, has come for a visit."
"What?!"

The old monk was shocked, scrutinizing Ding Ling, observing his tall, upright, and extraordinarily handsome appearance, his aura a blend of nobility, power, and sanctity, causing his heart to race, knowing that Ding Ling was no ordinary person, and upon comparing his looks with the legend of the Martial Arts Myth.
The old monk was so startled that his eyelids trembled continuously, he immediately stepped back two steps, bowed deeply to Ding Ling with respect, then clasped his palms together and said:
"Amitabha Buddha, I didn’t know it was Your Majesty, truly a lack of welcoming, please forgive us."
"No sin if unintentional, I’m here to browse the books in your Scripture Pavilion, you have no objections, right?"
"Of course not."
The old monk solemnly said:
"I am Xuan Ji, currently the head of the Precepts Hall. Your Majesty can freely visit the Scripture Pavilion, no one will dare to utter a word."
"Thank you.
"Your Majesty is too kind."
Ding Ling didn’t speak further, walking straight into the Scripture Pavilion.

Xuan Ji discreetly wiped a cold sweat, thinking: Our Shaolin Temple has already copied many Buddhist texts and Shaolin skills for the Great Ming Empire and sent them to Luoyang; does Your Majesty really need to come visit the Scripture Pavilion to read Buddhist scriptures? Is it necessary?
Despite his puzzlement,
He dared not disturb Ding Ling further, quickly left the Scripture Pavilion, and instructed others to keep an eye on it, to report any unusual occurrences to him immediately.
He was worried Ding Ling might need something.

Or concerned that someone from Shaolin might offend Ding Ling, which would cause trouble. Ding Ling’s decisive reputation has long been well known in the martial world, so Xuan Ji naturally recognized it, how could he dare to offend Ding Ling?
Tap tap!
After stepping into the Scripture Pavilion, Ding Ling wasn’t in a rush to find the Sweeping Monk, instead, he started picking up Buddhist scriptures to read.
He read books swiftly.
Going through them quickly.
He found that fifty to sixty percent of the Buddhist scriptures were ones he had already seen.
It goes without saying.
Shaolin Temple did contribute to those editions sent to Luoyang.
Ding Ling didn’t mind.
He continued reading.
Later,
He saw many of Shaolin Temple’s Seventy-Two Skills.
He went through them one by one.
[Arhat Divine Skill Full Level]
[Defense +0.4]
[Bodhi Heart Method Full Level]
[Dharma Breath Control Technique Full Level]
[Vajra Indestructible Body Divine Skill Full Level]
[Defense +1]
[Kasaya Demon Suppression Skill Full Level]
[Defense +0.4]
He went through them one by one.
Once he had gone through dozens of the Seventy-Two Skills,
Ding Ling’s defense points unknowingly reached the extreme value of 80 points.
After reaching this extreme,
Even though he continued to max out on the Seventy-Two Skills, he could no longer increase his True Qi or Four-dimensional Attributes.
Ding Ling didn’t mind this either.
He regarded it as enhancing his foundation while advancing the progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body.

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - 549: Full Level As You Wish Bone Shrinking Skill
paragraphs: After browsing through all the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills here.
Gathering the Seventy-Two Skills from several worlds.
Ding Ling has basically collected all the Seventy-Two Skills.
Buddha Light faintly flickered over his body.
Standing there, his dignified presence seemed to have the demeanor and grace of an Arhat.
Ding Ling continued to read the Buddhist Scripture.
Since he’s here.
It wouldn’t hurt to finish reading before finding the Sweeping Monk.
After all, the Sweeping Monk won’t leave the Scripture Pavilion.
When Ding Ling entered the first floor of the Scripture Pavilion, he noticed an old monk silently sweeping in a corner.
He was dressed in a cyan robe, with a thin physique, holding a broom, and with each sweep, the scant few long white hairs on his chin would lightly sway.
His demeanor was elegant, blending in with the dust, exuding a composed and unperturbed air.
Whether he heard the appellation given to him by Xuan Ji or not, or even if he heard it, he didn’t seem to care, appearing as if he didn’t notice Ding Ling at all.
Such a calm attitude, neither flustered nor hurried, indirectly attested to his extraordinary nature.
Ding Ling was not in a rush.
He began to quickly read the books.
Shuffling sounds!
Volume by volume, Shaolin Skills were read and quickly reached Full Level.
Apart from the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills.
The Shaolin Temple in this Celestial Dragon World also possesses an incredibly comprehensive collection of skills!
[Iron Arm Skill Full Level]
[Overlord Elbow Full Level]
[Golden Bell Shield Full Level]
[Iron Cloth Shirt Full Level]
[Lying Tiger Skill Full Level]
[Iron Knee Skill Full Level]
Each skill reached Full Level.
Adding to the previous dozens of Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills.
Ding Ling’s aura visibly strengthened.
Although his Four-dimensional Attribute Points and True Qi had already reached the limit of this world, unable to grow further.
But the skills reaching Full Level still continuously enhanced Ding Ling’s foundation, making him more profound and substantial.
After finishing the skills, he read the Buddhist Scripture.
Thus, over a day passed.
Ding Ling read from the first floor to the third floor.
After finishing.
[Buddha Qi + 3]
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body Progress: 34%]
It jumped by 11 percentage points from 23%.
Admittedly.
The richness of the collection here exceeded Ding Ling’s expectations.
The number of skills, much more than any batch sent to the Imperial Study.

It can be said that Shaolin Temple in the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World not only houses hidden talents, but its rich scriptures definitely crush those of the Shaolin Temples in the Divine Eagle and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Worlds.
The 11 percentage points increase went beyond Ding Ling’s expectations.
But it only signifies the astonishing amount of Martial Arts Secret Manuals here.
And the endless variety of skills.

Shaolin Child’s Skill, Tornado Palm, Golden Dragon Hand, Thousand-Pound Foot, Meteor Leg, Bright Fist, Bodhisattva Hand, Divine Palm Eight Strikes, Shaolin Flower-Scattering Palm, Drunken Eight Immortals Staff Technique, Dharma Eight Methods Divine Zen Staff Technique, Great Shifting Body Technique, Heart-Mind Qi Primordial Skill, Dragon-Taming and Elephant-Subduing Skill, As You Wish Bone Shrinking Skill, Supreme Demon Subduing Bead Technique...
There were many such skills.
Ding Ling mastered them all to Full Level.
It can be said.
In terms of the amount of Shaolin Ultimate Skills mastered, even if Dharma himself were resurrected, he wouldn’t surpass Ding Ling.
Despite mastering a considerable number of skills.

Ding Ling wasn’t worried about losing control, solely because two strands of Vast Righteous Qi tightly guarded his heart, warding off evil, additionally having Buddha Qi shielding him, repelling malevolence, suppressing inner desires, truly remarkable.
After finishing the books in the Scripture Pavilion.
Ding Ling approached the old monk, paid his respects, and said:
"Junior Ding Ling greets Senior."
"Unworthy of that title."
The old monk did not put down the broom in his hand, just glanced up and down at Ding Ling twice, expressing surprised admiration:

"I have lived for over eighty years. Yet, it’s the first time witnessing such a remarkable, supreme person like Your Majesty. No wonder tales circulate throughout Shaolin Temple alleging Your Majesty singlehandedly shattered four kingdoms, subduing Dali Kingdom and numerous smaller countries. I am beginning to understand."
Ding Ling was about to speak.
The old monk asked:
"The moment you set foot into the Scripture Pavilion, you noticed something peculiar about me, didn’t you?"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling candidly replied:
"Junior came primarily for Senior."
"Your Majesty, burdened with overwhelming affairs, forsake this vast kingdom, came to this Scripture Pavilion specifically to read for a whole day. It puzzles me greatly."
The old monk continued to display a calm demeanor:
"I wonder what brought Your Majesty here?"
"I wish to spar with Senior a bit."
"Is that all?"
"Indeed."
"Then I concede.
The old monk stood seven feet tall, straightened his posture, slightly raising his head to observe Ding Ling, smiling kindly:

"Your Majesty possesses a talent beyond compare, astounding throughout ages. Enough to leave anyone in awe and admiration. I am no exception. Your Majesty, over a day’s time, I observed everything you’ve done.
I saw it with my own eyes.

Learning various Divine Skill Secret Manuals instantly. Such skill and capability, I have never seen or heard of before. Leafing through ancient history, one rarely finds a person with unmatched talent like Your Majesty.
I am just a mere Sweeping Monk.
How then could I dare spar with someone as noble and supreme as Your Majesty?"
"I didn’t expect Senior to have such a silver tongue, flattering Junior."
"This is not flattery."
The old monk shook his head, solemnly stated:
"I am merely stating a fact."
He expressed admiration:

"Your Majesty’s rising Buddha Qi and mystical aura have increased tremendously within a short day. Even if I were to flatter, I couldn’t catch up; what capability do I have to compete with Your Majesty?"
"Senior, don’t belittle yourself. We’re merely exchanging skills; I hope you won’t decline."
"In that case, I shall spar with you."
The old monk, seeing Ding Ling’s resolved intention, knew refusal was futile, thus said:
"Let’s wait a bit, then spar in a secluded place. I prefer not to create too much noise leading to widespread notice."
"Naturally, I follow Senior’s guidance."
"Your Majesty esteemed as the most exalted royalty, I am merely a nameless old monk. Why does Your Majesty show such courtesy and respect? Just call me Sweeping Monk."
"Courtesy cannot be abandoned."
By saying this.
The old monk’s eyes showed a trace of kindness and emotion, evidently raising his approval of Ding Ling.
As he said.

Ding Ling, as the emperor of the Great Ming Kingdom, held an exalted position, could determine the fate of families with a word, such a figure was unexpectedly modest, gentle, and courteous, which the old monk hadn’t anticipated.
He and Ding Ling then started discussing Buddhist Techniques.
The old monk was extremely shocked that Ding Ling’s depth in Buddhist Study was something he couldn’t match.
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: You gained the high recognition of the Shaolin Temple’s Sweeping Monk (Li Canghai).]

[Note: The Sweeping Monk (Li Canghai) is proficient in Makeup Skill, Turtle Breath Skill, Bone Shrinking Skill, Vocalization Skill, Small Faceless Skill, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic... She has hidden in Shaolin Temple for forty-two years, always observing the world with a peaceful and indifferent mindset.
No person, nor any event has ever disturbed her inner peace.
She had intended to continue hiding and bring this life to an end.
Unexpectedly, she met you.
Your immense talent, versatility, profound Buddhist knowledge left her stunned, shocked, and in admiration.
Amazed that such a remarkable young man exists in this world.
She originally thought the world couldn’t possibly produce another figure as talented and accomplished as her mentor, Master Xiaoyao.
Yet, your talent undeniably surpasses that of her mentor!
Reaching an unprecedented new realm.
She is exceedingly impressed and greatly admires and acknowledges you.]
A notification sound suddenly rang after conversing with the Sweeping Monk for several hours.
