The old monk asked:
"The moment you set foot into the Scripture Pavilion, you noticed something peculiar about me, didn’t you?"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling candidly replied:
"Junior came primarily for Senior."
"Your Majesty, burdened with overwhelming affairs, forsake this vast kingdom, came to this Scripture Pavilion specifically to read for a whole day.
It puzzles me greatly."
The old monk continued to display a calm demeanor:
"I wonder what brought Your Majesty here?"
"I wish to spar with Senior a bit."
"Is that all?"
"Indeed."
"Then I concede.
The old monk stood seven feet tall, straightened his posture, slightly raising his head to observe Ding Ling, smiling kindly:
"Your Majesty possesses a talent beyond compare, astounding throughout ages.
Enough to leave anyone in awe and admiration.
I am no exception.
Your Majesty, over a day’s time, I observed everything you’ve done.
I saw it with my own eyes.
Learning various Divine Skill Secret Manuals instantly.
Such skill and capability, I have never seen or heard of before.
Leafing through ancient history, one rarely finds a person with unmatched talent like Your Majesty.
I am just a mere Sweeping Monk.
How then could I dare spar with someone as noble and supreme as Your Majesty?"
"I didn’t expect Senior to have such a silver tongue, flattering Junior."
"This is not flattery."
The old monk shook his head, solemnly stated:
"I am merely stating a fact."
He expressed admiration:
"Your Majesty’s rising Buddha Qi and mystical aura have increased tremendously within a short day.
Even if I were to flatter, I couldn’t catch up; what capability do I have to compete with Your Majesty?"
"Senior, don’t belittle yourself.
We’re merely exchanging skills; I hope you won’t decline."
"In that case, I shall spar with you."
The old monk, seeing Ding Ling’s resolved intention, knew refusal was futile, thus said:
"Let’s wait a bit, then spar in a secluded place.
I prefer not to create too much noise leading to widespread notice."
"Naturally, I follow Senior’s guidance."
"Your Majesty esteemed as the most exalted royalty, I am merely a nameless old monk.
Why does Your Majesty show such courtesy and respect?
Just call me Sweeping Monk."
"Courtesy cannot be abandoned."
By saying this.
The old monk’s eyes showed a trace of kindness and emotion, evidently raising his approval of Ding Ling.
As he said.

Ding Ling, as the emperor of the Great Ming Kingdom, held an exalted position, could determine the fate of families with a word, such a figure was unexpectedly modest, gentle, and courteous, which the old monk hadn’t anticipated.
He and Ding Ling then started discussing Buddhist Techniques.
The old monk was extremely shocked that Ding Ling’s depth in Buddhist Study was something he couldn’t match.
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: You gained the high recognition of the Shaolin Temple’s Sweeping Monk (Li Canghai).]
[Note: The Sweeping Monk (Li Canghai) is proficient in Makeup Skill, Turtle Breath Skill, Bone Shrinking Skill, Vocalization Skill, Small Faceless Skill, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic...
She has hidden in Shaolin Temple for forty-two years, always observing the world with a peaceful and indifferent mindset.
No person, nor any event has ever disturbed her inner peace.
She had intended to continue hiding and bring this life to an end.
Unexpectedly, she met you.
Your immense talent, versatility, profound Buddhist knowledge left her stunned, shocked, and in admiration.
Amazed that such a remarkable young man exists in this world.
She originally thought the world couldn’t possibly produce another figure as talented and accomplished as her mentor, Master Xiaoyao.
Yet, your talent undeniably surpasses that of her mentor!
Reaching an unprecedented new realm.
She is exceedingly impressed and greatly admires and acknowledges you.]
A notification sound suddenly rang after conversing with the Sweeping Monk for several hours.

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 550: Li Canghai
paragraphs: Ding Ling was taken aback.
He never expected that the Sweeping Monk in the Scripture Pavilion of Shaolin Temple was actually Li Canghai!
Li Canghai, the youngest disciple of Master Xiaoyao.
She was the little junior sister of Heavenly Mountain Granny Wu Xingyun, Wuya Zi, and Li Qiushui!
How could she possibly be hiding in Shaolin Temple?!
However, upon closer thought, it seemed reasonable.
The Sweeping Monk had been in Shaolin Temple for forty-two years.

It was exactly the time when Wuya Zi and Li Qiushui fell in love and married. Although Wuya Zi married Li Qiushui and had a daughter named Li Qingluo, it seemed he still couldn’t forget Li Canghai, as evidenced by the jade statues he carved and the portraits he painted, all in the image of Li Canghai.
It seemed that Li Canghai surely didn’t want to get involved in such a love triangle, so she simply distanced herself from Wuya Zi and Li Qiushui, leading a secluded life.
However, Wuya Zi was highly skilled and would surely find the reclusive Li Canghai.
But how could she make Wuya Zi unable to find her?
Through the use of Makeup Skill and Disguise Skill, and then changing her physique with Bone Shrinking Skill, she entered Shaolin Temple and became a ’male monk!’
No matter how great Wuya Zi’s abilities, it would be difficult to find a person like Li Canghai, even if the sky broke open.
Even Ding Ling himself.
If it weren’t for the sudden prompt sound reminding him.
He also couldn’t see that the Sweeping Monk in front of him was a woman!
This shows that her disguise and evasion skills had reached the pinnacle level! Even Ding Ling, with his Full-Level Observing People Skill and acting skills, couldn’t see through the disguise!
Such ability.
Is imaginable!
Wuya Zi may not have considered that Li Canghai would hide in this Shaolin Temple, and even if he did, it would be difficult to recognize her in person.
"It’s actually Li Canghai. I wonder if her appearance is truly identical to Li Qiushui."
’Clearly with the same looks and physique, why would Wuya Zi always remember Li Canghai?’
In the process of Ding Ling interacting and chatting with the Sweeping Monk Li Canghai, he gradually gained insight.
Li Canghai was tranquil and indifferent, unconcerned with worldly affairs, extremely gentle, and low-key, truly achieving a state of blending in without showing any sharpness, to the utmost degree.
In contrast, Li Qiushui was charming and enchanting, ruthless, and scheming, which was a world of difference!
Interacting and communicating with her was very pleasant, always making people feel warm and gentle.
With Li Qiushui, it was different; one was always tense and could easily get into arguments if slightly displeased.
"So that’s how it is."
Ding Ling was relieved.
"What is it?"
Li Canghai was puzzled and confused:
"I wonder what Your Majesty has figured out?"
"I’ve figured out some matters of human nature.
Ding Ling stood up and said:
"Senior, it’s getting late, why don’t we move outside for some sparring?"
Concerning task 2.
Of course, Ding Ling wouldn’t ignore it and give up.
This is also because the Sweeping Monk is the number one in the world.
If it were the elusive Zuo Ci from the Three Kingdoms World, Ding Ling figures he would be at a loss again.
To find the Sweeping Monk so smoothly.
Ding Ling could only say: ’Li Canghai truly deserves to contend with Little Dragon Girl as a super recluse!!’
Hiding in the Scripture Pavilion and sweeping for forty-two years!
Is this something an ordinary person can achieve?
Calling either Little Dragon Girl or Li Canghai a recluse is an understatement!
Thinking of Little Dragon Girl, Ding Ling felt warmth, and his attitude towards Li Canghai became somewhat kinder.

Li Canghai noticed, and became increasingly perplexed and confused; she instinctively suspected she had given herself away, but upon sensing her entire self carefully, finding nothing wrong, she relaxed her doubts, thinking:

"I have been in seclusion at Shaolin Temple for a full forty-two years. During which, my Disguise Skill, Makeup Skill, and As You Wish Bone Shrinking Skill reached the Great Perfection Realm, even acquaintances can’t see through my disguise.
Ding Ling is meeting me for the first time. How could he know who I am? How could he possibly see through my disguise?"
Thinking this way.
Li Canghai’s mind was settled, and she also stood up and said:
"Let’s do as Your Majesty says."
The two immediately left the Scripture Pavilion.
Ding Ling performed Soaring in the Void, with invisible waves of wind rising beneath his feet, lifting him to float up.
Li Canghai’s heart quivered at the sight, very shaken, is this Soaring in the Void?!
She was shocked:
"Isn’t the threshold for Soaring in the Void at least the Middle Tier Grandmaster level?! Thus, doesn’t that mean Ding Ling’s cultivation is at least above the Middle Tier Grandmaster level?!"
Li Canghai was moved.

But recalling Ding Ling’s methods of defeating the Four Kingdoms, she was relieved. Only with high cultivation paired with extraordinary lightweight and martial arts skills could one easily crush the Four Kingdoms like that.

To avoid revealing herself, she used Shaolin Temple’s ’Dragonfly Water-landing Lightness Skill,’ with her extremely high cultivation, proficient in most of Shaolin Temple’s skills, her power reached the Transformation Realm. Even with such an ordinary Lightweight Ascension Technique, she effortlessly caught up with Ding Ling with a speed as swift as the wind.
Ding Ling noticed, and slightly increased his speed.
Li Canghai kept pace.
This pace quickened three times.
Li Canghai couldn’t catch up, only then did Ding Ling slow his flying speed.
Li Canghai, seeing this, marveled deeply. With Ding Ling intentionally holding back so much, she still couldn’t catch up—considering Ding Ling’s young age, her admiration grew.
She felt that if her master were alive, seeing this child Ding Ling would no doubt be overjoyed, exclaiming that there’s someone to carry on!
Whoosh, whoosh!
Ding Ling and Li Canghai, one in front and one behind, soared out of Shaolin Temple, reaching a dense forest over ten miles away.
Under the moonlit night.
The clear moonlight, like cold water, spilled over the two, making them, standing atop tree tips, appear more and more transcendent and out-of-this-world.
After greeting each other, they began to spar and compete.
Both started off using Shaolin Temple’s Seventy-Two Skills.
Sometime Dorayaki, with piercing Vigorous Qi, penetrated the void, seemingly able to shatter the Void Nether.
In another moment, the Great Vajra Palm collided in the void, producing a loud booming sound.
At times, the Divine Palm Eight Strikes clashed back and forth, palm shadows filled the air, with continuous banging sounds.
The duo fought from tree tops to the ground.
Very tacitly, they simultaneously executed Shaolin Flower-Scattering Palm, —boom!—Amidst the flying flower petals, spiral qi entwined, collided, and dissipated in the void.

The two exchanged quick strikes, Prajna Divine Palm, Dragon Spin Palm, Tornado Palm, Golden Dragon Hand, Thousand-Pound Foot, Meteor Leg, Bright Fist, various Shaolin supreme skills, effortlessly wielded, each at the pinnacle, stirring the void with loud resounding forces!
Wherever they passed.
Flowers and leaves danced.
Tall trees swayed.
Like two Martial Gods in intense combat.
In less than half a moment they fought.
Li Canghai suddenly floated back three meters, folded her palms together, and said:
"The old monk has exhausted all skills and techniques, yet is far from being your match, Your Majesty... you held back too much."
She let out a long sigh, and said, "Let’s end our sparring here. I concede."
[1: Defeat over 20 Plane World experts: 114/20.],
from 113 increased to 114.
[2, You must defeat the strongest in the Plane. Prove that you are truly the World’s Number One. Progress 100%]
[Congratulations player Ding Ling, you have completed all tasks of the Path of the Glory War God!]
[Task Overachieved! Would you like to redeem the Glory Medal now? Proceed to an even higher Martial Hero Plane World?]
Ding Ling glanced at his Character Panel.
Sure enough, the task was completed.
But now was clearly not the right time for redemption.
He hadn’t finished reading the books in the Imperial Study.
Leaving like this.
Would be too wasteful.

Why did he become Emperor? Wasn’t it to gather all the secret manuals of the world for his own use? Now the secret manuals from small countries like Dali Kingdom are also being continuously sent to Luoyang.
How could Ding Ling leave now?
To leave.
Would be after finishing reading the secret manuals.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - 551: Master Xiaoyao’s Whereabouts
paragraphs: Thinking thus.
Ding Ling glanced at Li Canghai and suddenly said:
"Senior, are you Li Canghai?"
This question was asked so unexpectedly.
Li Canghai, already somewhat unsettled by Ding Ling’s overt actions, was taken aback by such a direct question, showing clear astonishment on her face!
But she was remarkable and quickly regained her composure, clasped her hands together, and said:
"Amitabha Buddha. The old monk cannot understand what Your Majesty is saying. I originally have no name. It is not Li Canghai."
"Senior, does your master Master Xiaoyao not know where you are nowadays?"
"Your Majesty, I do not understand what you are saying."
After recovering her calmness, Li Canghai’s face resumed its serene and tranquil state:
"Your Majesty, our sparring is now over. Let us part ways here."
After saying this.
She turned and walked away.
"Senior, are you aware that Wuya Zi is already dead?"
Upon hearing Ding Ling’s words.

Li Canghai’s body visibly trembled for a moment but soon returned to normal. She merely sighed deeply, seemingly aware that she had revealed herself several times and feared it was impossible to deceive Ding Ling any longer. She turned back to look at Ding Ling:
"Your Majesty, how did you come to know of my true identity?"
Under the clear glow of the crescent moon, Li Canghai’s face remained full of wrinkles, but her originally murky eyes now shone brightly, resembling the bright moon in the sky, dazzlingly beautiful.
She was still dressed in a blue robe, but somehow her physique seemed to have completely transformed, becoming graceful and charming!
Ding Ling was momentarily lost, then woke up and said:
"I am an alien. What’s strange about knowing?"
The contrast between the Sweeping Monk’s previous and current aura, gaze, and figure was too great.
It was a 180-degree unbelievable transformation.
Even Ding Ling, who had seen countless beauties, was momentarily dumbfounded by her sudden change.
"This isn’t right."
Li Canghai shook her head and said:

"There are too many aliens coming to Shaolin Temple to learn martial arts. Many often come to the Scripture Pavilion on the pretext of finding me, but no one calls me Li Canghai. I’ve never heard anyone discuss this name. Why is it only you who knows?"
"I am special."
Li Canghai was taken aback, pondering, and indeed it made sense.
Ding Ling was truly extraordinary.
Whether in martial arts cultivation, talent, disposition, status, or power, he was unmatched by other aliens.
The combined strength of all the aliens in this world was likely not enough to rival Ding Ling alone!
Not only was he special, but legendary!
Thinking thus.
Li Canghai reconciled, saying:
"It seems Your Majesty’s source of information is beyond my imagination. I am impressed."
She no longer referred to herself as the old monk.
Ding Ling seized the chance to ask:
"Do you know where your esteemed master is?"
"I do not know either."
Li Canghai shook her head with a look of melancholy:
"Master is cultivating the ’Eternal Youth Technique.’ This martial art is supreme and extremely difficult to learn. Neither my senior sister, senior brother, nor I could master it.
Master divided this martial art into three parts, namely Small Faceless Skill, North Nether Divine Skill, Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme.

All three martial arts can be considered parts of the ’Eternal Youth Technique’; in some sense, they all can be called the ’Eternal Youth Technique.’ Upon great success, they all grant eternal youth. The Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme grants perpetual youth more evidently, but it is also the most challenging to train..."
Li Canghai did not conceal anything from Ding Ling and slowly recounted some tales about Master Xiaoyao.
Master Xiaoyao sought across the Jiuzhou World, finding several extremely talented disciples for Wuya Zi, but none could inherit the strongest ultimate skill, the ’Eternal Youth Technique.’
She had to select some essence from this supreme skill and turn it into a single martial art, doing so thrice, resulting in three divine skills like the North Nether Divine Skill.
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling couldn’t help but be moved.
He thought to himself:
"Now that all three divine skills have reached great perfection in me, doesn’t that mean that with the right opportunity, I could smoothly cultivate the ’Eternal Youth Technique’?"
But where is that opportunity?
Ding Ling continued listening to Li Canghai.
Li Canghai, Wu Xingyun, and Li Qiushui were three women who spent most of their time together with Wuya Zi.
The four had different personalities.
But the attraction between men and women.
Over time, it naturally led to some love and enmity.
Li Canghai’s temperament was as calm as water, not fond of competing, and chose to withdraw voluntarily.
But no matter where she retreated.
Wuya Zi could always find her.

Li Canghai didn’t want her older sister Li Qiushui to know and subsequently ruin their relationship, so she used disguise skill, makeup skill, and bone shrinking skill to hide in the Shaolin Scripture Pavilion.
There she remained.
For forty-two years.

At first, she ventured outside a few times, knowing that Wuya Zi and the others had a daughter and were living well, she gave up the notion of going out altogether, staying at Shaolin Temple, preparing to spend her days in solitude.
During this period, out of boredom, she learned the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills and other divine skill secret manuals.
Due to her extraordinary talent, before she knew it, each divine skill was mastered by her, and her cultivation astonishingly reached the middle tier grandmaster level.
Approaching high tier grandmaster level was within her reach.
As for her master Xiaoyao?
After teaching all,
he drifted away.
Saying he went to seek the Immortal Dao.
And from then, never returned!

After listening to Li Canghai’s account, Ding Ling mentioned he had learned the three techniques: North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, and Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme.
Li Canghai was startled and amazed, asking Ding Ling to demonstrate.
Ding Ling performed according to her wish for a while.
Li Canghai, greatly moved, murmured:

"If the master was still here and saw someone could, at a young age, consecutively train these three divine skills to a state of great perfection, he would surely be excited and ecstatic beyond measure."
She gazed deeply at Ding Ling and said:

"Before leaving, the master said that if any of us learned the three divine skills, we should go to Dali Eternal Spring Valley. There, we would naturally find the opportunity for these three techniques to merge."
"Thank you."
Ding Ling did not expect Li Canghai to see through his thoughts so easily, and he promptly expressed his gratitude solemnly.
Li Canghai waved her hand, saying:
"Your Majesty is the esteemed one, this world is all yours. Yet you treat me with such respect, and I merely disclosed some unimportant information."
She sighed deeply:

"Moreover, if the master knew that Your Majesty could cultivate all three divine skills, he would indeed have you visit Dali Eternal Spring Valley immediately. I merely did what little should be done."
Li Canghai was so considerate and magnanimous.
Ding Ling admired it:
"Senior, do you know what you plan to do next?"
"I do not know either."
Li Canghai felt at a loss:
"Now that my identity has been revealed by you, there is really no need for me to stay at Shaolin Temple."

Why is it only you who knows?"
"I am special."
Li Canghai was taken aback, pondering, and indeed it made sense.
Ding Ling was truly extraordinary.
Whether in martial arts cultivation, talent, disposition, status, or power, he was unmatched by other aliens.
The combined strength of all the aliens in this world was likely not enough to rival Ding Ling alone!
Not only was he special, but legendary!
Thinking thus.
Li Canghai reconciled, saying:
"It seems Your Majesty’s source of information is beyond my imagination.
I am impressed."
She no longer referred to herself as the old monk.
Ding Ling seized the chance to ask:
"Do you know where your esteemed master is?"
"I do not know either."
Li Canghai shook her head with a look of melancholy:
"Master is cultivating the ’Eternal Youth Technique.’ This martial art is supreme and extremely difficult to learn.
Neither my senior sister, senior brother, nor I could master it.
Master divided this martial art into three parts, namely Small Faceless Skill, North Nether Divine Skill, Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme.
All three martial arts can be considered parts of the ’Eternal Youth Technique’; in some sense, they all can be called the ’Eternal Youth Technique.’ Upon great success, they all grant eternal youth.
The Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme grants perpetual youth more evidently, but it is also the most challenging to train..."
Li Canghai did not conceal anything from Ding Ling and slowly recounted some tales about Master Xiaoyao.
Master Xiaoyao sought across the Jiuzhou World, finding several extremely talented disciples for Wuya Zi, but none could inherit the strongest ultimate skill, the ’Eternal Youth Technique.’
She had to select some essence from this supreme skill and turn it into a single martial art, doing so thrice, resulting in three divine skills like the North Nether Divine Skill.
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling couldn’t help but be moved.
He thought to himself:
"Now that all three divine skills have reached great perfection in me, doesn’t that mean that with the right opportunity, I could smoothly cultivate the ’Eternal Youth Technique’?"
But where is that opportunity?
Ding Ling continued listening to Li Canghai.
Li Canghai, Wu Xingyun, and Li Qiushui were three women who spent most of their time together with Wuya Zi.
The four had different personalities.
But the attraction between men and women.
Over time, it naturally led to some love and enmity.
Li Canghai’s temperament was as calm as water, not fond of competing, and chose to withdraw voluntarily.
But no matter where she retreated.
Wuya Zi could always find her.

Li Canghai didn’t want her older sister Li Qiushui to know and subsequently ruin their relationship, so she used disguise skill, makeup skill, and bone shrinking skill to hide in the Shaolin Scripture Pavilion.
There she remained.
For forty-two years.

At first, she ventured outside a few times, knowing that Wuya Zi and the others had a daughter and were living well, she gave up the notion of going out altogether, staying at Shaolin Temple, preparing to spend her days in solitude.
During this period, out of boredom, she learned the Seventy-Two Shaolin Temple Skills and other divine skill secret manuals.
Due to her extraordinary talent, before she knew it, each divine skill was mastered by her, and her cultivation astonishingly reached the middle tier grandmaster level.
Approaching high tier grandmaster level was within her reach.
As for her master Xiaoyao?
After teaching all,
he drifted away.
Saying he went to seek the Immortal Dao.
And from then, never returned!

After listening to Li Canghai’s account, Ding Ling mentioned he had learned the three techniques: North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, and Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme.
Li Canghai was startled and amazed, asking Ding Ling to demonstrate.
Ding Ling performed according to her wish for a while.
Li Canghai, greatly moved, murmured:

"If the master was still here and saw someone could, at a young age, consecutively train these three divine skills to a state of great perfection, he would surely be excited and ecstatic beyond measure."
She gazed deeply at Ding Ling and said:
"Before leaving, the master said that if any of us learned the three divine skills, we should go to Dali Eternal Spring Valley.
There, we would naturally find the opportunity for these three techniques to merge."
"Thank you."
Ding Ling did not expect Li Canghai to see through his thoughts so easily, and he promptly expressed his gratitude solemnly.
Li Canghai waved her hand, saying:
"Your Majesty is the esteemed one, this world is all yours.
Yet you treat me with such respect, and I merely disclosed some unimportant information."
She sighed deeply:
"Moreover, if the master knew that Your Majesty could cultivate all three divine skills, he would indeed have you visit Dali Eternal Spring Valley immediately.
I merely did what little should be done."
Li Canghai was so considerate and magnanimous.
Ding Ling admired it:
"Senior, do you know what you plan to do next?"
"I do not know either."
Li Canghai felt at a loss:
"Now that my identity has been revealed by you, there is really no need for me to stay at Shaolin Temple."

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 552: Xuzhwu
paragraphs: Ding Ling was embarrassed:
"Senior..."
"Hehe."
Li Canghai, relaxed and at ease, smiled:
"You don’t need to be like this. Even without you, I would have eventually left the Shaolin Temple to take one last look at my senior brother and sister. It’s just a pity..."
She shook her head, seemingly regretful.
She then asked Ding Ling about Wu Xingyun and the others.
Ding Ling told her honestly.
Upon learning about Wuya Zi and Li Qiushui’s deeds.
Li Canghai sighed, not blaming Ding Ling, only saying:
"It’s unexpected that my senior brother would end up in such a state. You killed Ding Chunqiu, avenging him greatly. I think if he knew from the underworld, he would find peace.
As for my sister..."
Her expression was complex:

"I’m well aware of her personality; it’s normal for you, as an emperor, to dislike such a person. You didn’t kill her directly, just left her on Illusory Peak to fend for herself, which is already the best outcome for her."
Speaking of this.
She solemnly presented a salute to Ding Ling;

"Thank you, Your Majesty, for avenging my senior brother’s great enmity. And thank you, Your Majesty, for your softened heart at the end, allowing my sister to live out her days naturally, letting her go with some dignity."
She understood Wu Xingyun.
Although she hated Li Qiushui intensely, wishing to dismember her.
If Li Qiushui were truly powerless, and they met, Wu Xingyun might choose to let her die with some dignity.
Ding Ling was unaware of this, but seeing Li Canghai’s attitude, felt quite conflicted. But thinking of the Dali Eternal Spring Valley, Ding Ling felt stirred and said:
"If Senior doesn’t mind, you could accompany me to the Dali Eternal Spring Valley. Perhaps there you might find traces of your master, Master Xiaoyao."
Upon hearing this, Li Canghai said:
"Alright. With the influx of Aliens, the Shaolin Temple is no longer peaceful. I might as well take this opportunity to leave."
Even without Ding Ling.
Whether or not it was to take one last look at her senior brother and sister.
Or to avoid the endless Aliens near the Scripture Pavilion searching for her.
Li Canghai couldn’t stay long at the Shaolin Temple.

Staying at the Shaolin Temple before without leaving, partly because it wasn’t appropriate to leave for no reason, and partly due to the inertia of life, having lived there for forty-two years, having developed feelings for the Scripture Pavilion, without a suitable excuse or opportunity, in a complex state of mind, not leaving was quite normal.
Ding Ling’s clarity.
Immediately prompted her to consider leaving the Shaolin Temple.
At this moment, after agreeing to go with Ding Ling.
Li Canghai tore off the mask on her face, and simultaneously, her form and appearance quickly transformed.
Her previously emaciated frame, with barely any flesh, filled out.
In just a few breaths.
The former old monk transformed into a peerlessly beautiful woman, stunning and independent!

She stood in the moonlight, like Chang’e descending from the moon, with a gentle and charming demeanor, graceful and elegant. She glanced at Ding Ling, smiling faintly, a dimple appearing at the corner of her lips.
With this smile, Ding Ling felt as if his vision brightened, as if her smile caused countless flowers to bloom, turning the dark night into dawn, brilliantly magnificent.
"The women of Senior’s family truly all look alike."
Ding Ling, shocked, couldn’t help but exclaim.
If there’s anything distinguishing Li Canghai from Li Qiushui.
It’s that one has a dimple, the other doesn’t.
One has a beauty mark by her right eye, the other doesn’t.
Otherwise, they look exactly the same!
"Ever since I can remember, my mother used to tell me that the girls in our bloodline are all like this. But I don’t know why."
Li Canghai glanced at Ding Ling:
"Your Majesty, when do you plan to go to the Dali Eternal Spring Valley?"
Even Li Canghai didn’t know.
It seems the mystery of this bloodline is hard to truly resolve.
Ding Ling didn’t delve deeper, only mentioning that he must stay in Luoyang for a while first.
He solemnly invited Li Canghai to accompany him.
Li Canghai had no objections.
For her, she was already a person without a home; she could go anywhere in the vast territories of Jiuzhou.
They didn’t return to the Shaolin Temple anymore.
As they passed by the gate of the Shaolin Temple, Ding Ling saw a young, dazed, expressionless monk sitting on a stone step, looking up at the bright moon.
He had thick eyebrows, big eyes, upturned nostrils, prominent ears, and thick lips, an unattractive monk.
As Ding Ling passed by, a casual glance met the monk’s gaze.
The monk was startled and quickly stood up to pay respects.

Ding Ling smiled and walked alongside Li Canghai, his steps executing Ripple Step continuously, appearing slow but swift, like a wisp of smoke disappearing into the vast forest in just a blink, vanishing from sight.
The monk watched in shock and awe.
At this moment, Xuan Ji ran out from the temple. Seeing the monk, he said:
"Xuzhu, did you see the Emperor of the Great Ming?"
"Emperor of the Great Ming?"
Xuzhu was puzzled.
Xuan Ji explained carefully.
Xuzhu suddenly understood and pointed ahead:
"The emperor left gracefully with an extremely beautiful woman. They seemed shrouded in moonlight, and at a glance, I thought they were celestial companions walking on the moon."
"An extremely beautiful woman..."
Xuan Ji couldn’t make heads or tails of it.
Unsure of how Ding Ling, out for the night, got involved with a beauty!
Yet someone reported Ding Ling missing from the Scripture Pavilion.

Xuan Ji, fearing an accident, immediately sent people to search everywhere, even rushing outside the Shaolin Temple himself to see if there was news. Unexpectedly, he found useful information with Xuzhu.
Though perplexed,
Ding Ling had left.
Xuan Ji sighed with relief.
During Ding Ling’s stay here, he felt as if a mountain weighed down the Shaolin Temple, so oppressive that he dared not breathe deeply.
With his departure.
He felt invigorated, refreshed, surprisingly clear-minded and euphoric, even finding Xuzhu more pleasing to the eye:
"Xuzhu, why are you here at night instead of sleeping?"
"I miss my parents."
Xuzhu, innocent and straightforward, spoke honestly:
"I heard people say the deceased turn into stars in the sky. I want to stay and watch the stars, so they can get a good look at me too."
Xuan Ji, hearing this, was momentarily stunned, overwhelmed by a pang of bitterness.
He let out a long sigh, gazing at the bright moon and sparse stars, thinking:
"Abbot, if you have insight from the heavens, may you bless him."
Ding Ling returned with Li Canghai to the Imperial Study of the Luoyang Imperial Palace.
Soon after.
Li Qinglu hurried over.
Even at night, she could so accurately obtain Ding Ling’s whereabouts, one wonders how her maid manages to stay awake twenty-four hours a day!
"Your Majesty."
Li Qinglu arrived excitedly:
"It’s late today, would you come to my place? I will certainly take good care of you..."

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 553: Imperial Study
paragraphs: Li Qinglu hadn’t finished speaking.
Suddenly, she saw Li Canghai, and was taken aback, the words she was about to say swallowed back instantly.
She looked at Li Canghai with some surprise, confusion, and bewilderment.
"Who is she?!"
Li Canghai was also quite astonished.
She was a super homebody.
Never would she actively seek out information.
Therefore, although she learned a lot of secrets and big matters from the monks of Shaolin Temple and the alien.
It was all passively received.
So most of the information she was unaware of.
She only knew about some earth-shattering events, such as the establishment of the Great Ming Kingdom, how Ding Ling broke through the four great nations, and what Ding Ling looked like.
These were spread the widest.
Almost everyone at Shaolin Temple knew them.
She often heard, so naturally she knew.
But concerning Li Qinglu, she was completely in the dark and clueless.
Ding Ling introduced the two women to each other.
Li Qinglu was astounded, never expecting her grandmother to have a sister!
Li Canghai was equally surprised, she actually turned out to be related to Ding Ling?!
"So we’re all family now?"
Li Canghai muttered to herself.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling said with a smile:
"From now on, Senior will truly be my elder."
Li Canghai came to her senses, smiled a bit awkwardly, and finding herself suddenly gaining a granddaughter and grandson-in-law, it took her some time to adjust.

But she is a gentle and kind-hearted person, peaceful and contemplative, her thoughts only scrambled for a moment before she calmed down, and started conversing naturally with Ding Ling and Li Qinglu.
Knowing the excellent treatment Li Qinglu received in the palace, and Ding Ling not being too harsh on Li Qiushui’s descendants, Li Canghai’s heart sighed.
Then she didn’t think about these matters anymore.
The past was gone.
Since her senior brother and sister are no longer around.
Naturally, she no longer needs to hide from them, and from then on she could be herself.
Li Canghai thought clearly, and her eyes became clearer and brighter.
Next day.
The fourth batch of books filled the shelves of the Imperial Study.
Ding Ling began to peruse them again.
Li Qinglu, Li Canghai, Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing, Qin Hongmian, Gan Baby accompanied.

Duan Zhengchun also wanted to come, but Dao Baifeng, Azi, and others were difficult to attend to, so thinking Ding Ling might be too busy meeting too many people at once, he decided to delay the meeting.
Ding Ling didn’t particularly entertain Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian, his two mothers-in-law.
He only chatted politely with them for a while before letting them be free.
He then went to read books alone.
It took over a day again.
Buddha Qi increased.
[Wisdom +0.2]
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body progress 37%]
Vast Righteous Qi still hadn’t improved.
It’s said that nurturing a Vast Qi is as difficult as climbing to the heavens.
As for the Dao Scripture?
He read a lot, but mostly related to increasing wisdom and foundation.
No Dao Qi was generated.
Perhaps it’s due to insufficient foundation and having read too few Dao Scriptures, or something else?
Ding Ling didn’t delve too much into it.
After finishing reading these secret manuals, he had them carried out and new ones brought in.

With more minor countries submitting to the Great Ming Kingdom, these countries’ secret manuals are continuously being sent over, much faster than before, and the accumulation pace in the Imperial Study has increased quite a bit.
It shouldn’t take long.
The fifth batch of secret manuals might be able to fill it up again.
Li Canghai watched, amazed, deeply understanding why Ding Ling is called the All-Powerful Emperor.
Gan Baby, Qin Hongmian, and even Duan Zhengchun, Duan Zhengming, who couldn’t resist coming to visit, were stunned by Ding Ling’s reading and martial arts practice speed, overwhelmed with shock.
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Li Canghai’s high admiration.]
[Note: Your talent and ability once again drew Li Canghai’s attention and admiration.]
Last time, he earned an E-grade from Li Canghai.
This time earned a standard one.
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Gan Baby’s deep admiration]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Qin Hongmian’s deep admiration]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Duan Zhengchun’s high respect]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Duan Zhengming’s high respect]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Azhu’s deep recognition]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Azi’s high recognition.]
[Note: Azhu and Azi were already highly recognizing you, but witnessing your martial arts and reading speed again, they are further astonished by your divine nature!]
Earned fifteen achievement medals in one go.
Besides the aforementioned, there were Chuu Wanli, the Four Great Guards, and Duan Zhengming’s whole family.

Ding Ling was quite surprised too, finishing reading and earning so many achievement medals at once, apparently Duan Zhengming, Duan Zhengchun, and others were already in awe of him, having witnessed and interacted now, quickly stirred feelings of respect and admiration.
With one thought, Ding Ling figured it out.
But he didn’t intend to converse much with Duan Zhengchun, only exchanged a few casual words and went to handle the accumulating court affairs.
Li Canghai and Li Qinglu, for the sake of discretion, each covered their faces lightly with veils, and upon seeing Ding Ling leave, naturally followed him.
Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing followed closely behind.
Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian saw this and didn’t trail after, just exchanged glances, seeing the contentment and excitement in each other’s eyes.

Ding Ling was indeed as Zhong Ling and the others said, remarkable without exception, exceedingly handsome, noble, overbearing, and sacred in demeanor, attentively caring and protecting Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing, and highly esteemed towards them.
What could they be dissatisfied with?
Compared with Duan Zhengchun.
Ding Ling truly held a sense of responsibility.
As emperor of a superpower!
Venerable upon the throne!
Only had three beauties in his harem!
Whereas Duan Zhengchun?
The more Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian thought, the angrier they got, naturally finding themselves displeased and displeased with Duan Zhengchun.
Comparison is the fear.
Previously nothing seemed wrong, perhaps Duan Zhengchun had troubles.
But now, comparing him with Ding Ling, Duan Zhengchun seemed nothing!

Duan Zhengchun saw and couldn’t help secretly lamenting, thinking dear son-in-law, you’ve really given me a big challenge. When will you give me a True Scripture, so I might learn how your harem beauties harmoniously coexist?
Ding Ling stayed in Luoyang for over half a month.
Read five batches of books again.
After finishing the five batches.
[Wisdom +0.5]
Yet towards the end, the growth slowed significantly, almost stagnating on the last batch.
It shows the secret manuals in this world have provided Ding Ling’s wisdom attribute with a certain limit, only acquiring higher-level secret manuals might enable wisdom to grow further.
But in this world, Dao Scriptures, Buddhist Scriptures, Confucian School teachings, Military and Legal Schools philosophies have all been mostly read by Ding Ling.
Hoping for further increase, is nearly impossible.
Buddha Qi increased significantly again.
Vast Righteous Qi still hadn’t improved.
It shows that only by accumulating a deep enough foundation, Vast Righteous Qi will increase another layer.
Regarding Dao Qi?
No trace of it still.
Estimate probably due to insufficient foundation, perhaps after maxing out Dao Scriptures, all points got allocated to wisdom and such?
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body 48%]
Increased by 11 percentage points.
Provided about 2 percentage points per batch on average.
And after reading 9 batches of books continuously.
The secret manuals of this world were basically all browsed by Ding Ling, with some still arriving through martial arts masters or urgent deliveries.
But trying to fill the Imperial Study again won’t be easy.
With luck, it could take ten days or half a month.
During this time.
Ding Ling planned with Li Canghai to visit Dali Eternal Spring Valley.
Li Canghai stayed in the Imperial Palace for a long time.
Daily at the harem, growing closer with Li Qinglu, Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing, and others.
Zhong Ling and the others sought her martial arts instruction.
She didn’t spare guidance, intricately explaining Martial Dao principles.

She mastered North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Seventy-Two Shaolin Skills, Carefree Sect’s Secret Skill, etc., simply imparting to the young women was straightforward.

[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body progress 37%]
Vast Righteous Qi still hadn’t improved.
It’s said that nurturing a Vast Qi is as difficult as climbing to the heavens.
As for the Dao Scripture?
He read a lot, but mostly related to increasing wisdom and foundation.
No Dao Qi was generated.
Perhaps it’s due to insufficient foundation and having read too few Dao Scriptures, or something else?
Ding Ling didn’t delve too much into it.
After finishing reading these secret manuals, he had them carried out and new ones brought in.

With more minor countries submitting to the Great Ming Kingdom, these countries’ secret manuals are continuously being sent over, much faster than before, and the accumulation pace in the Imperial Study has increased quite a bit.
It shouldn’t take long.
The fifth batch of secret manuals might be able to fill it up again.
Li Canghai watched, amazed, deeply understanding why Ding Ling is called the All-Powerful Emperor.
Gan Baby, Qin Hongmian, and even Duan Zhengchun, Duan Zhengming, who couldn’t resist coming to visit, were stunned by Ding Ling’s reading and martial arts practice speed, overwhelmed with shock.
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Li Canghai’s high admiration.]
[Note: Your talent and ability once again drew Li Canghai’s attention and admiration.]
Last time, he earned an E-grade from Li Canghai.
This time earned a standard one.
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Gan Baby’s deep admiration]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Qin Hongmian’s deep admiration]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Duan Zhengchun’s high respect]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Duan Zhengming’s high respect]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Azhu’s deep recognition]
[Achievement Medal acquired: You earned Azi’s high recognition.]
[Note: Azhu and Azi were already highly recognizing you, but witnessing your martial arts and reading speed again, they are further astonished by your divine nature!]
Earned fifteen achievement medals in one go.
Besides the aforementioned, there were Chuu Wanli, the Four Great Guards, and Duan Zhengming’s whole family.

Ding Ling was quite surprised too, finishing reading and earning so many achievement medals at once, apparently Duan Zhengming, Duan Zhengchun, and others were already in awe of him, having witnessed and interacted now, quickly stirred feelings of respect and admiration.
With one thought, Ding Ling figured it out.
But he didn’t intend to converse much with Duan Zhengchun, only exchanged a few casual words and went to handle the accumulating court affairs.
Li Canghai and Li Qinglu, for the sake of discretion, each covered their faces lightly with veils, and upon seeing Ding Ling leave, naturally followed him.
Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing followed closely behind.
Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian saw this and didn’t trail after, just exchanged glances, seeing the contentment and excitement in each other’s eyes.

Ding Ling was indeed as Zhong Ling and the others said, remarkable without exception, exceedingly handsome, noble, overbearing, and sacred in demeanor, attentively caring and protecting Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing, and highly esteemed towards them.
What could they be dissatisfied with?
Compared with Duan Zhengchun.
Ding Ling truly held a sense of responsibility.
As emperor of a superpower!
Venerable upon the throne!
Only had three beauties in his harem!
Whereas Duan Zhengchun?
The more Gan Baby and Qin Hongmian thought, the angrier they got, naturally finding themselves displeased and displeased with Duan Zhengchun.
Comparison is the fear.
Previously nothing seemed wrong, perhaps Duan Zhengchun had troubles.
But now, comparing him with Ding Ling, Duan Zhengchun seemed nothing!
Duan Zhengchun saw and couldn’t help secretly lamenting, thinking dear son-in-law, you’ve really given me a big challenge.
When will you give me a True Scripture, so I might learn how your harem beauties harmoniously coexist?
Ding Ling stayed in Luoyang for over half a month.
Read five batches of books again.
After finishing the five batches.
[Wisdom +0.5]
Yet towards the end, the growth slowed significantly, almost stagnating on the last batch.
It shows the secret manuals in this world have provided Ding Ling’s wisdom attribute with a certain limit, only acquiring higher-level secret manuals might enable wisdom to grow further.
But in this world, Dao Scriptures, Buddhist Scriptures, Confucian School teachings, Military and Legal Schools philosophies have all been mostly read by Ding Ling.
Hoping for further increase, is nearly impossible.
Buddha Qi increased significantly again.
Vast Righteous Qi still hadn’t improved.
It shows that only by accumulating a deep enough foundation, Vast Righteous Qi will increase another layer.
Regarding Dao Qi?
No trace of it still.
Estimate probably due to insufficient foundation, perhaps after maxing out Dao Scriptures, all points got allocated to wisdom and such?
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body 48%]
Increased by 11 percentage points.
Provided about 2 percentage points per batch on average.
And after reading 9 batches of books continuously.
The secret manuals of this world were basically all browsed by Ding Ling, with some still arriving through martial arts masters or urgent deliveries.
But trying to fill the Imperial Study again won’t be easy.
With luck, it could take ten days or half a month.
During this time.
Ding Ling planned with Li Canghai to visit Dali Eternal Spring Valley.
Li Canghai stayed in the Imperial Palace for a long time.
Daily at the harem, growing closer with Li Qinglu, Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing, and others.
Zhong Ling and the others sought her martial arts instruction.
She didn’t spare guidance, intricately explaining Martial Dao principles.

She mastered North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Seventy-Two Shaolin Skills, Carefree Sect’s Secret Skill, etc., simply imparting to the young women was straightforward.

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 554: Valley of Eternal Spring
paragraphs: Ding Ling watched silently, letting them go their own ways.
He would try his best to handle the remaining matters of this world before leaving, and if Li Canghai could stay with Zhong Ling, Li Qinglu, and Mu Wanqing, that would be ideal.
Li Qinglu was a clever person. Ever since she learned that Ding Ling might ascend and shatter the void at any moment, she warmed up considerably to Li Canghai, as Ding Ling suggested.
Clearly, she grasped Ding Ling’s intentions.
It must be said.
Li Qinglu was indeed superior in cunning and intelligence, surpassing Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling by far.
On this day.
Ding Ling and Li Canghai arrived in Dali.
They both traveled using lightweight skills.
Because Li Canghai had learned the Breathing Technique, her speed increased tenfold, surpassing her past prowess. Thus, this journey through the air took far less time than traveling by horseback.
She also knew the Ripple Step and some exceptional lightweight skills, although her flying wasn’t as fast, steady, or high as Ding Ling’s.
But compared to other first-class experts,
she was no different from the Martial Dao God.
She knew the precise location of the Dali Eternal Spring Valley.
Hence, she led the way.
"That is the place we are looking for."
Li Canghai led Ding Ling into the Wuliang Mountain Range.
The area they reached was none other than the vicinity of the deep pool where the Scarlet Venom Toad resided.
Ding Ling glanced back and, sure enough, not far away was the spot where he had obtained the Green Pearl.
The Green Pearl was originally given to Zhong Ling’s Lightning Mink.
But after the Lightning Mink absorbed a significant amount of the poison from the Green Pearl, it had evolved to a certain limit.
Half a month ago.
The Lightning Mink no longer clung to the Green Pearl daily.
So Ding Ling took the Green Pearl back.
He was curious about why the Scarlet Venom Toad could hold the Green Pearl continuously, while the Lightning Mink stopped after a few months.
Was the Lightning Mink’s evolution faster and more intense than the Scarlet Venom Toad’s? Or was it due to some other reason?
Ding Ling didn’t know.
Now, when he heard Li Canghai say that the Eternal Spring Valley was nearby, he couldn’t help but be astonished.
Li Canghai said,

"The Eternal Spring Valley is shrouded by the Carefree Ten Extremes Array. It is difficult to discern with the naked eye or sense it clearly. To enter, one must follow the Life Gate path of the Ten Extremes Array."
"Do you know the Ten Extremes Array?"
Ding Ling asked.
"I don’t understand it."
Li Canghai shook her head and said,
"But I know how to step into this Life Gate."
Saying this, she immediately began explaining to Ding Ling how to enter the Carefree Ten Extremes Array, how to position oneself, and more.
After explaining,
Li Canghai took out a Secret Manual from her bosom.
It bore the words ’Small Faceless Skill’ prominently on it.
This Secret Manual looked extremely ancient, as though it had existed for many years. Seeing Ding Ling staring at the Secret Manual, Li Canghai explained,
"This Secret Manual is made from the bark of an Immortal Tree within the Eternal Spring Valley. With it, one can unlock this Eternal Spring Valley."
Hearing this for the first time, Ding Ling was intrigued, and inevitably asked a few more questions.
Li Canghai explained frankly,

"My master knew my nature was peaceful and steady, so he entrusted this Secret Manual for opening the Eternal Spring Valley to me, instructing me before leaving not to use this key unless absolutely necessary.

In addition, if the Small Faceless Skill, North Nether Divine Skill, and Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme are not all cultivated to Great Perfection, one should not step into this Eternal Spring Valley.
If one day, we as fellow apprentices have all three techniques cultivated to Great Perfection, then naturally we can step inside.
Alas, alas..."
As she spoke, her expression turned somber.
Clearly thinking of the love and hate among her senior brothers and sisters.
Blinded by love and hate, how could one achieve Great Perfection in all three Techniques?
Not to mention Wu Xingyun, or Li Qiushui, even Wuya Zi’s Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme was broken, making Great Perfection impossible in a lifetime!
In such a situation,
Li Canghai naturally had no hope of entering the Eternal Spring Valley, but to her great surprise, after waiting for decades, there was suddenly a new turn of events.
She had waited for a transcendent talent like Ding Ling.
Thus came about this action of theirs.

"I am also curious about what lies within the Eternal Spring Valley. But my master’s reminders still ring in my ears, and I dare not forget. My own strength is insufficient to open this Eternal Spring Valley, and I am not qualified to enter it."
She looked at Ding Ling and handed over the Secret Manual:
"This Secret Manual is for you."
Ding Ling accepted it.
Li Canghai continued,

"Simultaneously infuse three Great Perfection streams of Vigorous Qi from the Small Faceless Skill, North Nether Divine Skill, and Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme into the Secret Manual."
Ding Ling immediately operated the three Profound Skills, injecting three streams of True Qi into the ’bark’ crafted Secret Manual.
Boom!

As the True Qi poured in, the bark trembled, flew from his hand, transformed into a stream of light, and with a booming sound, crashed into the cave before them. In the next second, Ding Ling and Li Canghai felt a sudden brightness before their eyes.
They astonishingly discovered that within the cave, a mysterious tunnel had opened.
"That is where the Life Gate of the Ten Extremes Array is. Go in quickly."
Li Canghai urged, treading the Ripple Step like the wind, she was the first to fly inside.
Ding Ling followed closely, using the Dragon Capturing Skill to retrieve the ’Tree Bark Secret Manual’ that had fallen ten feet away after opening the secret path.
He sensed the Secret Manual might still be useful, so he dared not discard it.
Tap, tap!
Ding Ling followed right behind Li Canghai.
Reciting the Mantra, walking in particular stances and steps.
At times moving forward three steps, then six steps back;
At times leaping one meter high, and floating three feet to the right;
At times jumping ten feet deep into an unknown chasm, then shooting up eight feet again, flying and rushing unceasingly.
By the time Ding Ling reached the end, his head was almost spinning.
But after walking for half an hour,
the scene ahead suddenly opened up.
He realized he had arrived in a Grotto Heaven World.
A vast peach forest lay before him, dense and expansive.
A gentle breeze rustled the falling petals, a sight of unmatched beauty.
Looking up,
one could see a chaotic Celestial Palace.
Yet, strangely, within this Celestial Palace appeared to be a sun, casting warm and comfortable sunlight upon them.
Turning back to look,
he saw an endless abyss filled with flowing lights, departing fire, Xun Wind, and weak water.
To think that they had traversed this region just now.
Ding Ling broke out in a cold sweat.
"Worthy of the Ten Extremes Array."
Li Canghai noticed too, uttering in astonishment, then sprang upward, swiftly progressing on the peach tree tops.
Ding Ling operated the Soaring in the Void, leaping dozens of feet high, stepping on the breeze to proceed, and with this lofty leap, he saw farther ahead.
Indeed, it was a valley!
Mountains encircled them on all sides.
There was only one entrance and exit.
It was the abyss territory behind them.
The valley was roughly the size of a small city.
After passing through the vast peach blossom forest, there was a grassland, and in the center stood only a single tree.
Beside the tree was a deep pool.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 555: Stone Monument Image
paragraphs: Beside the deep pool stood a stone monument.
A large section of the stone monument was missing.
This missing piece was square-shaped, almost like a missing volume from a secret manual.
"This stone monument should contain what Master referred to as the ’Eternal Youth Technique’."
Li Canghai glanced at it thoughtfully and said to Ding Ling:
"Try channeling your three strands of Great Perfection Qi into this stone monument."
Ding Ling followed suit.
Clang! Clang!

As the three strands of Great Perfection Qi were continuously infused, the stone monument began to tremble with a clang, and faintly emitted beams of five-colored light. Within the light, a shadowy figure could be seen ’extracting’ a stone-bound secret manual from the monument.
The figure’s face was indistinct, yet his posture was graceful and elegant. At merely a glance, Li Canghai exclaimed, "Master!"
Could it possibly be Master Xiaoyao?
Ding Ling was moved.
How long ago was this?!
That the stone monument could automatically display itself upon receiving three strands of Qi!
How is this any different from a magical treasure in a Xianxia myth that has ’automatic memory playback’ capabilities?
Ding Ling fixed his gaze intently upon the image in the void.
The figure, upon extracting the stone-bound secret manual, began to peruse it.
The manual was three inches thick.
Every page was fashioned from thin stone slices.
Fragile as it seemed.
Yet apparently extremely durable and light, as the figure casually flipped through the pages.
He read very attentively and slowly.
As a result.
Ding Ling could clearly see the writing upon the stone-bound secret manual; it was indeed the Eternal Youth Technique.
This secret manual manifested in such a form.
Ding Ling instantly realized that the opportunity lay here!
He did not dare to relax or lose focus, and watched the image without blinking.

Li Canghai was also watching, her serene and calm face now brimming with excitement and joy. She reached out several times to touch the figure’s clothing in the void, but it was as futile as trying to catch the moon in water or fishing for wood, only adding joy tinged with poignant regret and melancholy.
She seemed to have an impeccable memory as well.
With Master Xiaoyao continuously flipping through the stone-bound secret manual, she also memorized the Eternal Youth Technique.
After finishing the manual.

She truly comprehended why Master Xiaoyao did not give them this manual for cultivation—entry-level required Grandmaster Cultivation, along with extraordinary comprehension, imagination, intuition, etc.
Any minor deficiency in understanding could hinder learning this Divine Skill.
Her expression stirred with emotion.
After Ding Ling finished reading the content of the secret manual.
In a mere instant.
[Eternal Youth Technique Full Level]
Upon reaching full level in this cultivation technique.
The Small Faceless Skill, North Nether True Qi, and the True Qi and Vigorous Qi of Eight Desolates and Six Harmonies, Only I Am Supreme all merged in Ding Ling’s Dantian.
Causing North Nether True Water to transform visibly into ’Longevity True Water’.
This True Water possessed all the advantages of these three Divine Skills.
Capable of Absorption, Transformation, Storage, imitating martial arts worldwide, and granting eternal youth!
The original Pure Yang Venerable Qi.
Also transformed at this moment into Longevity Venerable True Qi.
This Qi contained an essence of longevity.
Cycling repeatedly in Ding Ling’s organs and Dantian, making him feel at that instant, his lifespan increased by at least two hundred years!
Showing the power of this Longevity Venerable Qi.
Just this single strand being so formidable, how much more could he live with several strands, a millennia, ten thousand years?
"Truly worthy of the Eternal Youth Technique."
Ding Ling silently praised, yet became more certain of one thing—that Master Xiaoyao probably hasn’t passed away!
In the void image, he saw Master Xiaoyao bent over to fetch ’a scoop of water’ from the adjacent deep pool to drink.
After drinking.
Suddenly, Master Xiaoyao’s visage cleared up instantly.
Appearing with snow-white hair and youthful face, his appearance was handsome, clearly an elderly man, but after consuming this water, his white hair instantly turned black.
His skin became noticeably rosy and fair.
The decayed aura surrounding him vanished quickly, replaced by vitality and exuberance.
"This, this is?!"
Li Canghai was shocked.
Involuntarily, she looked towards the side of the deep pool, only to see its spring water bubbling up, seeming to be a pond of lively spring water.
"The Fountain of Youth?!"
Ding Ling was moved, and couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Who would have thought such a Divine Object exists in this world."
Li Canghai, however, did not rush to drink from the Fountain of Youth, instead continued watching the images in the void.

Master Xiaoyao, after drinking from the Fountain of Youth, also seemed rather shaken. After adjusting, he extracted a piece of bark from a tree by the deep pool, tried eating a bite, and upon doing so, not only did his aura become more mystical, but the vitality of his presence intensified!
He was delighted, took a second bite but found it had no effect, so he ceased eating, instead excavated another piece of bark, and floated away.
Clang! Clang!
The stone monument trembled.
The image began to slowly dim, and seeing this, Ding Ling pondered, then infused more True Qi of the Eternal Youth Technique into the stone monument.
Boom!
Receiving True Qi with quality, power, and level far surpassing the three strands of Qi, the stone monument trembled more violently, with reverberating sounds.
Beams of five-colored light shot out from all directions in the void.
Each beam contained an image.
Some were images of Master Xiaoyao.
Others were of different individuals.
Ding Ling unexpectedly saw an image where Master Xiaoyao returned.
This time, two others accompanied him.
One was tall, mighty, and overbearing, but a nine-foot tall fierce man, his eyes opening and closing with piercing brilliance, very formidable;
The other possessed regal demeanor, bearing three similarities to Duan Yu, but exuded a more commanding presence, standing there with a face expressionless yet innately dignified;
These two followed Master Xiaoyao into the valley, where they excavated the stone monument, discovering a Celestial Ladder leading to an unknown destination.
This Celestial Ladder seemed buried beneath the stone monument.
As the stone monument was extracted, the Celestial Ladder activated, piercing through the sky, and after exchanging a glance, the three of them proceeded up the Celestial Ladder, never to return.
"Who are those three?"
Ding Ling watched in secret amazement.
For he was quite familiar with this Celestial Ladder.
Every time he shattered the void, he beheld such similar ladders, and did not expect that a Valley of Eternal Spring contained one!
But where exactly did this Celestial Ladder lead?
Ding Ling continued watching other images.
Sure enough.
They belonged to those two individuals.

The two also came here sequentially after Master Xiaoyao, but without his fortuitous encounter. Despite drinking the water and eating bark, while vitality lengthened considerably, it seemed difficult to attain longevity effects.
The two left a line of words upon the Immortal Tree.
Ding Ling carefully examined the writing.

Capable of Absorption, Transformation, Storage, imitating martial arts worldwide, and granting eternal youth!
The original Pure Yang Venerable Qi.
Also transformed at this moment into Longevity Venerable True Qi.
This Qi contained an essence of longevity.
Cycling repeatedly in Ding Ling’s organs and Dantian, making him feel at that instant, his lifespan increased by at least two hundred years!
Showing the power of this Longevity Venerable Qi.
Just this single strand being so formidable, how much more could he live with several strands, a millennia, ten thousand years?
"Truly worthy of the Eternal Youth Technique."
Ding Ling silently praised, yet became more certain of one thing—that Master Xiaoyao probably hasn’t passed away!
In the void image, he saw Master Xiaoyao bent over to fetch ’a scoop of water’ from the adjacent deep pool to drink.
After drinking.
Suddenly, Master Xiaoyao’s visage cleared up instantly.
Appearing with snow-white hair and youthful face, his appearance was handsome, clearly an elderly man, but after consuming this water, his white hair instantly turned black.
His skin became noticeably rosy and fair.
The decayed aura surrounding him vanished quickly, replaced by vitality and exuberance.
"This, this is?!"
Li Canghai was shocked.
Involuntarily, she looked towards the side of the deep pool, only to see its spring water bubbling up, seeming to be a pond of lively spring water.
"The Fountain of Youth?!"
Ding Ling was moved, and couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Who would have thought such a Divine Object exists in this world."
Li Canghai, however, did not rush to drink from the Fountain of Youth, instead continued watching the images in the void.
Master Xiaoyao, after drinking from the Fountain of Youth, also seemed rather shaken.

After adjusting, he extracted a piece of bark from a tree by the deep pool, tried eating a bite, and upon doing so, not only did his aura become more mystical, but the vitality of his presence intensified!
He was delighted, took a second bite but found it had no effect, so he ceased eating, instead excavated another piece of bark, and floated away.
Clang!
Clang!
The stone monument trembled.
The image began to slowly dim, and seeing this, Ding Ling pondered, then infused more True Qi of the Eternal Youth Technique into the stone monument.
Boom!
Receiving True Qi with quality, power, and level far surpassing the three strands of Qi, the stone monument trembled more violently, with reverberating sounds.
Beams of five-colored light shot out from all directions in the void.
Each beam contained an image.
Some were images of Master Xiaoyao.
Others were of different individuals.
Ding Ling unexpectedly saw an image where Master Xiaoyao returned.
This time, two others accompanied him.
One was tall, mighty, and overbearing, but a nine-foot tall fierce man, his eyes opening and closing with piercing brilliance, very formidable;
The other possessed regal demeanor, bearing three similarities to Duan Yu, but exuded a more commanding presence, standing there with a face expressionless yet innately dignified;
These two followed Master Xiaoyao into the valley, where they excavated the stone monument, discovering a Celestial Ladder leading to an unknown destination.
This Celestial Ladder seemed buried beneath the stone monument.
As the stone monument was extracted, the Celestial Ladder activated, piercing through the sky, and after exchanging a glance, the three of them proceeded up the Celestial Ladder, never to return.
"Who are those three?"
Ding Ling watched in secret amazement.
For he was quite familiar with this Celestial Ladder.
Every time he shattered the void, he beheld such similar ladders, and did not expect that a Valley of Eternal Spring contained one!
But where exactly did this Celestial Ladder lead?
Ding Ling continued watching other images.
Sure enough.
They belonged to those two individuals.
The two also came here sequentially after Master Xiaoyao, but without his fortuitous encounter.
Despite drinking the water and eating bark, while vitality lengthened considerably, it seemed difficult to attain longevity effects.
The two left a line of words upon the Immortal Tree.
Ding Ling carefully examined the writing.

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - 556: Fountain of Youth
paragraphs: These two people’s inscriptions were clearly visible.
Duan Siping was here!
Murong Longcheng was here!
Even ancient people had this ’elegant interest,’ which was somewhat beyond Ding Ling’s expectations!
These two also took a piece of bark from the Immortal Tree and drifted off.
Aside from these two people,
there were also some images from the Ancient Era shooting out in the multicolored glow.

Ding Ling saw a blaze descending from the sky, carrying the momentum that could shatter everything as it collided heavily with the earth. After the transformations of time, the impact area formed a valley, seemingly the Valley of Eternal Spring?
Ding Ling analyzed from all sorts of images from all directions.
It’s very clear.
The clearer these light images are, the closer they are to the current era.
The more blurry ones are older.

Ding Ling even saw in an extremely blurry image in midair, someone planting a small sapling of the Immortal Tree, burying the Celestial Ladder, erecting a Stone Monument, casually digging a pit, and throwing something in it; this seems to be the original form of the Fountain of Youth.
The one who buried the Celestial Ladder appears to be a woman.
Although her face was not visible, looking at her demeanor and physique, one could tell she was definitely a peerless beauty.
After doing all this, she pierced the void and disappeared, becoming unknown.
From then on.
This valley, she never came back to it.
Spring passed and autumn came, year after year, countless years passed, the small sapling grew into the Immortal Tree, and a pit became a Fountain of Youth.
With Master Xiaoyao and others entering.
The vitality here seemed to increase somewhat.
"Unexpectedly, there are so many stories buried in this Valley of Eternal Spring."
As the images faded and disappeared,
Li Canghai’s expression was complex, looking up at the Celestial Palace:
"Master actually stepped on the Celestial Ladder and went to another world. I wonder if I will have the chance to see him again in this lifetime."

"As long as you strive to cultivate the Eternal Youth Technique, succeed in your studies, significantly extend your lifespan, and step onto the Celestial Ladder again to go to a higher Upper Realm, there will always be a day to reunite."
Ding Ling offered a few comforting words.
Li Canghai’s expression slightly perked up, smiling broadly, with dimples invisibly appearing at the corners of her mouth, she seemed at once as dazzling as a blossoming Immortal Flower:
"Your Majesty makes a good point."
Even if it’s just to see her master once more.
Li Canghai felt it necessary to cultivate diligently.
Originally living aimlessly, content with the status quo, while at the Scripture Pavilion of Shaolin Temple she thought of ending her days thus, it was good that no one knew her true identity.

Now having restored her real identity, Li Canghai still was unsure where her heart should lead her, but the warmth and kindness of Li Qinglu, Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing towards her warmed her once dry heart.
Now seeing her master hadn’t died after all.
Her heart enlivened somewhat; at this moment, she also had the motivation and goal to live: to strive to see her master again in her lifetime!
"Go ahead and try the Water of Eternal Youth."
Ding Ling directly walked over, took out a bowl from the Storage Pouch, scooped a bowl of water, observed carefully, found no anomalies, and directly drank it all in one go.
Breathe, breathe.
After drinking.
Ding Ling only felt his entire body relaxed, refreshed in spirit, with an indescribable sense of ease and comfort.
Aside from that,
this bowl of spring water continuously radiated an extremely pure Essence of Life.
This essence fell into the Dantian.
Ding Ling’s Dantian became more stable, more potential-filled, as if returning to the youthful era of reshaping his Dantian;
Falling into the organs.
The organs also became more lively.
Falling onto the skin and other areas.
Ding Ling, perceptible to the naked eye, realized his body underwent significant changes, he seemed to have suddenly become several years younger.
He looked towards Li Canghai.
Li Canghai was also looking at him, eyes filled with amazement:
"Unexpectedly, the Water of Eternal Youth still has an effect?! Didn’t the images show Murong Longcheng and Duan Siping found little effect after drinking?"
Ding Ling pondered:
"Perhaps because over time, this spring water reconsolidated quite a bit of Essence Qi?"
Speaking of this,

Ding Ling was somewhat embarrassed, he also thought the Water of Eternal Youth wouldn’t have much effect, so he tried it first, after all, he was Immune to All Poisons, even if the spring water was toxic, he wouldn’t be afraid, but it turned out he received the benefits first:
"Elder, give it a try.
He quickly handed over a bowl.
The Storage Pouch had two.
In Ding Ling’s second Storage Pouch, there were many pots and pans, not for anything more than convenience when going out, so he could roast, drink water, etc., anytime, anywhere.
Li Canghai took the bowl, also scooped a bowl of water to drink.
The spring water entered the belly.
Before long.
Her breath also underwent subtle changes, she originally looked not quite thirty, now after this she appeared several years younger, looking as if only in her twenties.
She touched her face, surprised, shocked:
"This spring water?"
"If effective, drink more."
Ding Ling suggested she drink more.
The two thus scooped and drank another bowl of water, but discovered it had no further effect.
Inevitably contemplative, they recalled Master Xiaoyao seemed to have experienced something similar.
They then no longer worried, but looked towards the Immortal Tree to the side.

This tree trunk was intertwined like a Coiling Dragon, its branches and leaves lush like a canopy, although not tall or big, its vitality was as abundant as a flowing river, like an expansive forest sea, the visceral vitality made them feel comfortable and serene, the closer they stood, the more apparent this feeling became.
Ding Ling and Li Canghai exchanged glances, the two of them understood why Master Xiaoyao, Murong Longcheng, Duan Siping drank the Water of Eternal Youth and then couldn’t help but bite the bark!
Considered from their perspective, everything here was a treasure.
Since the spring water was effective.
There’s no reason the Immortal Tree wouldn’t be.
Ding Ling and Li Canghai also followed suit, took a small piece of bark, broke it, and each ate half.
This bark was chewy, tasted faintly of mint and rose scent, not unpleasant, no wonder Master Xiaoyao ate a piece and wanted another.
Ding Ling understood.
Once the bark was in his belly.
Ding Ling again felt a particularly potent vitality entering his Dantian, organs everywhere, making them more tenacious and lively, not to mention.
A mysterious qi surged out from this bark, boom! actually merging with the Longevity Venerable Qi, causing the qi breath of Longevity Venerable Qi to double instantly.
The originally single Longevity Venerable Qi now became two-lines.
Lifespan instantly increased by two hundred years.
Ding Ling carefully sensed, discovering living to seven or eight hundred years now was no problem at all, he was moved, thinking: who would’ve imagined this opportunity increased my lifespan so much!
This time returning to reality, estimating the real world too could witness rapid lifespan growth.
