chapters.title: Chapter 566 - 557: Forbidden Realm
paragraphs: Not only has his lifespan increased.
Ding Ling’s vitality and regenerative abilities have improved even more.

Ding Ling felt that as the Longevity Venerable Qi increased, and with his Dantian and internal organs being infused with massive amounts of Life Essence Qi, even if he were seriously injured, he might recover quickly.
Of course.

He would not deliberately inflict serious harm on himself, but he did try to cut his arm slightly. True to his expectations, as the Longevity Venerable Qi moved around the wound, a surge of Life Essence Qi emerged, and the wound almost instantly healed, with the skin becoming as resilient as before.
"This regenerative power is amazing."
Ding Ling nodded to himself.
This Water of Eternal Youth only works with the first sip, and the same goes for the Immortal Tree Bark.
Ding Ling and Li Canghai even tried taking another bite of the bark and leaves.
Unfortunately, it was ineffective.
Evidently, only the first sip or bite of the water and tree has any effect here.
They drank a bowl of the Water of Eternal Youth, which was actually unnecessary since only the first sip seemed effective.
"Let’s see what the boundary of this area is like."
Ding Ling had acquired enough opportunities here.

He then used the Soaring in the Void technique, leaping a hundred feet high, feeling as if he could touch the Celestial Palace. Of course, Ding Ling knew it was an illusion. He flew forward and soon landed atop a mountain peak. Looking ahead, he saw a grey region, vast and endless.
Flying towards the surrounding mountains, he found it was the same.
It seemed like this world was all one Forbidden Realm, with the Valley of Eternal Spring being the concentration of all the essence and vitality of this world.
"It’s so strange."
Li Canghai stood beside Ding Ling.

With the consumption of the Water of Eternal Youth and tree bark, Li Canghai became younger and stronger. Her demeanor was so gentle and calm that standing next to Ding Ling, she appeared like an ethereal fairy, carefree, as if she might ascend to the heavens at any moment.

She looked ahead at the grey region and tossed a bit of tree bark into it experimentally. Sizzle! The bark had just fallen into the void and was quickly corroded into ashes before falling into the grey region, becoming part of its soil.
Ding Ling took out a bowl from his Storage Pouch and tossed it too.
The bowl rapidly cracked and shattered into pieces, turning into ashes just like the bark, falling to the ground, also becoming part of the soil.
In just two breaths, the bowl turned to ashes.
Ding Ling and Li Canghai exchanged glances and couldn’t help but take a step back.
"It seems that this world is completely different from ours."
Li Canghai said, moved:
"Or perhaps this world originally belonged to our world, but some horrifying conflict in the Ancient Era left it abandoned, except for the Valley of Eternal Spring."
The two exchanged thoughts.
Seeing how terrifying this Forbidden Realm was.
They naturally had no interest in exploring it further.
They both returned to the Stone Monument.

Ding Ling thought of how the monument was grabbed by the three of Master Xiaoyao and then restored automatically, suppressing the Celestial Ladder. He realized that the monument was extraordinary. Without it, the Valley of Eternal Spring might have collapsed.

Considering the effects of the Water of Eternal Youth and the Immortal Tree, Ding Ling had no intention of destroying this place. If Diao Chan and others ascended to this world in the future, they could come here to drink the water and gnaw on the bark.
Although it wouldn’t be as effective as now,
It would still be of some use.

Additionally, Ding Ling speculated that perhaps the sip of the Water of Eternal Youth Master Xiaoyao had drunk was the only one with longevity effects because he was the first to enter the Valley of Eternal Spring. This Fountain of Youth had gathered countless years of Life Essence Qi, and at Master Xiaoyao’s first drink, he could instantly change in appearance, giving the impression of eternal life and youth, which was quite normal.
"After returning, we can let Zhong Ling and the others come to try the Water of Eternal Youth."
Ding Ling suggested.
Li Canghai shook her head and said:
"I’m afraid they won’t have the ability to get in."
Ding Ling thought about the complexity of entering through the Life Gate and said:
"Once their cultivation and Lightweight Skill are high enough, it shouldn’t be a problem for them to come."
Li Canghai said:
"If I were in this world, I would guide them well."
Ding Ling thanked her.
"Your Majesty need not be so formal with me. Li Qinglu is, after all, my granddaughter. I also like Zhong Ling and Mu Wanqing very much. It is my choice to look out for them."
Hearing this, Ding Ling let the matter pass and instead mentioned how Master Xiaoyao knew about the Life Gate.
Li Canghai shook her head, saying she didn’t know, but added:
"For Master to set foot here, he must have acquired a special opportunity long ago, one that pointed out the path of life. Otherwise, how could Master have entered?"
Ding Ling nodded, realizing that the world is full of mysteries.
Who could have imagined a Celestial Dragon Eight Books World would hide a mysterious place like the Valley of Eternal Spring?
The two exchanged a look, then skillfully retrieved the Stone Monument.
As they unearthed the monument, there was a boom!
A Celestial Ladder erupted from beneath the ground, shooting up into the heavens, reaching an unknown realm in the void.

They both were curious about where the three of Master Xiaoyao went, and Ding Ling knew that as long as the Celestial Ladder was not part of a completed task, people could ascend and descend it freely.
Since Ding Ling hadn’t activated this world’s task ladder, he could naturally navigate the Celestial Ladder created by others freely.
Both of them, with supreme Lightweight Skill, leaped up the ladder, ascending skywards.
Their speed was incredible.
Along the way, they passed through the Celestial Palace, getting a clear view of the sun’s true form.
It turned out to be a spherical object, entirely red?!
’An artificial sun?!’
Ding Ling was surprised and wanted to get closer but couldn’t. The artificial sun seemed protected by a powerful array, and seeing this, Ding Ling could only continue ascending the ladder.
They passed through multiple layers of the celestial canopy.
Neither of them knew how long they traveled.
The two emerged from a narrow celestial tunnel into a strange realm.
Initially emerging, their eyes brightened.
They felt a sense of release, a weight lifted off their shoulders, bringing a sense of freedom.
But when they saw what lay before them, they both raised their eyebrows and their pupils constricted in shock.
Before them lay a deep, dividing chasm.
One side of the chasm was the broad platform the Celestial Ladder reached.
The other side.
Was shrouded in a thick, emerald mist.
Ding Ling’s extraordinary eyesight allowed him to vaguely make out layers of collapsed, fractured palaces within the mist.
As he walked to the edge of the chasm, he saw more clearly.
At the other side of the chasm, there stood a wide, majestic, yet broken and incomplete gate.
The signboard had shattered and lay on the ground.
Ding Ling could faintly recognize three ancient characters on the sign: South Celestial Sect!
"South Celestial Sect!"
Li Canghai was moved, exclaiming in surprise.
Evidently, she was well-versed and recognized these ancient characters.
The two exchanged glances, feeling shocked and amazed.
Was this the legendary South Celestial Sect at the end of the Celestial Ladder?!
This couldn’t be a joke, right?
"What about your master?"
Ding Ling thought of a question.
"Could he have entered inside the South Celestial Sect?"
"I don’t know either."
Li Canghai looked bewildered and fearful, considering the dreadful consequences if her master had entered such a realm.
"I’ll go over and take a look later."
Ding Ling glanced at the chasm, which was a hundred feet wide and bottomless.

They both were curious about where the three of Master Xiaoyao went, and Ding Ling knew that as long as the Celestial Ladder was not part of a completed task, people could ascend and descend it freely.
Since Ding Ling hadn’t activated this world’s task ladder, he could naturally navigate the Celestial Ladder created by others freely.
Both of them, with supreme Lightweight Skill, leaped up the ladder, ascending skywards.
Their speed was incredible.
Along the way, they passed through the Celestial Palace, getting a clear view of the sun’s true form.
It turned out to be a spherical object, entirely red?!
’An artificial sun?!’
Ding Ling was surprised and wanted to get closer but couldn’t.
The artificial sun seemed protected by a powerful array, and seeing this, Ding Ling could only continue ascending the ladder.
They passed through multiple layers of the celestial canopy.
Neither of them knew how long they traveled.
The two emerged from a narrow celestial tunnel into a strange realm.
Initially emerging, their eyes brightened.
They felt a sense of release, a weight lifted off their shoulders, bringing a sense of freedom.
But when they saw what lay before them, they both raised their eyebrows and their pupils constricted in shock.
Before them lay a deep, dividing chasm.
One side of the chasm was the broad platform the Celestial Ladder reached.
The other side.
Was shrouded in a thick, emerald mist.
Ding Ling’s extraordinary eyesight allowed him to vaguely make out layers of collapsed, fractured palaces within the mist.
As he walked to the edge of the chasm, he saw more clearly.
At the other side of the chasm, there stood a wide, majestic, yet broken and incomplete gate.
The signboard had shattered and lay on the ground.
Ding Ling could faintly recognize three ancient characters on the sign: South Celestial Sect!
"South Celestial Sect!"
Li Canghai was moved, exclaiming in surprise.
Evidently, she was well-versed and recognized these ancient characters.
The two exchanged glances, feeling shocked and amazed.
Was this the legendary South Celestial Sect at the end of the Celestial Ladder?!
This couldn’t be a joke, right?
"What about your master?"
Ding Ling thought of a question.
"Could he have entered inside the South Celestial Sect?"
"I don’t know either."
Li Canghai looked bewildered and fearful, considering the dreadful consequences if her master had entered such a realm.
"I’ll go over and take a look later."
Ding Ling glanced at the chasm, which was a hundred feet wide and bottomless.

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - 558: Celestial Palace
paragraphs: Ding Ling thought for a moment, took a bowl from the storage pouch and threw it into the abyss, then took another one and tossed it forcefully to the opposite side.
He observed carefully.
Saw that the bowl did not seem to shatter into ashes in the gray region.
He then took a rather long chain from the storage pouch, tied one end around his waist, and gave the other end to Li Canghai:
"If I show any sign of distress, remember to pull me back."
"Your Majesty, I think this isn’t safe."
Li Canghai’s face was full of caution:
"You are the supreme ruler, with a body worth a thousand gold, such dangerous tasks shouldn’t be undertaken by you. Let me do it instead."
"Are you immune to all poisons?"
Ding Ling asked.
Li Canghai shook his head.
"Is your cultivation higher than mine?"
Li Canghai still shook his head.
"Or do you think you run faster than me?"
Li Canghai felt embarrassed and ashamed, nodded and said:
"I understand. Your Majesty, please be very careful."

Ding Ling did not say more, took a deep breath, and performed Soaring in the Void to step into the air above the chasm. As soon as he stepped in, he felt his body sink, as if an invisible force was locking him, causing him to involuntarily descend. But luckily, with the True Qi of the Eternal Youth Technique in his body, he fiercely pushed, amplifying his body technique tenfold, instantly stabilizing his figure. He took a moment to carefully feel it, and confirmed it was safe.
Ding Ling signaled Li Canghai to release the chain, then he retrieved the chain and sped forward, treading the wind and waves.
He felt very fortunate at this moment for the enhancement he underwent in the Valley of Eternal Spring.
If not for this enhancement.
He might not even be able to cross this chasm.

The True Qi of the Eternal Youth Technique far surpasses the previous North Nether True Qi, of a higher level, paired with tenfold amplified strength, allowing him to counteract this invisible force’s binding, whereas the previous True Qi, due to slight qualitative differences, might have caused him to sink into the abyss.
This chasm crossing seems to have an invisible threshold.
Those whose True Qi level is not sufficient, have no right to step in.
The further he went, the more noticeable this feeling became.
It’s like stepping from a mortal plane into a higher plane, without reaching a certain level, entry is impossible.
"Indeed, this place is quite extraordinary."
Ding Ling crossed the hundred-feet chasm, bang! His legs heavily stepped onto the opposite earth realm, leaving footprints.
The opposite side was covered in endless gray dust mist.
The ground was filled with dust, Ding Ling’s foot stirred up dust swirling rampantly.
Wanting to leap up, he found his body unusually heavy, nearly impossible to jump, only able to utilize the Lightweight Skill to the extent of ’Walking on Snow’.
"This is indeed another plane world."
Ding Ling realized:
"This world’s solidity level is too high."

Ding Ling attempted to strike a Human Emperor Fist into the void, no aura appeared, the world’s solidity level far surpassed that depicted in the Celestial Dragon Eight Books by hundreds, thousands of times.
"Could this really be the Celestial Palace?"
Ding Ling murmured uncertainly.
He performed Ripple Step all the way, treading thick dust, swiftly arriving at the South Heavenly Gate.
Clearly seeing, from the opposite side, the South Heavenly Gate did not seem far.
But upon reaching this side, he could clearly sense the distance to the South Heavenly Gate was surely hundreds of feet, the visual distortion and disparity were too apparent.
"From the opposite view, even adding the hundred-feet distance of the chasm, at most it seemed over a hundred feet away. But standing here, it’s at least more than five hundred feet away!"
Ding Ling puzzled, could only define this world as possessing extremely high-level certain material laws, beyond his understanding.
Standing at the South Heavenly Gate.
He examined carefully.
Saw the gate seemed to have been severed, the cut surface smooth as new, and the other half fallen inside the South Heavenly Gate, piled with dust.

But this gate standing here was utterly jade-like, glassy, shining bright, like an adorned treasure, with two broken Tongtian Pillars each coiled with a gold-scaled sunlit Red-Beard Dragon. One dragon’s head was missing, the tail of another was gone.
The dragons coiled on these pillars were lifelike, vivid as if real dragons, only the body without a dragon head was exceedingly dim.
The Red-Beard Dragon without a tail still seemed to possess some vigour, subtly emanating hardly visible crimson rays.
Seeing this.
Ding Ling suddenly realized.
The pillar of this gate remains untouched by dust, surely because of the power of this Dragon Soaring Map without a dragon tail.
Approaching.
He saw the fallen plaque of the South Heavenly Gate on the ground.
Three words, dragon flying phoenix dancing, as if forged by laws, just a glance filled Ding Ling with a heavenly vision, a refreshing clarity.
"Impressive."

Ding Ling’s Vast Righteous Qi within slightly trembled, his mind instantly cleared, silently praised, these three characters on the plaque, abandoned for unknown years, still seemed to enchant one’s heart, evidently a precious item. Finding the plaque too wide to fit in the storage pouch, he thought to bring it out for careful study upon returning.
He proceeded forward.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Ding Ling tread the Ripple Step swiftly.
Passed the South Heavenly Gate, sighting three Broken Bridges ahead.

Imprinted on the bridges were vibrant feathered Red-capped Phoenix soaring, due to the bridge break, some losing heads or phoenix tails, the bridges with headed phoenix still shone bright, illuminating sky, green mist veiling bridge entrances.
This verdant mist mingled with the prior mist, Ding Ling immediately recognized it.
"This is the toxic haze over the deep pool where the Scarlet Venom Toad resides! Highly poisonous."
Ding Ling approached, reached out to test, indeed highly poisonous.
Upon contact, his skin started sizzling.
But Ding Ling was immune to all poisons, shortly adapted to this toxic haze, his skin quickly returned to normal.
"Seems I can now resist this toxic haze."
Ding Ling reassured himself, crossed the toxic haze, tread the broken bridge, arrived on the other side.
Among these broken bridges, the one with the headed Red-capped Phoenix remained radiant, forming a Rainbow Bridge, though fractured, Ding Ling still could tread the Rainbow Bridge to the other side.
"This is indeed the Celestial Palace. Such decoration, arrangement is beyond the terrestrial realm."
Mysteriously.
Ding Ling felt familiar with this Celestial Palace, like he had seen it somewhere?
Was it in some movie? TV drama?
Ding Ling shook his head, not contemplating more, continued forward.
After traveling merely a hundred or so feet, he saw a multitude of pavilions and palaces.
Compared to the pillars and broken bridges.
These palaces were far more damaged.
A scene of ruins, debris remains.
Ding Ling crossed numerous palaces, eventually arriving in front of a completely collapsed palace, here marking the world’s edge.
Beyond lay an expanse of gray region.
Ding Ling threw a fractured stone forward, sizzle! Just into the gray region, immediately corroded to pieces, turning into ashes.
"Indeed, the gray region of the Valley of Eternal Spring comes from here."
Ding Ling observed the endless gray region, boundless like the galaxy or sea.
And the Celestial Palace stood at this gray region’s edge, like a lone hero atop a cliff, facing countless troops, the sense of tragic resolve surged.
Ding Ling’s brow twitched, not lingering his gaze, but explored all around.
Only finding a broken Divine Weapon.
A long spear.

Upright in the ruins of Lingxiao Palace, Ding Ling tried hard to uproot but couldn’t, ultimately activating Longevity Venerable Qi, the long spear seemed to respond, allowing him to easily pull it out.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 559: Ghost God
paragraphs: The Lingxiao Palace is the last ruin site where Ding Ling was just now.
The reason it was recognized as the Lingxiao Palace was due to the broken plaque on the ground.
The plaque of the South Celestial Sect was intact.
But the Lingxiao Palace was completely collapsed, yet the fuzzy outlines of four big characters could still be discerned: Lingxiao Palace!
"This is indeed the Celestial Palace."
Ding Ling shook his head.
Feeling somewhat strange.
In the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World, having a Valley of Eternal Spring, a Fountain of Youth, and an Immortal Tree is fair enough.
But there was even a Celestial Ladder piercing through the layers of the celestial curtain, leading him to the gate of the Celestial Palace.
"I wonder which world’s Celestial Palace this is?"
Ding Ling walked through multiple Celestial Palaces, and having found no more relics, prepared to leave with the broken halberd in hand.
Although the halberd was broken with only half remaining.
It was extremely sharp.
And since the halberd tip was still intact, it could be used as a long knife, long sword, or short spear.
Especially when infused with Longevity Venerable Qi, the halberd tip revealed a chilling gleam, seemingly able to pierce through the Celestial Palaces.
Ding Ling had previously tested it.
Infusing Longevity Venerable Qi could pierce through the Celestial Palace surface, no matter how indestructible, showing the halberd’s unrivaled nature, doubtlessly a weapon used by immortals!
It wouldn’t be wrong to call it an Immortal Weapon.
Regrettably,

there were only two strands of Longevity Venerable Qi, and Ding Ling could only use the halberd twice at most, needing to pause and wait for the Longevity Venerable Qi to automatically regenerate before continuing to use it.
"Seems like it can only be used as a trump card."
Thinking so, Ding Ling retraced his steps.
The Celestial Palace Realm was vast, over a hundred miles long and wide.
Ding Ling spent hours rapidly searching for treasures,
and finding none, he naturally wanted to leave.
"Everything is broken."
He scanned the eight directions one last time, musing:

"Moreover, dust is pervasive, and the marks of time are too apparent. It seems there was a cataclysmic battle here long ago, yet there’s not a single corpse. What’s more, among Immortal Weapons, there’s only one broken halberd. Where did all the corpses and weapons ultimately go?"
Confused, Ding Ling didn’t dwell on it.
In his view,
as long as he continuously ascends and grows stronger, all obstacles could naturally be overcome.
He had risen from being a low-level soldier, destroying multiple worlds, deeply understanding this.
Swish! Swish!

Ding Ling activated Soaring in the Void, walking on the wind. Due to the extreme solidity and heaviness of this world, he could only achieve the effect of "Walking on Snow," which slowed him down considerably.
Yet he was no slower than a galloping horse.
As he was about to step onto the Broken Bridge again,
a figure suddenly leapt out from the Hongyuan beneath the bridge.
The figure’s owner was armored, nine feet tall, his appearance shrouded in a dense green mist, and his appearance was sudden and ghostly!
His eyes glowed green, and he only glanced at Ding Ling for a moment before, swish! He disappeared into thin air.
Startled, Ding Ling instinctively spun the broken halberd into a Wind Wheel, protecting himself tightly!
Boom!
However, just as the Wind Wheel spun up, a loud noise erupted, and Ding Ling felt as if struck by lightning, uncontrollably flying backward several zhang.
In mid-air, Ding Ling could see more clearly.
It was the nine-foot giant attacking him with terrifying speed, difficult to discern with the naked eye, using his bare hands against Ding Ling.

His hands struck the halberd precisely, making it tremble violently! To Ding Ling’s relief, the halberd was extremely hard, not only blocking the strike but also dispelling some of the terrible Vigorous Qi.
The force that struck Ding Ling was pure brute strength, which caused his blood to surge, but with just a brief circulation of the Eternal Youth Technique, he returned to normal.
"Six Meridian Divine Sword!"
Ding Ling swung the halberd with his left hand, and with his right hand unleashed an attack on the nine-foot giant, sending five streaks of Sword Qi shrieking toward him.
The giant, seeing Ding Ling’s Sword Qi, froze for a moment and uttered four words:
"Six, Meridian, Divine, Sword!"
Each word weighed as if it bore a thousand forces.
Slow, harsh, grating, resonant as if tempered through chattering bones.
As Ding Ling remained alert,
the giant inexplicably stood still, unresponsive to Ding Ling’s attack with the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
After half a moment,
his green-glowing eyes cast a deep look at Ding Ling and, without further attack, turned to leave in the direction of the Broken Bridge.
Ding Ling was baffled.
Mostly shaken.
His Six Meridian Divine Sword had shot at this man, yet it did no harm.
Clearly, this man’s strength far exceeded his own.
Ding Ling had wanted to try other techniques against him, but seeing those eyes emitting green fire, he remembered the Ghost King he had slain in the Three Kingdoms World!
Back then, other means were ineffective against the Ghost King, but the Human Emperor Swordsmanship was just the right counter.

Ding Ling had considered switching to Human Emperor Spear Technique, Human Emperor Swordsmanship, combined with the Supreme Yang and Firm Longevity Venerable Qi to kill the opponent, yet the opponent simply walked away.
He naturally wouldn’t seek trouble uninvited and quietly watched as the nine-foot giant reached the bridge, flipped over, splash!
The sound of water was heard, and he appeared to dive into the abyssal flood beneath the Broken Bridge.
Ding Ling hurried to the front of the Broken Bridge and leaned over for a look.
The abyss was deep and unfathomable, with tumultuous green murky water, making it difficult to see clearly what lay within.
After the giant plunged into the water, he was never seen again.

Looking at the flood below, pondering the giant’s prowess, Ding Ling dared not delay, quickened his pace, and stepped onto the Rainbow Bridge. He soared through the sky to the front of the South Celestial Sect, reached the plaque, and tried to lift it, almost stumbling, nearly falling over.
"So heavy!"
The plaque weighs at least hundreds of thousands of jin!
Incredibly heavy.
Yet appearing so thin! Its material must be extremely rare.
Ding Ling was moved.
He considered and then infused Longevity Venerable Qi to move the plaque.
To his surprise,
the once overwhelmingly heavy plaque suddenly became much lighter.
Ding Ling was astonished.
He thought to himself:

"The first strand of Longevity Venerable Qi was a fusion of three divine skills, evolving into Supreme Qi. The second strand evolved from drinking the Fountain of Youth water and Immortal Tree bark. Both the Eternal Youth Technique and the water and bark relate to the Valley of Eternal Spring.
And this valley can directly lead to the Celestial Palace.
Could it be that this Eternal Youth Technique was left by some Great God here?"

He considered and then infused Longevity Venerable Qi to move the plaque.
To his surprise,
the once overwhelmingly heavy plaque suddenly became much lighter.
Ding Ling was astonished.
He thought to himself:
"The first strand of Longevity Venerable Qi was a fusion of three divine skills, evolving into Supreme Qi.
The second strand evolved from drinking the Fountain of Youth water and Immortal Tree bark.
Both the Eternal Youth Technique and the water and bark relate to the Valley of Eternal Spring.
And this valley can directly lead to the Celestial Palace.
Could it be that this Eternal Youth Technique was left by some Great God here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 560: Duan Yu’s Ancestor
paragraphs: Ding Ling thought of that Unparalleled Divine Lady who planted the Immortal Tree Seedling.
Perhaps this technique belongs to her, and she must have a deep connection with this mysterious plaque of the South Celestial Sect.
Otherwise, how could it be such a coincidence?
Other techniques are ineffective, but the Longevity Venerable Qi, evolved from the Eternal Youth Technique, is coincidentally able to lift this plaque?
Ding Ling tried with force.
Sure enough.
He actually managed to lift the plaque.
Although it was a bit strenuous.
But as the Longevity Venerable Qi surged more wildly, that sense of strain became lighter and weaker, until the plaque in his hands felt as light as nothing.
Ding Ling was amazed.
Involuntarily, he swung the plaque up, boom!
Smashed it down on the ground with a crash, crack!

The ground started to crack, making Ding Ling’s eyelids twitch; he dared not smash it again. There was already an abyss here, and if smashed too many times, causing the place to collapse entirely and triggering some unknown change, making him unable to return, wouldn’t that be troublesome?
It’s better to return to the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World for careful observation and experimentation.
However, the reason Ding Ling dared not try again was that when using the Longevity Venerable Qi to smash this plaque, the consumption of his Longevity Venerable Qi increased sharply.
Ding Ling feared that if this continued, he would not be able to control the plaque for long, so he naturally wouldn’t smash it again.
Tap tap!
Ding Ling, holding the large plaque, ran all the way to the chasm, then used Soaring in the Void, fusing Vigorous Qi tenfold to amplify himself, the Longevity Venerable Qi enhancing his body, whoosh!
Flying over the chasm, his entire body sank, and Ding Ling dared not waste another second, speeding to the opposite side of the chasm, thud!
Landing heavily on the ground, even the ground seemed to shudder three times.
"Your Majesty."

Li Canghai rushed over to assist him, trying to help take down the plaque, but found it incredibly heavy; without using Inner Strength, she couldn’t move it at all, and even if she exerted all her strength, she would only be able to lift a corner of it, leaving her in shock.
"Your Majesty, why is this thing so heavy?"
"It is indeed very heavy."
Ding Ling gently placed the plaque on the ground, boom! The entire surface trembled.
The weight of the plaque is evident, comparable to a small mountain, without exaggeration.

Li Canghai tried again to activate Fusion Qi, tenfold amplifying to move it, managing to carry it around. However, she could not achieve the ease with which Ding Ling lifted it, as if it weighed nothing, effortlessly.
She couldn’t help but be full of admiration.
"Not only is it heavy, but the material seems extremely unique, in the Lower Realm, with a tenfold amplification, I would never find moving something this heavy so difficult and laborious."
Li Canghai remarked, then couldn’t help but ask:
"Your Majesty. What did you encounter there? What happened?"
Ding Ling relayed the details.
Li Canghai was moved:
"Unexpectedly, such a catastrophe also occurred in the Upper Realm. I truly don’t know what happened in the Ancient Era? Something’s not right..."
She thought of the Ghost God warrior Ding Ling mentioned and asked him to describe it in detail.
Ding Ling simply took paper and pen from the Storage Pouch and quickly sketched out the vivid likeness of the Ghost God.
His drawing skill was at Great Perfection.
Drawing skills collected from several worlds.
The Ghost God on the paper seemed ready to step out, incredibly lifelike and vivid.
Li Canghai stared at it carefully, then suddenly said:
"This person looks like Duan Siping."
"Duan Siping?"
Ding Ling was taken aback, contemplating the image he saw in the Valley of Eternal Spring and finding several suspicious points upon comparison.
This Duan Siping and Murong Longcheng were both towering, imposing, and commanding figures.
But compared to Murong Longcheng,
Duan Siping was slightly shorter. But here, this figure was evidently taller.
Although the height of the Ghost God was more akin to Murong Longcheng,
the armor on this Ghost God’s body, including the Jade Pendant around his neck, was exactly the same as Duan Siping’s.

"Perhaps because Duan Siping experienced a drastic change in the Upper Realm, leading to significant physical alterations. But the armor and Jade Pendant cannot lie. Moreover, as you mentioned, he didn’t attack you when seeing you use the Six Meridian Divine Sword. This implies a deep connection with the Six Meridian Divine Sword, making it likely he is Duan Siping."
Duan Siping was the ancestor of the Duan Family, the founding emperor of Dali, and the creator of the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
This was the record of the Duan Family.
Ding Ling had heard of it before.
And Murong Longcheng was the ancestor of the Gusu Murong Clan, a Martial Arts Genius who created Star Shifting.
These two, along with Master Xiaoyao, were legendary figures of their time.
Unexpectedly all entered the Valley of Eternal Spring, ascended the Celestial Ladder, and came here.
Moreover, given the situation,
The three likely met with misfortune as well.
Ding Ling could think of these things.
Li Canghai naturally thought of them too, becoming sad and distressed:
"Who would have thought that Master’s lifelong wish of achieving the Immortal Dao would end up as an empty endeavor."
Her face darkened.
Evidently thinking the three ascended to the Immortal Realm and entered the South Celestial Sect.
Duan Siping became a Ghost God.
Master Xiaoyao probably didn’t fare much better either.
"I don’t think so."
Ding Ling consoled:

"Your Master drank the first drop from the Fountain of Youth, becoming immortal. Eating the first bark of the Immortal Tree further blessed him with immense divine power and limitless potential. I didn’t see any corpses in the Celestial Palace, so we can’t just assume your Master is dead simply because we saw Duan Siping in a Ghost God form."
With those words,
Li Canghai’s sorrow eased considerably, but she was still uneasy, only sighing:
"According to what you said, the Celestial Palace shattered, and beyond is a vast Forbidden Realm. Where would my Master and the others go?"
How would Ding Ling know?
After asking this, Li Canghai seemed to realize this point, thought for a moment, then said:
"Can I try to observe it myself?"
"You’re unlikely to make it across."
Ding Ling casually replied, but seeing Li Canghai’s insistence, he took out a chain, tied it around her waist, holding onto the other end himself, letting her try.
Sure enough.
As Li Canghai leaped, she sank straight down into the abyss.
Ding Ling took the opportunity to pull the chain, bringing her back up.
She said with lingering fear:
"It seems like my lack of power is the issue."
"And impure power."
Ding Ling reminded:
"Once you’ve mastered the Eternal Youth Technique, you’ll likely be able to enter."
"So that’s it."
Li Canghai carefully sensed and explored, then came to terms:
"I was confused as to why leaping over the chasm felt like being shackled, unable to exert any strength."
"Additionally, you must be immune to all poisons."
Ding Ling pointed out all the difficulties.
Li Canghai fell silent, ceasing to speak about exploring, but her gaze towards Ding Ling became more nuanced, filled with awe.
Ding Ling could enter freely and, amidst the Ghost God’s attacks, remained unharmed, eventually retreating entirely unscathed.

Though it related to the Ghost God recognizing the Six Meridian Divine Sword and retreating, if they really fought, with Ding Ling being the All-Purpose King, it would be hard to say who would win or lose.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 561: Abdication
paragraphs: Ding Ling and Li Canghai were no longer interested in exploring the Celestial Palace.
At that moment, they noticed the Celestial Ladder had dimmed significantly.
Not daring to delay, they immediately retraced their steps, descending the Celestial Ladder.
Ding Ling held the massive plaque of the South Celestial Sect in front, swiftly flying down.
Ascending the Celestial Ladder is difficult.
Descending it is even harder.
But for someone like Ding Ling, with exceptional lightweight skill, it was no problem.

In the Celestial Palace Realm, Ding Ling felt shackled, as if he had entered a world of weak waters, his body extremely heavy, struggling to soar, but at the Celestial Ladder, it was entirely different.
He flew swiftly, like the wind, like lightning.
His figure was light and graceful, like drifting clouds slicing through the sky.
Because the Celestial Ladder descended almost vertically, the speed of dashing down was much faster than going up.
This was true for Ding Ling.
For those without strong lightweight skills.
It truly was ’easier to go up the mountain than down,’ and on these increasingly vertical steep slopes, without high lightweight skills, it was easy to fall and die when descending.
Of course.
This referred to the Celestial Ladder of the Valley of Eternal Spring.
The Celestial Ladder where Ding Ling completed his task was not so steep, but for most first-class experts, it was indeed easier to ascend.
On the return.
Ding Ling once again saw the artificial sun.
This time he guessed it might be related to the Divine Maiden who erected the stone monument and planted the Immortal Tree.
Perhaps it was a treasure she held.
Unfortunately.
Now unable to approach the sun, Ding Ling could only look at the treasure and sigh.
Swish, swish!
Ding Ling and Li Canghai, one in front, one behind, landed in the Valley of Eternal Spring.
Almost immediately after they landed.
Swish!

The Celestial Ladder’s light dimmed rapidly, and with a whoosh-like sound, it retracted back into the ground, the speed was swift, and at the same time, the stone monument that had been toppled over automatically righted itself again, standing at the original position where the Celestial Ladder was located.
Ding Ling and Li Canghai were stunned by what they saw.
Ding Ling became increasingly certain that this stone monument was a Magical Treasure. He stepped forward again attempting to extract it, but no matter what, he could not move it, saying:

"It seems that activating the Celestial Ladder beneath this stone monument requires energy. Now the energy is depleted, it may take another ten or hundred years to accumulate it again, to topple the stone monument and activate the Celestial Ladder."
Li Canghai nodded in agreement, thinking the same thing. Just like the Immortal Tree and the Fountain of Youth, to be effective, they required time to gather life essence energy.
"Let’s go back."
They had explored here.
To return, they might have to wait until Zhong Ling and others become stronger, led by Li Canghai.
Ding Ling prepared to arrange the follow-up matters upon his return, then shatter the void and leave.
To the Celestial Palace.
Feeling the omnipresent shackles and restrictions.
Only then did Ding Ling deeply realize that he was still very weak and needed continuous improvement.
The two, each with a piece of fresh bark, left the Valley of Eternal Spring.
Bang!
After stepping out of the Exit Gate’s tunnel.
In just the blink of an eye.
The tunnel vanished into thin air.
Upon looking again.
It was just a regular cave.
No one would imagine that within this cave world, there was another hidden realm!
Moreover, walking around these caves for dozens of rounds, no one would notice any abnormalities.
The Valley of Eternal Spring was unmistakably in a different dimensional grotto heaven world.
The key to opening the portal.
Ding Ling returned it to Li Canghai.
He kept a piece of bark himself. If he wished to visit, he could use the piece he kept.
But once outside the Valley of Eternal Spring.
The bark became as tough as iron.
Upon closer inspection.
Indeed, it had lost any enhancement of life vitality or similar effects.
Clearly, the bark was only effective when consumed near the Immortal Tree.
"So strange."
Li Canghai couldn’t understand it and could only conclude:
"The Great Thousand Worlds truly are full of wonders."
Ding Ling wholeheartedly agreed.
Having seen even the broken South Celestial Sect gate.
Such oddities, while strange, were also completely understandable.
Ding Ling returned to Luoyang Imperial Palace.
The South Celestial Sect plaque was placed in a corner of the Imperial Study.
After returning, he tested the power of the plaque.
Indeed, it was domineering and unparalleled.
A plaque smashing down could easily demolish a small mountain!
However, it severely depleted Longevity Venerable Qi, making it impossible for Ding Ling to wield it as a weapon for long.
This was secondary.
The most troublesome issue was the plaque’s massive width, making it inconvenient for Ding Ling to use as a weapon; the best method was to melt it down and craft it into a superior Divine Weapon.
However, Ding Ling had tried fire and other methods.
Unable to refine!
"It seems the fire grade in this world is too low, while the material grade of the plaque is too high!"
Ding Ling was both surprised and delighted.
This plaque, if kept, could perhaps be used to craft Magical Treasures and Immortal Weapons in the future.

"It appears there’s no way to bring this plaque to the Upper Realm. Just let it remain in this world. If I don’t find suitable materials to make Immortal Weapons later, I can always return to this world and refine this plaque again."
Unable to refine now.
Due to inadequate techniques and flame grades.
Ding Ling was self-aware, and wouldn’t forcibly attempt it.
The reason he’s not preparing to take this plaque to the Upper Realm.
First, the plaque is too large, smooth all over, without handles, larger than common doors, and not suitable for weapon making.
Second, operating this plaque consumes too much Longevity Venerable Qi. Rather than that, he’s better off using the broken Immortal Weapon Long Halberd he acquired.
Thirdly, it can’t fit in a Storage Pouch, carrying a plaque around daily is impractical. Moreover, Longevity Venerable Qi can’t support Ding Ling carrying a plaque around daily.
Upon returning to Luoyang, Ding Ling’s Longevity Venerable Qi was severely depleted, forcing him to leave the plaque aside, rest, recover, and then resume his journey.
Fourthly, leaving the plaque in this world allows its use upon returning to the Lower Realm.
Thinking this way.
Ding Ling decided not to worry about the plaque anymore.
And began addressing state affairs, reading books.
The tenth batch of books wasn’t fully stocked.
Ding Ling didn’t mind.
If free, he would go and take a look.
In his free time, he would also specially guide Li Canghai, Li Qinglu, Zhong Ling, and Mu Wanqing in cultivation techniques.

Li Canghai’s abilities were incredibly profound, having also drunk Water of Eternal Youth and chewed Immortal Tree Bark, her aptitude and potential seemed to have improved considerably. She was naturally gifted with a photographic memory, her perception and wisdom exceedingly high, fulfilling the minimum requirement for cultivating the Eternal Youth Technique.
Upon returning, she began transitioning to this cultivation.

But there were many areas she didn’t understand, so she consulted Ding Ling, whose mastery of this technique was Full Level, explaining from a commanding position, striking the root, hitting the mark.
Often enlightening Li Canghai as if she’d been infused by profound insights, opening up new understanding.
Her admiration and respect for Ding Ling increased daily.
She often marveled that if Master Xiaoyao saw Ding Ling, he too would surely exclaim that each generation produces talented individuals who replace the old!
In the blink of an eye, half a month passed.
Ding Ling finally completed the tenth batch of books.
After finishing reading, Buddha Qi rose.
[Wisdom +0.1]
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Progress 50%]
Leaping two percentage points from 48%.
Reaching this step.
The surface-level Secret Manuals of this world had been essentially drained by Ding Ling.
Bear in mind, each batch of books required Ding Ling to read for over a day, and sometimes two to three days.
Even for him, who read books like flipping pages, it took such long durations.
One can imagine the vastness of a batch of books!
To say that he had learned from merely five cartloads of books is to underestimate him.
Overflowing with literary knowledge, well-read, highly talented, these terms couldn’t fully describe his current strength.
Ding Ling saw that the time had come.
And began to call Xiaoo Feng, to discuss in detail the matter of succession.
For over half a year.
Ding Ling had been consciously cultivating Xiaoo Feng.

Xiaoo Feng was also a genius, with various guidance from Ding Ling, coupled with help from renowned ministers on the court, he excelled in both governance and military tactics, not the top but quite remarkable.
Most importantly, Xiaoo Feng was bold, open-minded, broad-hearted, perceptive and discerning, deeply loyal and righteous.
Ding Ling greatly appreciated such a person.
However, even so.
Xiaoo Feng was startled to not dare accept the position.
Claiming he’s Khitan, unfit for such a heavy responsibility.
Ding Ling said:

"Xiaoo Feng, what I value is your character, not your origin. Besides, Khitan and Han people are family now. Why speak of two families when you’re one? As long as you love the country and its people, serve them, and strive to overcome obstacles and govern Jiuzhou with vigor and vision, why should you lack confidence?"
Xiaoo Feng was at a loss.
Ding Ling further persuaded him a few times.
Xiaoo Feng was ashamed, moved, knelt down, made a grand salute, and said:

"Since Your Majesty’s enthronement, understanding people’s talents, enforcing strict discipline, refining internal affairs, exhibiting grand demeanor, accepting honest advice, the country’s power has increasingly strengthened, surrounding small nations respect and submit through admiration!
I’m afraid I can’t achieve Your Majesty’s excellence."
"Afraid of what?"
Ding Ling smiled and replied:
"Since I took office, I essentially managed little. When you’re bold and do well, you’ll make it. I believe in you."
Xiaoo Feng’s experience as Southern Court King proves his capability.
Moreover, over the past half year.
Ding Ling assessed Xiaoo Feng multiple times.
Proven, indeed Xiaoo Feng was talented, apt to be a king, possibly a ruler.
"It’s settled. Prepare yourself, succession in three days."
"Your Majesty."
Xiaoo Feng panicked:
"Please reconsider thoroughly."
"I’m about to ascend, what is there to reconsider? Withdraw now. It’s set."
Upon hearing Ding Ling’s impending ascension.
Xiaoo Feng was momentarily stunned, then suddenly understood.

A plaque smashing down could easily demolish a small mountain!
However, it severely depleted Longevity Venerable Qi, making it impossible for Ding Ling to wield it as a weapon for long.
This was secondary.
The most troublesome issue was the plaque’s massive width, making it inconvenient for Ding Ling to use as a weapon; the best method was to melt it down and craft it into a superior Divine Weapon.
However, Ding Ling had tried fire and other methods.
Unable to refine!
"It seems the fire grade in this world is too low, while the material grade of the plaque is too high!"
Ding Ling was both surprised and delighted.
This plaque, if kept, could perhaps be used to craft Magical Treasures and Immortal Weapons in the future.
"It appears there’s no way to bring this plaque to the Upper Realm.
Just let it remain in this world.
If I don’t find suitable materials to make Immortal Weapons later, I can always return to this world and refine this plaque again."
Unable to refine now.
Due to inadequate techniques and flame grades.
Ding Ling was self-aware, and wouldn’t forcibly attempt it.
The reason he’s not preparing to take this plaque to the Upper Realm.
First, the plaque is too large, smooth all over, without handles, larger than common doors, and not suitable for weapon making.
Second, operating this plaque consumes too much Longevity Venerable Qi.
Rather than that, he’s better off using the broken Immortal Weapon Long Halberd he acquired.
Thirdly, it can’t fit in a Storage Pouch, carrying a plaque around daily is impractical.
Moreover, Longevity Venerable Qi can’t support Ding Ling carrying a plaque around daily.
Upon returning to Luoyang, Ding Ling’s Longevity Venerable Qi was severely depleted, forcing him to leave the plaque aside, rest, recover, and then resume his journey.
Fourthly, leaving the plaque in this world allows its use upon returning to the Lower Realm.
Thinking this way.
Ding Ling decided not to worry about the plaque anymore.
And began addressing state affairs, reading books.
The tenth batch of books wasn’t fully stocked.
Ding Ling didn’t mind.
If free, he would go and take a look.
In his free time, he would also specially guide Li Canghai, Li Qinglu, Zhong Ling, and Mu Wanqing in cultivation techniques.
Li Canghai’s abilities were incredibly profound, having also drunk Water of Eternal Youth and chewed Immortal Tree Bark, her aptitude and potential seemed to have improved considerably.
She was naturally gifted with a photographic memory, her perception and wisdom exceedingly high, fulfilling the minimum requirement for cultivating the Eternal Youth Technique.
Upon returning, she began transitioning to this cultivation.

But there were many areas she didn’t understand, so she consulted Ding Ling, whose mastery of this technique was Full Level, explaining from a commanding position, striking the root, hitting the mark.
Often enlightening Li Canghai as if she’d been infused by profound insights, opening up new understanding.
Her admiration and respect for Ding Ling increased daily.
She often marveled that if Master Xiaoyao saw Ding Ling, he too would surely exclaim that each generation produces talented individuals who replace the old!
In the blink of an eye, half a month passed.
Ding Ling finally completed the tenth batch of books.
After finishing reading, Buddha Qi rose.
[Wisdom +0.1]
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Progress 50%]
Leaping two percentage points from 48%.
Reaching this step.
The surface-level Secret Manuals of this world had been essentially drained by Ding Ling.
Bear in mind, each batch of books required Ding Ling to read for over a day, and sometimes two to three days.
Even for him, who read books like flipping pages, it took such long durations.
One can imagine the vastness of a batch of books!
To say that he had learned from merely five cartloads of books is to underestimate him.
Overflowing with literary knowledge, well-read, highly talented, these terms couldn’t fully describe his current strength.
Ding Ling saw that the time had come.
And began to call Xiaoo Feng, to discuss in detail the matter of succession.
For over half a year.
Ding Ling had been consciously cultivating Xiaoo Feng.

Xiaoo Feng was also a genius, with various guidance from Ding Ling, coupled with help from renowned ministers on the court, he excelled in both governance and military tactics, not the top but quite remarkable.
Most importantly, Xiaoo Feng was bold, open-minded, broad-hearted, perceptive and discerning, deeply loyal and righteous.
Ding Ling greatly appreciated such a person.
However, even so.
Xiaoo Feng was startled to not dare accept the position.
Claiming he’s Khitan, unfit for such a heavy responsibility.
Ding Ling said:
"Xiaoo Feng, what I value is your character, not your origin.
Besides, Khitan and Han people are family now.
Why speak of two families when you’re one?
As long as you love the country and its people, serve them, and strive to overcome obstacles and govern Jiuzhou with vigor and vision, why should you lack confidence?"
Xiaoo Feng was at a loss.
Ding Ling further persuaded him a few times.
Xiaoo Feng was ashamed, moved, knelt down, made a grand salute, and said:

"Since Your Majesty’s enthronement, understanding people’s talents, enforcing strict discipline, refining internal affairs, exhibiting grand demeanor, accepting honest advice, the country’s power has increasingly strengthened, surrounding small nations respect and submit through admiration!
I’m afraid I can’t achieve Your Majesty’s excellence."
"Afraid of what?"
Ding Ling smiled and replied:
"Since I took office, I essentially managed little.
When you’re bold and do well, you’ll make it.
I believe in you."
Xiaoo Feng’s experience as Southern Court King proves his capability.
Moreover, over the past half year.
Ding Ling assessed Xiaoo Feng multiple times.
Proven, indeed Xiaoo Feng was talented, apt to be a king, possibly a ruler.
"It’s settled.
Prepare yourself, succession in three days."
"Your Majesty."
Xiaoo Feng panicked:
"Please reconsider thoroughly."
"I’m about to ascend, what is there to reconsider?
Withdraw now.
It’s set."
Upon hearing Ding Ling’s impending ascension.
Xiaoo Feng was momentarily stunned, then suddenly understood.

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 562: The End of the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World! Sui and Tang Qin Qiong
paragraphs: Seeing Ding Ling insist like this.
Thinking about Ding Ling’s impending ascension.
Xiaoo Feng sighed, reluctantly saying:
’The world will miss having such a strong and caring emperor like Your Majesty; it is a loss to Jiuzhou, a loss to the people!’
Ding Ling did not speak, but waved his hand, signaling Xiaoo Feng to withdraw and prepare.
Xiaoo Feng got up and respectfully excused himself.
Ding Ling is still the Emperor now.
As a General of the Great Ming Kingdom, he must naturally show respect to the Emperor.
This is a matter of principle.
Three days swiftly passed.
Ding Ling smoothly abdicated the throne to Xiaoo Feng.
From then on, he became the Supreme Emperor.
Accompanied by his consorts Li Qinglu, Zhong Ling, and Mu Wanqing, he traveled to the Ancient Capital of Chang’an.
Li Canghai also followed along.
And so Chang’an.
Was designated as the second Capital City of the Great Ming Kingdom.
Symbolizing the home of the Supreme Emperor.
Ding Ling’s early abdication sparked immense controversy both in the court and among the public.
Because in the half year since Ding Ling ascended the throne and founded the kingdom, he accomplished numerous significant feats, surpassing countless past emperors.
Singlehandedly, he shattered four major nations, intimidating numerous small countries around him, expanding the Great Ming Kingdom to unprecedented territories.
Even as the Great Ming army was attacking the Western Realm, one nation defied the Ming by aiding numerous small countries in resisting the Great Ming Kingdom.
Outraged, Ding Ling charged thousands of miles alone, pierced the Western great nations, extinguished their royal families, and absorbed the entire nation!
This act intimidated even more countries.
No one dared to defy the sword’s direction of the Great Ming Kingdom!
Thus it began.
Nations paid tribute to the Great Ming Kingdom!
The happiness, pride, and belonging of the citizens of the Great Ming Kingdom reached its zenith!
Especially as the citizens of surrounding smaller nations competed to become citizens of the Great Ming Kingdom, the sense of glory made them proud to be part of it!
And when larger nations came to pay tribute, their reverent demeanor made the officials and citizens of the Great Ming Kingdom feel superior!
As if they were inherently higher than these foreigners!
All brought about by Ding Ling!
Thus.
Ding Ling’s abdication created an upheaval both among the public and in the court.
"I disagree with His Majesty’s abdication! I want His Majesty to live a long life! Reign for a century!"
Many people shouted loudly in Chang’an, Luoyang, and other places, their voices like thunder.
Zhong Ling, within the deep courtyard of the Imperial Palace in Chang’an, heard it faintly, glanced at Ding Ling, and said:
"Husband, listen. The people can’t bear to part with you."
Since he was no longer the emperor.
Zhong Ling changed her address.
This made her feel more at ease, as she wouldn’t be tense every day facing the Great Ming Emperor who could decide the life and death of nine families.
Now returning to a ’normal identity,’ she felt more joyful.

"Indeed. Husband may not be talked about for his governance, but in terms of martial arts, he is undoubtedly the greatest ruler in history! His presence is enough to make countless future emperors look up and worship!"
"Perhaps in a thousand years, husband will become a myth, a legend."
Mu Wanqing said proudly.
"Husband is already a living legend now."
Li Qinglu looked at Ding Ling with admiration:
"Husband, can you stay a little longer?"
"I’ve stayed long enough."
Ding Ling sighed deeply:
"It’s been almost a year."
He stood up tall:
"I’ll accompany you for a few more days. After that, I will truly leave."
Seeing Ding Ling insist.
Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing, and Li Qinglu had to use all their skills to attend to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling once again experienced the enjoyable life of an ancient foolish monarch.
Six days later.
The voices of the people grew stronger.
Ding Ling was incredibly surprised.
He thought these voices would gradually settle down.
Upon inquiry.
It was known that Xiaoo Feng, although decent, was far inferior in martial arts, insufficient to suppress the military, and even less to control all nations!
Nations were restless.
The people’s sense of belonging, pride, and safety began to decline.
Naturally, they hoped Ding Ling would regain power and restore them as proud citizens of the Great Ming Kingdom!
"So, that’s how it is."
Ding Ling felt relieved:
"Spread the word that I might return to the Lower Realm at any moment. If any barbarian state dares to rebel, I will extinguish their nine families upon my return!"
There were palace maidens and servants in the Palace of Chang’an.
These words quickly spread.
The world was lost in silence.
The restless nations quickly quelled their pursuits and became deferential to the Great Ming Kingdom once more.
Xiaoo Feng, who was overwhelmed and severely sleep-deprived, was astonished upon knowing this, admiring and gratefully moved:
"His Majesty just spoke and easily removed mountains for me, truly remarkable."
Xiaoo Feng rarely admired anyone this much in his life.
Ding Ling was the only one!
"With His Majesty present, everything prospers and pleases!"
"When he left, I felt beset by internal and external difficulties. Now with His Majesty’s words, I feel a sigh of relief as if the clouds parted and the moon appeared."
"His Majesty is a true divine being! I need to learn from him."
Xiaoo Feng said.
Xiaoo Yuanshan nodded deeply in agreement:
"Feng’er, the gap between you and His Majesty is vast. I am glad you have this mindset and attitude."

"Valuing self-awareness is important. I know I am far inferior to His Majesty in governance, martial arts, and talents in various aspects. How dare I be complacent? Proud? I must remain diligent, conscientious, and practical!"

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 562: The End of the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World! Sui and Tang Dynasties, Qin Qiong 2
paragraphs: On this day.
Ding Ling arrived at the Ten-Mile Pavilion outside Chang’an City.
Still the same location.
It hasn’t changed.
Ding Ling was also considering friends who would come after.
He didn’t want them to groping in the dark, unable to find the location of the Celestial Ladder.
[Task over-completed! Would you like to cash in the Glory Medals now? Proceed to the next level of the Martial Hero Plane World?]
Ding Ling clicked ’Yes’!
[Exchange successful!]
[Task 1. Defeat more than 20 plane strongmen 150/20. Gain Glory Medal 1. Glory bonus 750%. Final Glory Medals amount to 8.]

Originally it was 114, later he defeated first-class experts such as Duan Zhengchun, Duan Zhengming, Chuu Wanli, Zhu Danchen, and others from the Dali Kingdom and other small kingdoms’ royal and imperial households under the guise of sparring and guidance. It became 137.

It must be said. The experts of small countries are basically gathered in the royal and imperial households. Ding Ling considered this point, which is why he ordered that the subject small countries’ royal and imperial households must all settle in Luoyang; otherwise, the extermination of nine clans awaited them.
These royal and imperial households dared not resist and all came, which conveniently helped Ding Ling to farm Achievement Medals and task progress.
Ding Ling also took time to defeat various small countries and a big country in the Western Realm. It became 150.
[2, you must defeat the strongest in the plane. Prove that you are truly the world’s number one. Progress 100%]
[Task 2. Gain Glory Medal 1]
[3: You must make your reputation as the world’s number one resonate throughout the Plane World. 100%/100%.]
[Task 3: Gain Glory Medal 1]
The final number of Glory Medals obtained was: 10.
[Glory Medals settlement completed.]
[Would you like to open the Path of Glory now?]
Ding Ling clicked ’Yes’!
[The Path of Glory is about to open. Please choose a location for the Path of Glory.]
[Friendly reminder: The Path of Glory is the Heaven-Reaching Dao...]
The process was so familiar.
Ding Ling didn’t look much, directly selected, and clicked down.
[Confirm choosing the Ten-Mile Ancient Pavilion outside Chang’an City?]
Confirm!
[Selection completed. Cannot be changed!]
Boom!
The next moment.

The icy river descended from the sky, frost swept across Jiuzhou, accompanied by streaks of shocking lightning, the Celestial Ladder descended into the Mortal World, along with brilliant seven-colored rainbow light, destroying all impressions.
With an overpowering momentum, like a bolt of lightning, it fell at Ding Ling’s feet.
Ding Ling was too familiar with this.
After reminding Zhong Ling and the others several times, he stepped onto the Celestial Ladder.
Whoosh!
Stepping on the stream of light, he moved forward.
Soon after.
He once again saw the Gate of Glory.
[Congratulations to player Ding Ling for being the first to conquer the third level of the martial hero plane portal!]
[As the first person to conquer the third level of the martial hero plane. You will receive the following rewards:]
[1: An exclusive Martial Hero Plane World where only you can tread!]
[2: Gain one opportunity to return to the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World.]
[3: Reward of choosing the fourth level of the martial hero plane freely! Note: Only the first person to conquer the plane world has this reward. No one else does.]
[4: Reward includes carryable ascension items: 5 weapons, 5 sets of clothing, 5 mounts, 500 taels of gold. Note: Other ascenders can only carry one weapon and one set of clothing.]
Ding Ling shook his head and sighed.
Thinking: Just as I expected.
In his storage pouch, he already placed five weapons: Giant Que Sword, Drumming Golden Hammer, Gentleman’s Sword, broken Immortal Weapon Long Halberd, Green Pearl.
He entrusted the Heaven-Swaying Sword, Golden Snake Sword, Divine Wood King Tripod, etc. to Zhong Ling and others.
Comparing Immortal Weapon Long Halberd, Heaven-Swaying Sword, Golden Snake Sword, they were really not impressive.
Green Pearl felt very mystical to Ding Ling, so he kept it with him.
As for the Heaven-Swaying Sword and other weapons, if he learned better Artifact Refining Skills in the future, these Divine Weapons would be reforged by him into superior weapons.
But for now, he wasn’t impressed with them.
So he left them with Zhong Ling and the others as protective weapons.
For mounts, Ding Ling selected the two horses.
With a flash of light.
The Ferghana Horse neighed and appeared beside him.
Ding Ling continued walking forward.
[Fourth layer martial hero plane: World’s Number One, The Legend of Great Tang Double Dragons, Wind and Cloud World Domination. Choose one of three.]
Ding Ling chose Wind and Cloud.
Although there were plenty of opportunities in the other worlds, Wind and Cloud had many opportunities as well.
[Choice completed. Selection cannot be changed.]
[Would you like to spend 10 Achievement Medals and 1 Glory Medal to open the Gate of Glory?]
[Note 1: Once the Gate of Glory is opened, it is irreversible.]
Yes!
Thud!
Ten Silver Light Medals and one Golden Light Medal combined to form a three-colored array imprint, which quickly imprinted on the Gate of Glory.
Click!
The Gate of Glory opened.
What came into view were three very familiar Heaven-Reaching Daos.
Ding Ling was swept by golden light to the front of the Dao belonging to Wind and Cloud World Domination.
Along with him were two Ferghana Horses.
"This process, this special effects, this rhythm... it’s so familiar."
[The player is about to enter the Wind and Cloud World Domination plane world.]
[Before entering, would you like to exchange for Storage Space? Bone Treasure?]
’Yes.’
Thud!
Ding Ling once again saw that familiar Seven-Colored Glazed Chaos Counter.
This time he went straight ahead and chose to exchange for a True Pill Tier Two.
He spent 10 Glory Medals.
The pill was in hand.
Ding Ling swallowed it in one go.
After a while.
[Bone +1]
[Bone 6]
Hmm?
He remembered that last time the Tier Two Pill directly added 2 Bone points!
This time it only added 1 point.
"It seems the pill here also has drug resistance."
Ding Ling realized.
"It seems there’s no need to buy True Pills below Tier Two in the future."
But those above Tier Two, Ding Ling couldn’t afford them.
He could only save up now.
His current savings were:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 129, E-Level 23]
Originally, there were only 99 ordinary ones, 21 E-Level ones.

But those above Tier Two, Ding Ling couldn’t afford them.
He could only save up now.
His current savings were:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 129, E-Level 23]
Originally, there were only 99 ordinary ones, 21 E-Level ones.

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - 562: The End of the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World! Sui and Tang Dynasties - Qin Qiong 3
paragraphs: Later, by obtaining Achievement Medals from other small countries and completing achievements in major countries, he earned dozens more.

Even after exchanging for strength and returning to reality, and opening the Gate of Glory, he still had so many. However, it was because he had exchanged many times earlier, so the subsequent exchanges naturally required fewer medals.
[Glory Medal: 1]
Originally 12. Now, directly down to 1.
"As for the Storage Pouch?"
Ding Ling had two Tier Four ones.
He wanted to buy a Tier Five.
But couldn’t afford it.
Price of Tier Five Storage Pouch: 160 Ordinary Achievement Medals, 32 E-level Achievement Medals.
"Still a bit short."
"I’ll save it for next time then."
Ding Ling was determined.
Next time, he would still not be unable to afford a Tier Five Storage Pouch!
Ding Ling turned and stepped onto the Heaven-Reaching Dao leading to the World of Wind and Clouds.
[Player is about to enter the Plane of Wind and Cloud World Domination. Please prepare.]
[Countdown.]
Boom!
A golden light enveloped Ding Ling and the two Ferghana Horses, instantly transporting them to the end of the Dao...
Not long after Ding Ling ascended.
An expert stepped onto the Celestial Ladder, ready to venture into other worlds.
"It’s Qin Qiong!"
A player screamed.
This expert was a nine-foot-tall fierce man wielding a Tiger-Headed Gold-Inlaid Spear.
Mu Wanqing and Zhong Ling glanced sideways, recognizing the familiarity of this towering figure.

"I remembered, it seemed like we saw him near Wudang Mountain. At that time, he was riding a horse with the momentum of a tiger, heading towards us. My husband chose to avoid him, and thus he passed by us. Who would have thought he was actually Qin Qiong."
Ding Ling naturally had told Mu Wanqing and them about his grievances with certain individuals.
He also warned them to be wary of people from certain worlds.
Among them were Qin Qiong and others from the Sui and Tang World.
"It seems he is wise. He didn’t choose to oppose my husband, otherwise, he would have surely died."
Li Qinglu raised her head to look at Qin Qiong.

At this time, Qin Qiong also looked over at them, his expression extremely complex. When compared to the first meeting, it was even more intense, filled with resentment and struggle. Finally, he sharply turned his head and stomped up the Celestial Ladder.
Clearly, Qin Qiong knew he couldn’t defeat Li Canghai and others.
If he had conflict with Zhong Ling and them, he would surely die!
Although Ding Ling was no longer an emperor.
He was the Supreme Emperor.
The status of the women around Zhong Ling remained lofty, and the number of experts secretly and overtly guarding them was countless. Anyone who dared appear would essentially be courting death.
"It seems Qin Qiong hasn’t gained much fortune in this world and has given up staying here. Instead, he seeks opportunities in the Upper Realm."
Zhong Ling quickly understood:

"The resources of this world have been monopolized by the Great Ming Kingdom. And the Great Ming Kingdom is under my husband’s command. These people are marked blacklisted figures, naturally not welcome by others.
These people would be the first to leave when they see the Celestial Ladder appearing."
"Ah! It’s Li Xunhuan!"
Someone else screamed.
Li Canghai and the ladies looked over.
They saw a handsome and elegant man, with a jade-like face, eyes like bright stars, a nose like a hanging gall, and lips like painted vermilion, walking over.
He held a wine jug, walked to the Celestial Ladder, and greeted Zhong Ling, Mu Wanqing, and Li Qinglu, acknowledging them as the consorts of the current Supreme Emperor.
Zhong Ling and the others gestured for him to dispense with formalities.
The elegant man then smiled, straightened his back, and quickly ascended the Celestial Ladder using his body technique.
"This man is much more courteous than Qin Qiong."
Zhong Ling said.
"Li Xunhuan has no grudge against my husband, it’s normal."
Mu Wanqing said:
"Honestly, seeing them all ascend the Celestial Ladder, I really want to go too."
’I know you want to follow husband. But didn’t husband say he would definitely come back for us in the future? He asked us to await him with peace of mind. You’re not listening to husband?’’
Li Qinglu said.

Mu Wanqing immediately fell silent, but her expression remained somewhat gloomy. Her loved one had left this world, and now they were separated by the ends of the earth. She had no idea when they would meet again.
Li Canghai sighed and said:

"Let’s all go back. Train diligently. Strive to reach a higher Martial Arts Realm soon. Otherwise, even if His Majesty brings back better Martial Arts Skills, if your cultivation isn’t up to par, it will also be difficult to train."
The higher the level of the skill,
the higher the threshold,
the more requirements needed.

Zhong Ling and the others were naturally aware of this, and upon hearing it, their expressions became serious. They then immediately followed Li Canghai back to the Chang’an Imperial Palace and began their closed-door training.
And in this world,
with Ding Ling’s departure,
a number of waves stirred that month.
Some people’s hands began frequently reaching into various domains, attempting to subvert Great Ming.
These individuals were mostly highly skilled Ascenders from other worlds.
They all thought, ’If things really become impossible, then go to the Upper Realm! After all, there’s a way out.’
Therefore, they acted with impunity.
But the person they encountered was Xiao Feng.
A bold and decisive, no less brutal than Ding Ling, figure of grand audacity.
Once Xiao Feng caught wind of it and uncovered everything,
he immediately issued a deadly order to seal the entrance of the Celestial Ladder.
Anyone wishing to ascend must register and be verified before they are allowed to ascend!
Upon this decree,
the Ascenders who had been secretly stirring the pot were dumbfounded.
They had, of course, tried to force their way through under the dark of night, but failed miserably.
Under Xiao Feng’s fierce determination,
he directly gathered tens of thousands of Divine Archers at the Celestial Ladder’s entrance.
In this world, besides Ding Ling, who can block so many arrows from Divine Archers? Which other expert could stand against it?
At that time, quite a few experts were shot and killed.
With Xiao Feng’s order,
the Jianghu calmed considerably.
Citizens and officials alike silently praised Ding Ling’s discerning eye, recognizing the courage and wisdom of his chosen successor who had unparalleled decisiveness!

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 563: Full Level Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill
paragraphs: Snap!
Ding Ling landed in a forest, while the neighing of two Ferghana Horses echoed past his ears.
Ding Ling’s eyelids fluttered slightly, and he abruptly opened his eyes.
He promptly awakened from a state of chaos.
"Did I hit something during this ascent?!"

Ding Ling vaguely remembered that when the golden light enveloped him, piercing through various world dimensions at light speed, he faintly heard a loud bang, as if a violent collision had occurred with something.
He then fell unconscious.
Until the neighing of the horses rose, he suddenly awoke.
"What on earth was that?"
Ding Ling only roughly recalled it as a black light, extremely bizarre in shape and hard to discern with the naked eye, moreover it was just a fleeting glimpse, so he didn’t see it clearly.
He pondered for a while.
Without understanding it.
He decided not to think further about it.
Instead, he operated Soaring in the Void, leaping tens of feet high, landing lightly on the tip of a hundred-year-old tree, surveying and gazing into the distance.
About a dozen miles to the east, smoke was rising, presumably from a household.
To the west lay an endless and vast forest. The northern view was somewhat more open but was still obscured by a towering mountain at the horizon’s end.
The south was roughly the same.
Ding Ling then flew down, jumped onto horseback, and rode eastward.
Along the way.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel.
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 28 years old
Race: Human
Faction: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (Great Wei Kingdom)...Celestial Dragon Eight Books World (Great Ming Kingdom)
Occupation: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (First-Rank Prince)...Celestial Dragon Eight Books World (Emperor)
Level: 5 (Note: Congratulations to the player for leveling up! Only with the appropriate level...)
Strength: [Root Bone 6, Wisdom 7.4, Strength 80, Agility 80, Constitution 80, Defense 80, Charm 12.4. True Power Value: 21 points]
Weapons: Drumming Golden Hammer, Gentleman’s Sword, Green Pearl, broken Immortal Weapon Long Halberd, Tier Four Mortal Storage Pouch...
Mount: Ferghana Horse

Skills: Dragon Capturing Skill, Crane Controlling Art, Star Shifting, Canhe Finger, Returning Wind Willow Saber, Demon Suppression Saber, One-Character Wisdom Sword, Golden Snake Swordsmanship, Jade-Breaking Fist, Divine Transformation, Netherworld Ghost Claw, Turtle Breath Skill, White Rainbow Palm Force, Transformation Technique, Arhat Divine Skill, Bodhi Heart Method, Dharma Breath Control Technique, Vajra Indestructible Body Divine Skill, Iron Cloth Shirt, Kasaya Subduing Demon Skill, Shaolin Child Skill, Dragon-Taming and Elephant-Subduing Skill, As You Wish Bone Shrinking Skill, Supreme Demon Subduing Bead Technique, Eternal Youth Technique...]
[Achievement Medals: Common 129, E-rank 23]
[Glory Medal: 1]
[The Path of Glory in the World of Wind and Clouds has not been activated yet, would you like to activate it now?]
Ding Ling directly chose to activate it.
[Activation successful!]
[Given that the player has chosen the Path of the War God, the Path of Glory for War Gods is opened once again for the player!]
[The rules of the Path of the War God in this Plane World are as follows:
1: You must defeat more than twenty strong entities in the plane. The more you defeat, the more honor bonus you receive.
The rules were almost identical to the previous Martial World ones.
"Continuing on the path to becoming the world’s number one. This should be manageable."
Ding Ling recalled that the most notable opportunities in the World of Wind and Clouds are almost all within the Lingyun Cave of the Le Shan Giant Buddha.
His first destination was indeed Lingyun Cave.
"In Lingyun Cave there are Dragon Veins, Blood Bodhi, Proud Cold Six Formulas, Fire Qilin Sword, Snow-Drinking Mad Saber, Fire Qilin, Ten Strong Martial Dao..."
With so many opportunities.
Ding Ling found it impossible to ignore their existence.
"Better hurry to Lingyun Cave before players swarm into the Wind and Cloud world."
Once players flood in.
The storyline in the Wind and Cloud world will likely collapse.
It’s quite possible characters like Celestial Gate Emperor Shitian and other formidable persons will emerge early.
So time is of the essence.
"Oh right."
Ding Ling thought of something, quickly looking at the library in his mind.
Sure enough.
The ’Breathing Technique Secret Manual’ which was previously flickering and unstable was glowing again.
This time he chose the Human Emperor Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling gently closed his eyes.
In an instant.
[Human Emperor Breathing Technique Full Level]
[Charm +0.6]
Another breathing technique reached full level.

Combined with the earlier six techniques, now he had a total of seven great breathing techniques functioning alongside top-notch heart techniques like the Eternal Youth Technique, upon using Fusion Qi, piercing through mountains and stones became effortless, greatly enhancing the power.
"Indeed a benefit for Ascenders."
Ding Ling nodded secretly.

The Human Emperor Breathing Technique is also one of the top breathing techniques in the Three Kingdoms World. In historical planes, it is said that anything surpassing it is essentially one in a million.

The Sword God Breathing Technique, Medicine King Breathing Technique, etc., are also among the top breathing techniques, and they are on par with the Human Emperor Breathing Technique, each with their strengths. Some are sharper, while others excel in medical healing.
After mastering the Human Emperor Breathing Technique to full level.
A majestic righteous aura of emperors, imbued with incredible dignity, instantly enveloped Ding Ling!
Like a righteous and invincible emperor! Upright, magnanimous, grand!
"Besides this breathing technique, the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill also seems like it can reach full level."
Ding Ling moved his thoughts.
The flickering, uncertain Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill Secret Manual promptly manifested into a tangible form and landed on the shelf.
In the next instant.
[Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Strength +1]
[Strength +1]
[Constitution +1]
[Constitution +1]
[Defense +1]
[Defense +1]
Rushing primordial qi and spiritual mechanism surged in.
Quickly refining into Longevity True Qi, in just a moment, three strands of Longevity True Qi condensed in the dantian.
Besides that.
Ding Ling’s constitution and defense were skyrocketing.
In just two breaths.
Ding Ling felt like he was starving to death.
"This?!"
A thought arose in his mind, realizing a daunting outcome.
He suddenly remembered, whenever he improved his constitution or strength, he would feel significantly hungry, thus requiring timely energy replenishment.
Either chewing on Great Medicine or eating meat right away.
But now with the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill full level.
This advancement in strength and constitution was beyond the scope of ordinary cultivation techniques.
Causing Ding Ling to feel almost completely drained of energy in just two breaths due to the rapid enhancement of his constitution and strength.
His starvation felt dizzying, almost about to faint from exhaustion.
Ding Ling dared not delay, immediately using his Lightweight Skill to dart into the vast forest, catching a spotted deer, and then directly killing it to drink its blood and eat it raw.
Up to this time, his digestive ability was astoundingly powerful.
Consuming Great Medicine raw.
Merely required a slight technique operation to rapidly digest and absorb. Ordinary meat was naturally even less of a challenge.
Especially now with Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill at full level, his digestive power had surged to an incredible level.
Truly, any meat he consumed was instantly digested.
Even though at this moment Ding Ling had entered a ’Primitive Era’ of eating raw flesh and drinking blood, he was undeniably the strongest ’primitive man’!
No one could compete with his digestion.
The Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, a divine skill requiring thousands, if not tens of thousands of years to master properly.
Manifested its endless might upon entering this higher plane.
