chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 564: Advancement! Entering the City
paragraphs: The surge in digestive ability is one aspect.
The constant frenzied increase in strength, physique, and defense is the most critical.

No matter how Ding Ling speeds up eating meat and drinking blood, ultimately, he can’t withstand the severe backlash from the insane boost in strength, physique, and defense, and with a momentary blackout, he collapses uncontrollably.
Neigh!
The two Ferghana Horses guard Ding Ling, their eyes vigilantly scanning the surroundings.
They have traversed several worlds with Ding Ling, consuming plenty of Great Medicine, and have become sentient.
Neigh!
The urgent neighing wakes Ding Ling up again.
He abruptly opens his eyes, following the sound, only to see a fierce tiger battling the two Ferghana Horses.
The horses strive hard with their hooves, but they are no match for the fierce tiger, getting bitten with blood streaming, wailing incessantly.
Yet they do not retreat a step, firmly guarding Ding Ling. In an instant, Ding Ling understands what has happened and, without a second thought, points a finger, Six Meridian Divine Sword!
A streak of Sword Qi bursts from his fingertip, whoosh! It swiftly strikes and pierces the heart of the fierce tiger, which lets out a tragic cry before collapsing dead on the ground.
The two Ferghana Horses express joy in their eyes upon seeing Ding Ling awake, trotting to his side and stretching their heads to lick him.
Ding Ling stops them with a hand and presses it on the wound of the Ferghana Horse, letting Longevity Venerable Qi flow through.
The wound swiftly heals.
In no time.
The two horses are well.
They neigh in gratitude.
Ding Ling chuckles, glancing at the fierce tiger, then walks over to perform the Burning Wood Saber Technique, roasting the meat on the spot.
He still feels incredibly hungry.
There’s a sense of imminent starvation.
He looks at the character list.
[Strength +9]
[Physique +9]
[Defense +9]
Ding Ling’s pupils constrict.
The extent of this increase is too exaggerating!
It’s known that the Vajra Indestructible Body Divine Skill only adds +1 to defense.
Other Divine Skills merely increase by about 0.1, 0.3, or 0.2 points.
This time, each attribute increased by 9 points!
Ding Ling still feels his strength, physique, and defense continuously enhancing.
He glances at the prompt list:
[Strength +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
"It seems the surge was so fierce my body couldn’t handle it, triggering an auto-protection mechanism?!"
Ding Ling ponders.
It’s like someone overeating until their stomach can’t handle it, risking bursting;
Or like someone desperately training to boost muscle and strength in a short time, ending up injured.
The enhancement in Ding Ling’s strength, physique, and defense is hundreds, thousands, or even ten thousand times more astonishing than just a little muscle boost!
This is the root cause of his falling faint from hunger.
The increase was too intense.
If it had been slightly slower, it wouldn’t be like this.
Just like now.
Constantly growing strength, physique, defense, but at a much slower pace.
"It seems the library sensed my crisis and slowed down the improvement speed?"
Ding Ling subtly perceives and explores but finds nothing.
He decides not to overthink it.
Yet after experiencing this crisis,

Ding Ling comes up with an idea: in the future, when encountering skills like the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, which are game-changing, he ought to prepare Great Medicine and food in advance; otherwise, if the same thing happens, wouldn’t it be unlucky?

"Even two to three hundred years old Great Medicine only increases about 0.1 points. Plus, there’s drug resistance after enough consumption. This has increased a full 9 points. How much Great Medicine would that require? No wonder I fainted from hunger."
Ding Ling smiles in relief.
The meat is roasted to about medium-rare before he can’t stand the hunger and starts devouring. After eating, he still feels extremely hungry!
"It seems this boost has left me starving miserably. To completely alleviate it, I must consume enough Great Medicine."
Comparing the spiritual mechanism and primordial Qi contained in food.
The Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi of Great Medicine are evidently more abundant!

Ding Ling cannot find Great Medicine in the forest for the moment, so he activates Soaring in the Void, fluttering around the forest like a breeze. Upon seeing an animal, he kills, skinned, and eats it raw.
He consumes no fewer than hundreds of wild beasts.
He eats for a full day and night.
Only then does Ding Ling feel slightly relieved.
Though he still feels very hungry and weak.
He plans to look for more beasts, only to discover the forest is dead silent, even the bird songs are gone.
Obviously.
His blatant carnage in the forest scared nearly all the wild beasts away! Even those who didn’t run chose to hide instead of foraging now.
Ding Ling can’t find beasts and doesn’t bother looking, returning to the Ferghana Horses, and speeding towards the east.
He wants to enter the city to buy some Great Medicine.
The effects of consuming Great Medicine surpass eating flesh and blood by far.
"I also don’t know which time point we are in the Fengyun storyline now."
Ding Ling suddenly recalls.
It appears that 24 hours have passed already.
Players are all online now!
"I also don’t know how long I’ve been unconscious? If it were very long, players could have logged in even earlier."
Ding Ling sighs.
Had he known the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill was this monstrous,
he would never have improved it unprepared.
He thought the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, though stronger, wasn’t excessively outrageous compared to Toad Skill or Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
Yet this Cultivation Technique.
Indeed, peculiar like his unusually long cultivation years.

"Cultivating for thousands to tens of thousands of years to achieve Great Perfection. Ordinary Earth Immortals can’t reach Great Perfection. I’ve achieved Great Perfection directly. The physical body’s quality elevates constantly. It seems this Cultivation Technique alone might let my physical body quality reach the peak value of this world."
Ding Ling speculates.
The specific facts are unknown.
Clip-clop!
The Ferghana Horse’s speed is very fast.
Speeding all the way.
Along the way, passed a few villages.
Ding Ling inquired of a couple of passersby and, upon learning that there was a city further ahead, thanked them and sped up his journey.
After some time.
Reached the city.
Ding Ling carefully observed.

He noticed that this city was no different from those in other Martial Worlds, except that the local sects were even more rampant, with a flag waving above the city bearing the words: World Association!
It was evident that imperial power had declined to the extreme here.
Ding Ling recalled scenes from TV shows where the Jiuzhou Emperor was captured and controlled by Japan’s Godless Palace and felt at ease. In such a High Martial World, combat power was everything.
Facing Grandmaster Level masters.
Bringing in more soldiers would be futile.
This is why Jianghu sects gradually replace the declining royal power in this world.
Unless an unparalleled figure like Emperor Qin Shi Huang emerged, royal power would still be despised, disdained, and trampled by other martial artists.
Clip-clop!
Ding Ling did not see any players in this small city, probably because they were either more scattered or had gone to various sects to learn martial arts and become apprentices.
And there are three more worlds now.

New players have more choices, and since the Breathing Technique is no weaker than Inner Power, it is imaginable that players who have thrived in the Historical Plane would never give up their cultivation to come to the Martial World.
Yet, the number of new players compared to old players is much smaller, and with so many world choices, they disperse into various worlds and then into different parts of Jiuzhou.
In such a small city, there might only be a few players allocated.
Understanding this clearly.
Ding Ling stopped worrying, asked a few elder folks, and then rode straight to a large medicine shop.
Directly asked the shopkeeper how much Great Medicine they had and to pack it all up for him.
"Are you sure?"
The shopkeeper was moved.
"Hurry up."
Ding Ling took off a storage pouch from his waist and pulled out a hundred taels of gold from it: "You won’t be short on money."
The Ascension reward was 500 taels of gold.
Now it seemed it played its role just in time.
"So much gold.
The shopkeeper’s pupils constricted, but what really took him aback was that such a small pouch in Ding Ling’s hand could hold so many treasures!
Greed flickered briefly in his eyes.
Ding Ling saw it clearly but couldn’t be bothered to argue, only urged him to hurry up as he was starving.
All of Ding Ling’s weapons were placed in the storage pouch, and he would take them out whenever he needed them.
This was a habit he developed in his previous worlds.
Upon arriving in this world, the habit didn’t change immediately.
When he realized it, he inwardly sighed, thinking he was really too hungry to think clearly and didn’t know how to keep a low profile?
But considering the existence of players, Ding Ling’s intention to keep a low profile instantly faded.
Now, which player doesn’t know he has a storage pouch? Has treasures?
Keeping a low profile doesn’t help!
Thinking this way.
Ding Ling felt relieved.
Whatever comes will come.
But no matter what.
Soldiers will counter if the enemy comes; earth will dam if water floods.
Ding Ling feared nothing.
"Sir. Here is the Great Medicine you asked for, please check it."
Ding Ling received it, glanced casually, and most were 100-year-old Great Medicines, totaling fifty plants.
It seemed that gold was still quite valuable in this world.
Ding Ling asked if there were more.
The shopkeeper said only the owner had more. If Ding Ling didn’t mind, he could take him to the owner’s place.
Ding Ling frowned and turned to leave.
The shopkeeper called after him several times, but he didn’t stop. In a hurry, the shopkeeper immediately summoned an assistant and gave a few instructions.
After Ding Ling left the medicine shop, he started munching on the herbs.
As the Great Medicine was consumed one by one.

Vast Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi were rapidly digested, replenishing all parts of his body. The constant state of extreme ’weakness’ and ’emptiness’ in his body felt like a drought meeting a spring, instantly sweeping away much of that powerlessness and ’sickly weakness’ feeling.
[Strength +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
However, his physical qualities continued to grow slowly.
The Great Medicine he consumed eventually couldn’t satisfy his needs.
Soon after.
Ding Ling felt empty and hungry again.
Each 100-year-old Great Medicine could at most increase 0.1 Attribute Points.

But the quality of the 200-year-old Great Medicine was excellent, better than many in the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World, and the effects on Ding Ling were quite strong, increasing by 0.3 attribute points, with Strength, Constitution, and Defense each increasing by 0.1, totaling 0.3.
Normally, consuming Great Medicine would simultaneously increase the four-dimensional attributes.

But now, the growth of these three-dimensional attributes was too fast, leading to a serious deficit, so all the Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi in these Great Medicines were used to supplement these three-dimensional attributes.
"Still not enough."
After consuming enough Great Medicine,
Getting ready to go to the next medicine shop,
But unexpectedly, a shout came from behind.
"Young brother. Wait."
Initially, Ding Ling thought it was for someone else, so he ignored it.
Only when the person dashed in front of his horse to stop him did Ding Ling realize it was directed at him.
He recalled returning to reality, looking in the mirror, and seeing that his appearance had become much younger, like an 18-year-old youth, and felt at ease.
It had to be said about the immense effects of Longevity Venerable Qi, the Water of Eternal Youth, and Immortal Tree Bark.
It worked as soon as it was consumed back then.
Afterward, with the constant operation of Longevity Venerable Qi and the Everlasting Skill’s Longevity Qi, Ding Ling continued to grow younger.
This led to a reason why he still looked like a youth even in his twenties.
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling was surprised; the person before him looked impressive, with an extraordinary aura; he was evidently a middle-aged hero with a touch of elegance.
"I am Lü Yi, the Mansion Master of the Hero Prince’s Mansion."
Lü Yi smiled slightly and said:

"I heard from Shopkeeper Wang of the Hundred-Year Medicine Shop that a young brother spent a huge sum of gold just to buy herbs. Our Hero Prince’s Mansion has quite a lot of medicinal herbs, but I wonder if the young brother still has any spare gold?"

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 565: Hero Prince’s Mansion
paragraphs: "Of course there is."
Upon hearing the name Lü Yi of the Hero Prince’s Mansion.
Ding Ling suddenly realized, the current time point in the Wind and Cloud World should be before Kong Ci was beaten to death.
After Kong Ci’s death, Bu Jingyun killed Lü Yi and his family.
Lü Yi is not dead yet.
It seems Bu Jingyun has not come yet.
"Then, I invite you to visit my Hero Prince’s Mansion."
Lü Yi said with a kind face:

"My Hero Prince’s Mansion is the place with the largest storage of medicinal herbs within a ten-mile radius. If you want to purchase herbs, cooperating with my mansion is absolutely the most cost-effective and convenient choice."
"If that’s the case, fine."
Ding Ling nodded.
The cultivation of Lü Yi from the Hero Prince’s Mansion is at most a First-class Middle Tier.

Such a person can be crushed by just a finger, so what’s there to worry about? Since the herbs are in the Hero Prince’s Mansion and Lü Yi is inviting him generously, Ding Ling naturally feels too lazy to search elsewhere.
So, the two walked one behind the other towards the center of the city.
The Hero Prince’s Mansion is located right in the center of the city.
Numerous houses are built around the mansion, forming an Eight Trigrams layout to protect the Hero Prince’s Mansion.
Looking at the robust men coming in and out of these houses, it goes without saying, they are all minions gathered by the Hero Prince’s Mansion.
The Hero Prince’s Mansion covers an extremely vast area.
With pavilions and lofts linked to each other, adorned with mountains and pools, and lavishly decorated to every extent.
Upon reaching the main hall, a glance reveals carved beams and majestic houses, beautifully decorated beyond imagination.
Seeing the tip of the leopard through the tube.
The wealth and luxury of the Hero Prince’s Mansion is apparent.
Under Lü Yi’s invitation, Ding Ling sat at the left-hand seat in the main hall.
Lü Yi noticed Ding Ling’s calm face, showing no fear, and couldn’t help but secretly be surprised, thinking:

"Any ordinary young man would be attracted and overwhelmed by the splendor and luxury here in my Hero Prince’s Mansion; but this Ding Ling seems completely unaffected. Either he’s pretending, or his background must certainly not be inferior to my Hero Prince’s Mansion."
However, Lü Yi had asked Ding Ling along the way.
Ding Ling said his parents died early and he had no dependency in this world.
At that time, Lü Yi observed Ding Ling’s complexion and expression and roughly concluded that Ding Ling was probably not lying, so...
Lü Yi then gave a signal to his subordinates.
The subordinate immediately ran out.
Soon after.
A maid came holding a tea set and snacks, offering tea and water to Ding Ling, and Lü Yi also laughed heartily:

"Brother Ding, this is top-grade fine tea, sourced from deep within Tian Mountain, specifically gifted to me by the current Huixiong Gang Leader from the World Association; I’ve always been reluctant to drink it. Give it a try, it will definitely satisfy you."
Ding Ling watched without expression.
Once the maid poured the tea, he picked up the teacup, took a sniff, and suddenly looked at Lü Yi:
"Master Lü, what do you mean by giving me a cup of poisoned tea to drink?"
"Hmm?!"
Lü Yi’s face slightly changed, his expression somewhat unnatural, as he said:
"This is top-grade, exquisite tea, how can it be poisoned tea?"
"Hmph."
Ding Ling snorted lightly, unwilling to waste more words, he opened his palm, deploying Ice Collection Skill and Profound Ice Skill, instantly conjuring thin ice shards on his palm.
With a wave of his hand.
Over a dozen ice shards shot toward Lü Yi like meteors streaking through the sky.
"What is this?!"
Lü Yi was already on guard when Ding Ling questioned him, and upon seeing the attack, he was shocked, flipping himself away and swiftly drawing his sword to stab at Ding Ling:

"Ding Ling! You refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit. As Master of this Mansion, I regard you as an honored guest, and yet you dare show me disrespect. Today, I’ll let you witness the Hero King Swordsmanship, passed down through generations in my Hero Prince’s Mansion!"
Before the voice fell.
He had already mustered all his energy, executing the Lü family’s Supreme Skill.
At that moment.
The sky was filled with golden sword shadows!
Accompanied by majestic, overwhelming heroism, swords aimed at Ding Ling’s vital spots.

Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, not even looking, simply reached out and grabbed thin air; in just a moment another handful of thin ice shards formed in his hand, he waved them, and the shards flew toward Lü Yi like fleeting beams of light.
Clang clang clang!
As the sword shadows fell around Ding Ling, the ice shards shot at Lü Yi simultaneously landed on him.
Lü Yi did not evade, thinking his sword was surely stronger than these so-called ice shards!
But to his horror, when his sword struck Ding Ling, it sparked brilliantly, and with the naked eye, a fluctuating protective barrier enveloped Ding Ling.
"What kind of kung fu is this?!"
Lü Yi was in shock:
"So young, orphaned early, how could you have mastered such supreme skills?! Who exactly are you?"
Ding Ling did not answer.
He simply activated the Life and Death Talisman.
The next moment.

Lü Yi felt as though thousands of fine needles were piercing his vital points, involuntarily screaming miserably, and soon his entire body seemed to be covered by countless ants biting him, from head to toe, leaving no part untouched, itchy and painful.
Lü Yi couldn’t bear it.

Unable to resist scratching and clawing at himself, in less than a moment his whole body was covered in blood from his scratching, still screaming miserably, continually pleading with Ding Ling for mercy and crying for help.
When others in the Hero Prince’s Mansion heard the noise, they came over, all astonished and aghast at the sight.
A handsome, eight-foot-tall youth saw this scene, his face changing dramatically, shouting ’Father,’ he drew his sword and charged at Ding Ling:
"You scoundrel, dare harm my father. I demand your life!"

Ding Ling snorted lightly, the Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind’s Sound Wave Skill converged into a straight line, heading straight for the young man, and in the next instant, the youth’s eardrum burst, clutching his head and screaming as he fell.
Just from one snort.
The Young Master of the Mansion’s ears bled, screaming on the ground without stopping.
The others who had just rushed in from the Hero Prince’s Mansion inhaled sharply at this sight, hesitating between advancing and retreating, unsure whether to continue to die or retreat.
But Ding Ling wouldn’t tolerate them, following up with several more light snorts.
The guards at the entrance all toppled over, ears bleeding, pupils exploding, their fate unknown.

The maid who served Ding Ling tea was petrified, standing frozen in place, her complexion pale. Ding Ling glanced at her, which scared her to the point that her legs went soft, kneeling on the ground and knocking her head, begging:
"Hero, spare me, spare me."
Ding Ling waved his hand, signaling she could leave.
The maid was overjoyed, quickly lifted her skirt, and dashed out, as if chased by ghosts or gods, fleeing in a panicked yet swift manner, midway she stumbled due to rushing and fell over.
Ding Ling was indifferent, only to unleash the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, striking Lü Yi’s vital point with one palm.
The next moment.
Lü Yi felt a warm flow entering his body, instantly dissipating the original pain and itchiness like receding floodwaters.
He was both shocked and delighted, feeling around his body, but found no pain.
But recalling the previous unbearable suffering.
His heart chilled.
The look in his eyes at Ding Ling changed over and over again, filled with extreme fear.
[You have obtained the Achievement Medal: You have intimidated Lü Yi of the Hero Prince’s Mansion.]

[Note: Lü Yi heard Shopkeeper Wang mention your Storage Pouch and greed took hold of his heart. He immediately came to test you. Knowing you had no backing, he developed the thought of stealing by force.
He poisoned your tea and released another poison into the air.
Only when the two poisons mixed inside the body.
Would they activate immediately, making survival impossible, yet death unachievable!
By then, in order to survive, you would have to hand over your Storage Pouch and willingly become his lowly subordinate.
He thought this way, but you used his own method against him, letting Lü Yi suffer horribly, agonizing beyond endurance!]

sentences.text: "Of course there is."
Upon hearing the name Lü Yi of the Hero Prince’s Mansion.
Ding Ling suddenly realized, the current time point in the Wind and Cloud World should be before Kong Ci was beaten to death.
After Kong Ci’s death, Bu Jingyun killed Lü Yi and his family.
Lü Yi is not dead yet.
It seems Bu Jingyun has not come yet.
"Then, I invite you to visit my Hero Prince’s Mansion."
Lü Yi said with a kind face:
"My Hero Prince’s Mansion is the place with the largest storage of medicinal herbs within a ten-mile radius.
If you want to purchase herbs, cooperating with my mansion is absolutely the most cost-effective and convenient choice."
"If that’s the case, fine."
Ding Ling nodded.
The cultivation of Lü Yi from the Hero Prince’s Mansion is at most a First-class Middle Tier.
Such a person can be crushed by just a finger, so what’s there to worry about?
Since the herbs are in the Hero Prince’s Mansion and Lü Yi is inviting him generously, Ding Ling naturally feels too lazy to search elsewhere.
So, the two walked one behind the other towards the center of the city.
The Hero Prince’s Mansion is located right in the center of the city.
Numerous houses are built around the mansion, forming an Eight Trigrams layout to protect the Hero Prince’s Mansion.
Looking at the robust men coming in and out of these houses, it goes without saying, they are all minions gathered by the Hero Prince’s Mansion.
The Hero Prince’s Mansion covers an extremely vast area.
With pavilions and lofts linked to each other, adorned with mountains and pools, and lavishly decorated to every extent.
Upon reaching the main hall, a glance reveals carved beams and majestic houses, beautifully decorated beyond imagination.
Seeing the tip of the leopard through the tube.
The wealth and luxury of the Hero Prince’s Mansion is apparent.
Under Lü Yi’s invitation, Ding Ling sat at the left-hand seat in the main hall.
Lü Yi noticed Ding Ling’s calm face, showing no fear, and couldn’t help but secretly be surprised, thinking:
"Any ordinary young man would be attracted and overwhelmed by the splendor and luxury here in my Hero Prince’s Mansion; but this Ding Ling seems completely unaffected.
Either he’s pretending, or his background must certainly not be inferior to my Hero Prince’s Mansion."
However, Lü Yi had asked Ding Ling along the way.
Ding Ling said his parents died early and he had no dependency in this world.
At that time, Lü Yi observed Ding Ling’s complexion and expression and roughly concluded that Ding Ling was probably not lying, so...
Lü Yi then gave a signal to his subordinates.
The subordinate immediately ran out.
Soon after.
A maid came holding a tea set and snacks, offering tea and water to Ding Ling, and Lü Yi also laughed heartily:

"Brother Ding, this is top-grade fine tea, sourced from deep within Tian Mountain, specifically gifted to me by the current Huixiong Gang Leader from the World Association; I’ve always been reluctant to drink it.
Give it a try, it will definitely satisfy you."
Ding Ling watched without expression.
Once the maid poured the tea, he picked up the teacup, took a sniff, and suddenly looked at Lü Yi:
"Master Lü, what do you mean by giving me a cup of poisoned tea to drink?"
"Hmm?!"
Lü Yi’s face slightly changed, his expression somewhat unnatural, as he said:
"This is top-grade, exquisite tea, how can it be poisoned tea?"
"Hmph."
Ding Ling snorted lightly, unwilling to waste more words, he opened his palm, deploying Ice Collection Skill and Profound Ice Skill, instantly conjuring thin ice shards on his palm.
With a wave of his hand.
Over a dozen ice shards shot toward Lü Yi like meteors streaking through the sky.
"What is this?!"
Lü Yi was already on guard when Ding Ling questioned him, and upon seeing the attack, he was shocked, flipping himself away and swiftly drawing his sword to stab at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling!
You refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit.
As Master of this Mansion, I regard you as an honored guest, and yet you dare show me disrespect.
Today, I’ll let you witness the Hero King Swordsmanship, passed down through generations in my Hero Prince’s Mansion!"
Before the voice fell.
He had already mustered all his energy, executing the Lü family’s Supreme Skill.
At that moment.
The sky was filled with golden sword shadows!
Accompanied by majestic, overwhelming heroism, swords aimed at Ding Ling’s vital spots.

Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, not even looking, simply reached out and grabbed thin air; in just a moment another handful of thin ice shards formed in his hand, he waved them, and the shards flew toward Lü Yi like fleeting beams of light.
Clang clang clang!
As the sword shadows fell around Ding Ling, the ice shards shot at Lü Yi simultaneously landed on him.
Lü Yi did not evade, thinking his sword was surely stronger than these so-called ice shards!
But to his horror, when his sword struck Ding Ling, it sparked brilliantly, and with the naked eye, a fluctuating protective barrier enveloped Ding Ling.
"What kind of kung fu is this?!"
Lü Yi was in shock:
"So young, orphaned early, how could you have mastered such supreme skills?!
Who exactly are you?"
Ding Ling did not answer.
He simply activated the Life and Death Talisman.
The next moment.

Lü Yi felt as though thousands of fine needles were piercing his vital points, involuntarily screaming miserably, and soon his entire body seemed to be covered by countless ants biting him, from head to toe, leaving no part untouched, itchy and painful.
Lü Yi couldn’t bear it.

Unable to resist scratching and clawing at himself, in less than a moment his whole body was covered in blood from his scratching, still screaming miserably, continually pleading with Ding Ling for mercy and crying for help.
When others in the Hero Prince’s Mansion heard the noise, they came over, all astonished and aghast at the sight.
A handsome, eight-foot-tall youth saw this scene, his face changing dramatically, shouting ’Father,’ he drew his sword and charged at Ding Ling:
"You scoundrel, dare harm my father.
I demand your life!"

Ding Ling snorted lightly, the Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind’s Sound Wave Skill converged into a straight line, heading straight for the young man, and in the next instant, the youth’s eardrum burst, clutching his head and screaming as he fell.
Just from one snort.
The Young Master of the Mansion’s ears bled, screaming on the ground without stopping.
The others who had just rushed in from the Hero Prince’s Mansion inhaled sharply at this sight, hesitating between advancing and retreating, unsure whether to continue to die or retreat.
But Ding Ling wouldn’t tolerate them, following up with several more light snorts.
The guards at the entrance all toppled over, ears bleeding, pupils exploding, their fate unknown.
The maid who served Ding Ling tea was petrified, standing frozen in place, her complexion pale.
Ding Ling glanced at her, which scared her to the point that her legs went soft, kneeling on the ground and knocking her head, begging:
"Hero, spare me, spare me."
Ding Ling waved his hand, signaling she could leave.
The maid was overjoyed, quickly lifted her skirt, and dashed out, as if chased by ghosts or gods, fleeing in a panicked yet swift manner, midway she stumbled due to rushing and fell over.
Ding Ling was indifferent, only to unleash the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, striking Lü Yi’s vital point with one palm.
The next moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 566: Relief
paragraphs: "Mu... Much appreciated, Hero, for sparing my life."
Lü Yi respectfully bowed deeply to Ding Ling.
His attitude now was completely different from before.
No longer calling him ’little brother’ or ’Brother Ding’.
Gone was the lofty demeanor of a senior.
Ding Ling understood why, but did not expose him, simply saying:
"Bring me all the Great Medicine from your Hero Prince’s Mansion."
Now he understood why this Hero Prince’s Mansion was so prosperous.
Not only did Lü Yi pick the softest persimmons to pinch, but he also used poison to seize wealth! The caution and vigilance of the man were evident.
No wonder he could develop such a vast empire.
"Yes, yes, yes."
Lü Yi responded several times, then immediately went to the door. With a roar, subordinates promptly came to report, and he issued orders.
The subordinates headed to the Medicine Warehouse to transport the herbs.
Lü Yi dared not run.

He could feel the Ice Shards Ding Ling had placed still lingering in his body. He was extremely remorseful and regretful! Had he known the Ice Shards were so terrifying, he would never have chosen to face Ding Ling’s move head-on.
He respectfully walked to Ding Ling’s side, his attitude a complete turnaround from his previously overbearing demeanor towards his subordinates.
From arrogance to humility.
A hypocritical scoundrel!
Ding Ling cast a glance at him, internally defining Lü Yi, and sat back down, taking a gulp of tea.
This tea was indeed of top quality, containing plenty of Spiritual Vitality. Once ingested, it was immediately refined, slightly alleviating Ding Ling’s hunger and emptiness.
"He... Hero, you, you, you..."
Lü Yi was dumbfounded, incredulous.
"Heh."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly, offering no further explanation.
He was immune to all poisons.
Except for paralyzing or intoxicating poisons like the Intoxicating Bee or drugs purely for activating hidden bodily desires.
Otherwise, no poison could do him harm. The mixed toxins deadly to other experts were innocuous to him.
Yet Lü Yi could not understand this, momentarily doubting that the tea was poisoned, thinking Ding Ling had bluffed him, growing more frustrated for losing his nerve.
However, as he subconsciously poured a cup of tea, the dog at the door merely licked it before howling and collapsing dead.
His heart tightened at that moment, and his gaze at Ding Ling changed again.
He guessed Ding Ling might be immune to this poison!
"Father."
Lü Yi’s son, Lü Lian, ears ringing, got up at this point, standing behind Lü Yi, softly calling him.
Lü Yi ignored him, merely glaring at him, signaling not to act rashly.
Lü Lian, intimidated by Ding Ling, was filled with hatred, as well as fear and trepidation. It was inconceivable how a young man could possess such superior Martial Power.
Even the World Association’s No-Crying Death God Bu Jingyun and Wind God Leg Nie Feng might be far inferior to this youth!
[Obtained Achievement Medal: Intimidated Lü Lian.]
[Annotation: Though young, you surpass Lü Lian by hundreds or thousands of times, making him tremble!]
Collected another one.
Better than nothing. It could help in purchasing a Tier Five Storage Pouch.
The exchange for reality also required Achievement Medals, and Ding Ling found as many of them as possible to be beneficial.
After some time.
As people entered the Main Hall one by one,
boxes of medicinal herbs were brought in.
Splash!
Splash!
The boxes were opened, and all the herbs presented themselves before Ding Ling.
Ding Ling stepped forward to carefully examine them.
There were probably five or six hundred plants!
The Hero Prince’s Mansion, far inferior to the World Association in the Wind and Cloud World, surprisingly had so many herbs hidden.
Indeed...
Their money-making capability was exceptional!
Ding Ling stepped forward and directly began consuming the hundred-year Great Medicine.
The hundred-year Great Medicine was the most plentiful.
More than four hundred plants.
Eight large boxes.
Around fifty plants per box.
Ding Ling ate swiftly.
As he ate.
The Great Medicine could hardly provide much enhancement anymore, having developed resistance.
But it was no hindrance.
Ding Ling only needed the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi within them. He devoured them frantically, the crunching echoing endlessly in the Main Hall.
The people of the Hero Prince’s Mansion looked at Ding Ling as if an Immortal.
It was simply unimaginable that a person could consume over four hundred medicinal plants in one go?!
Such potent medicines, consumed in such quantities, and not causing harm?! Not afraid of excessive supplementation, causing blood to flow from all orifices and resulting in death?
But watching Ding Ling, full of vitality, looking increasingly spirited.
Lyu Yi and Lyu Lian felt chills in their hearts, growing more fearful of Ding Ling.
Consumed the hundred-year-old herbs.
Consumed the two or three hundred-year-old herbs.
The oldest herbs were four hundred years old, only three of them.
Consumed them all in one go.
The feeling of constant hunger and impending starvation for Ding Ling finally disappeared.
He took a deep breath.
Feeling greatly satisfied.
The backlash this time was too terrifying, luckily the Hero Prince’s Mansion came through in the nick of time, proving to be rare ’good people.’
Ding Ling glanced at them, saying:
"That’s all?"
"Isn’t that enough?"
Lyu Yi instinctively replied:
"Basically all the herbs from the surrounding villages are here with me."
But seeing Ding Ling’s cold gaze, he quickly shivered, wryly smiled, and said:

"Lord Xiong of the World Association also requires a large number of herbs, but the ordinary great medicines are useless to him, so whenever we harvest five or six hundred-year-old great medicines, we immediately send them to the World Association."
Upon hearing Lyu Yi say this.
Ding Ling knew that Lyu Yi seemed to have been secretly subdued by Xiong Ba long ago.
Recently, they openly raise their flags.
This might be due to the significant appearance of aliens.
Ding Ling did not think much about the rationale; he merely asked Lyu Yi to lead the way to the library.
Lyu Yi was puzzled.
But still led the way.
The library was located on the east side, majestic and imposing, with an ancient charm.
Books filled all four walls, containing no less than ten thousand volumes.
Ding Ling looked at the decoration and marveled at the wealth and luxury of the Hero Prince’s Mansion, but upon truly looking at the books, he felt a sense of mediocrity.
Though the library had many books.
Most were not as good as the top-tier collections from the Lower Realm.
Only a small portion could compare.
Nevertheless, it was better than nothing.
Ding Ling began reading in detail.
Reading the books like flipping through them.
Occasionally drinking some fine tea or medicinal wine.
These fine teas and medicinal wines contained Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi, which Ding Ling wouldn’t miss; he had Lyu Yi constantly supply them.
Lyu Yi watched Ding Ling drink wine and tea like water, shocked and simultaneously pained.
In his life, he had never seen a freak like Ding Ling!
Eating so much.
Drinking so much.
Yet his stomach didn’t seem to expand?
Little did he know that Ding Ling’s ability to refine Essence Qi had long reached an unimaginable level. Once the food and herbs entered the stomach, they were almost instantly refined clean.
Moreover, drinking too much alcohol and tea, he could directly expel water and alcohol through the acupoints and meridians opened by the Six Meridian Divine Sword.
Thus, half a day passed.
Ten thousand books were read.
[Wisdom +0.1]
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Body progress: 51%]
The progress increased by 1 point.
Wisdom increased by 0.1.
It was because that later, Ding Ling unexpectedly saw many excellent Confucian, Daoist, and Buddhist scripts!
These Confucian, Daoist, and Buddhist scriptures excelled in growing wisdom.
Unfortunately.
There were too few.
Failed to increase Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi.
"Just these books?"
Ding Ling looked at Lyu Yi and his son.
This library contained quite a few second-rate and third-rate martial arts secret manuals, reading them all to full level.
Ding Ling’s foundation improved somewhat.

But in his view, such a luxurious place as the Hero Prince’s Mansion was rarely seen even across the Fengyun World, places surpassing it should probably only be World Association, Unrivaled City, Godless Palace, and other superior sects.
Among middle-tier sects and factions.
The Hero Prince’s Mansion should be doing quite well; otherwise, how could it be so grand and luxurious?
Therefore, Ding Ling did not believe Lyu Yi had only these martial arts secret manuals.
"This is all there is."
Lyu Yi was secretly amazed at Ding Ling’s speed of reading.
Initially thinking Ding Ling was pretending, acting, as he read through. But as Ding Ling continued viewing, an inexplicable change occurred in Ding Ling’s aura.

He guessed that Ding Ling might genuinely have completely comprehended and even understood these books — astonishingly celestial — growing more fearful and regretful, realizing he had overlooked such capable talent!

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 567: Hero King Swordsmanship Full Level
paragraphs: "Are you lying to me?"
Ding Ling looked at Lü Yi expressionlessly and said indifferently:
"I have not seen your Hero King Swordsmanship from the Hero Prince’s Mansion."
"That is an ancestral secret technique."
Lü Yi sweated on his forehead:
"Cannot be taught without permission."
Ding Ling frowned and directly struck out a palm in the air, hitting the acupoint on Lü Yi’s body.
In an instant, it dispersed the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm power that had been previously unleashed.
The next second.

Lü Yi was again swallowed and overwhelmed by the sensation of being eaten alive by a million ants. He involuntarily rolled to the ground, starting to scratch himself madly, regardless of the blood oozing out, only incessantly screaming and begging for mercy.
Lü Lian beside him watched with cold sweat, looking at Ding Ling, his heart shattered, his legs went weak, and he fell to his knees with a thud, kowtowing:
"Hero, hero, I-I know where the Hero King Swordsmanship is hidden. I can tell you."
Lü Yi, now completely tormented by pain, couldn’t stop Lü Lian from leading Ding Ling out of the library.
He wanted to get up and chase.

But was tortured to the point where he couldn’t circulate his inner strength, only frantically scratching himself to alleviate pain, but ironically, the more he scratched the Life and Death Talisman, the more unbearable it became in the end.
Lü Yi’s screams grew louder and louder.
It could be said.

In the creation of the Life and Death Talisman, Ding Ling had reached the Transformation Realm, far beyond Heavenly Mountain Granny Wu Xingyun and others. Therefore, his Life and Death Talisman, unless a true supreme master or someone with extremely firm will, or someone with a special technique to restrain the Life and Death Talisman, if hit, would be worse than death.
Lü Lian, however, grew more fearful and terrified as he heard, not daring to delay, and under Ding Ling’s urging, walked faster and faster.
Soon.
They arrived at a bedroom.
After several explorations.
They activated a mechanism.
A key was ejected from the corner on one side of the bedroom.
Lü Lian used the key to open a small door at the back of the bed in the bedroom.
This small door was hidden by the bed.
Ordinary people entering wouldn’t be able to see it.
Even Ding Ling with top-level mechanism skills and secret techniques could overlook this point if not careful.
After opening the door.
Lü Lian walked in.
Ding Ling followed closely behind, entered the inner room, glanced around, and saw that this place resembled an underground space. All sides except for a small door were closed.
Inside, there were many gold and silver treasures, secret manuals, treasure manuals, divine weapons, and sharp tools.
Ding Ling chuckled.
Using the Dragon Capturing Skill, he plucked a treasure sword placed on a rack, drew it casually, clang! Carved on it were three characters ’Hero King Sword’!
"This is the ancestral treasure sword! Back then, the ancestor relied on it to shock the world."

Ding Ling used treasure appraising skills, materials identification skills, forging skills, etc., to finely sense it and found that this Hero King Sword was no less than the Giant Que Sword, an unparalleled treasure sword, with extremely special and extraordinary material, extremely tenacious in texture. Ding Ling flicked his finger, hearing the crisp sound of ding-ding-dang-dang, the sword bounced, but remained unscathed.

To know that at Ding Ling’s current level of cultivation, ordinary divine weapons would break easily with a single flick, this divine weapon remained unscathed, eligible to be classified among top-notch divine weapons.
Ding Ling casually carried it on his back.
The Giant Que Sword was too heavy and wide, inconvenient to carry, while the Hero King Sword, no less than the Giant Que Sword, was convenient to carry.
Lü Lian’s eyelids twitched madly upon seeing this, his face bitter, yet not daring to resist much, only obediently standing to the side.

Ding Ling looked at the other divine weapons again, although still decent, were far inferior to the Hero King Sword, only considered ordinary divine weapons, unworthy in Ding Ling’s eyes, hence he didn’t take them.
Instead, he turned and grabbed a box of gold, putting it into his storage pouch.
Walking the Jianghu, gold and silver are indispensable, it’s wise to be prepared.
Ding Ling approached a bookshelf, glanced over, only a mere four or five secret manuals were there.
He picked up the first one.
The cover had four striking characters: "Hero King Swordsmanship"!
Ding Ling quickly flipped through it.
After finishing it.
In an instant.
[Hero King Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Within the blink of an eye, Ding Ling completely grasped the profoundness of this sword technique.
Far superior to the Golden Snake Swordsmanship, incomparable to some top-notch sword techniques.

Once full level, activating the sword technique would naturally generate an overwhelming surge of heroic aura around him, which, combined with the sword technique, would make the sword righteous, unrivaled, and sharper.
Having learned this sword technique.
Ding Ling picked up the second secret manual to read.
Rustle!
Reading ten lines at a glance.
Finished quickly.
[Hero King Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Wooosh!
The surging spiritual mechanism and primordial qi came rushing in, engulfing Ding Ling completely.
The Eternal Youth Technique was activated, instantly refining this vast amount of primordial qi, and another strand of Longevity True Qi appeared within the dantian.
Previously, the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill at full level added three strands.
Making the True Power Value reach 22 points.
Now with one more strand, adding two more will increase the True Power Value again.

Lü Lian was utterly dumbfounded. Previously, he didn’t understand what Ding Ling was doing, but when Ding Ling finished reading the second secret manual, and the spiritual mechanism and primordial qi flooded over, engulfing Ding Ling, he instantly realized that Ding Ling must have mastered and comprehended this top-level heart technique.

He couldn’t help but be stunned. Unbelievable that such a genius existed in the world! At the same time, he understood why Ding Ling, so young, possessed such unfathomable cultivation, capable of easily subduing the entire Hero Prince’s Mansion!
"The Hero King Heart Method combined with Hero King Swordsmanship is indeed not weaker than the Nine Yin Scripture."
Ding Ling was moved!
At the same time, he realized why the Hero Prince’s Mansion could stand for so many years without falling!
With such supreme skills handed down through generations, if cultivated well, the future prospects are limitless.
It seems this Hero King was surely a person at the Peak of Innate or Grandmaster Level!
Ding Ling contemplated in his heart and continued reading.
The following three secret manuals were also first-class secret manuals.
Ding Ling finished reading all to full level.
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.3]
Compared to Hero King Swordsmanship, these three first-class secret manuals were much inferior.
But they still provided some assistance in enhancing Ding Ling’s strength.
However, because Ding Ling’s strength due to the full level of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill was already increasing constantly.
Now it increased so much all of a sudden.
He immediately felt hungry again.
He asked Lü Lian to bring some superior medicinal wine and good tea.
Lü Lian, a bit afraid of Ding Ling, awkwardly said:
"Hero, hero, you’ve already drunk all the medicinal wine and good tea."
"Can’t you go to the city’s pharmacy to buy some herbs and medicinal wine?"
Ding Ling frowned.
Lü Lian quickly realized and hurriedly complied.
Ding Ling casually reached into the void, grabbing a dozen thin ice shards, then with a flick of his hand, the ice shards shot into Lü Lian’s body like flowing light.
Lü Lian was terrified, his brain started feeling tied up, his legs went weak, and he knelt back down on the ground again:
"Hero, hero, hero..."
"Rest assured, as long as you work well for me, this Life and Death Talisman won’t activate within a year, or else a year later, you will be better off dead than alive."
"I will certainly devote myself wholeheartedly to working for the hero! Even if it means going through fire and ice, I am willing."
"Heh."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly, noncommittally saying:
"Go on. I’ll wait for you in the library."
Ding Ling went to the library and used the palm power of the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm to temporarily halt the effect of the Life and Death Talisman on Lü Yi.
Lü Yi no longer felt pain, in an instant, it was like he came back to life, he looked at Ding Ling with both dread and trepidation, saying:
"Hero, hero, kill or skin, I’ll comply, why torture me like this?"
"Without letting you see the power of the Life and Death Talisman, how would you know fear?"
Ding Ling coldly eyed Lü Yi:
"I want your Hero Prince’s Mansion to follow my orders. Become my spy, gather information and collect great medicines and secret manuals for me, can you do that?"
Lü Yi instinctively replied:
"I have already submitted to the World Association."
"Then so be it."
Ding Ling was about to disperse the palm power of the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm on Lü Yi when Lü Yi quickly said:
"I am willing to submit to the hero! In the future, I will only follow the hero’s commands."
’Very well.’
Ding Ling casually said:
"The palm power I left in your body can at most ensure the Life and Death Talisman doesn’t activate for a year. After a year, come find me voluntarily. To avoid the pain and death upon activation."
Lü Yi’s scalp tingled as he hurriedly nodded in agreement.
Once Lü Lian returned, Ding Ling drank dozens of jars of medicinal wine, and ingested sixty to seventy great medicines, only then did he feel much better.
Then.
He didn’t delay any longer.
Taking the map given by Lü Yi, he was about to leave the territory of Hero Prince’s Mansion and head to the Le Shan Giant Buddha.
Before departing.
Lü Yi, with an uneasy face, reported to Ding Ling about one matter:

"To curry favor with Xiong Ba, I sent information via carrier pigeon about master having a storage pouch to a World Association outpost a hundred miles away. If nothing unexpected happens, the World Association’s forces should be arriving soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - 568: Ice Soul
paragraphs: Ding Ling looked deeply at Lü Yi.
If he didn’t think Lü Yi was still somewhat useful.
Ding Ling would want to destroy him now.
However, Lü Yi’s reminder.
Did make Ding Ling think of the Ice Soul of the Hero Prince’s Mansion.
He asked Lü Yi to lead the way to where the Hero King’s body was laid to rest.
The Hero King’s corpse was placed in the ancestral temple in the backyard.
The person’s face was red and glowing, eyes bright and piercing, imposing without anger, just like a living person!
Ding Ling couldn’t help but secretly marvel, ready to take the Ice Soul.
Lü Yi knelt on the ground and begged.
Ding Ling ignored him.
He didn’t kill Lü Yi and Lü Lian, only because they were useful; otherwise, according to his usual temperament, these two would certainly be dead.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling used the Dragon Capturing Skill, grabbed in the air, and pulled the Ice Soul from the Hero King’s mouth.
The Ice Soul glittered brilliantly, shining with a dazzling blue light in the sun’s rays, resembling a Dragon Pearl shrouded in ethereal dreams.
And the Hero King, who lost the Ice Soul.
Instantly turned into ashes, scattered on the ground.
Lü Yi, Lü Lian knelt on the ground, disheartened.
Ding Ling looked at the Ice Soul, sensed it carefully, and seemed contemplative.
The Ice Soul was extremely cold, the most supreme yin and cold spiritual object in the world that could preserve a corpse forever without decay; just this effect was quite extraordinary.
And the fact that the Hero King possessed such a treasure shows how extraordinary his power was!
Thinking of the era of the Hero King, it was during the time of Nie Feng’s ancestor Nie Ying and Duann Lang’s ancestor Duann Zhengxian!
One fought the Fire Qilin for days and wounded the Fire Qilin!
The other similarly battled the Fire Qilin and forcibly took a scale from it, crafting the Fire Qilin Sword!
And it was in this era when these two were rampant on one side! The Hero King could still make a name for himself as the Hero King, showing his prowess!

Unfortunately, the Hero Prince’s Mansion has declined to Lü Yi’s generation, already setting with the sun. The Hero King Heart Method and Hero King Swordsmanship were extremely strong, but Lü Yi and Lü Lian clearly neglected their martial arts, not fully mastering them!

"No one dared to take the Ice Soul, presumably because of the Hero King’s residual power, but the Hero King has been dead for over a hundred years. Over time, his deterrence diminishes, and eventually, the Ice Soul will be taken by someone strong."
Ding Ling also knew the reason why the Lü Family would place the Hero King in this temple.
Hoping that the Hero King’s residual power could intimidate others.
So that future generations might enjoy peace.
Unfortunately, they later encountered Bu Jingyun, a ruthless man, and the entire clan was exterminated.
Besides.
The Hero King’s last words were effective, he personally said to place him in the center of the temple.
Ding Ling previously puzzled over why the Hero King would request this, but upon seeing the temple’s layout, it all became clear.
"This Hero King truly was a prodigious hero, is he trying to defy destiny, resurrect and return?"
Ding Ling saw the complexity and mystery of this place’s layout.
It could gather the vitality of heaven and earth, converge into the body, and over time, when the vitality is enough, it might be possible to resurrect!
"No wonder it’s openly placed here. But it’s a pity."
Although Ding Ling now understood thoroughly, he had no regrets.
Because if the Hero King resurrected and knew how he treated Lü Yi and Lü Lian, he might immediately turn against him and use suppressive means.
Since destined to be enemies.
Why would Ding Ling show mercy?
"There seems to be quite a few immortals in this Wind and Cloud World."
Ding Ling thought of Emperor Shitian, Xiaao Sanxiaao, Immortal God, and others.
Now there’s another, the Hero King.
"Truly a world full of talented individuals."

Ding Ling looked at the Ice Soul in his hand, it condensed into ice shards out of thin air, then used the Burning Wood Saber Technique to melt the ice shards into water, repeatedly washing the Ice Soul several times.
Then he put it into the Storage Pouch.
This Ice Soul is extraordinarily useful, if forging a Divine Weapon, the spiritual nature of the weapon will surely be very strong, not to mention possessing the supreme yin and cold attributes.
Besides, the place where the Ice Soul is, is a natural refrigerator, corpses can be preserved from decay, so dishes can naturally also be kept from spoiling.
Ding Ling turned to leave.
But after taking only two steps.
Ding Ling suddenly felt a very intense Blood Evil Resentment invade his chest.
"Is it transformed from the resentment after the Hero King’s death?"

Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly, accelerated the circulation of Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi, his body trembled slightly, faintly hearing a scream, upon sensing again, the Blood Evil Resentment had vanished without a trace.
’Bu Jingyun definitely doesn’t have Buddha Qi, Vast Righteous Qi. How long can he resist the corruption of Blood Evil Resentment?’
Ding Ling thought:

"Failing to resist will lead to madness. But Bu Jingyun’s innate talent is extremely high, his willpower strong, I think this Blood Evil Resentment won’t affect him. For others, though, that’s not certain."
Ding Ling left the Hero Prince’s Mansion.
Just blew a whistle, calling two Ferghana Horses.
A group suddenly ran out of the side passage.
Leading the group were three people.
One was seven feet tall, dressed in black, wearing a black crying face mask;
One held an iron broom, towering eight feet, looking fierce;
One was obese, hunched over, looking like an evil dog.
Behind the three were twenty or so burly men dressed in red, holding large sabers.
This group of people charged fiercely, anyone daring to block their way would be rudely knocked away or killed by them.
They were reckless, causing chaos on the streets, cries rising everywhere.
No one dared to curse or resist, they all retreated, or simply shut their doors tightly.
Thus.
Their speed was very fast, in no time, they arrived before Ding Ling, the fierce-looking man with the iron broom glanced at Ding Ling, arrogantly said:
"Brat, go quickly and call Lü Yi to see me."
His voice was loud, his gaze unruly, attitude brazenly arrogant.
Ding Ling ignored him, directly leapt onto the horse’s back, tightened the reins, maneuvering the horse around the group, intending to leave.
The fierce-looking man paused for a moment, then laughed angrily:
"Truly lawless! You’ve eaten the heart of a bear and the guts of a leopard. Don’t even recognize us, the Celestial Pool Twelve Fiends?! Kid, you’re tired of living, get down for me!"
The fierce-looking man’s lightweight skill was swift, quickly advancing behind Ding Ling, sweeping the iron broom heavily against Ding Ling’s back.
This sweep.
The wind was fiercely strong, seemingly intent on sweeping through the universe, exterminating all enemies, the void crackled loudly.
The fierce-looking man’s strike clearly came with the intention to kill Ding Ling.
Ding Ling frowned, the Protective Gang Qi operated all over his body, the Star Shifting Secret Technique activated.
As the iron broom struck the Protective Gang Qi Shield.
The Star Shifting showed its power, one spin, one shift.
The iron broom came back even faster than it came, from an inconceivable angle, with a loud bang, hit the fierce-looking man’s forehead, shattering it on the spot, he was dead beyond rescue.
"Iron Broom Immortal!"
The other two were stunned, each felt it was unbelievable.
How did Iron Broom Immortal hit himself to death?!

One was obese, hunched over, looking like an evil dog.
Behind the three were twenty or so burly men dressed in red, holding large sabers.
This group of people charged fiercely, anyone daring to block their way would be rudely knocked away or killed by them.
They were reckless, causing chaos on the streets, cries rising everywhere.
No one dared to curse or resist, they all retreated, or simply shut their doors tightly.
Thus.
Their speed was very fast, in no time, they arrived before Ding Ling, the fierce-looking man with the iron broom glanced at Ding Ling, arrogantly said:
"Brat, go quickly and call Lü Yi to see me."
His voice was loud, his gaze unruly, attitude brazenly arrogant.
Ding Ling ignored him, directly leapt onto the horse’s back, tightened the reins, maneuvering the horse around the group, intending to leave.
The fierce-looking man paused for a moment, then laughed angrily:
"Truly lawless!
You’ve eaten the heart of a bear and the guts of a leopard.
Don’t even recognize us, the Celestial Pool Twelve Fiends?!
Kid, you’re tired of living, get down for me!"
The fierce-looking man’s lightweight skill was swift, quickly advancing behind Ding Ling, sweeping the iron broom heavily against Ding Ling’s back.
This sweep.
The wind was fiercely strong, seemingly intent on sweeping through the universe, exterminating all enemies, the void crackled loudly.
The fierce-looking man’s strike clearly came with the intention to kill Ding Ling.
Ding Ling frowned, the Protective Gang Qi operated all over his body, the Star Shifting Secret Technique activated.
As the iron broom struck the Protective Gang Qi Shield.
The Star Shifting showed its power, one spin, one shift.
The iron broom came back even faster than it came, from an inconceivable angle, with a loud bang, hit the fierce-looking man’s forehead, shattering it on the spot, he was dead beyond rescue.
"Iron Broom Immortal!"
The other two were stunned, each felt it was unbelievable.
How did Iron Broom Immortal hit himself to death?!

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - 569: Full Level Roar God Manual
paragraphs: "Could it be this young man’s doing?!"
The masked man suddenly looked up at the young man, eyes filled with suspicion and uncertainty hidden behind the mask.
The obese, hunchbacked man was furious beyond measure, roaring at Ding Ling without a second thought.
Roar!
Mighty sound waves converged into towering waves, drilling angrily towards Ding Ling’s ears, as if to shatter his eardrums and smash his skull.
Ding Ling responded with a roar as well.
Roar!

Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind and Lion Roar Skill roared out simultaneously, as if the cold underworld descended upon the mortal realm, gusts of eerie wind sweeping the land, akin to the roars of lions and tigers!

The sound waves formed by such a Sound Wave Skill came out later but arrived first, shattering the opponent’s sound waves, then, with lightning speed, struck in front of the obese man and the masked man, amidst a series of cracking sounds, the originally menacing group all fell to the ground.
Among them, those with burst pupils and bleeding eardrums were not few.

Ding Ling considered that people from the Hero Prince’s Mansion might be of some use, so he held back against Lü Lian and others, but showed no mercy to this group, thus with a roar, dozens of people were all injured.
More than ninety percent were critically injured and near death.
Such is the power of a single roar, ferocity unparalleled.
The masked man and the hunchbacked man exchanged glances, clearly seeing the fear in each other’s eyes.
Ding Ling, however, was not accustomed to them, opening his right hand.
The Six Meridian Divine Sword swept across.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Sword Qi pierced through the air, penetrating even rocks with ease, how could these mere flesh and bone withstand it? In no time, they were all killed.
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidated Iron Broom Immortal.]
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidated Dog King.]
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidated Xibao.]

[Note: As experts among the Celestial Pool Twelve Fiends and top assassins of the world, the three were proud, considering only a few such as Xiong Ba worth their notice, even looking down on the likes of Lü Yi from the Hero Prince’s Mansion!
Your appearance shattered their perception, making them realize that peerless experts could emerge from the wandering youth of Jianghu as well!]
"So it’s these three?"
Ding Ling used the Dragon Capturing Skill, grabbing Iron Broom Immortal’s corpse from a distance, operating the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill! Storage Skill! Transformation Skill!
Whoosh, whoosh!
A surge of pure Inner Qi emerged from Iron Broom Immortal’s meridians and was fully absorbed by Ding Ling.
[Inner Power Value +92]
He was indeed a first-class top expert.

The cultivation technique he practiced was extremely miraculous, with high-quality Inner Strength, and seven-tenths of the impurities were refined by the Eternal Youth Technique, extracting nearly a strand of extremely pure Longevity True Qi!
Compared to North Nether True Qi.
The quality and level of Longevity True Qi are evidently higher.

Therefore, although Iron Broom Immortal, who is much more formidable than Murong Fu’s four great guards Bao Butong, Gongye Qian, and others from the Celestial Dragon World, absorbing his Inner Power Value was actually lesser.
After draining all of Iron Broom Immortal’s Inner Strength, Ding Ling repeated the process, grabbing Xibao, Dog King, and others’ corpses to absorb.
[Inner Power Value +90]
[Inner Power Value +85]
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +2]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Dog King had a stronger presence with 90 points of Inner Power Value, Xibao was next. The total Inner Power Value from others amounted to 35.
As he absorbed the Inner Power from these people,
two more strands of Longevity True Qi appeared in Ding Ling’s dantian. Combined, they formed a drop of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 23 points]
True Power Value rose once again.
Ding Ling nodded silently, thinking:

"This Eternal Youth Technique is indeed more advanced than the North Nether Divine Skill. The North Nether Divine Skill cannot absorb Inner Strength from corpses. Not so with the Eternal Youth Technique, absorbing even from the dead!"
This was something Ding Ling discovered by chance in a previous world.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have chosen to kill these people outright; he might have spared them.
But precisely because they were dead, as long as absorption was timely, Inner Strength could still increase.
That’s why Ding Ling didn’t hold back.

"Unlike the North Nether Divine Skill, the Eternal Youth Technique can absorb the Inner Strength scattered throughout the internal organs and meridians. Hence, even after death, if Inner Strength is promptly absorbed, it’s still possible to increase it."
If absorption is delayed.
Inner Strength dissipates from the corpse, then into the air.
Naturally, it would be difficult to employ.
But as long as Inner Strength remains in the corpse,
the Eternal Youth Technique can absorb it, placing it a level above the North Nether Divine Skill!
In essence, the Eternal Youth Technique is an upgraded version of the North Nether Divine Skill, naturally more extraordinary.
Ding Ling glanced at the dog lying beside Dog King.
This dog was extremely fierce, not at all inferior to a first-class expert, but under Ding Ling’s Sound Wave Skill attack, it was knocked down in the first wave.
Ding Ling used the Dragon Capturing Skill, exposing their torsos, most possessing only some bottles, jars, gold, and silver items.
Ding Ling had no interest.
However, a Secret Manual in Dog King’s possession drew his attention.
He pulled it over nimbly from a distance.
Seeing the three words on the Secret Manual: Roar God Manual!
Ding Ling quickly skimmed through it.
After finishing.
In an instant.
[Roar God Manual Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]

Instantly reaching full level, Ding Ling acquired another Sound Wave Skill not at all inferior to the Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind, and to some extent, this Sound Wave Skill was even more domineering and fierce than the Lion Roar Skill and Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind!
It’s just that Dog King’s cultivation was far inferior to Ding Ling’s.
Otherwise, merely with this Great Perfection level Roar God Manual, he could have roamed free in Jianghu.
Ding Ling, sharp-eyed as he was, saw at a glance that Dog King had achieved Great Perfection level cultivation in the Roar God Manual, clearly a talented individual, but unfortunately met Ding Ling.
Ding Ling shook his head, pulled the reins, and rode eastward.
His purpose was clear.
Le Shan Buddha Lingyun Cave!
Ten Strong Martial Dao!
Rumored to be a martial art created by Wu Wudi capable of defeating Emperor Shitian! Ding Ling must learn it!
[Strength +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
As he journeyed on.
Ding Ling’s strength, defense, and constitution continued to grow.
This was because the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill kept rendering effects.
This martial art elevated too fast for Ding Ling to endure.
Therefore, its escalating speed was considerably slower, but even so, accumulated over time, the improvement was not insignificant.
This also caused Ding Ling to feel hunger more keenly over a period, leading him to stop for meat, buy medicinal wine, and Great Medicine.
Fortunately, along the journey.
There were plenty of drugstores.
Medicines over three hundred years old were virtually unobtainable.
Even those over two hundred years were hard to find.

But those a century or decades old were purchasable. Ding Ling consumed such Great Medicine, not to increase Attribute Points, but to swallow and refine the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi within, to alleviate the void and hunger caused by the increase in strength, defense, and constitution.
He was not short of gold and silver, thus he traveled as a wealthy patron.

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - 570: Bu Jingyun
paragraphs: After walking so much, one sees a lot.
Ding Ling naturally discovered a fact.
That is, the area where the Hero Prince’s Mansion is located is indeed a rather prosperous place, where having medicinal herbs that are one or two hundred years old in pharmacies is quite common.
But in other cities, the majority of medicinal herbs are only a few decades old, showing the difference.
However, Ding Ling did not mind.
All he needed was the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi within them.
He frequently spent gold lavishly, and his reputation as a wealthy guest spread far and wide as he traveled.
On this day.
Ding Ling had just walked out of a small city, gnawing on medicinal herbs, refining the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi within them to nourish himself, alleviating hunger and fatigue.
Suddenly, a man, eight feet tall and carrying a coffin, walked towards him from the road ahead.
His face was stern, his eyes deep, and he emitted a cold and aloof aura that warned strangers to keep away.
He was staring at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling ignored him and chose to ride around him.
As he traveled
because of his reputation as a wealthy guest, he encountered numerous people who were either enthusiastic, disdainful, curious, or directly attempted to rob him of his gold.
He didn’t care about those who were enthusiastic or disdainful.
All he bought were herbs, medicinal wines, and Spirit Tea.

He wasn’t concerned with how others viewed him; after all, different people have different preferences. No matter how well one does, there will always be those who like you and those who don’t. Ding Ling naturally didn’t hope for everyone to like him and worship him.
What he pursued was not these things, but rather immortality and the path of invincibility under the heavens!
As a result.
Anyone who dared to rob him was easily killed by him.
Having killed so many,

naturally, no one dared to try robbing him again, and the journey became much more peaceful. This further proved the principle that in any world, the weak have no rights, and the strong are feared and cannot be bullied.
Kind people are bullied, gentle horses are ridden. This is true in reality, and in Jianghu, it is even more vividly demonstrated.
"Da da!"
The stern man carrying a coffin stepped to block Ding Ling’s path.

Ding Ling had tried to go around twice, and he blocked him twice. At this point, Ding Ling couldn’t miss that this person was here for him. Sitting upright on his horse, he glanced at the man and frowned, saying:
"Who are you?"
"Bu Jingyun!"
The stern man uttered three words.
"Hall Master Bu Jingyun of World Association’s Flying Cloud Hall?"
Ding Ling turned his eyes.
He truly did not expect to meet Bu Jingyun here.
"Yes, I am Bu Jingyun.
Bu Jingyun’s expression was icy and indifferent, his eyes glinting with a deep, cold light:
"But I am no longer a member of the World Association. I came to find you this time for Ice Soul."
He carried the coffin on his shoulder, supporting it with one hand, and extended the other hand towards Ding Ling, stating decisively:
"I want Ice Soul!"
"Why should I give it to you?"
Ding Ling felt baffled.
However, by this point.
Ding Ling realized that, barring any surprises, the one in Bu Jingyun’s coffin should be Kong Ci?
He hadn’t expected that Kong Ci would still die!
It seems Xiong Ba’s plan to sow discord succeeded. However, perhaps due to players’ intervention, Xiong Ba’s plan might be exposed prematurely!
But even so.
Why should Ding Ling give Ice Soul, such a divine object under the heavens, to Bu Jingyun, for no reason?
Just because Kong Ci is dead?
To let him preserve Kong Ci’s corpse with Ice Soul?
Ding Ling and Bu Jingyun weren’t familiar, so why?

If Ding Ling had met Bu Jingyun at the beginning of the game, he might have given it to him, but times had changed. Ding Ling had ascended through several worlds, dominating all directions, and had long developed an overbearing, confident demeanor.
He wouldn’t overly regard or favor the natives.
Naturally, he wouldn’t eagerly try to make connections with them.
"I want Ice Soul!"
Bu Jingyun said word by word, his eyes gradually turning red:
"You must give it to me, whether you will or not! I’m determined to get Ice Soul today!"
He had gone through so much trouble to find Ding Ling!
Having finally found him, why would he let go?
The most crucial thing is that Kong Ci’s body is already decaying.
He couldn’t delay any longer!
"Hehe."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly, shook his head, and maneuvered his horse to retreat three zhang.
Bu Jingyun immediately closed the distance of three zhang.
With his tiger-like eyes fixed on Ding Ling, his voice turned cold:
"Don’t force me to use lethal force!"
"So you want to rob me if I don’t give it. Bu Jingyun, you’re no more than that.
"Haha..."
Bu Jingyun laughed aloud, his single palm exerting force to gently push the coffin to the roadside. He used skillful energy, and the coffin landed lightly on the ground without any damage.
With no burden in his hand, his aura instantly surged, appearing increasingly extraordinary and formidable!
He stepped forward, and a fierce wind arose out of thin air, making his clothes flap noisily in the wind:
"Since reasoning doesn’t work, don’t blame me for being discourteous!"
Bu Jingyun suddenly directed both of his palms towards Ding Ling!
Cloud-Pushing Palm!
Cloud Flipping and Rain Covering!
Mountain Shifting and Sea Overturning!

With both palms striking out, the palm shadows flickered unpredictably, the moves tangled and complex. Each move of the Cloud-Pushing Palm Technique surged out with immense momentum, imposing a towering pressure, with palm forces pouring towards Ding Ling with a mountain-moving and sea-overturning vigor.

Ding Ling’s expression slightly changed, for he hadn’t expected Bu Jingyun to be so decisive and fierce, striking without hesitation. He didn’t accommodate Bu Jingyun and likewise struck out with his palm!
Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
Dark Clouds Without Rain!
Time Riding Six Dragons!

With one palm strike, dense, dragon-shaped Qi surged forth from Ding Ling’s right palm like a divine dragon descending, either executing Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing or Dragon Battle in the Wilderness. Every strike of dragon-shaped Qi clashed fiercely with the Cloud-Pushing Palm’s power, accompanied by crackling, thunderous sounds resonating across the sky.
In the next moment!

The Dragon Subduing Palm Power shattered the Cloud-Pushing Palm Power with unstoppable force, hitting Bu Jingyun squarely in the chest with a booming sound, causing him to vomit blood and fly backward. At that moment, a scroll also fell diagonally from his chest with a thud, landing on the ground.
Ding Ling’s eyes slightly brightened, and with a move of his hand, the Dragon Capturing Skill’s Vigorous Qi formed a claw, and from several zhang away, grabbed the scroll into his hand.
Ding Ling quickly unfurled the scroll.
The characters at the top caught his eyes.
"Holy Spirit Swordsmanship!"
It turned out to be Holy Spirit Swordsmanship!
Ding Ling was intrigued and without hesitation, placed the scroll into his Storage Pouch. However, at that moment, Bu Jingyun flipped over and again charged towards him:
"I want Ice Soul!"
He roared, with the Cloud-Pushing Palm Power endlessly surging, unpredictably changing, pressing down on Ding Ling once more.
This time, the Cloud-Pushing Palm Power condensed into a pair of giant palms, seemingly intending to crush Ding Ling into the ground!
It was evident.
This time Bu Jingyun used his full strength.
Ding Ling unleashed a Splitting Sky Palm and shattered the Cloud-Pushing Palm Power.
Then used a White Rainbow Palm Force!
Whoosh!
A brilliant rainbow light swept across the sky, turned in midair, and hit Bu Jingyun from an incredible angle, easily toppling him to the ground.
