Cloud-Pushing Palm!
Cloud Flipping and Rain Covering!
Mountain Shifting and Sea Overturning!
With both palms striking out, the palm shadows flickered unpredictably, the moves tangled and complex.

Each move of the Cloud-Pushing Palm Technique surged out with immense momentum, imposing a towering pressure, with palm forces pouring towards Ding Ling with a mountain-moving and sea-overturning vigor.
Ding Ling’s expression slightly changed, for he hadn’t expected Bu Jingyun to be so decisive and fierce, striking without hesitation.
He didn’t accommodate Bu Jingyun and likewise struck out with his palm!
Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
Dark Clouds Without Rain!
Time Riding Six Dragons!
With one palm strike, dense, dragon-shaped Qi surged forth from Ding Ling’s right palm like a divine dragon descending, either executing Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing or Dragon Battle in the Wilderness.
Every strike of dragon-shaped Qi clashed fiercely with the Cloud-Pushing Palm’s power, accompanied by crackling, thunderous sounds resonating across the sky.
In the next moment!

The Dragon Subduing Palm Power shattered the Cloud-Pushing Palm Power with unstoppable force, hitting Bu Jingyun squarely in the chest with a booming sound, causing him to vomit blood and fly backward.
At that moment, a scroll also fell diagonally from his chest with a thud, landing on the ground.
Ding Ling’s eyes slightly brightened, and with a move of his hand, the Dragon Capturing Skill’s Vigorous Qi formed a claw, and from several zhang away, grabbed the scroll into his hand.
Ding Ling quickly unfurled the scroll.
The characters at the top caught his eyes.
"Holy Spirit Swordsmanship!"
It turned out to be Holy Spirit Swordsmanship!
Ding Ling was intrigued and without hesitation, placed the scroll into his Storage Pouch.
However, at that moment, Bu Jingyun flipped over and again charged towards him:
"I want Ice Soul!"
He roared, with the Cloud-Pushing Palm Power endlessly surging, unpredictably changing, pressing down on Ding Ling once more.
This time, the Cloud-Pushing Palm Power condensed into a pair of giant palms, seemingly intending to crush Ding Ling into the ground!
It was evident.
This time Bu Jingyun used his full strength.
Ding Ling unleashed a Splitting Sky Palm and shattered the Cloud-Pushing Palm Power.
Then used a White Rainbow Palm Force!
Whoosh!
A brilliant rainbow light swept across the sky, turned in midair, and hit Bu Jingyun from an incredible angle, easily toppling him to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 571: Qin Shuang
paragraphs: Watching the White Rainbow Palm Force, exquisite and fierce like the palm of a Divine Being, about to ’smash’ Bu Jingyun dead on the spot, suddenly a person rushed in from the side, exerting all their strength to strike a punch!
Boom!

The Frost River Reflection rolled out, clashing heavily with the White Rainbow Palm Force in an instant, but in just a moment, the Frost River Reflection was shattered, and the White Rainbow Palm Force continued downward, Bang! Directly hitting the newcomer’s chest!
The newcomer groaned, involuntarily flying diagonally several meters away, spinning in mid-air, half-kneeling on the ground, face flushed, and spitting out a stream of blood.
With just one strike, he had already suffered serious injuries.
But regardless of his own injury, he covered his chest with one hand, raised the other high, and shouted loudly: "Hero, wait!"
Ding Ling looked at the newcomer.
Seeing his righteous aura and appearance, both strong and gentle, couldn’t help but ask:
"Who are you?"
The opponent’s fist technique earlier was filled with chilling air, clever and fierce to the extreme.
The newcomer surely has a remarkable heritage.
"I am Qin Shuang."
The newcomer stood up with difficulty, clasping his fists toward Ding Ling, a face full of shame and apology:

"I apologize to the hero on behalf of Junior Brother Yun. I hope you can forgive his recklessness. He was just too concerned about Kong Ci, which made him impulsively attack you. He absolutely did not mean to target you, hero."
"Celestial Frost Hall’s Hall Master Qin Shuang?"
Ding Ling was surprised.
Unexpectedly, Qin Shuang had been following behind Bu Jingyun all along.
It seems the players have intervened.
The plot indeed has changed.
"It’s me indeed."
Qin Shuang staggered to Bu Jingyun’s side.
Bu Jingyun had been struck several times, already severely injured, unconscious, muttering ’I want the Ice Soul’ ’I want the Ice Soul’ ’Kong Ci, Kong Ci, no, don’t leave me!’

Qin Shuang listened, feeling extremely sorrowful, and the camaraderie for Bu Jingyun surged in his heart, a mix of emotions intertwined, making his feelings for Bu Jingyun at this moment extremely complex.
On the wedding night.
The bride was killed.
The body was even taken away by his Junior Brother.

Such a blow is no less than a bolt from the blue. But Qin Shuang, after all, is not ordinary, and when he saw Bu Jingyun about to be killed, he couldn’t help but rush out swiftly, taking a White Rainbow Palm Force meant for Bu Jingyun.
He was puzzled earlier, wondering how Bu Jingyun could not withstand a casual palm strike from Ding Ling, being instantly heavily injured and vomiting blood!
But upon really encountering it, he realized the terrifying, overwhelming, and fierce power of this young man’s palm!
It’s simply not on the same level!
If he wanted to kill him,
it would take no effort at all!
Understanding this clearly, Qin Shuang showed extreme respect.
"Please spare Junior Brother Yun this time. I am willing to apologize to the hero on his behalf."
"What gift are you planning to offer as compensation?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
Although Bu Jingyun is passionate and overbearing, Ding Ling appreciates him, but the two are only strangers for now, so Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t condone him.
"This..."
Qin Shuang hesitated.
Suddenly realizing that he had nothing to offer.
He expressed as much.
Ding Ling then said:
"Your fist technique is good."
Qin Shuang froze, murmuring:
"This is my master’s unwritten secret, how can it be casually passed on..."
But thinking of Xiong Ba’s scheme.
Qin Shuang felt disheartened, as though enveloped in icy frost, his whole being seemingly falling into an icy abyss.
He sighed and said:
"The greatest sorrow is a heart that has died... I can give you the fist manual of the Celestial Frost Fist. Just please spare Junior Brother Yun’s life this time."
"Alright. Give me the manual."
Ding Ling was unconcerned about Bu Jingyun’s life and death.
What he cared about was the Secret Manual, about enhancing his powers.
"I need paper and ink."
"I have it."
Ding Ling glanced around.
Noticed the growing number of spectators.
Then said:
"Let’s go to a secluded place to talk."
"As you wish, hero."
Qin Shuang was respectful.
Realizing the difference between them, he dared not put on any airs in front of Ding Ling.
A while later.
Qin Shuang carried a coffin with one hand, and Bu Jingyun with the other, walked forward.
No one dared to block their path.
Obviously they had seen the battle earlier.

Though Qin Shuang lost, with just one Celestial Frost Fist Frost River Reflection, he could freeze everything; an ordinary first-class expert facing the Celestial Frost Fist would be instantly defeated!
These onlookers were mostly third-rate or second-rate Jianghu figures, only daring to watch from afar, not daring to get too close.
Until Ding Ling and the others were far away.
Only then did they erupt in loud discussions:

"I recognize that stern man carrying the coffin, it’s No-Crying Death God Bu Jingyun! Who would’ve thought that this No-Crying Death God, who has traveled the world for the World Association, would be heavily injured and vomit blood with just one move against that riding man! Who exactly is this man? He’s too formidable!"
"Indeed. Looks so young. Really can’t guess how he has trained!"
The crowd’s discussion continued.
Finally, a player hiding among the crowd couldn’t help but reveal Ding Ling’s identity.
All at once.
The crowd became even more tumultuous, unrest was rife.
Who would have thought Ding Ling was an Ascender, and the emperor of the Lower Realm at that! This is truly remarkable!
The player was even more shocked.
He was a new player.
Arriving he had landed in a small city’s martial arts gym, taking a local native as his master.
There must be several players like him.
But in this city, he was the only player!
If it weren’t for his curiosity bringing him here to watch, he might not have witnessed Ding Ling’s explosive scene of overwhelming Bu Jingyun and Qin Shuang!
"This is Jianghu, this is Martial World!"
The player was fervently excited, full of admiration:

"Ding Ling is incredibly strong. Even a Great God like Bu Jingyun was almost killed by him easily. I’ve only just started, not even as good as a third-rate expert, how many years will it take until I can, like Ding Ling, exact revenge and gallop across Jianghu? Smiling, proud wanderer of the world?"
The player fantasized, dreaming of the future.
Far from the crowd.
At a pavilion.
Seeing no one there.
Ding Ling leapt off his horse, taking out paper and ink from his Storage Pouch for Qin Shuang.
This paper and ink were bought by Ding Ling earlier when passing through some towns.
He had money!
Thus, he bought some essentials.
Pots and pans, paper and ink, guqin, jade flute, bow, and arrow; he bought some of each to be prepared.
After all, there were two Storage Pouches.
Not bought excessively, but enough to fit.
"Truly a Divine Object."

Qin Shuang paused for a moment, feeling increasingly curious about Ding Ling’s background, but dared not ask further, fearing Ding Ling’s disapproval. He simply picked up the pen, dipped some ink, spread out the paper, and began to write.
The Celestial Frost Fist is a powerful superior martial art that integrates External Skill and Inner Power.
Qin Shuang was indeed a straightforward person.
External skill technique mantra,
Inner Power Heart Method mantra, precautions all listed one by one.

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - 572: Holy Spirit Swordsmanship Full Level
paragraphs: "Hoo."
After Qin Shuang finished writing, he blew on the paper, and the ink dried instantly.
He picked up the paper and turned to hand it to Ding Ling:
"Hero. Here."
Ding Ling accepted it.
Reading ten lines at a glance.
Quickly.
With a new secret manual added to the library shelf.
[Celestial Frost Fist Internal Power Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Celestial Frost Fist External Heart Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]
Instant Full Level.
Rolling primordial qi surged in, overwhelming Ding Ling.
The Eternal Youth Technique took effect, quickly refining the primordial qi, resulting in an additional longevity true qi in the dantian.
Carefully perceiving his own body.
Ding Ling came to understand the fierce and awe-inspiring aspect of the Celestial Frost Fist.
No doubt.
This Inner Power Heart Technique is definitely among the most superior first-class secret manuals, rivaling the Hero King Heart Method.
A supreme skill is dignified thus.
If three skills become one, forming the Three-in-One Essence Qi, the power can be imagined.
The Inner Power Heart Technique is indeed excellent.
However, the external techniques of the Celestial Frost Fist seem to be incomplete.
Only eight moves.
Namely: Wind and Frost on the Face, Frosty Cold Moon, Frost Binding the Middle Sky, Frost and Snow Flying, Frosty River, Frost Marks, Frost Clarity, Wearing Frost and Dew.
Thinking of how Qin Shuang realized the ninth move after losing an arm, Ding Ling understood.

It is rumored that the Celestial Frost Fist is the strongest among the three supreme skills, and Xiong Ba left it incomplete as a precaution against his disciples, withholding one move from the Cloud-Pushing Palm and Wind God Leg, but six moves from the Celestial Frost Fist.
Ding Ling previously doubted its veracity.
Now it seems to be true.

Given Ding Ling’s current cultivation power and profound foundation, while he cannot create techniques, his perception and insight are unparalleled, and through careful perception, he determined that the Celestial Frost Fist is missing about six moves.
Ding Ling mentioned this to Qin Shuang.
Qin Shuang, shocked and bewildered, returned to his senses after pondering for a while and sighed:

"Junior Brother Yun sensed his Cloud-Pushing Palm was incomplete long ago. Although I reacted slower, when I practiced the Celestial Frost Fist to its peak, I still felt unfulfilled, so I knew for certain the master retained some moves from me, but I never thought he kept as many as six moves hidden."
His melancholy was evident.
Nie Feng and Bu Jingyun had only one move withheld, while Qin Shuang had so many, despite his utmost loyalty to Xiong Ba.
The greater the expectation.
The greater the disappointment.
The psychological impact was naturally greater as well.
"I must depart.
Having obtained the Celestial Frost Fist, Ding Ling employed Soaring in the Void, taking a Void Stepping to mount his horse, riding away without looking back, waving a hand:
"Qin Shuang, until fate allows us to meet again!"
Ding Ling admired Qin Shuang for being sentimental and righteous, fearless unto death.
His wife was killed.
Yet he could set aside past brotherly ties and charge forward to receive Ding Ling’s strike, even voluntarily revealing his supreme skill.
This courage and sense of duty far surpasses many so-called heroes!
"Until fate allows us to meet again!"
Qin Shuang had learned Ding Ling’s name, yet barely enough time to converse at length.
Merely watching his departing figure.
Falling into deep contemplation.
He thought, how had the Celestial Frost Fist ended up with Ding Ling, who mastered at an instant?!
Though Ding Ling hadn’t performed it.
But when Ding Ling reached full level, with the scene of primordial qi surging in, a sense of ’Extreme Cold Fist Intent’ from the Celestial Frost Fist arose, which Qin Shuang clearly perceived.
"Instant Heart Technique and techniques arriving simultaneously at Great Perfection."
"Such talent, extraordinary beyond belief."
"Perhaps comparable to the Martial Arts Myth, Elder Wuming."
Rumor had it Wuming’s talent in the Sword Dao was extraordinary, mastering any sword technique at first glance, excelling at second.
Yet even being so, achieving simultaneous Great Perfection in both internal and external heart techniques is likely difficult.
"Truly terrifying."
"Henceforth Jianghu may see chaos. With Ding Ling, this incredibly gifted youth, emerging. The master’s path to dominance may be disrupted."
Recalling Mud Bodhisattva’s predictions.
Qin Shuang found it absurd.

"What ’Success through Fengyun, failure through Fengyun’?! Surely the master sought to sow discord and killed Kong Ci due to this? Now with Ding Ling, such a genius in Jianghu, will he seek to kill Ding Ling as well? Can he even kill him?"
Considering Ding Ling’s fearsome, unrivaled nature.
Qin Shuang shook his head, immediately sat in meditation, commencing Inner Power Heart Method healing.
As for Kong Ci?
She is dead.
Let her return to dust.
However...
Qin Shuang couldn’t help but pick up a piece of paper Ding Ling threw to him upon departure, with a line written:
"Kong Ci’s twin sister Ding Ning: Placed by Xiong Ba as a servant in Godless Palace."
When had Ding Ling prepared this paper?
Qin Shuang knew nothing of it.
He inwardly marveled at Ding Ling’s mysteriousness, simultaneously feeling stirred:
"Twin sister Ding Ning?!"
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Stunned Bu Jingyun.]
[Note: Bu Jingyun swore to seize the Ice Soul but was seriously injured by your effortless strike. He was bewildered, astounded, unable to believe it!]
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Stunned Qin Shuang.]
[Note: Your martial power completely subdued Qin Shuang.]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: You earned Qin Shuang’s high recognition.]
[Note: Your talent and goodwill moved Qin Shuang deeply.]
On the road, Ding Ling heard the prompt sound.
Thought to himself:
"Now Bu Jingyun and Qin Shuang have stepped into the initial tier of innate. Within a few years, becoming Grandmasters and Great Grandmasters should not be beyond the realm of possibility."
Qin Shuang’s talent is not inferior.
Just that later opportunities hadn’t matched. If opportunities were met, he wouldn’t necessarily differ greatly from Bu Jingyun.
Ding Ling took out a scroll from the storage pouch.
Quickly flipped through it.
Shortly after.
[Holy Spirit Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.3]
This is a supreme sword technique.
Surpassing all sword techniques Ding Ling previously learned, rivaling only the likes of Dugu Nine Swords and a few other top-tier techniques.
It consists of twenty-two moves.
Sword One to Sword Eighteen, are swords of emotion!
Sword Nineteen to Sword Twenty-Two, ruthless and merciless, are swords of absolute dissociation!
In theory.
Ding Ling could never wholly dissociate, yet he still practiced this sword technique to full level.
With a single thought.
A surge of ruthless and merciless sword qi arose, straight to the heavens!
"No doubt aided by cheats."
Ding Ling silently praised.
If he were to train it manually, he could train until dying and still not master it to full level!
Learning it doesn’t guarantee mastery, mastering it doesn’t guarantee perfection, Great Perfection!
But Ding Ling achieving Great Perfection in an instant, skipped countless years of hard practice!
Moreover, all challenges were bypassed.
Simply said.
"It’s delightful with cheats."
Ding Ling thus mused, on horseback, using finger as sword, executing a few moves of the Holy Spirit Swordsmanship.
Unsusprisingly.
Sword One to Sword Eighteen, each move exceptionally fierce, swift as lightning, barely discernible to the naked eye;
Sword Nineteen to Sword Twenty-Two, loaded with deadly intent, exceedingly ruthless, one strike unleashed, cold and piercing sword intent shot forth, compelling the enemy to cower, retreat.
"Excellent."
Ding Ling was pleased.
"Having learned Sword Twenty-Two, learning Sword Twenty-Three would be perfection."
Ding Ling upon achieving Great Perfection in Sword Twenty-Two, naturally sensed Sword Twenty-Two wasn’t exhaustive, surely there exists an even more perfect invincible sword move!

The master’s path to dominance may be disrupted."
Recalling Mud Bodhisattva’s predictions.
Qin Shuang found it absurd.
"What ’Success through Fengyun, failure through Fengyun’?!
Surely the master sought to sow discord and killed Kong Ci due to this?
Now with Ding Ling, such a genius in Jianghu, will he seek to kill Ding Ling as well?
Can he even kill him?"
Considering Ding Ling’s fearsome, unrivaled nature.
Qin Shuang shook his head, immediately sat in meditation, commencing Inner Power Heart Method healing.
As for Kong Ci?
She is dead.
Let her return to dust.
However...
Qin Shuang couldn’t help but pick up a piece of paper Ding Ling threw to him upon departure, with a line written:
"Kong Ci’s twin sister Ding Ning: Placed by Xiong Ba as a servant in Godless Palace."
When had Ding Ling prepared this paper?
Qin Shuang knew nothing of it.
He inwardly marveled at Ding Ling’s mysteriousness, simultaneously feeling stirred:
"Twin sister Ding Ning?!"
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Stunned Bu Jingyun.]
[Note: Bu Jingyun swore to seize the Ice Soul but was seriously injured by your effortless strike.
He was bewildered, astounded, unable to believe it!]
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Stunned Qin Shuang.]
[Note: Your martial power completely subdued Qin Shuang.]
[Acquired Achievement Medal: You earned Qin Shuang’s high recognition.]
[Note: Your talent and goodwill moved Qin Shuang deeply.]
On the road, Ding Ling heard the prompt sound.
Thought to himself:
"Now Bu Jingyun and Qin Shuang have stepped into the initial tier of innate.
Within a few years, becoming Grandmasters and Great Grandmasters should not be beyond the realm of possibility."
Qin Shuang’s talent is not inferior.
Just that later opportunities hadn’t matched.
If opportunities were met, he wouldn’t necessarily differ greatly from Bu Jingyun.
Ding Ling took out a scroll from the storage pouch.
Quickly flipped through it.
Shortly after.
[Holy Spirit Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.3]
This is a supreme sword technique.
Surpassing all sword techniques Ding Ling previously learned, rivaling only the likes of Dugu Nine Swords and a few other top-tier techniques.
It consists of twenty-two moves.
Sword One to Sword Eighteen, are swords of emotion!
Sword Nineteen to Sword Twenty-Two, ruthless and merciless, are swords of absolute dissociation!
In theory.
Ding Ling could never wholly dissociate, yet he still practiced this sword technique to full level.
With a single thought.
A surge of ruthless and merciless sword qi arose, straight to the heavens!
"No doubt aided by cheats."
Ding Ling silently praised.
If he were to train it manually, he could train until dying and still not master it to full level!
Learning it doesn’t guarantee mastery, mastering it doesn’t guarantee perfection, Great Perfection!
But Ding Ling achieving Great Perfection in an instant, skipped countless years of hard practice!
Moreover, all challenges were bypassed.
Simply said.
"It’s delightful with cheats."
Ding Ling thus mused, on horseback, using finger as sword, executing a few moves of the Holy Spirit Swordsmanship.
Unsusprisingly.
Sword One to Sword Eighteen, each move exceptionally fierce, swift as lightning, barely discernible to the naked eye;
Sword Nineteen to Sword Twenty-Two, loaded with deadly intent, exceedingly ruthless, one strike unleashed, cold and piercing sword intent shot forth, compelling the enemy to cower, retreat.
"Excellent."
Ding Ling was pleased.
"Having learned Sword Twenty-Two, learning Sword Twenty-Three would be perfection."
Ding Ling upon achieving Great Perfection in Sword Twenty-Two, naturally sensed Sword Twenty-Two wasn’t exhaustive, surely there exists an even more perfect invincible sword move!

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 573: Lingyun Cave
paragraphs: But the Twenty-Third Sword has not yet been created even by the Sword Saint himself, so Ding Ling can only choose to wait for the right opportunity.
The current pressing task.
Is still to go to Lingyun Cave.
"The Twenty-Second Sword is now in Bu Jingyun’s hands, seems like this Wind and Cloud World has some connection to the TV series version?"
Is this Wind and Cloud World entirely based on the TV series? The comic? Or the original novel?
It’s hard to say clearly.

But from Bu Jingyun obtaining the Holy Spirit Swordsmanship scroll, it can be inferred that the storyline must have some relation to the TV series version, as after all, the comic version is about obtaining swordsmanship after killing the Dugu Sword Saint.
However, Ding Ling knows that the Dugu Sword Saint is not dead yet.
As for how deep the connection is with the storyline of the TV series version in this world, Ding Ling does not know.
He didn’t analyze further.
Because with the limited information now, it’s also difficult to analyze.
"Soldiers come to stop, water comes to cover. It’s still strength that determines the hero!"
Ding Ling’s mind was clear, without overthinking, he traveled all the way east.
Hurrying along quickly.
He finally reached the location of the Le Shan Giant Buddha in the morning hours of the day.
Looking around.

Seeing that the Le Shan Giant Buddha is embedded within a high mountain, majestically seated at the confluence of Minjiang River and Qingyi River, towering tens of feet high, equal in height with the mountain, feet stepping on the Great River, hands resting on knees, sitting solemnly by the river, it appears dignified and serene, with a compassionate demeanor, like a real Buddha that unconsciously inspires respect and admiration.
Not far from this Giant Buddha, a group of people were gathered at a wide mountain pass, but they did not enter, and instead frequently whispered to each other, pointing inside.
As Ding Ling approached, he listened carefully and learned this place was Lingyun Cave.
He couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, thinking he had finally arrived.
Listening again.
He learned that countless people have entered Lingyun Cave.

Especially some new players seeking opportunities, they swarmed in, resulting in ninety-nine out of a hundred being bitten, burned, or trampled to death by the Fire Qilin, and only a few lucky ones barely escaped the Fire Qilin’s chase, yet with nothing gained!
Not only players.
The local natives, upon hearing from the players about the abundance of opportunities in Lingyun Cave, also went crazy!
Each of them rushed over.
Now, hearing the commotion in Lingyun Cave, it was evident there were quite a few people inside!
Ding Ling was at a loss for words.
Thinking to himself, these players are really troublemakers!
Indeed, wherever they go, the storyline collapses!
"The plot of Wind and Cloud World has completely collapsed. It seems Emperor Shitian, Xiaao Sanxiaao, and others should have emerged too."
Ding Ling shook his head, not worrying further.
Emerging is emerging!
His Lightweight Skill was excellent, if he could win, he would fight, if he couldn’t, he would flee!
Moreover, he still had the option to visit other worlds, if truly pushed to the limit, he could go to other worlds to improve himself.
Therefore.
Ding Ling had no mental burden, for he had confidence.
Tap Tap!
Ding Ling forcibly squeezed into the crowd, reaching the entrance of the cave, stepping inside alone.
The Ferghana Horse was placed in a farmhouse several miles away, given some silver, and entrusted to an elderly man for care.
Tap Tap!
Ding Ling walked quickly, one moment at the entrance, the next, he was stepping the Ripple Step and disappearing like a gust of wind from everyone’s sight.
"So fast!"
"Such exquisite Lightweight Skill! Who is this person!"
A native exclaimed.
"It’s Ding Ling."
The majority were persistent players, for this Lingyun Cave could be considered the best place for defying fate.
Obtaining Blood Bodhi, Snow-Drinking Mad Saber, Proud Cold Six Formulas, Ten Strong Martial Dao, saying one can become a super expert in a day’s time would not be an exaggeration!
But evidently.
These new players weren’t capable, nor lucky enough to break into the depths of Lingyun Cave.
Especially some players, holding the mindset of ’If I can’t get it, neither can you’, spreading the word about the opportunities within Lingyun Cave, making heroes around the world aware!
This time the new players have even less chance.
And now seeing Ding Ling had come, they were both excited, dejected, and envious.
Excited to see the legendary super idol!
Dejected because with Ding Ling here, they had even less hope.
Envious of Ding Ling’s absolute power.
"Who is Ding Ling?"
A native asked confused.
The players proudly began to introduce:
"Ding Ling is also a member of the aliens, number one among our alien group! In terms of ability and talent, you could say that if he is here, none of you people stand a chance!"
Players were profoundly affected by the locals of this world.
Because the richness of Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi in this world far surpasses the Lower Realm.
As such, places were filled with third-class experts, second-class experts were as numerous as cattle, first-class experts were too many to count!
Only those who step into Innate are considered strong!
And as for the players?
The majority were new players, not to mention third-class, they weren’t even to fourth-class or fifth-class, naturally experiencing profound defeat!
Wherever they go, they are inferior.
Can’t even beat a bandit!

Precisely because of this, players were greatly despised by the natives, initially, the natives were somewhat bewildered and fearful of the sudden influx of information in their minds, but after truly interacting with players, they relaxed upon discovering the players weak and easily killed.
Thus.
Local natives look down on aliens.
Which made the aliens feel particularly frustrated and oppressed! They were players! And yet despised by NPCs!
Being looked down on by Nie Feng and Bu Jingyun could be understood.
Being despised by bandits, hooligans, ruffians, and even random minions, they couldn’t stand it!
But couldn’t stand it they must endure.
Because they couldn’t beat the other side!
Now suddenly within the player group emerged an illustrious Ding Ling!

Amidst jealousy and envy, players became excited and thrilled, as they suddenly found they had organization, a place to vent, now when they confront the natives, they were more confident, because one super powerful and invincible Ding Ling was on their side:

"Ding Ling’s strength is enough to overturn any of your factions, major sects! Trust me, you’ll understand Ding Ling’s prowess soon enough! I warn you, don’t underestimate the aliens, among us are heroes and strong ones too!!"
After being defeated for so long.
Finally able to proudly tell the world!
The aliens have organization, backing, idols, and heroes!
Ding Ling knew nothing about this.
He dislikes deep engagement with players.
Therefore.
Navigating multiple worlds, he maintained absolute distance from players, even when some pretty female players showed great favor, he pretended not to notice.
At this moment, Ding Ling had penetrated at least ten miles deep inside Lingyun Cave.
Twisting and turning all the way.
Ding Ling almost got confused.
Yet saw no sign of Blood Bodhi or Snow-Drinking Mad Saber.
He was bewildered, secretly pondering what to do when a person suddenly emerged from a narrow passage ahead.
This person stood at eight feet tall.
Broad and burly, with thick eyebrows and large eyes.
He carried an aura of Evil Qi, with a fierce expression, evidently in an extremely bad mood, just happening to bump into Ding Ling, he gave Ding Ling a glance and spoke directly:
"Kid, you look no older than seventeen or eighteen, daring to venture into Lingyun Cave. You’ve got guts!"
"It seems your age isn’t too old either. You dare venture, why can’t I?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
"What kind of onion are you to dare compare with me? Do you know who I am?"

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - 574: Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg
paragraphs: The eight-foot man glanced at Ding Ling with a wild expression and eyes full of disdain.
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling calmly asked.
"I am the Young Master of Unrivaled City, Dugu Ming!"
The man sneered at Ding Ling and said disdainfully:
"And who are you, what’s your name?"
Before Ding Ling could reply, he impatiently said:

"I don’t care who you are. In the entire Jianghu, the greatest powers are the World Association and my Unrivaled City. I’ve met the God of Capture, Xiong Ba’s son. Since you aren’t his son, why should I waste words with you? Tell me, what opportunity did you gain in this Lingyun Cave?"
He stepped forward, his face filled with rage, and said:
"My patience is limited. If you’re wise, hand it over immediately!"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly.
So it’s Dugu Ming.
And even he knows about the God of Capture, Xiong Ba’s son.
It seems a player leaked the information to Dugu Ming, and by chance, Dugu Ming encountered the son of Xiong Ba.
It appears this setting of the God of Capture as Xiong Ba’s son.
Is more closely linked to the television version.
Thus, whether the Immortal God and others will appear in this world, Ding Ling is unsure at the moment.
But since Dugu Ming has delivered himself here, Ding Ling wouldn’t be courteous with him.
Immediately, Ding Ling grabbed the air, deploying both Ice Collection Skill and Profound Ice Skill. Pieces of thin ice formed in his hands, and with a wave, he hurled them towards Dugu Ming.
Dugu Ming was startled, then enraged:
"You dare attack me! Seeking death!"

He jumped into the air, not dodging the ice shards Ding Ling threw at him, instead using his Supreme Skill ’Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg’. Dragon roars resounded instantly, and dense Dragon-Subduing Qi formed in the void, covering Ding Ling’s head from above.
The passage space here was very narrow.
Dugu Ming couldn’t avoid Ding Ling’s ice shards.
Ding Ling also couldn’t avoid his Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg.

But Ding Ling didn’t dodge his Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg either, he simply activated his Protective Gang Qi Shield. The Star Shifting technique was activated, and as the dense Dragon-Subduing Qi struck Ding Ling’s protective shield, the Star Shifting technique rotated and turned, bam bam bam!
The Dragon-shaped Qi instantly reversed, flying back with even greater speed, akin to the Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing, heavily hitting Dugu Ming.
Dugu Ming couldn’t react, was hit and flew back ten more meters, in mid-air, uncontrollably spewing out two streams of blood.
Bang!
He crashed heavily to the ground, kicking up some dust.
"How is this possible?!"

He looked shocked, clutching his chest, feeling a little breathless. His Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg he kicked out just now was like a vast ocean, fiercely powerful! Originally intending to finish the opponent in one stroke, but unexpectedly the Qi reversed, nearly kicking himself to death!
"What martial arts is this?! It can reverse my Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg through Star Shifting!
His pupils constricted, voice trembling slightly:
"Who exactly are you?"
Clearly, he recognized Ding Ling’s extraordinary nature.
Ding Ling ignored him, just pointed a finger in the air, the One Yang Finger shot forward.
Whoosh!
The Finger Force was like a sharp bolt of lightning, instantly hitting a pressure point on Dugu Ming.
Then Ding Ling activated the Life and Death Talisman.
In an instant.
Dugu Ming felt like being devoured by thousands of ants, numbing, itching, and pain surged throughout his body, reaching a peak, as if he fell into a frozen purgatory, truly worse than death.
He wanted to scream, but couldn’t, only gasping, rolling on the ground, madly scratching himself, soon bleeding profusely.
Ding Ling saw that continuing would surely lead to his death, so casually struck out with the Palm Power of the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm.
Slap!
The Palm Power sent remotely to Dugu Ming’s pressure point.
Not long after.
Dugu Ming felt the intense pain recede like a tidal wave, his entire being suddenly returned from the icy hell to the warm human world.
He broke out in a cold sweat, looking at Ding Ling with eyes filled with undeniable terror.
Ding Ling flicked a finger, and the One Yang Finger immediately unlocked his pressure point.
"Speak."
Ding Ling coldly glanced at Dugu Ming:
"Reveal the mantra of your Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg, demonstrate the moves. Otherwise, you’ll experience that taste of being worse than death again."
"You, you, you..."
Dugu Ming was both angry, anxious, and frightened:
"My, my father is Dugu Yifang, my uncle is the renowned Sword Saint. How dare you treat me like this, you..."
Ding Ling didn’t wait for him to finish speaking.
Casually struck a palm and a finger.
Dugu Ming fell to the ground again, rolling madly.
He couldn’t scream, only emitted gasping noises, a face covered with scratches he ignored, only painfully looking at Ding Ling, clearly begging for mercy.
Ding Ling once again struck with the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm to relieve his pain, then pointed the One Yang Finger to unlock his pressure point.
"Are you going to speak or not?"
"I will, I’ll speak."
Dugu Ming was drenched, like he was fished out of the water, having walked several times at the gate of hell, utterly shocked and terrified.
Life and Death Talisman!
Especially driven by the Great Perfection Innate Ability of the Eternal Youth Technique, the power of the Life and Death Talisman reaches its peak!
Enough to make someone endure the ninefold heaven of icy fires purgatory and unable to escape from it!
Calling it a real torture is not an exaggeration at all.
"Speak."
Ding Ling, hands behind his back, said indifferently.
Dugu Ming wanted him dead.
How could Ding Ling be lenient with him, naturally intending to drain him dry and then kill him.

At this moment, Dugu Ming couldn’t care about what Ding Ling would do to him later, but was being tormented by the Life and Death Talisman, his heart trembling, his mind instinctively fearing and resisting that ultimate ’torture!’
Obediently reciting and demonstrating the mantra and techniques of the Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg.
Just once.
[Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg Inner Power Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
This Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg is surprisingly a top-tier technique combining both Inner and External Skills.
Not inferior to the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
In fact, it resembles the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms in many aspects.
Just that the upper limit of this world is noticeably higher than the Lower Realm, thus this Heart Technique’s power potential is also extreme.
But Dugu Ming hasn’t fully mastered this technique, making it seem like this Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg is mediocre.

It’s just like, the same Kung Fu, used by different people, the power is definitely different; some people have just reached the Initial Tier, while others are at Great Perfection, naturally the power used is different!
Hoo hoo!
Rolling Primordial Qi surged in, engulfing Ding Ling.
The Eternal Youth Technique slightly activated, quickly refining this Primordial Spirit, transforming into Longevity Qi.
Combined with the previous two.
Three combined, forming a drop of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 24 points]

He wanted to scream, but couldn’t, only gasping, rolling on the ground, madly scratching himself, soon bleeding profusely.
Ding Ling saw that continuing would surely lead to his death, so casually struck out with the Palm Power of the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm.
Slap!
The Palm Power sent remotely to Dugu Ming’s pressure point.
Not long after.
Dugu Ming felt the intense pain recede like a tidal wave, his entire being suddenly returned from the icy hell to the warm human world.
He broke out in a cold sweat, looking at Ding Ling with eyes filled with undeniable terror.
Ding Ling flicked a finger, and the One Yang Finger immediately unlocked his pressure point.
"Speak."
Ding Ling coldly glanced at Dugu Ming:
"Reveal the mantra of your Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg, demonstrate the moves.
Otherwise, you’ll experience that taste of being worse than death again."
"You, you, you..."
Dugu Ming was both angry, anxious, and frightened:
"My, my father is Dugu Yifang, my uncle is the renowned Sword Saint.
How dare you treat me like this, you..."
Ding Ling didn’t wait for him to finish speaking.
Casually struck a palm and a finger.
Dugu Ming fell to the ground again, rolling madly.
He couldn’t scream, only emitted gasping noises, a face covered with scratches he ignored, only painfully looking at Ding Ling, clearly begging for mercy.
Ding Ling once again struck with the Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm to relieve his pain, then pointed the One Yang Finger to unlock his pressure point.
"Are you going to speak or not?"
"I will, I’ll speak."
Dugu Ming was drenched, like he was fished out of the water, having walked several times at the gate of hell, utterly shocked and terrified.
Life and Death Talisman!
Especially driven by the Great Perfection Innate Ability of the Eternal Youth Technique, the power of the Life and Death Talisman reaches its peak!
Enough to make someone endure the ninefold heaven of icy fires purgatory and unable to escape from it!
Calling it a real torture is not an exaggeration at all.
"Speak."
Ding Ling, hands behind his back, said indifferently.
Dugu Ming wanted him dead.
How could Ding Ling be lenient with him, naturally intending to drain him dry and then kill him.

At this moment, Dugu Ming couldn’t care about what Ding Ling would do to him later, but was being tormented by the Life and Death Talisman, his heart trembling, his mind instinctively fearing and resisting that ultimate ’torture!’
Obediently reciting and demonstrating the mantra and techniques of the Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg.
Just once.
[Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg Inner Power Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
This Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg is surprisingly a top-tier technique combining both Inner and External Skills.
Not inferior to the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
In fact, it resembles the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms in many aspects.
Just that the upper limit of this world is noticeably higher than the Lower Realm, thus this Heart Technique’s power potential is also extreme.
But Dugu Ming hasn’t fully mastered this technique, making it seem like this Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg is mediocre.

It’s just like, the same Kung Fu, used by different people, the power is definitely different; some people have just reached the Initial Tier, while others are at Great Perfection, naturally the power used is different!
Hoo hoo!
Rolling Primordial Qi surged in, engulfing Ding Ling.
The Eternal Youth Technique slightly activated, quickly refining this Primordial Spirit, transforming into Longevity Qi.
Combined with the previous two.
Three combined, forming a drop of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 24 points]

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - 575: Shi Wuzun
paragraphs: The True Power Value had increased again.
The increase in True Power Value.
Made Ding Ling’s aura even more profound and vast, a fleeting wave of terrifying vigor swept out, shaking Dugu Ming to his core, horrified beyond measure.

"How, how, how can this person’s aura be so terrifying?! More powerful than my father?! He’s so young, how is it possible?! Not even Bu Jingyun of the World Association or Nie Feng of the Divine Wind Hall were this formidable! How did he achieve this?!"
Dugu Ming had witnessed it all just now.
Even though Ding Ling had not demonstrated any techniques.
The swirling Primordial Qi was refined.
The condensation and eruption of Dragon-subduing True Intent on his body was perceived clearly and distinctly.
In sheer amazement, he was stunned, awestruck as if by a Ghost God, shivering all over, his soul detached from his body:
"This person’s talent is truly inconceivable!"
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidated Dugu Ming.]
[Annotation: Your power and talent, terrified his spirit!]
Upon hearing the prompt, Ding Ling instinctively performed the Dragon Capturing Skill, grabbing Dugu Ming from afar, naturally exerting the Eternal Youth Technique!
Absorption Skill! Transformation Skill! Storage Skill!
In an instant.
Dugu Ming’s Inner Strength was drained and refined.
[Inner Power Value +98]
His Inner Strength was exceedingly formidable, much stronger than Xibao and Iron Broom Immortal among the Celestial Pool Twelve Fiends.
However, due to the high level and quality of the Longevity True Qi.
Dugu Ming’s Inner Strength was ultimately transformed into a strand of Longevity True Qi.
"You, you..."
Dugu Ming screamed in disbelief, staring at Ding Ling with shock.
He couldn’t fathom that someone in this world could possess martial arts capable of absorbing others’ Inner Strength for their own use!
Pa!
Ding Ling directly executed the Heart-Pushing Palm.
Peng, with a soft resonance, the Palm Force shattered Dugu Ming’s heart.
Dugu Ming’s body went limp, slumping to the ground, dead but unyielding.
For someone like Dugu Ming, raised in opulence, arrogant and tyrannical as a ’Young City Lord’, Ding Ling lacked patience to engage with him.
Even if used for his own purposes, this fellow was unlikely to thrive or truly deliver effectiveness.
If that’s the case.
It was naturally simplest to kill him.
Otherwise, if the Sword Saint learned of his grudge with Dugu Ming, obtaining the Twenty-Third Sword would become considerably more difficult!
With this thought.
Ding Ling was about to leave the area.
Unexpectedly, just as he was leaving the passage where Dugu Ming had emerged, another person appeared.
This person came swiftly, evidently sensing something and ran fast.
But upon nearing, seeing Dugu Ming lying dead on the ground, his expression changed dramatically, looking at Ding Ling with a suddenly cold voice:
"Did you kill the Young City Lord?"
This person’s figure was upright, waist rigid, short-haired, wearing a kasaya, dressed as a monk.
Appearing kind and gentle, but the harshness in his gaze was quite evident at the moment.
"Indeed."
The evidence was plain, hard to conceal, and Ding Ling had no intention of hiding it, so he said:
"Who might you be?"
"Amitabha Buddha."
The man joined his palms together, saying:
"The monk, named Shi Wuzun, is now added as a Guardian of Unrivaled City. Boy, you killed the Young City Lord, I must take you back to Unrivaled City for the City Lord to judge you!"
"It’s Shi Wuzun."

Ding Ling glanced sideways, seeing the Buddha Light faintly flashing on this person, realizing he was definitely gathering power to act against him, immediately he secretly condensed thin slices of Life and Death Talisman:
"Even if I go to Unrivaled City, I will do so of my own accord, not dragged by you."
"There’s no negotiating!"
Shi Wuzun shouted, making a sharp move towards capturing Ding Ling:
"Be sensible, don’t force me to use killing techniques!"
He had momentarily engaged a strong opponent, allowing Dugu Ming to go first, only to realize Dugu Ming had fallen here; had he known, he would not have let Dugu Ming escape alone.
Shi Wuzun regretted thoroughly, dealing with Ding Ling increasingly fiercely.
Yet he suddenly realized, the youth who could kill Dugu Ming unharmed must be no ordinary; certainly an expert!
Therefore.
His move was with a Supreme Skill.
Tathagata Divine Palm!
Buddha Light appears!
Layers of palm shadows strike, the pervasive Buddha Light glistens.
Ding Ling only felt a blur before his eyes and couldn’t see anything clearly.
But he wasn’t flustered, fully operating his Defensive Gang Qi, while Star Shifting and Tai Chi Qi spread all over his body. The sound of crackling strikes started to ring out.
Peng Peng!
It seemed someone was repelled by the rebounding force.
At this moment, Ding Ling adapted to the intense and dazzling Buddha Light, his eyes bright and clear. What he saw was a single move that sent Shi Wuzun flying with his own palm force.
"What a clever technique of Using Force to Counter Force!"
Shi Wuzun shouted:
"I wonder how many palms you can take from me!"
He had just used a skillful force.
Thus, the palm force backlash did not harm him.
At this moment, realizing the power of Ding Ling’s Star Shifting, he couldn’t help but feel a shock in his heart, and the power of the Tathagata Divine Palm was raised to the maximum.
"Young man, I advise you to surrender; otherwise, you will not have a good time ahead!"
He pressed his palms together.
A faint shadow of a Buddha appeared behind him, protecting his whole body.
Ding Ling was secretly amazed, but his hands didn’t slow down. As the Life and Death Talisman flew out, he also struck in mid-air with White Rainbow Palm Force!
Whoosh!
A splendid rainbow light condensed into a palm, moving swiftly, striking towards Shi Wuzun.
Seeing this, Shi Wuzun’s expression turned serious; he dared not be negligent, and he uttered "Amitabha Buddha" before decisively striking a palm forward.
Tathagata Divine Palm!
Heavenly Buddha Incarnation!

A Buddha figure manifested in the void, its form vast as the universe, clearly standing in the passage yet seemingly in another dimensional world. With one palm, it shattered the ice shards and continued to strike towards Ding Ling’s White Rainbow Palm Force.
Boom!
The two palm forces collided, erupting with a resounding sound that made the passage buzz and hum, as if it might collapse at any moment.
Peng!

The clash of palm forces lasted but an instant, and the White Rainbow Palm Force shattered the Buddha’s palm force from an unbelievable angle, at lightning speed, hitting Shi Wuzun’s arm. It shook his body violently, shattering the bones in one hand.
This was as quick as a hare.
Shi Wuzun hadn’t reacted at all, and by the time he realized it, it was too late.
He felt intense pain assault his mind and couldn’t help but gasp:
"A palm force that can turn! Who are you really?"
Ding Ling didn’t answer but instead operated the Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg he had just learned!
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s legs moved like the wind, swiftly covering several dozen feet, getting before Shi Wuzun, and kicked heavily at him!
Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg!
Slaying the Dragon for the Dao!
With this move, dragon-shaped qi suddenly appeared, forming a terrifying dragon tornado, sweeping towards Shi Wuzun like plowing the land.
Shi Wuzun was shocked and found it unbelievable because he recognized this technique:
"The Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg technique, unique to the Young City Lord. How do you know it?"
He couldn’t make sense of it no matter how he thought.
But his body didn’t slow down.
Taking a deep breath, he endured the pain of his shattered arm and used his other hand to unleash a powerful move.
Tathagata Divine Palm!
Ten Thousand Buddhas Worship!
With a single palm, countless shadowy Buddha figures appeared faintly on all sides, chanting in unison, descending upon Ding Ling.
Crackle!
Boom boom boom!
The dragon tornado formed by Dragon-Subduing Qi collided fiercely with the Buddha illusion!
But it only lasted a moment.

The dragon tornado, like an autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves, quickly overwhelmed umpteen Buddha illusions, irresistible, enveloping Shi Wuzun. A loud bang was heard as Shi Wuzun was kicked dozens of feet away, hitting hard against the passage wall, causing countless fine dust and stones to fall from the shaken cave wall.
Shi Wuzun seemed embedded in the wall, unable to move for a long while.
Ding Ling operated Ripple Step and instantly got close to Shi Wuzun.
His figure moved like electricity.
His bearing was graceful and unrestrained, leaving people dazzled!
Shi Wuzun bled from the corner of his mouth, his pupils wide with shock and disbelief:
"So young, so incredibly powerful. Who are you really? When did someone like you appear in the Jianghu Martial Arts?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - 576: Tathagata Divine Palm at Full Level
paragraphs: Ding Ling remained silent, merely placing his hand on Shi Wuzun’s shoulder.
Activating the Eternal Youth Technique.
In an instant.
Rolling inner strength surged into Ding Ling’s dantian like a mighty wave, its volume far surpassing that of Dugu Ming five times over.
Ding Ling’s Eternal Youth Technique refined it for several breaths before it was completely absorbed.
[Inner Power Value +510]
Five streams of Longevity True Qi suddenly emerged in the dantian.
Adding to the previous one.
Instantly condensed into two drops of Longevity True Water.
[True Power Value: 26 points]
Power skyrocketed!

Ding Ling’s strength leaped forward two small stages! Now his True Qi surged like the sea, and even the unintentional leakage of his energy caused the powerless Shi Wuzun to cough up blood continuously.
"Such... such strong, domineering energy!"
Ding Ling could actually absorb his power in an instant and make it his own.
Such a Divine Skill unheard and unseen before!
Shi Wuzun’s heart was filled with extreme shock, his mind quickly scanning through the new talents of various sects in the Jianghu, yet none matched the young man before him.
"Who... who exactly are you?!"
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidating Shi Wuzun.]
[Note: Your miraculous Divine Skill, surging palm power, and extraordinary leg technique made Shi Wuzun tremble! Inexplicable! Confused!]
Upon hearing the notification.
Ding Ling glanced at Shi Wuzun.
This person was an expert at the Innate Middle Tier!
His True Qi was extremely pure. If not, he wouldn’t have been able to provide Ding Ling with a full 510 Inner Power Value at once.
How much Great Medicine would be needed for such a huge Inner Power Value?

Ding Ling noticed something seeming to protrude from Shi Wuzun’s pocket and used the Dragon Capturing Skill and Crane Controlling Art to lift Shi Wuzun’s clothing and seize two scrolls from his pocket.
"Give... give them back to me."
Shi Wuzun struggled.
Ding Ling glanced at him and casually released a Canhe Finger strike.
Whoosh!
The Canhe Finger was shapeless, traceless, and shadowless, shooting out like a bolt of lightning, bang! It landed squarely on Shi Wuzun’s chest.
Shi Wuzun died instantly, his eyes wide open.
Likewise, he died without closing his eyes.
Ding Ling shook his head, fearing more trouble might arise if others came soon, and used Ripple Step to whisk away, racing down the passage and rapidly leaving the scene.
Several miles away.
Ding Ling saw no one around.
He then opened the scrolls.
The first scroll turned out to be a map of the Lingyun Cave.
Ding Ling was secretly surprised and puzzled:
"How could Shi Wuzun have a map of the Lingyun Cave?! How did he get it?"
The map looked as if it had been drawn recently, with ink still fresh.
Moreover, the map didn’t delve particularly deep into the realm.
But comparatively.
Better than Ding Ling exploring alone.
At least by seeing this map, Ding Ling knew where the Fire Qilin was.
This way, following the map was far better than Ding Ling wandering blindly many times over.
"Either it was snatched from someone during a fight or Shi Wuzun has been in the Lingyun Cave, exploring and mapping it out himself."
No matter the truth.
It all worked to Ding Ling’s advantage now.
He opened the second scroll.
The first line of words caught his eyes.
Ding Ling’s eyebrow twitched.
He saw the first line was:
"Tathagata Divine Palm!"
"It’s actually the Tathagata Divine Palm!"
Ding Ling’s breathing hastened for a moment but soon calmed down.
Judging from Shi Wuzun’s moves, this Tathagata Divine Palm, despite being impressive, didn’t seem that extraordinary?
No matter the truth.
Ding Ling needed to see for himself.
He opened the scroll and read rapidly at a glance.
Finished reading.
He slightly closed his eyes.
As a new Secret Manual appeared on the bookshelf of the library.
In an instant.
[Tathagata Divine Palm Inner Power Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Tathagata Divine Palm External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]
This Tathagata Divine Palm was an internal and external skill unifying Supreme Technique of Void Shattering Level.
Unlike the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill focusing more on Body Refining, this technique emphasized Qi Cultivation more.
Thus, different from other first-class top-notch techniques.
This method could directly be cultivated to Shattering Level.
Instant full level immediately increased 300 Inner Power Value.
Whoosh whoosh!
Rolling Primordial Spirit surged in, Ding Ling quickly refined it with Eternal Youth Technique, and soon added three Longevity True Qi in his dantian.
True Qi condensed into one.
With a drop of True Water forming.
[True Power Value 27 points]
With the Tathagata Divine Palm at full level.
Ding Ling discovered this technique was far more terrifying than he imagined.
With his current Grandmaster Level True Qi driving this technique, his combat power could double!
"Seems Shi Wuzun hadn’t mastered it entirely."
Ding Ling was enlightened.
He finished reading the Tathagata Divine Palm.
And understood the immense difficulty in cultivating this technique, akin to ascending to the heavens!

It not only required Buddha Bone, natural wisdom, but also a thorough memorization of Three Thousand Buddhist Scriptures, only when three Buddha Qi were self-generated in the heart could one be qualified to practice this technique.
And to achieve Great Perfection required a long period of study and research, needing to spontaneously produce relics to achieve fullness; Great Perfection required qualities of becoming a Buddha.
To let Ding Ling cultivate it.
Even with a hundred years, he might not reach Great Perfection! Simply because it was too difficult.

"This Tathagata Divine Palm isn’t meant for ordinary people. Shi Wuzun’s success in cultivating it is already commendable. Unfortunately, unfortunately, he was my enemy, and grudges persist, so he must be sent to hell."
Ding Ling casually placed the Tathagata Divine Palm scroll into his Storage Pouch.
He now somewhat understood why Shi Wuzun kept this scroll with him.
Simply because this Tathagata Divine Palm was overly mysterious.
Often one would quickly forget the second line after reading the first; this technique carried a demon nature!
"Perhaps the Buddha who created this Tathagata Divine Palm was indeed a Demon Buddha?"
Ding Ling thought of the Great Sun Buddha from the Wind and Cloud World!
His brows twitched violently.
He hoped this world didn’t have a Great Sun Buddha, or else conquering this world would be troublesome!
"However, it seems that this Demon Buddha would never have imagined the technique he created would one day be mastered to Great Perfection."
The creator of this Tathagata Divine Palm.
Never intended for it to be practiced to Great Perfection.
Especially in the later stages.
The text became increasingly chaotic and unclear.
Often one would forget immediately after reading it.
This was also due to Ding Ling’s cheats being extremely advanced; he’d automatically record it after reading, otherwise, he’d have no chance.
"Shi Wuzun keeping this scroll was likely because the technique was too difficult to learn; he couldn’t recite it all, so he kept it for constant reference. Nonetheless, it worked in my favor."
After obtaining the Tathagata Divine Palm.
Ding Ling was more convinced of one thing.
From now on, after a kill.
He must loot the corpse!
Otherwise, missing out on some Secret Manuals, Magical Treasures, if other players looted them, wouldn’t that be a huge loss?

How much Great Medicine would be needed for such a huge Inner Power Value?

Ding Ling noticed something seeming to protrude from Shi Wuzun’s pocket and used the Dragon Capturing Skill and Crane Controlling Art to lift Shi Wuzun’s clothing and seize two scrolls from his pocket.
"Give... give them back to me."
Shi Wuzun struggled.
Ding Ling glanced at him and casually released a Canhe Finger strike.
Whoosh!
The Canhe Finger was shapeless, traceless, and shadowless, shooting out like a bolt of lightning, bang!
It landed squarely on Shi Wuzun’s chest.
Shi Wuzun died instantly, his eyes wide open.
Likewise, he died without closing his eyes.
Ding Ling shook his head, fearing more trouble might arise if others came soon, and used Ripple Step to whisk away, racing down the passage and rapidly leaving the scene.
Several miles away.
Ding Ling saw no one around.
He then opened the scrolls.
The first scroll turned out to be a map of the Lingyun Cave.
Ding Ling was secretly surprised and puzzled:
"How could Shi Wuzun have a map of the Lingyun Cave?!
How did he get it?"
The map looked as if it had been drawn recently, with ink still fresh.
Moreover, the map didn’t delve particularly deep into the realm.
But comparatively.
Better than Ding Ling exploring alone.
At least by seeing this map, Ding Ling knew where the Fire Qilin was.
This way, following the map was far better than Ding Ling wandering blindly many times over.
"Either it was snatched from someone during a fight or Shi Wuzun has been in the Lingyun Cave, exploring and mapping it out himself."
No matter the truth.
It all worked to Ding Ling’s advantage now.
He opened the second scroll.
The first line of words caught his eyes.
Ding Ling’s eyebrow twitched.
He saw the first line was:
"Tathagata Divine Palm!"
"It’s actually the Tathagata Divine Palm!"
Ding Ling’s breathing hastened for a moment but soon calmed down.
Judging from Shi Wuzun’s moves, this Tathagata Divine Palm, despite being impressive, didn’t seem that extraordinary?
No matter the truth.
Ding Ling needed to see for himself.
He opened the scroll and read rapidly at a glance.
Finished reading.
He slightly closed his eyes.
As a new Secret Manual appeared on the bookshelf of the library.
In an instant.
[Tathagata Divine Palm Inner Power Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Tathagata Divine Palm External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]
This Tathagata Divine Palm was an internal and external skill unifying Supreme Technique of Void Shattering Level.
Unlike the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill focusing more on Body Refining, this technique emphasized Qi Cultivation more.
Thus, different from other first-class top-notch techniques.
This method could directly be cultivated to Shattering Level.
Instant full level immediately increased 300 Inner Power Value.
Whoosh whoosh!
Rolling Primordial Spirit surged in, Ding Ling quickly refined it with Eternal Youth Technique, and soon added three Longevity True Qi in his dantian.
True Qi condensed into one.
With a drop of True Water forming.
[True Power Value 27 points]
With the Tathagata Divine Palm at full level.
Ding Ling discovered this technique was far more terrifying than he imagined.
With his current Grandmaster Level True Qi driving this technique, his combat power could double!
"Seems Shi Wuzun hadn’t mastered it entirely."
Ding Ling was enlightened.
He finished reading the Tathagata Divine Palm.
And understood the immense difficulty in cultivating this technique, akin to ascending to the heavens!

It not only required Buddha Bone, natural wisdom, but also a thorough memorization of Three Thousand Buddhist Scriptures, only when three Buddha Qi were self-generated in the heart could one be qualified to practice this technique.
And to achieve Great Perfection required a long period of study and research, needing to spontaneously produce relics to achieve fullness; Great Perfection required qualities of becoming a Buddha.
To let Ding Ling cultivate it.
Even with a hundred years, he might not reach Great Perfection!
Simply because it was too difficult.
"This Tathagata Divine Palm isn’t meant for ordinary people.
Shi Wuzun’s success in cultivating it is already commendable.
Unfortunately, unfortunately, he was my enemy, and grudges persist, so he must be sent to hell."
Ding Ling casually placed the Tathagata Divine Palm scroll into his Storage Pouch.
He now somewhat understood why Shi Wuzun kept this scroll with him.
Simply because this Tathagata Divine Palm was overly mysterious.
Often one would quickly forget the second line after reading the first; this technique carried a demon nature!
"Perhaps the Buddha who created this Tathagata Divine Palm was indeed a Demon Buddha?"
Ding Ling thought of the Great Sun Buddha from the Wind and Cloud World!
His brows twitched violently.
He hoped this world didn’t have a Great Sun Buddha, or else conquering this world would be troublesome!
"However, it seems that this Demon Buddha would never have imagined the technique he created would one day be mastered to Great Perfection."
The creator of this Tathagata Divine Palm.
Never intended for it to be practiced to Great Perfection.
Especially in the later stages.
The text became increasingly chaotic and unclear.
Often one would forget immediately after reading it.
This was also due to Ding Ling’s cheats being extremely advanced; he’d automatically record it after reading, otherwise, he’d have no chance.
"Shi Wuzun keeping this scroll was likely because the technique was too difficult to learn; he couldn’t recite it all, so he kept it for constant reference.
Nonetheless, it worked in my favor."
After obtaining the Tathagata Divine Palm.
Ding Ling was more convinced of one thing.
From now on, after a kill.
He must loot the corpse!
Otherwise, missing out on some Secret Manuals, Magical Treasures, if other players looted them, wouldn’t that be a huge loss?

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - 577: Ice Emperor
paragraphs: Ding Ling followed the map and proceeded.

Occasionally, with the full-level Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg in operation, his feet seemed to step on a divine dragon, shooting forward a hundred meters in a flash. At other times, using Ripple Step, his figure was elusive, turning sharply at high speed, like a breeze, swiftly passing through barriers and tunnels.
In the depths of Lingyun Cave, he saw many experts.
Some were traveling in groups, others were alone.
Ding Ling generally wouldn’t start trouble or cause trouble.
Therefore, if these people didn’t bother him, he would quickly avoid and bypass them.
His main objective was to find the Blood Bodhi and Ten Strong Martial Dao, not to confront or battle these people.
He wasn’t a Murderous Demon King.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!

Ding Ling’s speed increased. The Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg was not only unrivaled in attack but also exceptional in speed, resembling a whirlwind sweeping the ground. In a flash, he bypassed deep passages and arrived at an entrance.
From here, he could faintly see the rolling firelight inside and sense an unparalleled ominous aura.
This aura was evil, with an extreme demon nature.
It swept over him!
Ding Ling couldn’t help but pause:
"This aura with a corrosive, scorching sensation, could it be the Fire Qilin?"
Roar!
Roar!
Boom, boom, boom!
Accompanied by fierce collision sounds and beastly roars, Ding Ling could vaguely see flashes of blades and swords, striking in all directions!
Roar!
The beast moved swiftly. One moment it seemed far away, the next second, it suddenly charged not far in front of Ding Ling, rushing straight toward him.
Taking a closer look.
He saw the beast had a dragon’s head, antlers, lion’s eyes, tiger’s back, bear’s waist, and snake scales, with blazing flames erupting from its body, frantically fleeing.
"Fire Qilin!"

Ding Ling recognized it at a glance. Scanning around, he realized his position coincided precisely with the Fire Qilin’s path. Unless he turned and ran, a collision with the Fire Qilin was only a matter of time.
Ding Ling didn’t currently want to engage in a battle with the Fire Qilin, so he turned and flew away.
He ran quickly.
The Fire Qilin also sprinted fast, continuously opening its mouth to spray fire toward him.

Ding Ling’s speed was exceptional; the Fire Qilin couldn’t catch up in an instant. But soon, Ding Ling saw a figure soaring through the air across the stone wall, appearing directly above the Fire Qilin, hands forming into claws, fiercely tearing toward the Fire Qilin’s head.
With that tear, surging cold air erupted from his fingertips, covering the entire Fire Qilin.
The Fire Qilin let out a mournful cry and collapsed to the ground.
Its head was entirely frozen, unable to move.
"Haha..."
The newcomer looked extremely peculiar.
A face seemingly washed by frost and snow held a pair of blood-red eyes, white hair draped over shoulders, looking both wickedly charming and demonically wild!
He laughed heartily three times, saying, ’The Fire Qilin is nothing more than this!’
Suddenly.
He looked at Ding Ling:
"You brat, haven’t you watched enough? Get over here and accept your fate! If you dare run, I’ll make sure you can’t live nor die!"
Ding Ling looked bewildered, puzzled:
"I’m just passing by."
"It seems you don’t recognize me."
The white-haired man twisted his neck, looking at Ding Ling with a faint smile:
"I’ve killed so many people in Lingyun Cave. I didn’t expect there’s still someone who doesn’t recognize me. Must be new."
He took a deep breath:
"I just killed the Fire Qilin and am in a good mood. Out of kindness, I’ll introduce myself. I’m the Ice Emperor! The one who is cruel, brutal, and kills without mercy!"
He took pride in this rather than feeling ashamed, laughing heartily three times:
"Disciple of Emperor Shitian under the Celestial Sect! Known as the Ice Cold Red Spot!"
"Ice Emperor?!"
Ding Ling’s pupils contracted.
In the Wind and Cloud Comics, above the Divine Mother is a Senior Brother called the Ice Emperor.
This person is extremely violent, with an astonishing talent for martial arts, arrogant as if invincible in the world. However, wasn’t this Ice Emperor sealed by Emperor Shitian?
Now unsealed, it seems a player has intruded, causing the plot to collapse.

Ding Ling felt at ease; he didn’t expect to encounter the Ice Emperor here, but since it happened, seeing the Ice Emperor’s ferocious appearance with overwhelming killing intent, there seemed to be little chance for reconciliation between them.
Ding Ling put his palms together and said:
"Ice Emperor, I don’t wish to oppose the Celestial Sect. Let’s part ways and live our own lives, how about it?"
Ding Ling indeed didn’t want to have a conflict with Emperor Shitian at the moment.
The Celestial Sect’s influence was vast.
Experts were numerous.
Ding Ling needed to develop stably for a while longer.
"Not happening!"
The Ice Emperor took a step forward, and a cold aura instantly congealed into a surging frost river, charging rapidly towards Ding Ling:
"No one I want to kill has ever lived for one hour! Boy, prepare to die!"
"Cruel and ruthless."

Ding Ling no longer hesitated. Immediately, he activated the Great Perfection Level Tathagata Divine Palm. Instantly, Buddha Light shone brightly, with Ding Ling standing there, complementing the Buddha Qi within his body, making him appear like a Buddha standing between heaven and earth, exuding a supreme aura!
Tathagata Divine Palm!
Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root!
Even when a lion fights a rabbit, it uses all its strength! The Ice Emperor felt extremely dangerous to Ding Ling. It was evident the opponent was definitely a high-tier Grandmaster!
Facing someone of a higher cultivation level than himself.
How could Ding Ling be careless?
He attacked with full force, and with the Fusion Qi activated, the power of Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root was amplified tenfold.
Amidst the void, at every corner of the passageway.
In an instant.
The void was filled with dense Buddha phantoms!
A full ten thousand Buddhas, some smiling with a flower-picking gesture, pointing thunderously toward the Ice Emperor’s head;
Others in the image of a Furious Vajra, punching toward the Ice Emperor’s chest and abdomen;
Or in the form of Thousand-Hand Guanyin, with palm shadows overflowing the sky, striking at the Ice Emperor!
The Great Perfection Tathagata Divine Palm.
Activated by Fusion Qi.
Unleashed an unparalleled, supreme power!
Though the passage was not large, these illusory Buddha phantoms manifested in the air, exerting a world-shaking force of palm energy!

The Ice Emperor inhaled sharply; he thought of himself as invincible in the world, disregarding figures like Divine Mother Luo Xian and Emperor Shitian. Only after failing to challenge Emperor Shitian did he learn to restrain himself a bit, but he still looked down on others beyond Emperor Shitian.
Yet now, facing Ding Ling’s Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root.
He felt an overwhelming suffocating pressure.
"How is it possible?!"
"I’m the Ice Emperor!"
"Snow Blood Claw!"

The Ice Emperor roared in anger, and his entire body surged with Ice Cold True Qi, as he fiercely grasped towards Ding Ling’s direction. The Ice Frost True Qi congealed into a violent storm, in which blood claws loomed, continually attacking and grabbing at Ding Ling.
Boom, boom, boom!
Crackle, snap!
Snow Blood Claw and Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root, two of the world’s top cultivation techniques, generated forces constantly colliding in the void.

chapters.title: Chapter 589 - 578: Fire Qilin’s Corpse
paragraphs: The forces of the two Divine Skills clashed violently!
Crackling explosions and rumbling thunder echoed!
There was a dazzling firelight and chilling rays shooting everywhere!
The Buddha illusion stood against the Snow Blood Claw for a moment.
In the end, the Ten Thousand Buddhas took the upper hand, smashing the Frost Storm of the Snow Blood Claw, and pressed down on the Ice Emperor!
"How is this possible?!"
The Ice Emperor was shocked:
"You, young boy!"
Saying this, he didn’t slow down his actions, retreating dozens of meters, his hands forming into claws, continuously waving the icy storm of the Snow Blood Claw!
However, the Buddha illusion continuously gathered amid the chanting of ’Amitabha Buddha’, extinguished and reborn, endless and inexhaustible.
Ding Ling stood at the center of Ten Thousand Buddhas, one hand making the Flower-picking Finger, the other pushing forward, releasing one Tathagata Divine Palm after another!
The Ice Emperor was in a desolate state, ultimately forced to flee frantically.
"Where are you running to!"
How could Ding Ling let go of such an unparalleled master as the Ice Emperor, once confronted, he must suppress and kill the opponent!
He was extremely shaken inside.

If it weren’t for the tenfold amplification ability of Fusion Qi, if it weren’t for mastering this Void Shattering Level Supreme Dharma Buddha Palm, he might not have been able to defeat the Ice Emperor.
The Ice Emperor was absolutely an unparalleled master at High-tier Grandmaster level!
A master of such caliber, if plotting from behind, could be unforeseeable, how could Ding Ling justify not killing him.
He unleashed the Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg, resembling a storm sweeping over the ground, in the blink of an eye, he soared a hundred meters, arriving beside the Fire Qilin.
He instinctively glanced, seeing the Fire Qilin already frozen, its scales shedding off massively, its body bloodied and mangled, yet it was already dead.
Ding Ling was moved.

Judging by the Fire Qilin’s injuries, it definitely wasn’t just fighting the Ice Emperor alone, it might have been jointly attacked by several people, failing to kill it, leaving it for the Ice Emperor to finish off.
The exact circumstances.
Remain unknown.

Ding Ling didn’t dwell on it, he simply emptied one of the Storage Pouches quickly, immediately grabbing the corpse of the Fire Qilin, using skillful force, squeezed it into one of the Storage Pouches.
The body of the Fire Qilin is invaluable.
Its blood dripped on the ground, nurturing a plant, resulting in Blood Bodhi.
A single scale forged into the unparalleled Divine Weapon Fire Qilin Sword!
Some blood spilled onto humans’ arms creating the endlessly potential Qilin Arm!
Such a Fire Qilin corpse.
How could Ding Ling possibly abandon it.
He threw away pots and pans.
Just to store the Qilin’s body, fortunately, one Storage Pouch barely accommodated the Qilin’s corpse, yet it was filled to its brim.
The grandeur of the Qilin.
Is evident.
Ding Ling’s actions were swift, clearing the Storage Pouch and stowing away the Fire Qilin took only a few breaths.
Afterwards.
He utilized the Fusion Qi’s tenfold amplification with Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg.
Swoosh!
Like a tornado sweeping over the earth, at unbelievable speed.
Like lightning swiftly darting between the channels!

Ding Ling mastered a skill of ’Tracking and Tracing’! Having fought and contacted the Ice Emperor, naturally understood his trail and aura very well, tracking without delay, shortly seen in a deep, dark passageway.
He was fleeing frantically.
Such exquisite Lightweight Skill.
Truly extraordinary!
However, Ding Ling’s tenfold amplification of the Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg and Soaring in the Void outmatched him by far.
"What?!"
The Ice Emperor seemed to sense it, a glance back, locking eyes with Ding Ling’s, feeling a chilling heart, incredulously:
"Who are you?!"
He roared:
"Not to mention you know the Tathagata Divine Palm! Your Lightweight Skill is exceptionally supreme!"
The Ice Emperor’s keen eye clearly recognized the Tathagata Divine Palm.
In his understanding, the Tathagata Divine Palm was never this powerful!
Only Ding Ling appears so formidable!

And Ding Ling, young in age, possessing supreme Cultivation! This dealt a severe blow to the Ice Emperor! He always deemed himself as the world’s number one genius! Now, facing someone more gifted than him, how can he accept this?!
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: You intimidated the Ice Emperor]

[Annotation: The Ice Emperor is brutal, fierce, arrogant and self-absorbed. Your appearance created cracks in his pride! He first realized that someone could not only be younger but also mightier than him!]
Indeed a D-level?!
Ding Ling’s eyes slightly brightened.
Realizing this abruptly.
Needless to say, this D-level Achievement Medal is unlocked only by Grandmaster Level and above experts, the Ice Emperor fittingly matches the criteria!
Gaining the D-level medal, predictably, upon conquering this world, even more valuable items for exchange will certainly become available.
A Grandmaster expert can easily challenge a nation alone! Against such an expert, numerous minions are merely fodder!
Yet even Grandmasters vary in strength.

Although the Ice Emperor’s True Qi surpasses Ding Ling’s in magnificence, lacking the Breathing Technique by his side, he is still inferior to the most powerful strike of the tenfold amplified Tathagata Divine Palm Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root!
Swoosh swoosh!
The Ice Emperor accelerated rapidly, shouting several resentful phrases, seeing Ding Ling not responding, inevitably, frustrated, who ever dared treat him this way!
But Ding Ling’s Martial Arts surpasses him! His methods are excessively formidable, unable to fight back, he can only flee!
Swoosh swoosh!
The two dashed, one forward, the other chased behind, swiftly passing through channels, occasionally brushing past other masters.
Among them, two experts witnessing the scene, sensing the aura emitting from Ding Ling and the Ice Emperor, exchanged glances, clearly noticing the awe in one another’s eyes.
One of them, hair graying at the temples, formidable physique, possessing an overbearing aura, stood proudly aside, fully showcasing the spirit of a bold, cunning hero;
The other, small in stature, childlike appearance, riding a ’wooden horse’, although a dwarf, emanates malice, making him evidently a difficult character.
This dwarf glanced at the heroic man, murmuring:
"Gang Leader, it’s getting more chaotic here. Moreover, the masters are increasing and growing terrifying. I suggest we should leave here for now."
"Makes sense."
The heroic man glanced at the dwarf, said:

"Child Emperor, we came to seek opportunities and strengthen ourselves, expand the World Association. Unexpectedly, we witnessed batches of masters, realizing so many remarkable figures exist in this world?!"
He gawked, tongue-tied:
"Why hadn’t I, Xiong Ba, ever spotted this before?!"
These two, one is the World Association’s Gang Leader Xiong Ba.
The other is the leading figure of the Celestial Pool Twelve Fiends Child Emperor.
These two arrived at Lingyun Cave, initially tyrannical, confident, roamed the Ten Directions Realm with impunity, believing Lingyun Cave to be akin to their backyard.
If not for considering the powerful Fire Qilin, surely they might have rooted themselves in Lingyun Cave, not leaving until finding the opportunity!
However.
Beyond their expectations it was!
