Just to store the Qilin’s body, fortunately, one Storage Pouch barely accommodated the Qilin’s corpse, yet it was filled to its brim.
The grandeur of the Qilin.
Is evident.
Ding Ling’s actions were swift, clearing the Storage Pouch and stowing away the Fire Qilin took only a few breaths.
Afterwards.
He utilized the Fusion Qi’s tenfold amplification with Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg.
Swoosh!
Like a tornado sweeping over the earth, at unbelievable speed.
Like lightning swiftly darting between the channels!
Ding Ling mastered a skill of ’Tracking and Tracing’!
Having fought and contacted the Ice Emperor, naturally understood his trail and aura very well, tracking without delay, shortly seen in a deep, dark passageway.
He was fleeing frantically.
Such exquisite Lightweight Skill.
Truly extraordinary!
However, Ding Ling’s tenfold amplification of the Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg and Soaring in the Void outmatched him by far.
"What?!"
The Ice Emperor seemed to sense it, a glance back, locking eyes with Ding Ling’s, feeling a chilling heart, incredulously:
"Who are you?!"
He roared:
"Not to mention you know the Tathagata Divine Palm!
Your Lightweight Skill is exceptionally supreme!"
The Ice Emperor’s keen eye clearly recognized the Tathagata Divine Palm.
In his understanding, the Tathagata Divine Palm was never this powerful!
Only Ding Ling appears so formidable!
And Ding Ling, young in age, possessing supreme Cultivation!
This dealt a severe blow to the Ice Emperor!
He always deemed himself as the world’s number one genius!
Now, facing someone more gifted than him, how can he accept this?!
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: You intimidated the Ice Emperor]
[Annotation: The Ice Emperor is brutal, fierce, arrogant and self-absorbed.
Your appearance created cracks in his pride!
He first realized that someone could not only be younger but also mightier than him!]
Indeed a D-level?!
Ding Ling’s eyes slightly brightened.
Realizing this abruptly.
Needless to say, this D-level Achievement Medal is unlocked only by Grandmaster Level and above experts, the Ice Emperor fittingly matches the criteria!
Gaining the D-level medal, predictably, upon conquering this world, even more valuable items for exchange will certainly become available.
A Grandmaster expert can easily challenge a nation alone!
Against such an expert, numerous minions are merely fodder!
Yet even Grandmasters vary in strength.

Although the Ice Emperor’s True Qi surpasses Ding Ling’s in magnificence, lacking the Breathing Technique by his side, he is still inferior to the most powerful strike of the tenfold amplified Tathagata Divine Palm Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root!
Swoosh swoosh!
The Ice Emperor accelerated rapidly, shouting several resentful phrases, seeing Ding Ling not responding, inevitably, frustrated, who ever dared treat him this way!
But Ding Ling’s Martial Arts surpasses him!
His methods are excessively formidable, unable to fight back, he can only flee!
Swoosh swoosh!
The two dashed, one forward, the other chased behind, swiftly passing through channels, occasionally brushing past other masters.
Among them, two experts witnessing the scene, sensing the aura emitting from Ding Ling and the Ice Emperor, exchanged glances, clearly noticing the awe in one another’s eyes.
One of them, hair graying at the temples, formidable physique, possessing an overbearing aura, stood proudly aside, fully showcasing the spirit of a bold, cunning hero;
The other, small in stature, childlike appearance, riding a ’wooden horse’, although a dwarf, emanates malice, making him evidently a difficult character.
This dwarf glanced at the heroic man, murmuring:
"Gang Leader, it’s getting more chaotic here.
Moreover, the masters are increasing and growing terrifying.
I suggest we should leave here for now."
"Makes sense."
The heroic man glanced at the dwarf, said:
"Child Emperor, we came to seek opportunities and strengthen ourselves, expand the World Association.
Unexpectedly, we witnessed batches of masters, realizing so many remarkable figures exist in this world?!"
He gawked, tongue-tied:
"Why hadn’t I, Xiong Ba, ever spotted this before?!"
These two, one is the World Association’s Gang Leader Xiong Ba.
The other is the leading figure of the Celestial Pool Twelve Fiends Child Emperor.
These two arrived at Lingyun Cave, initially tyrannical, confident, roamed the Ten Directions Realm with impunity, believing Lingyun Cave to be akin to their backyard.
If not for considering the powerful Fire Qilin, surely they might have rooted themselves in Lingyun Cave, not leaving until finding the opportunity!
However.
Beyond their expectations it was!

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - 579: Xiong Ba
paragraphs: In Lingyun Cave, the most terrifying thing is not the Fire Qilin!
It’s the mysterious and powerful martial artists!
These martial artists.
Neither Xiong Ba nor Child Emperor has seen them.
The two couldn’t help but look at each other, somewhat bewildered, confused, and frightened!
To know that the World Association is the strongest force in this world.
Even they don’t know these powerful people?!
Aliens?
How is that possible!
Aliens are as weak as trash, easily crushed, not worth considering. So who are these people?!
Xiong Ba and Child Emperor felt cold in their hearts, a strong sense of unreality as if living in a fantasy world!
Xiong Ba’s inner alarm was ringing loudly, feeling at every moment that he might fall.
He took a breath and turned around without hesitation:
"Go back and immediately notify the members of the World Association to restrain themselves and not cause trouble!"
"The Gang Leader is wise."
Child Emperor rode a wooden horse tightly following behind Xiong Ba and said:
"Not long ago, I also heard some aliens say that our world has organizations like the Celestial Sect, initially thought it was nothing. Now, thinking about it, it might be true!"
"Aliens know quite a lot."
Xiong Ba used the Wind God Leg, swiftly moving:
"After returning, make deep contact with them and extract all the information from their mouths!"
Previously, Xiong Ba also looked down on aliens.
Too weak!
He could crush a large group with one finger!
So he had no interest in communicating with aliens.
This time, he came to Lingyun Cave because he heard about the Ten Strong Martial Dao, Blood Bodhi, and other secret skills and treasures of Heaven and Earth!
This sparked his interest to come.
Unfortunately, having been here for so long, he hasn’t found anything of value, let alone the Ten Strong Martial Dao or Blood Bodhi.
This made Xiong Ba extremely aggrieved and depressed!
What made him most agitated and shocked was the two people who passed by them just now, one with a deep icy aura that seemed to freeze the land for miles;
And the other with an immense overbearing aura, like an unrivaled emperor riding a phoenix overlooking the human world!
These two people.
Xiong Ba had a premonition that either of them could easily crush him!
"After returning, I will immediately enter seclusion and will not emerge until I’ve perfected the Three-in-One Essence Qi to Great Perfection!"
Xiong Ba’s sense of crisis rose to the extreme, but secretly swore to himself.
As the two continued moving quickly into the tunnel where Ding Ling and the Ice Emperor had fought, they couldn’t help but show teeth and express awe seeing the battle traces.
"Such terrifying qi!"
"It seems a fierce battle happened here not long ago!"
’Looks like it was those two people before, the remaining aura is very strong, very similar to those two.’
Xiong Ba and Child Emperor have extraordinary eyesight.
At a glance, they saw the aura, one vast and majestic like Buddha smiling with a flower;
The other icy and bone-chilling, capable of shattering and freezing everything.
Both auras were extremely powerful and overbearing, beyond what they could challenge.
"Too strong!"
Xiong Ba was shocked:
"Unexpectedly, apart from the martial arts myth Wuming, there are such strong characters in the world!"

"Wuming is reclusive and doesn’t emerge. Only then the World Association could sweep the world. Now, more and more unknown strong people appear. It seems the world might fall into chaos. Gang Leader, it is necessary to plan ahead."
"This is reasonable."
Xiong Ba nodded, his mind racing with thoughts.
At that moment.
He thought of many things.
He had a strong desire to recruit those two masters for his use but thought of the masters being much stronger than him, recruiting them might lead them to seize control!
Thus, he immediately dismissed the idea.
But how to establish a good relationship with these two masters?
Xiong Ba was momentarily troubled. He believed such masters were not many; if he could establish a great relationship with even one of them, the crisis would be resolved.
Especially the young lad, whose stature was grand, aura vast, like a Human Emperor, was Xiong Ba’s key focus.
He shared this matter with Child Emperor.
Asked Child Emperor to find a way.
Child Emperor said:

"That young lad looks merely seventeen or eighteen, yet so capable, must come from an extraordinary background. After returning, have an artist draw his likeness and consult with aliens to see if they recognize him. If they do, we can learn about this lad’s background. Then based on the actual situation, we can plan whether to recruit or directly..."
Child Emperor glanced at Xiong Ba, suddenly thinking of a clever plan:
"Heroes love beauties since ancient times. Gang Leader’s daughter Youruo is as beautiful as a celestial, intoxicatingly charming; if she could marry this young lad, wouldn’t it be a perfect match?"
Xiong Ba’s expression changed slightly, showing some displeasure.
Child Emperor noticed and hurriedly explained:

"I understand the Gang Leader’s urge to protect his daughter. You are also worried about future enemies in the Jianghu chasing, using Youruo to threaten you, so you keep her confined in Lake Heart Pavilion. This was unknown to others before. If the Gang Leader hides well, undoubtedly there’ll be no issues.
But aliens appeared.
Our World Association and even this world seem to have no secrets.
The matter of the Gang Leader’s daughter Youruo has become known to everyone, becoming a major weakness of the Gang Leader.
If the Gang Leader wants to gain a strong ally, without concern.
In my opinion, marriage alliance is the best choice."
Xiong Ba’s face showed mixed emotions, sometimes angry, sometimes hesitant, sometimes moved.
But felt Child Emperor spoke reasonably.
"Just worried that the young lad might not agree."
Xiong Ba said this.
Clearly, he was leaning towards finding a strong ally.
The world was in chaos.
Too many strong people.
Xiong Ba had no sense of safety!
Especially Youruo’s whereabouts being known to all, furthering his headache, constantly thinking he must resolve this issue.
Now with Child Emperor’s suggestion, instinctively rejecting it initially, but upon reconsideration, felt it made sense!
Youruo would eventually need to marry!
She should marry a peerless, extraordinary, unparalleled martial artist young lad!
"That young lad just now is hundreds of times stronger than Fengyun!"
Child Emperor said:
"Wanting to know if he’d agree, better gather information about him upon return and then plan in detail."
Xiong Ba nodded, noncommittal.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Ice Emperor and Ding Ling rushed into a darker, deeper, sinister tunnel one after the other.
The further they went inside.
The sinister, violent dark power became more intense, heavier.

Yet Ice Emperor seemed unaware, occasionally turning back to counter Ding Ling with Snow Blood Claw, but Ding Ling could often shatter the icy storm formed by the Snow Blood Claw using Tathagata Divine Palm.
In such attempts multiple times.
Ice Emperor, seeing futility, focused solely on rushing, walking for about half an hour, suddenly a person appeared walking in the passage ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - 580: Divine General
paragraphs: The man was tall and standing upright, extremely imposing.
He walked slowly, but his pace was deceptively fast. One moment, he was a hundred meters away, and the next, he was already close to the Ice Emperor.
Seeing the arrival, the Ice Emperor was not surprised but rather pleased, and he shouted:
"Divine General, you’re just in time. Join me in slaying this brat behind me!"
"Oh?"
The Divine General raised an eyebrow slightly, casting a half-smiling glance at the Ice Emperor:
"The famous and invincible Ice Emperor actually needs someone else’s help? And to deal with a mere young man?!"
His gaze pierced through the Ice Emperor, looking at Ding Ling:
"So young! To actually chase the Ice Emperor like a dog! The younger generation is truly to be feared!"
His words made the Ice Emperor’s face turn green.
He wanted to get angry.
But the Ice Emperor held back, again and again, eventually restraining himself, quickly moving to the side of the Divine General, standing shoulder to shoulder with him, confronting Ding Ling:
"This brat is extraordinary. His Tathagata Divine Palm is as unfathomable as ghosts and gods, I... I can’t beat him!"
"That even the high-minded Ice Emperor admits inferiority."
The Divine General’s pupils slightly contracted, scanning Ding Ling up and down:
"Young man, you are remarkable!"
Ding Ling was also observing the Divine General.
In Ding Ling’s understanding, the Divine General remained a character from comics.

This person was a disciple under the Immortal God of Divine Search Palace, saved by his Turtle Breath Skill after being frozen, discovered and rescued by Duann Lang, and then joined the Celestial Sect.
But judging from the current situation, this Divine General joined the Celestial Sect early.
Players intervened, the plot collapsed.
Ding Ling understood and comprehended all of this.
However, the Divine General’s joining made Ding Ling unsure of taking down these two simultaneously.
Judging by the heavy aura emanating from the Divine General, his cultivation and strength were certainly no less than the Ice Emperor’s!
He was a high-tier Grandmaster!
Two high-tier Grandmasters.
In Ding Ling’s mind, Ripple Step, Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg, Soaring in the Void Lightweight Body Technique were already fluctuating between his feet.
Even though he absolutely couldn’t win.
After all, his current strength was only that of a low-tier Grandmaster, lagging behind by two whole stages.
Overcoming one was possible, but taking on both was pushing it too far.
Thinking this way, Ding Ling said:
"Are you the Divine General, disciple of the Immortal God?"
The Divine General’s face grew displeased, letting out a humph, he said:
"I am now a Divine General in the Celestial Sect, only accountable to the Master of the Celestial Gate! Young man, with such impressive cultivation, who is your master?"
The Ice Emperor couldn’t help but glance over, clearly curious about this too.
But Ding Ling did not answer, instead, he said:
"I wonder, has the Master of Celestial Gate, Emperor Shitian, come to Lingyun Cave?
"Sigh."
The Divine General sighed, his whole body surging with True Qi:
"You young man simply do not cooperate. Since that’s the case, don’t blame us for being impolite."
"It should have been like this. Why waste words on him."

The Ice Emperor let out a long roar, heavily clawing towards Ding Ling’s position, swish! Frost condensed into a storm, occasionally, bloody claws appeared, tearing menacingly towards Ding Ling’s head.
Ding Ling clasped his palms together, with one hand in the flower-picking stance, and the other pushing forward.
Tathagata Divine Palm!
Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root!
Amidst the chanting of Buddha, countless Buddha phantoms densely manifested around, guarding Ding Ling tightly.
Ding Ling stood at the center of Ten Thousand Buddhas, his entire body emitting resplendent Buddha light, with a face of sanctity, resembling the true descent of Buddha to the world.
He continuously clapped forward.
Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root unleashed repeatedly.
One Buddha after another angrily struck towards the Ice Emperor in the void.
Once they exchanged blows, earth-shaking ensued, collapsing the passageways, making the ground surge!

The Divine General watched with wildly twitching eyebrows, shocked at Ding Ling’s martial power, yet understanding why the Ice Emperor, who dared defy Emperor Shitian with his formidable power, was also defeated by Ding Ling!
This technique, Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root.
It was indeed too strong.
"Divine General, still not helping!"
The Ice Emperor roared in fury.
The Divine General noticed that the Ice Emperor couldn’t hold on much longer, he chuckled loudly, saying, "Young man, you’ve brought this on yourself!"

Before the words landed, the Divine General spread his ten fingers wide, World-Ending Demon Body’s Fire Thunder Gang Qi roared out, transforming into ten streaks of blazing light, shooting fiercely at Ding Ling’s vital spots!
This Fire Thunder Gang Qi, akin to Celestial Thunder and Earthly Fire condensed into one frenzied energy, incredibly fast, exceedingly powerful!
Ding Ling sensed it from afar, not daring to be careless.
The palm strikes became increasingly faster!
With Fusion Qi’s tenfold amplification.
The speed of his hands became phantom-like!
Ding Ling stood in the center of Ten Thousand Buddhas!
Continuously launching Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root forward!
The chanting of Buddha grew louder, as the speed of the striking Buddhas equally surged.
The intense battle between the two sides.
Escalated into a feverpitch.
At this moment, it further erupted the conflict to the Celestial Extreme.
Boom boom boom!
Bam bam bam!
In the void, Fire Thunder Gang Qi, Frost Storm, and Ten Thousand Buddha shadows collided fiercely, clashing! The roar of thunder was unending.
After persisting for a while.
Ding Ling saw the Fire Thunder Gang Qi and Frost Storm in the void crazily pulverizing the Ten Thousand Buddhas.
Making the already flickering Buddha shadows dim progressively.
Ding Ling thought it was unfavorable; at the moment the Buddha shadows were about to be shattered, he swiftly withdrew.
With the tenfold invoked Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg and Soaring in the Void.
Whoosh!
Like a tornado sweeping through the ground, he vanished into the distance in an instant.
"Chase!"
The Ice Emperor, being chased like a grandson by Ding Ling, found it hard to quell his rage, how could he possibly let Ding Ling go?
He immediately roared in fury, chasing fiercely with the Divine General, one in front and one behind.
The Divine General was inwardly astounded, couldn’t help but glance at the Ice Emperor, blurting out:
"This young man is extraordinary! He has far better talent than us! Why did you provoke such a person for no reason?"
The Ice Emperor was also filled with regret, he despised everyone but Emperor Shitian, not even holding the Divine General in esteem, how could he possibly respect these ’minions’ in Lingyun Cave?
To him, Ding Ling was just another ant, to be killed at will, why ask why?
But little did he expect, after killing many.
He provoked someone he shouldn’t have!
He was already gloom-ridden, and now being retorted by the Divine General, made him even more embarrassed.
The Divine General saw this, let out a light snort, elucidated but not keen to point it out further, merely accelerated forward.
Ding Ling fled all the way.
Speed incredibly fast.

With his exceptional Tracking and Tracing skill, he knew that the Ice Emperor and the Divine General were rapidly catching up, a thought struck him, causing him to flee towards the habitat of the Fire Qilin.
This location was mapped out by Ding Ling.
Following the map.
A moment later.
Arriving at the destination.
Looking around.
It appeared as a Demon Cave.
The internal space was huge.
Several tens of zhang high! A hundred zhang in length and width!
Resembling a Grotto Heaven World.
Moving swiftly past.
It was clear to see that the center of this Earth Realm was occupied by a magma pool.
This magma was peculiarly strange, half red fire, half black fire, swirling continuously in a Tai Chi formation.
Ding Ling glanced around, and then all around, activating Mechanical Skill, Array Skill, Geomancy Skill, finding a crucial point in merely an instant.

This Fire Thunder Gang Qi, akin to Celestial Thunder and Earthly Fire condensed into one frenzied energy, incredibly fast, exceedingly powerful!
Ding Ling sensed it from afar, not daring to be careless.
The palm strikes became increasingly faster!
With Fusion Qi’s tenfold amplification.
The speed of his hands became phantom-like!
Ding Ling stood in the center of Ten Thousand Buddhas!
Continuously launching Ten Thousand Buddhas Return to the Root forward!
The chanting of Buddha grew louder, as the speed of the striking Buddhas equally surged.
The intense battle between the two sides.
Escalated into a feverpitch.
At this moment, it further erupted the conflict to the Celestial Extreme.
Boom boom boom!
Bam bam bam!
In the void, Fire Thunder Gang Qi, Frost Storm, and Ten Thousand Buddha shadows collided fiercely, clashing!
The roar of thunder was unending.
After persisting for a while.
Ding Ling saw the Fire Thunder Gang Qi and Frost Storm in the void crazily pulverizing the Ten Thousand Buddhas.
Making the already flickering Buddha shadows dim progressively.
Ding Ling thought it was unfavorable; at the moment the Buddha shadows were about to be shattered, he swiftly withdrew.
With the tenfold invoked Dragon-Subduing Divine Leg and Soaring in the Void.
Whoosh!
Like a tornado sweeping through the ground, he vanished into the distance in an instant.
"Chase!"
The Ice Emperor, being chased like a grandson by Ding Ling, found it hard to quell his rage, how could he possibly let Ding Ling go?
He immediately roared in fury, chasing fiercely with the Divine General, one in front and one behind.
The Divine General was inwardly astounded, couldn’t help but glance at the Ice Emperor, blurting out:
"This young man is extraordinary!
He has far better talent than us!
Why did you provoke such a person for no reason?"
The Ice Emperor was also filled with regret, he despised everyone but Emperor Shitian, not even holding the Divine General in esteem, how could he possibly respect these ’minions’ in Lingyun Cave?
To him, Ding Ling was just another ant, to be killed at will, why ask why?
But little did he expect, after killing many.
He provoked someone he shouldn’t have!
He was already gloom-ridden, and now being retorted by the Divine General, made him even more embarrassed.
The Divine General saw this, let out a light snort, elucidated but not keen to point it out further, merely accelerated forward.
Ding Ling fled all the way.
Speed incredibly fast.

With his exceptional Tracking and Tracing skill, he knew that the Ice Emperor and the Divine General were rapidly catching up, a thought struck him, causing him to flee towards the habitat of the Fire Qilin.
This location was mapped out by Ding Ling.
Following the map.
A moment later.
Arriving at the destination.
Looking around.
It appeared as a Demon Cave.
The internal space was huge.
Several tens of zhang high!
A hundred zhang in length and width!
Resembling a Grotto Heaven World.
Moving swiftly past.
It was clear to see that the center of this Earth Realm was occupied by a magma pool.
This magma was peculiarly strange, half red fire, half black fire, swirling continuously in a Tai Chi formation.
Ding Ling glanced around, and then all around, activating Mechanical Skill, Array Skill, Geomancy Skill, finding a crucial point in merely an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - 581: Devouring Qilin Blood
paragraphs: Ding Ling looked at the magma pool and, without hesitation, leaped in.
Plop!
A soft sound.
Ding Ling submerged into the magma pool and disappeared from sight.
Almost at the moment he dove into the pool.
Whoosh!
A Frost Storm arrived in the blink of an eye.
Then afterward.
A Thunder Fire shot into the air, landing beside the storm.
As the storm and thunder fire dissipated, two tall and mighty figures emerged—they were the Ice Emperor and the Divine General.
Their eyes were like lightning, sweeping across the Ten Directions Realm, yet they didn’t see Ding Ling, leaving them looking at each other in surprise.
The Divine General sighed and admiringly said:
"That guy can really run fast. We pushed ourselves to the limit and still couldn’t catch him! It shows his Lightweight Skill must be refined to the extreme!"
The Ice Emperor snorted and said:
"He is our mortal enemy. As long as he lives, I will never be at ease! Now that we’ve joined forces, we must find and kill him today."
The Divine General agreed deeply and sighed:
"This guy’s talent is truly unmatched in the world. I’m afraid no one can compare to him, and having offended him, it’s not just you who is uneasy, I am too."
He glanced at the Ice Emperor and said:
"You didn’t think of me when dividing the benefits, but when it comes to such a mess, you drag me in first!"
"We are all part of the Celestial Sect, we should naturally be friendly and mutually helpful."
The Ice Emperor stiffly replied.
"Heh."
The Divine General sneered twice:
"Even you don’t believe in your own words."
He leaped into the air like a spring, shooting out dozens of feet away, landing in the center of the Demon Cave, and looked down at the magma pool:
"This place is unobstructed, the only place to hide is this magma pool. Ice Emperor, you go down and take a look."
The Ice Emperor gave the Divine General a sidelong glance:
"Why don’t you go down!"
"You’re the one asking me. Not me asking you."
The Divine General coldly taunted:
"If you don’t want to go down, then forget it. That young man will definitely target you first! Even if you die, you’ll definitely die before me."
The Ice Emperor’s face darkened, and with a grim expression, he reluctantly flew into the magma pool, vanishing instantly beneath the surface.
But it wasn’t long before, with the sound of rushing water, he emerged again, grimacing in pain:

"It’s too hot, too sinister. There is a very powerful corrosive, scorching force within. My Protective Gang Qi won’t last very long. Divine General, you go take a look; your World-Ending Demon Body is invulnerable, unrivaled; this mere magma should not be able to harm you."
"Heh."
The Divine General lightly chuckled:

"You can’t hold on for long. So that young man can hold on for long? Why not just wait here and see how long he can last. When he can’t anymore, he will naturally jump out, and by then, we can kill him, which will surely satisfy you."
"Makes sense."
The Ice Emperor’s eyes brightened:
"That guy must be here, and most likely hiding in this magma pool. Let’s wait here patiently. Let’s see if he would rather be consumed by that scorching corrosive air or choose to let us kill him."
After Ding Ling entered the magma pool.
Protective Gang Qi activated.
His body continued to sink.
His eyes were sharp, scanning in all directions.
What he saw was the rolling magma surging like a mighty river, sometimes rising to high altitudes, sometimes suddenly descending ten feet.
If Ding Ling wasn’t controlling his descent, he would be involuntarily swept along, and in due time, be reduced to ashes.
Whoosh!
A scorching, corrosive aura assaulted him.

Ding Ling frowned slightly, feeling some discomfort, but he didn’t think he wouldn’t be able to endure. With Breathing Technique Body Refining, his Seven Great Breathing Techniques were at Great Perfection, and his physical quality was countless times higher than that of the average Grandmaster.
With Gang Qi protecting his body.
His strong physical quality was enough to safeguard him for now.
Continuing to descend.
Suddenly the ground below became empty.
Ding Ling’s entire body fell and landed in a new realm.
Ding Ling quickly surveyed his surroundings.
It was a new cave.
Larger, deeper, and darker than the Fire Qilin’s cave.
In the distance, terrifying howls, shrieks, and sharp cries could faintly be heard, as if demons were wailing, crying, and screaming.
Looking up.
A crimson rock wall emitted a faint red glow, sometimes rising, sometimes sinking, as if it were breathing, eerily strange.
And it was this dim red light that illuminated the area of several dozen feet around Ding Ling.
Beyond that was enshrouded in darkness, obscuring clear vision.
Ding Ling knew he was not invincible in this world.
Not to mention Emperor Shitian.
That Xiaao Sanxiaao, the Half-God, Great Sun Buddha, and others, were undoubtedly strong at the Void Shattering Level!
As for whether there’s actually a Great Sun Buddha in this world?
Ding Ling did not know.
But he knew one thing.
In this world, it is the law of survival of the fittest, and only the strong can dominate heaven and earth.
He took a deep breath.
Used his skill to retrieve the Qilin’s corpse from the Storage Pouch and placed it on the ground.
He looked at the Fire Qilin’s body and thought:
"The Fire Qilin is a treasure in itself. Being one of the Four Great Divine Beasts. Even if it’s inferior to the Divine Dragon, Phoenix, and Dragon Turtle, it shouldn’t be too much of a gap."
Ding Ling took out the broken Immortal Weapon Long Halberd and a bucket, and began to drain the Qilin’s blood.
Puff!
The Immortal Weapon Long Halberd pierced the major artery in the Qilin’s neck, and fresh blood gushed out, quickly being collected by Ding Ling into a bucket.

"This long halberd is indeed sharp; the scales at the Qilin’s neck have the strongest defense. I couldn’t break through, but this long halberd, when used with Longevity Venerable Qi, can easily open it, truly revealing unmatched sharpness. It’s a pity, it can only be used twice."
The Immortal Weapon Long Halberd greatly consumes Longevity Venerable Qi.
After Ding Ling used it twice.
He had to wait for the Longevity Venerable Qi to restore automatically before using it again.
He quickly drained half a bucket of Qilin blood.
Ding Ling immediately took out a bowl, scooped a bowlful, and gulped it down.
While he discarded many pots and pans, he left one for himself to use.
Whoosh!
As soon as the Qilin blood entered his stomach.
Ding Ling felt a hot, surging energy, carrying corrosive, sinister, and demonic power, rampaging throughout his entire body, as if intending to burn and melt him.
This power was too violent.
Ding Ling only drank a bowl.
Feeling like he had swallowed a bomb.
Rolling thunderous sounds constantly roared and exploded inside him.
Ding Ling’s expression slightly changed, and he immediately began frantically running the Seven Great Breathing Techniques, Eternal Youth Technique, Nine Yang Divine Skill, and other divine skills.
All of these skills were at Full Level.
With a thought, Ding Ling could activate them rapidly.
At this moment, Ding Ling fully exerted himself to run these divine skills.
Rolling Blood Qi and Primordial Qi were immediately refined and absorbed.
Ding Ling’s physical quality began to soar.
The previous depletion and weakness caused by Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill were not only swept away, but he also felt a strong sense of power increase.

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - 582: Dragon Elephant
paragraphs: [Strength +1]
[Physique +1]
[Defense +1]
The attribute points that were originally growing slowly suddenly surged again.
It was the body refining effect of the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill starting to accelerate once more.
This Qilin blood truly deserves its reputation for producing the Mad Blood family, known for being extremely evil and demonic.
After Ding Ling swallowed this blood.
Although the attribute points skyrocketed.
His roots were constantly being transformed in the unseen, and his potential value began to rise.
But that omnipresent demonic nature also started rushing towards the location of Ding Ling’s heart.
Buzz!
Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi guarded his heart, confronting the Demon Qi head-on.
Boom!
With the heart as the battlefield, a mere thirty-nine Buddha Qi brutally shattered a thick Demon Qi that rushed into the heart.
However, after shattering this Demon Qi.
One of the Buddha Qi became slightly dim.
"It indeed worked."
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.

He sensed that Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi could directly confront this Evil Qi and Demon Qi, daring him to drink this Qilin blood, otherwise he wouldn’t have dared to drink such Mad Blood casually!
"It’s normal for the body of the Divine Beast Qilin to have divinity, but I didn’t expect it to have such a great demonic nature!"
Ding Ling thought to himself:
"No wonder Emperor Shitian doesn’t come to kill this Fire Qilin. Seems he looks down upon the blood of the Fire Qilin."
The blood of the Fire Qilin does not confer immortality.
It is useless to Emperor Shitian.
Moreover, the demonic nature is too deep, the side effects are too great.
Ordinary people simply don’t dare to drink it.
But Ding Ling dares.
"Continue."
Ding Ling leaned over and scooped up three large bowls of blood, gulping them down directly.
With the Qilin blood entering his stomach.
Ding Ling’s whole body felt like it was on fire.
That feeling of his roots being forged and elevated.
The sensation of his physical attributes rising wildly appeared again.
The Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill accelerated the refining of Blood Qi and Primordial Qi, but in a moment.
Ding Ling’s Strength, Physique, and Defense all increased by +2.
Three strands of Demon Qi charged into his heart.
Shattered by Buddha Qi.
One of the thirty-nine Buddha Qi was completely discolored, then dimmed and disappeared, becoming thirty-eight.
Ding Ling pondered:
"Apparently, four large bowls of blood can yield four strands of Demon Qi, and ultimately four strands of Demon Qi will be dissipated along with one Buddha Qi."
"Not just that. This Qilin blood seems to be gradually developing resistance."
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Roots 6, Wisdom 7.5, Strength 93.8, Agility 81.9, Physique 93.8, Defense 91, Charm 13. True Power Value: 27 points]
Because of the continuous improvement of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill.
The Blood Qi, Spiritual Mechanism, and Primordial Qi of this Qilin blood first replenished the three-dimensional Attribute Points of Strength, Physique, and Defense.
The growth in strength allowed Ding Ling’s physical strength alone to exceed nine thousand pounds now.
Growth in Physique caused Ding Ling’s endurance and vitality to break into a new boundary again!
Defense seemed to stack up like nine layers of armor! Ordinary people can hardly break through.
"But it’s still not enough. Continue."
Ding Ling then scooped up four more large bowls of Qilin blood.
Under the joint action of the Breathing Technique and Eternal Youth Technique.
Rolling Blood Qi and Primordial Qi poured into the body shell.
The Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill automatically operated, absorbing all this refined Blood Qi and Primordial Qi.
[Strength +2]
[Physique +2]
[Defense +2]
Four strands of Demon Qi emerged, charged into the heart, and neutralized one Buddha Qi.
[Buddha Qi: 37 strands]
Thus Ding Ling kept swallowing Qilin blood.
Until seventy percent of the Qilin blood was completely ingested by him.
[Buddha Qi: 27 strands]
[Strength 100, Physique 100, Defense 100]
Strength, Physique, and Defense all rose to a new boundary.
Thunk!
Ding Ling’s body slightly trembled, and under the crazy operation of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, the absorbed refined Blood Qi and Spiritual Mechanism transformed into two extremely pure Origin Qi.
"These two Qi?"
Ding Ling clenched his fist slightly, activating the two Qi, only to feel that with these two Qi injected into his fist, he seemed capable of smashing Heaven and Earth, crushing the Earth.
"Such a powerful feeling!"
"Is this the true power of the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill?!"
After Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill reached Great Perfection.
Because Ding Ling didn’t timely replenish Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi, wildly increasing a massive segment of three-dimensional attributes, causing Ding Ling to nearly starve to death.
Later, the library sensed it, slowing down the increase rate.
Only then did Ding Ling avoid the fate of starving to death, yet still constantly felt hungry.
Only after taking Great Medicine, did he feel somewhat better.
But ultimately he still couldn’t avoid feeling hungry after a while!

Know that Ding Ling is not what he used to be, starving for ten days and nights wasn’t a problem, yet he often felt hungry, showing that the side effects of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill’s rapid improvement were extremely terrifying.
And after swallowing Qilin blood, this feeling almost disappeared entirely.
Ding Ling felt only vigorous, full of energy!
As if he transformed into the Dragon and Elephant!
"These two Qi?"
Ding Ling closed his eyes, delicately sensing.
Only felt two faintly discernible Qi wandering through his internal organs, and all over his body, among which one Qi, quite dragon-like, the other, elephant-like!
The two Qi intertwined and wound together, occasionally wandering through Ding Ling’s body shell, as they passed, Ding Ling’s shell continued becoming stronger!
Toughness, endurance, defense, etc., all increased.
Though the increase was slow.
But indeed it was increasing.
"Is this a Dragon and Elephant?"
Ding Ling was surprised, deeply moved:
"The birth of a Dragon and Elephant within the body. This is the true power of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill?"
"No wonder it is claimed to be a supreme skill that requires thousands of years to successfully cultivate. Indeed, extraordinary."
Ding Ling thought so.
Involuntarily glanced at the Qilin blood.
After consuming seventy percent of this Qilin blood.
Resistance had reached its peak.
Almost nothing useful remained.
Fortunately, Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill just needs the powerful Blood Qi and Primordial Qi within it.
This Blood Qi carries divinity!
It is an extremely fitting Qi for the Dragon Form and Elephant Form of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!
The birth of Dragon Form and Elephant Form is greatly attributed to this Blood Qi!
"No wonder it’s a Divine Beast."
Ding Ling continued to swallow Qilin blood without hesitation.
Swallowing several large bowls in succession.
The growth of three-dimensional attributes was slow.
But the vague state of Dragon Form and Elephant Form was gradually solidifying.
Ding Ling clenched his fists slightly, able to clearly sense that as these two Qi infused into his fists, he could effortlessly strike out with the power of Dragon and Elephant!
"This is the essence of the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!"
"Only the true Great Perfection can, after absorbing a large amount of Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi, and divinity, give birth to the Divine Qi of Dragon Form and Elephant Form!"
"These two Divine Qi have limitless potential, perhaps developing all the way, they might truly become a Dragon and an Elephant in the future!"
Ding Ling was exhilarated.
At this moment.
He realized why Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill is almost impossible for anyone to cultivate to Great Perfection.
Because this Cultivation Technique is incredibly tough to master.
Resources, aptitude, time, insight, and the like are indispensable.
Gulp, gulp!
After Ding Ling finished drinking all the Qilin blood at once.
The Dragon Form and Elephant Form of the two Qi progressed from a vague invisible state to a visible state.

Ding Ling’s body slightly trembled, and under the crazy operation of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, the absorbed refined Blood Qi and Spiritual Mechanism transformed into two extremely pure Origin Qi.
"These two Qi?"
Ding Ling clenched his fist slightly, activating the two Qi, only to feel that with these two Qi injected into his fist, he seemed capable of smashing Heaven and Earth, crushing the Earth.
"Such a powerful feeling!"
"Is this the true power of the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill?!"
After Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill reached Great Perfection.
Because Ding Ling didn’t timely replenish Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi, wildly increasing a massive segment of three-dimensional attributes, causing Ding Ling to nearly starve to death.
Later, the library sensed it, slowing down the increase rate.
Only then did Ding Ling avoid the fate of starving to death, yet still constantly felt hungry.
Only after taking Great Medicine, did he feel somewhat better.
But ultimately he still couldn’t avoid feeling hungry after a while!

Know that Ding Ling is not what he used to be, starving for ten days and nights wasn’t a problem, yet he often felt hungry, showing that the side effects of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill’s rapid improvement were extremely terrifying.
And after swallowing Qilin blood, this feeling almost disappeared entirely.
Ding Ling felt only vigorous, full of energy!
As if he transformed into the Dragon and Elephant!
"These two Qi?"
Ding Ling closed his eyes, delicately sensing.
Only felt two faintly discernible Qi wandering through his internal organs, and all over his body, among which one Qi, quite dragon-like, the other, elephant-like!
The two Qi intertwined and wound together, occasionally wandering through Ding Ling’s body shell, as they passed, Ding Ling’s shell continued becoming stronger!
Toughness, endurance, defense, etc., all increased.
Though the increase was slow.
But indeed it was increasing.
"Is this a Dragon and Elephant?"
Ding Ling was surprised, deeply moved:
"The birth of a Dragon and Elephant within the body.
This is the true power of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill?"
"No wonder it is claimed to be a supreme skill that requires thousands of years to successfully cultivate.
Indeed, extraordinary."
Ding Ling thought so.
Involuntarily glanced at the Qilin blood.
After consuming seventy percent of this Qilin blood.
Resistance had reached its peak.
Almost nothing useful remained.
Fortunately, Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill just needs the powerful Blood Qi and Primordial Qi within it.
This Blood Qi carries divinity!
It is an extremely fitting Qi for the Dragon Form and Elephant Form of Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!
The birth of Dragon Form and Elephant Form is greatly attributed to this Blood Qi!
"No wonder it’s a Divine Beast."
Ding Ling continued to swallow Qilin blood without hesitation.
Swallowing several large bowls in succession.
The growth of three-dimensional attributes was slow.
But the vague state of Dragon Form and Elephant Form was gradually solidifying.
Ding Ling clenched his fists slightly, able to clearly sense that as these two Qi infused into his fists, he could effortlessly strike out with the power of Dragon and Elephant!
"This is the essence of the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill!"
"Only the true Great Perfection can, after absorbing a large amount of Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi, and divinity, give birth to the Divine Qi of Dragon Form and Elephant Form!"
"These two Divine Qi have limitless potential, perhaps developing all the way, they might truly become a Dragon and an Elephant in the future!"
Ding Ling was exhilarated.
At this moment.
He realized why Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill is almost impossible for anyone to cultivate to Great Perfection.
Because this Cultivation Technique is incredibly tough to master.
Resources, aptitude, time, insight, and the like are indispensable.
Gulp, gulp!
After Ding Ling finished drinking all the Qilin blood at once.
The Dragon Form and Elephant Form of the two Qi progressed from a vague invisible state to a visible state.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - 583: The Forging of Divinity and Blood
paragraphs: [Buddha Qi: 22 paths.]
[Power: 102, Defense: 102, Constitution: 102]
Although drinking Qilin Blood eventually had little effect, the three attributes each grew by two points.
After breaking through the 100-point mark.
Ding Ling’s physical traits underwent a profound transformation unseen.
The Dragon Elephant Qi that emerged was evident.
Clearly, only when the defense attribute breaks 100 can one naturally generate this Dragon Elephant Qi; otherwise, it cannot be born.
It is like how shallow waters cannot nurture a Flood Dragon, nor can small temples accommodate a True God!
Just like in the Lower Realm, where Spiritual Vitality is scarce, making it hard to birth an Immortal! After all, the world’s limits are set.
Similarly,
The physical constitution is akin to this world; only when robust enough can it birth mighty Qi.
And this Dragon Form, Elephant Form Qi,
Has Divinity!
It’s extraordinary, uncommon Qi, only Ding Ling with such physical traits can give birth to!
"Now the Dragon and Elephant Forms have moved from a faint state to one that is clear and perceptible, though still very hazy."
Ding Ling thought to himself:
"It seems the potential of these Dragon and Elephant Forms is vast."
In the process of drinking Qilin Blood, Ding Ling’s perception grew clearer.
The Divinity of Qilin Blood facilitated the expansion of these two forms of Qi!
If Divinity is the soul,
Then the Spiritual Vitality of Qilin Blood is the flesh.
Without the soul, the Dragon and Elephant Forms are dead, limited in potential, but with Divinity, the soul is gained, raising future potential.
"Good."
Ding Ling nodded quietly, glancing at the Fire Qilin’s corpse.
With all its blood drained,
Its fiery red luster also lost its brilliance.
Needless to say,
All its Essence undoubtedly resided in the blood.
Thunk!

Ding Ling slightly clenched his fist, activating the Dragon and Elephant Forms, lightning injected into his fist, he instantly felt he had the power to overturn the heavens, his punch seemingly able to smash everything!
"It shouldn’t be an illusion."
Ding Ling clearly felt as the Dragon and Elephant Form Qi infused, his attack power was crazily growing!
As if his arm truly became a Dragon Elephant!
"Impressive."
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows.
With these two forms of Qi on his side, Ding Ling’s confidence in defeating the Ice Emperor and Divine General soared considerably.
Just how long can these two forms of Qi last in battle?
Ding Ling hasn’t tested it, not very sure.
"Still a bit fuzzy. Seems more Divinity and Blood Qi must be consumed to develop these two forms of Qi."
The two forms of Qi constantly traveled around the body.
Physical attributes strengthened as they traveled, continually growing stronger.

"It’s fundamentally because the Fire Qilin is too weak, if Divine Dragon Blood were consumed, these two forms of Qi would certainly materialize, casting one punch would unleash the power of both a Dragon and an Elephant, simply explosive!"
Here, the Dragon Elephant is the Divine Dragon and the ancient Great Elephant!
Ding Ling once saw this kind of Great Elephant in an ancient book of this world by chance.
A Thunder Elephant that can fiercely battle the Divine Dragon, evenly matched, a massive powerful entity!

"If my Dragon and Elephant Forms were completely materialized, equaling Divine Dragon and Thunder Elephant combined on me, not even one Emperor Shitian, but two Emperor Shitians wouldn’t be enough for me to defeat!"
As Ding Ling speculated.
He couldn’t help but glance at the Fire Qilin.
Approached.
Began to cut flesh.
Devour.
Refine.
Even though flesh isn’t as potent as blood,
It is still useful.
Sure enough.
As the Seven Great Breathing Techniques, Eternal Youth Technique, and others collectively operated, rapidly refining the Essence Qi, Blood Qi, Primordial Qi, and Divinity contained in the flesh.
Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill started automatically absorbing this Divinity and Blood Qi Primordial Qi again.
The three-dimensional Attribute Points began to grow again.
[Power+0.1]
[Defense+0.1]
[Constitution+0.1]
Though due to drug resistance, the growth speed is somewhat slow.
But this doesn’t affect the Dragon and Elephant Forms rapidly devouring Divinity and Blood Qi Primordial Qi to refine itself, making the body increasingly formidable and solid.
Moreover, the flesh contains less Demon Qi, Evil Qi compared to the blood.
Ding Ling’s consumption of Buddha Qi greatly decreased, he couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
He was really worried Buddha Qi would be exhausted here.
Although reading Buddhist Scripture can increase Buddha Qi,
It’s naturally better to consume less.
After Ding Ling ate, digested all of the Qilin’s flesh and bones.
[Buddha Qi: 18 paths]
[Power: 105, Defense: 105, Constitution: 105]
The three-dimensional attributes each increased by three points.
Towards the end it almost had no effect, but gaining three points is still not bad.
Most importantly is the refinement degree of Dragon and Elephant Forms.
Can be observed.
Became clearly visible.
Ding Ling waved his hand.
The Dragon and Elephant Forms manifested in the void,
A Divine Dragon coiled around his body once, a dragon head emerged from his left shoulder, imposing with an overbearing aura, immeasurable;

A Thunder Elephant stood in the void behind Ding Ling, well over a zhang tall, its massive body like a small mountain, like Ding Ling’s Guardian God, wrapped in bolts of lightning, illuminating the Ten Directions Realm, supporting Ding Ling who looked like an Immortal or a Saint, not a Mortal World person!
"Indeed it can manifest in the void."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:

"Very good. The Fire Qilin fulfilled its destiny. Its corpse completed me. Now my Dragon and Elephant Forms have nearly absorbed all the Divinity and Blood Qi of the Fire Qilin. Gained the Qilin’s spirit and blood, forged a remarkable foundation. Possesses very powerful attack capability now."
Ding Ling did not need to display.
Just perceive,
He could clearly feel the powerful attack force and protective power on the Divine Dragon and Thunder Elephant.
The combination of Divine Dragon and Thunder Elephant seemed stronger compared to the Fire Qilin’s power.
After all, before birthing the Dragon and Elephant Forms, Ding Ling consumed many Great Medicines, medicinal wines, etc.!
"Though the Divine Dragon and Thunder Elephant’s external manifestation seems majestic, ultimately it’s not as powerful as being infused into my fist."
The two Divine Forms combined stronger compared to the Fire Qilin.
But still crushed under the High-tier Grandmaster fate.
When infused into the fist.
Fusion Qi driven, tenfold amplification.
Dragon Elephant Power combined with Tathagata Divine Palm, combat strength increased twentyfold.
Surpassing realms, battling Ice Emperor, Divine General will not be an issue.
"Time to go out."
The Fire Qilin was consumed completely by Ding Ling.
No need to stay here.
Ding Ling never expected he would end up eating the Fire Qilin completely!
He came here only seeking the Blood Bodhi, yet he finished off the Fire Qilin.
Boom!
Ding Ling soared in the Void, flying to the top of the cavern wall, about to punch through the top, step into the rolling magma.
Suddenly from afar in the dark realm a Yin wind blew.
Within this Yin wind was a faintly discernible silhouette shrieking toward Ding Ling.
Ding Ling frowned, focused his gaze.
Under dim red illumination, in the distance, dozens of zhang away, a black tornado storm within stood a towering figure over one zhang two in height.

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - 584: Wolf Demon
paragraphs: The figure’s protagonist stood in the eye of the storm, baring its fangs and claws towards him.
Its face was extremely vague, sometimes appearing suddenly, sometimes flickering and disappearing.
Ding Ling saw it clearly during the brief appearance.
It was a face strikingly similar to that of a werewolf!
Hairy, with ears standing upright on the head, narrow eyes flashing with cold glint, canine nose, elongated face, overall resembling a wolf’s head embedded in the tall human body.
It was howling fiercely at Ding Ling, its voice sharp and piercing.
Seeming full of hostility and murderous intent towards Ding Ling.
Yet, it seemed afraid to step into the domain of the dark red light, only wandering and hovering outside the light’s aura, in the darkness.
Ding Ling frowned:
"What kind of ghostly thing is this?!"
"Are there wolf demons appearing in the Wind and Cloud World?!"
While Ding Ling was stunned, he quickly thought of the ’beast medicine’ developed by Emperor Shitian, his heart stirred:
"Could it be that Emperor Shitian has also come, right in this ghostly place?"
The beast medicine made by Emperor Shitian turns humans into a half-human half-beast, a monstrous appearance.
It resembles the figure across?
"Emperor Shitian is quite the genius. Having lived for over a thousand years, he’s thought of every crooked idea, even succeeded in developing them."
Emperor Shitian not only succeeded in developing beast medicine.
He also invented the ’underwater diving device’!
He’s got quite a knack for scientific innovation.
Various other aspects, not limited to just those.
Clearly, Emperor Shitian is an all-round talent. Over a thousand years, one might get bored, possibly dabbled into all sorts of skills, learned them all!
Having learned everything.
He started playing with people’s minds, adding drama for himself, becoming an actor!
His acting skills are quite high.
Playing the likes of Fengyun, turning them in circles! Initially, they hadn’t realized Xu Fu was Emperor Shitian at all!
"If Emperor Shitian is here, how did he even get in? Could it be, like me, he sank through the lava in Fire Qilin’s dwelling?"
"But if he is here, why hasn’t he discovered me until now? Or is he busy with some major affair, having no time to bother with me?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But he didn’t bother thinking too much.
He looked up at the dark red cave ceiling above.
Lava surged endlessly, rising and falling, seemingly breathing like a living creature, with a particularly regular pattern.
Oddly though, the lava did not fall down.
Ding Ling attempted just now, diving straight in, but no matter how he tried, he couldn’t enter, inevitably channeling all of his power, threw a heavy punch at the cave wall.
Boom!
The punch landed, causing the entire cave wall to shake violently, faintly resembling sharp cries and wails.
Ding Ling’s heart skipped a beat, glanced around, other than the twelve-foot-tall ’wolf demon’ howling fiercely at him, no one else was visible.
He examined the cave wall carefully.
Presently his skills were exceedingly profound, exerting a punch imbued with Dragon Elephant Power should easily shatter stones, yet it failed to break through the cave wall?!
"Something’s off."
Ding Ling meticulously examined the mysterious essence of the cave wall.
Boom!

Again he thrust out a punch, causing the wall to tremble once more, this time Ding Ling saw clearly, there were dark red threads flashing briefly, connecting the entire wall to something beneath the ground, seeming to resonate?
"Is this an array?"
Ding Ling was moved:
"If I want to shatter the wall and burst out, it would inevitably cause this realm to collapse directly. At that time, I might be buried alive here!"
Ding Ling sighed:
"So directly passing through this path is not feasible?"
He would need extraordinary proficiency to unravel this array’s art of breaking.
Yet after observing for a long time, Ding Ling discovered this array was exceedingly profound, far beyond his understanding.

"It is a type embedded with divine and demonic nature. Interconnected and rotating in Tai Chi. No wonder the magma pool where the Fire Qilin dwells is half red fire, half black fire, revolving in Tai Chi state, it seems the root lies here!"
If Ding Ling’s guess was correct.
The Fire Qilin containing both divine and demonic nature is definitely closely related to the array.
"If the upper path won’t work."
"Then we must try other means."
Ding Ling took a deep breath, looked at the wolf demon, it stood upon the black storm, baring its fangs and claws, its face appearing and disappearing, extremely fierce.

Ding Ling abruptly activated Soaring in the Void, stepping a stride, his figure blasted across like a meteor, towards the wolf demon, in a moment reached face to face, and delivered a palm infused with Dragon Elephant Power, the Tathagata Divine Palm!
Heavenly Buddha Incarnation!
Once the palm was issued, a Heavenly Buddha appeared faintly in the void, followed by a dragon form and elephant form illusion striking at the wolf demon.
Awoo!

The wolf demon raised its wolf claw, slashing fiercely towards Ding Ling’s head area, with this tear, the storm roared, with wolf shadows faintly visible in it, angrily howling and biting towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling disregarded everything.
Once the palm struck.
The storm was obliterated.
Countless wolf shadows were annihilated!
In just an instant, the Tathagata Divine Palm imprinted upon the wolf demon’s heart!
Poof!
A heavy noise, the imposing like mountains palm print directly penetrated the wolf demon’s body.
"Uh, uh..."
The wolf demon looked down at its heart area, in disbelief, its entire body uncontrollably fell from the storm, collapsed onto the ground, only able to inhale but not exhale, close to death.

Ding Ling glanced at his palm, thought silently: Indeed, Fusion Qi triggering Dragon Elephant Power with the Tathagata Divine Palm, enhances strength twentyfold, allows easy suppression of high-tier Grandmaster’s power.
This wolf demon’s prowess is extraordinary, reaching middle-tier Grandmaster’s strength.
Yet was effortlessly slain by a single palm from Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s power increased rapidly, clearly evident.
"Just a wolf demon is already this strong."
Ding Ling stepped forward, slightly bent over, placed his hand on the wolf demon’s shoulder, activating the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
Whoosh!
A torrent of sinister and demonic power surged out of the wolf demon’s Dantian and meridians, pouring into Ding Ling’s body.
It was swiftly refined.
Strands of pure Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi were refined out.
Simultaneously, waves of sinister and demonic power manifested the wolf demon’s figure, attempting to rush towards Ding Ling’s bloodstream, heart, and other areas.
Boom!
Divine Power of Dragon Form and Elephant Form appeared in various parts of the body, overwhelmingly repelling the ’wolf demon’ directly out of the body.
Bang!
The wolf demon was expelled out, still circling Ding Ling continuously roaring and growling.
Ding Ling ignored it.
He hadn’t expected Dragon Form and Elephant Form Qi to be this potent!
No need for Buddha Qi or Vast Righteous Qi to act, directly repelling this demonic power!
"Indeed, Gods and Demons stand opposed!"
"The Elephant Form and Dragon Form absorbed all Fire Qilin’s Divine Power! Unless stronger than Fire Qilin’s Divine Power, ordinary demonic forces cannot stain me!"

The wolf demon looked down at its heart area, in disbelief, its entire body uncontrollably fell from the storm, collapsed onto the ground, only able to inhale but not exhale, close to death.

Ding Ling glanced at his palm, thought silently: Indeed, Fusion Qi triggering Dragon Elephant Power with the Tathagata Divine Palm, enhances strength twentyfold, allows easy suppression of high-tier Grandmaster’s power.
This wolf demon’s prowess is extraordinary, reaching middle-tier Grandmaster’s strength.
Yet was effortlessly slain by a single palm from Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s power increased rapidly, clearly evident.
"Just a wolf demon is already this strong."
Ding Ling stepped forward, slightly bent over, placed his hand on the wolf demon’s shoulder, activating the Eternal Youth Technique.
Absorption Skill!
Transformation Skill!
Storage Skill!
Whoosh!
A torrent of sinister and demonic power surged out of the wolf demon’s Dantian and meridians, pouring into Ding Ling’s body.
It was swiftly refined.
Strands of pure Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi were refined out.
Simultaneously, waves of sinister and demonic power manifested the wolf demon’s figure, attempting to rush towards Ding Ling’s bloodstream, heart, and other areas.
Boom!
Divine Power of Dragon Form and Elephant Form appeared in various parts of the body, overwhelmingly repelling the ’wolf demon’ directly out of the body.
Bang!
The wolf demon was expelled out, still circling Ding Ling continuously roaring and growling.
Ding Ling ignored it.
He hadn’t expected Dragon Form and Elephant Form Qi to be this potent!
No need for Buddha Qi or Vast Righteous Qi to act, directly repelling this demonic power!
"Indeed, Gods and Demons stand opposed!"
"The Elephant Form and Dragon Form absorbed all Fire Qilin’s Divine Power!
Unless stronger than Fire Qilin’s Divine Power, ordinary demonic forces cannot stain me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 585: Coffin
paragraphs: Ding Ling was filled with confidence and his spirit soared!
With the protection of Dragon Form and Elephant Form.
Typical demonic and evil forces, he can completely ignore!
The Fire Qilin accomplished Ding Ling.
Only the ground was left with scales flashing a dim light. Ding Ling collected these scales for future weapon crafting.
Comparing to the Fire Qilin.
This Wolf Demon is useless, except for its True Qi.
[Inner Power Value +500]
The True Qi of this Wolf Demon, although extremely dense, far exceeds Shi Wuzun.
But because the demonic nature and evil forces are too intense, the refined Spiritual Vitality only resulted in five strands of Longevity True Qi.
[True Power Value: 28 points]
True Power Value rises again.
Ding Ling feels his strength has been significantly enhanced.
Not only that.
As Ding Ling’s strength improves, it seems that Dragon Form and Elephant Form have also absorbed a bit of Spiritual Vitality mysteriously, growing somewhat.
Peng!

Ding Ling unleashed the Tathagata Divine Palm, a move of Boundless Dharma, hitting the Wolf Qi concentrated from demonic and evil forces, Peng! With a crisp sound, the Wolf Qi was instantly dispersed.
The Tathagata Divine Palm, imbued with the divine power of Dragon Form and Elephant Form, happens to be the nemesis of this Wolf Qi!
"I wonder who the mastermind behind this Wolf Demon is?"
Ding Ling continued forward.
Soon.
He saw a mighty figure as tall as two zhang with a fox head.
He is also a figure of Middle Tier Grandmaster, charging at Ding Ling like the wind, fierce and vicious, as if to tear Ding Ling apart.
Ding Ling didn’t think; he directly struck with a palm, Tathagata Divine Palm!
Buddha Moves Mountain and Rivers!
With a palm strike, a ’swastika’ appears and disappears on the palm, as Ding Ling launches the palm, the ’swastika’ flies like a flash of lightning and imprints on the Fox Demon’s heart, Peng!
The Fox Demon was immediately knocked back dozens of zhang, spewing several blood arrows in mid-air, and when collapsed to the ground, was already dead.
Died even faster than the Wolf Demon.
Yet, Ding Ling has gradually learned how to perfectly use the power of Dragon Form and Elephant Form to complement the Tathagata Divine Palm.
He sped up and moved forward.
Activating the Eternal Youth Technique! Absorption Skill! Transformation Skill! Storage Skill!
Rolling Magic Power surged into the Dantian.
Spiritual Vitality was refined out.
Evil Qi and Demon Qi were jointly expelled from the body by Dragon Form and Elephant Form!
[Inner Power Value +500]
[True Power Value: 30 points]
Ding Ling’s strength surged by two more points.
Feeling that breakthrough is within reach.
"It seems the True Power Value needed to shatter the void far exceeds my expectations."
Ding Ling, when confronting Divine General and Ice Emperor, felt the absolute True Qi gap between him and them.
Now it seems.
It’s as expected.
Their True Power Value should be over 40 points.
"But I have reached 30 points. Tenfold amplification with Elephant Form, Dragon Form, and Tathagata Divine Palm are enough to suppress Divine General and Ice Emperor!"
Ding Ling, holding the broken Immortal Weapon Long Halberd, rushed forward.
His strength greatly increased.
Walking through the dark realm, he wasn’t too scared.
He had quite a few trump cards.
Facing life and death crisis, he could cope with ease.
Thus.
All the way.
The faster he walked.
Whizzing!
Stepping on Qingfeng, a hundred meters in an instant, rushed into the depths of darkness, no idea how far.
Ding Ling finally reached the end of the cave.
Holding the scales of the Fire Qilin, which emitted faint red light in the darkness, allowing Ding Ling to clearly see the condition of the earth realm ahead.
It’s a stone wall, several dozen zhang high.
The stone wall looked left and right, seemingly no end in sight.
Ding Ling glanced behind.
The boundless earth realm shrouded in black fog and black wind, extremely gloomy and dark! The occasional wailing sound seemed like vengeful spirits running rampant within.
Ding Ling came through the darkness.
Also attempted to search for other demons, but did not find a third one.
He knows that there must be other demons in the darkness.
However, these demons did not appear actively.
Finding them is extremely difficult.
He didn’t deliberately look.
Instead, he walked around the stone wall.
If the end of this realm has no portal, Ding Ling could only smash the stone wall, burying this cavern world together.
He still didn’t believe he had trump cards to timely go to other worlds, yet would still be helpless!
Dada!
Ding Ling blew past like the wind, quickly reaching the end of the stone wall on the left side, finding no anomaly, then turned around, heading to the right.
When he reached the right end.
He finally saw an unusual place.
Marks of artificial excavation were present.
Ding Ling deduced a location using Mechanical Skill, Feng Shui Skill, Stargazing Skill, etc.
Went ahead and tried a few knocks.
Ka-chunk!
With a crisp sound.
Closely followed by a rumbling sound of the ground shaking.
Ding Ling stepped back two steps.
With the light of the scales.
It was clear.
The stone wall was slowly moving to the sides, moving slowly, but Ding Ling waited awhile, knowing the situation behind the stone wall.
Sure enough.
The mechanism portal opened.
Revealing a deep passage from within.
"Who laid an array here and carved such a passage?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Stepped and shattered the ground, grabbed a handful of stones mid-air, tossed them into the depths of the passage. Pop-pop! Stones fell to the ground, not triggering any trap!
Seeing no anomaly.
Then Ding Ling entered.
Roar!
As he stepped into the passage, it felt like entering another world.
A surge of extremely abundant Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi entered the nine orifices.
With each breath, his strength surprisingly increased.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
Not only inner power.
Four-dimensional attributes also began to grow.
Compared to the outside world, how many times faster? Tenfold? Hundredfold?
Ding Ling dared to bet.
Training here for ten years.
Definitely stepping into High-tier Grandmaster!
"Where exactly is this place?"
Ding Ling grew increasingly astonished.
Is there such a realm in the Wind and Cloud World?
Needless to say.
It must be a buried ancient history.
Just like the Fountain of Youth in the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World, had Ding Ling not come to explore, who would know that realm?
This place should be akin to the Fountain of Youth.
Ding Ling walked quickly.
Soon reached the end of the passage.
Gazed intently.
Only to see another Tai Chi appeared ahead.
One side was fiery red flames reaching the skies;
One side was deep dark black flames.
One half red, one half black.
Forming a Tai Chi, slowly rotating.
"Such phenomenon again."
Ding Ling stepped forward.
Saw on the side of fiery red flames placed as many as eight eggs the size of a person!
The aura emanated from these eggs made Ding Ling feel a kindred connection.
Ding Ling was silently shaken, sensed them carefully, couldn’t help but be moved:
"They’re all Qilin Eggs! So many?!"
He sensed one of the Qilin Eggs seemed restless, ready to break out at any time.
Couldn’t help but think:

"According to the original plot, after Nie Feng slashed a Fire Qilin, another Fire Qilin appeared. Maybe that Fire Qilin was resurrected, but it’s more likely these Qilin Eggs hatched a new Fire Qilin."
And a Fire Qilin could walk out from here.
That indicates.
There must be a passage going out.
Ding Ling sighed a breath of relief.
He understood why he felt a kindred connection to Fire Qilin.
It’s because he devoured a Fire Qilin!
The divinity and blood, bones, meat of the Fire Qilin were devoured cleanly by Ding Ling.
Saying he’s a living Qilin now, is not an exaggeration.
"And that other place..."
Ding Ling stepped forward two steps, gazed closely, now seeing clearly this black flame harbored a coffin!
The coffin within swirled with demon aura and evil aura, forming storms to constantly corrode the Qilin Eggs!

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - 586: Xuanyuan Sword
paragraphs: The Qilin Egg, endowed with immense divinity, was covered with demonic patterns!
"So that’s how it is."
"The source is actually here."
The Fire Qilin, even before its birth, was already soaked in the demon energy and evil energy here.
No wonder it was born with Mad Blood!
Thus indirectly giving rise to the Mad Blood family.
"Who on earth is buried in this coffin?"
Ding Ling was curious.
Yet he didn’t have the intention to step forward and open the coffin.
Just because the arrays here are interlinked with those outside, attempting to break the formations here would also smash the grand array outside, causing this cavern world to completely collapse!
"It seems breaking this array is nearly impossible."
Ding Ling previously hit the stone wall hard, causing it to shake violently, believing that a magnification of power dozens of times could break through the array on the stone wall.
It seems now.
That it is difficult to accomplish.
Just because to break the array, one must also destroy the Qilin Egg and the coffin before him!
Leaving aside the power the eight Qilin Eggs possess.

This coffin was extremely strange and demonic, its surrounding demon energy and evil energy surged immensely like overwhelming waves, crashing fiercely, enough to seemingly hear the roaring water noises.
Very obviously.
The demon energy and evil energy here have materialized.
Ding Ling, with his limited Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi, feared he would lack the strength to disperse these demon energies.
Of course, Ding Ling wouldn’t recklessly go forward and try.
"Even if my Dragon Form and Elephant Form combined forces, it would probably still be hard to withstand the counterattack of this demon energy and evil energy."
This demon energy and evil energy could easily corrode the eight Qilin Eggs!
Ding Ling’s Dragon Form and Elephant Form only possess the divine power of one Fire Qilin.
How can it withstand the vicious counterattack of this materialized demon energy?
Ding Ling did not look at the coffin any longer.
Instead, he turned and closely examined the arrangement in all directions.

Here it looked like a sort of cavern, with stalactites hanging down above, bizarre yet vivid, depicting things like an eagle playing with a bear, a lone golden rooster, and flowers and plants, all vividly alive.
Not just the upper stone walls, everywhere in the cave walls and passageways were jagged stones and strange rocks;
With the radiant red glow emitted by the Qilin Eggs, Ding Ling could see very far.
At the end of the passage seemed to be luminescent fiery trees and silver flowers, rugged rocks, and naturally formed pavilions.
Ding Ling saw all these and was quite moved, thinking: "Could this place have been inhabited before? Otherwise, why else would it be constructed so exquisitely? Like a paradise?"
Ding Ling carefully used Stargazing Skill, Geomancy Skill, and Mechanical Skill to examine the structure all around, determined the path ahead, and boldly strode forth.
Before long,
He came to the luminescent fiery trees and silver flowers, glanced up, three zhang tall, clearly stone carvings yet looking like living things, extremely dazzling.
Ding Ling shook his head, didn’t look any further.
Many treasures here.
Appeared earth-shattering, quite extraordinary.
But they were all made of stone, useless to him.
Of course, he was afraid of missing treasures, but upon careful sensing, without exception, they truly were made of stone.
Ding Ling also wondered what kind of person was so idle, to carve ’artworks’ all over this cavern?

But when Ding Ling reached the end of the passage and saw a faintly glowing portal, he suddenly realized that these stone sculptures were intricately linked to absorb the essence of heaven and earth, used to suppress the coffin.
"Not only these artworks capable of automatically absorbing essence, but also those eight Qilin Eggs, all were used to suppress that coffin."
"It seems that what’s in the coffin must be a peerless evil demon. Hence someone needed to spend such a huge effort for multiple levels of suppression!"
Ding Ling looked at the door before him.
It embedded in the ground, serving as the array eye, enlivening all the artworks in the cavern.
Ding Ling stepped within, instantly feeling his power nearly uncontrollably draining away?
"What is this?"
Ding Ling looked down.
This array was siphoning his power!
And as the power was being drawn,
The array glittered, the artworks all around began to glow in tandem, accompanied by a booming sound, the portal opened, and Ding Ling stepped into emptiness, his whole body falling down.
Crack!
After he fell,
The door immediately closed, reverting to its previously ordinary appearance.
Thud!
Ding Ling dropped into an area of flat ground out of nowhere.
He quickly scanned his surroundings.
This place was a very expansive realm.
Both sides of the ground still held numerous stonework artworks, the largest being a dragon a hundred zhang long!
Like the previous artworks, this dragon emitted a faint glow, vividly lifelike, seemingly alive.
And at the dragon’s head, where Ding Ling was, at the very end, there was a section of bone.
This bone, although less than four feet long, shimmered with mystical light, seemingly resonating with the carved divine dragon.
Adjacent to the bone was a human skeleton, and beside the skeleton rested a fully golden sword.
"Where is this?"
Ding Ling was taken aback.
It looked so familiar.
"Could this be a Dragon Vein?"
Ding Ling’s heart stirred, he leaped, soaring elegantly, ascending on wind, his feet skimming over the hundred-zhang body of the divine dragon, landing gently beside the Dragon Vein.
Ding Ling reached out to pick up the Dragon Vein.
But upon touching it, he retracted his hand,
Instead reached for the golden sword nearby.
The golden sword had no scabbard.
When Ding Ling picked it up, he could clearly see three characters engraved on its blade:
"Xuanyuan Sword!"
"Indeed, it’s the ancient Human Emperor Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan!"
"This must indeed be where a Dragon Vein is kept!"
Ding Ling tried to activate the Xuanyuan Sword.
He tried many methods, finding it as unresponsive as dead wood, almost entirely ineffective.
Only when he unconsciously operated the Human Emperor Breathing Technique, clanging!
The Xuanyuan Sword seemed to come alive, starting to tremble and hum, bursting forth with sky-piercing sword light.
The main body continuously ripples with brilliance, but changed drastically in an instant.
Originally the blade only had three characters inscribed
Now it bore engravings of sun, moon, and stars on one side, mountains, rivers, and flora on the other!
On the originally blank hilt, small characters rose to the surface.
Ding Ling scanned through them rapidly.
In an instant,
[Farming and Breeding Skill Full Level]
[Four Seas Unification Strategy Full Level]
Written upon it were the two essential techniques for a Human Emperor.
After Ding Ling had both techniques at full level,
A peculiar energy naturally arose within him, constantly resonating with the Xuanyuan Sword, causing torrents of Sword Qi within the Xuanyuan Sword to shoot out incessantly.
For a moment,
Heaven and earth changed color.
Fengyun emerged spontaneously!
Sword Qi shot towards the Celestial Extreme, spontaneously drawing in torrents of Spiritual Qi into Ding Ling!
Such an extraordinary phenomenon,
Was terrifying!

It caused the two eight-foot tall men guarding the door outside this space to look at each other, seemingly sensing something, and then, in perfect synchronization, they opened the gate and rushed in.
