Ding Ling’s heart stirred, he leaped, soaring elegantly, ascending on wind, his feet skimming over the hundred-zhang body of the divine dragon, landing gently beside the Dragon Vein.
Ding Ling reached out to pick up the Dragon Vein.
But upon touching it, he retracted his hand,
Instead reached for the golden sword nearby.
The golden sword had no scabbard.
When Ding Ling picked it up, he could clearly see three characters engraved on its blade:
"Xuanyuan Sword!"
"Indeed, it’s the ancient Human Emperor Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan!"
"This must indeed be where a Dragon Vein is kept!"
Ding Ling tried to activate the Xuanyuan Sword.
He tried many methods, finding it as unresponsive as dead wood, almost entirely ineffective.
Only when he unconsciously operated the Human Emperor Breathing Technique, clanging!
The Xuanyuan Sword seemed to come alive, starting to tremble and hum, bursting forth with sky-piercing sword light.
The main body continuously ripples with brilliance, but changed drastically in an instant.
Originally the blade only had three characters inscribed
Now it bore engravings of sun, moon, and stars on one side, mountains, rivers, and flora on the other!
On the originally blank hilt, small characters rose to the surface.
Ding Ling scanned through them rapidly.
In an instant,
[Farming and Breeding Skill Full Level]
[Four Seas Unification Strategy Full Level]
Written upon it were the two essential techniques for a Human Emperor.
After Ding Ling had both techniques at full level,
A peculiar energy naturally arose within him, constantly resonating with the Xuanyuan Sword, causing torrents of Sword Qi within the Xuanyuan Sword to shoot out incessantly.
For a moment,
Heaven and earth changed color.
Fengyun emerged spontaneously!
Sword Qi shot towards the Celestial Extreme, spontaneously drawing in torrents of Spiritual Qi into Ding Ling!
Such an extraordinary phenomenon,
Was terrifying!

It caused the two eight-foot tall men guarding the door outside this space to look at each other, seemingly sensing something, and then, in perfect synchronization, they opened the gate and rushed in.

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - 587: Nie Renwang! Marshal Duann
paragraphs: Then, they saw the Xuanyuan Sword being activated, the entire space filled with swirling Sword Qi in an astonishing scene!
"This, this, this..."
A man holding a large saber, with a face full of whiskers and an imposing demeanor, widened his pupils, gasping in disbelief as he murmured:
"The Xuanyuan Divine Sword, someone actually picked it up and even activated it?! How, how is this possible?!"
"Indeed."
Another middle-aged man with a heroic appearance was also full of shock:

"When I, Marshal Duann, was young, I traveled across the lands and met many strange and exceptional people. But someone capable of activating the Human Emperor Sword, not to mention seeing, I dare not even imagine."
These two were none other than.
Indeed, they were Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang.
Marshal Duann is the father of Duann Lang, known as the ’Southern Qilin Sword Master’ and ’Half a Lifetime of Invincibility’!
Nie Renwang is the father of Nie Feng, known as the Northern Drinking Mad Saber!

After unintentionally discovering the secret of the Dragon Vein, the two abandoned their personal matters, vowing to dedicate their lives to guarding the Dragon Vein and protecting Jiuzhou from falling!
For so many years.
Thanks to their loyal guardianship.
No calamities have occurred in this Dragon Vein region.
Even though more and more experts are entering the Lingyun Cave.
The two would act accordingly, using the extremely complex terrain of the Lingyun Cave, continuously leading experts away, keeping them far from the Dragon Vein.
Initially, in the past two days, the two were very anxious and nervous.
Suddenly realizing abnormalities within the Dragon Vein’s inner space, they were horrified to death!
Upon opening the gateway and entering,
they saw a young man raising the Xuanyuan Divine Sword with his right hand, surrounded by dense Human Dao Sword Qi swirling around him, seemingly in worship and submission!
Such scenes.
Clearly showed that the Xuanyuan Divine Sword had acknowledged the young man!
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann knew this well, naturally unable to remain calm, extremely shocked.
"How did he get in?"
The two looked at each other, bewildered, puzzled.
They were clearly standing guard at the entrance.
And even if drawing people away from the Dragon Vein region.
It was only one person doing the guiding.
The other person continued guarding the portal to prevent any accidents.
However.
Even with their caution!
The Dragon Vein region was still intruded upon; the two were puzzled, finding the matter too strange and unfathomable!
"Let’s see what happens and act accordingly."
The two exchanged a glance.
But they understood each other’s eyes.
The two were deeply bonded, understanding each other with just a glance.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Countless Sword Qi suddenly converged, gathering toward the direction of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
In the storm of Sword Qi.
Ding Ling closed his eyes, carefully experiencing the supreme sensation brought by this Sword Qi.
At the moment the Sword Qi was activated.
Ding Ling was instantly enlightened with a cultivation technique.
"Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture"
Unfortunately.
It was only the basics.
Ding Ling briefly skimmed through it.
[Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture Basic Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.3]
Undoubtedly.
This was a peerless cultivation technique.
Engraved within the Xuanyuan Sword!
Only when a true Human Emperor of this age activates the inner space of the Xuanyuan Sword, with Sword Qi surging forth, will this Sword Technique emerge in accordance with the times.
Following the Sword Intent, it integrated into Ding Ling’s organs.
The average Human Emperor.
Even upon acquiring this Sword Intent.
Would find it extremely difficult to cultivate the basic technique of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture to success in a short time, let alone to Great Perfection.
Yet Ding Ling reached Great Perfection in an instant.
Free from future worries.

Simply because of the limited existence of this Sword Intent, if unable to comprehend it thoroughly in a short time, the basic technique of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture would dissipate with the Sword Intent.
This opportunity would be lost.
However, Ding Ling accurately seized this opportunity, thoroughly understanding everything.
"Only by mastering the basics of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture do I qualify to cultivate the true Supreme Technique recorded in the Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture!"
Ding Ling sighed deeply.
Alas.
"I’m afraid I won’t have the chance to acquire the Supreme Technique of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture."
Only because the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan has been dead for so, so long.
His legacy has already been severed!
"Fortunately, as long as I master the basics of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture, I can wield the power of the Xuanyuan Sword!"
Ding Ling activated the full level of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword Scripture’s basic technique. In the next second, the countless Sword Qi converged with a clang, surging into the Xuanyuan Sword.
These Human Dao Sword Qi, incredibly majestic, vast, and sharp.
Now were claimed for Ding Ling’s use in a single thought!
"From now on, the Xuanyuan Sword belongs to the Ding family!"
Ding Ling looked at the Xuanyuan Divine Sword in his hand with great satisfaction.
This sword is truly a legendary Divine Artifact!
Too extraordinary!
By sheer chance, he managed to activate this sword. For ordinary people, even lifting it, let alone activating it, would be a problem, Ding Ling estimated.
"It seems that only those imbued with the Human Emperor’s Aura have the right to pick it up."
"And only those who have achieved the full level of the Human Emperor Breathing Technique have the qualification to activate it!"
Ding Ling now fully believed that the Human Emperor Breathing Technique was the technique of Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan!
Such an ancient technique could be passed down to the Three Kingdoms Era without being lost.
It must be said.
This is truly a fortunate event!
Otherwise, even with the Xuanyuan Divine Sword, Ding Ling would have been left clueless!
After obtaining the Xuanyuan Divine Sword.
Ding Ling shifted his gaze to the Dragon Vein.
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann saw this, realizing the danger, and without much thought, shouted out:
"Hold on!"
Ding Ling had already noticed the two and, hearing this, turned his head and called out:
"I wonder who the two of you might be?"
The two then introduced themselves.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, not expecting to meet these two here, and respectfully greeted them.
The two dared not be negligent and hurriedly returned the salute, then exchanged a glance, and swiftly performed the Lightweight Body Technique, arriving not far from Ding Ling, and said to him:
"Young hero, the Dragon Vein must not be disturbed."
"Why?"

"If the Dragon Vein is disturbed, the formation here will drastically change, and then it will no longer be possible to suppress the evil demon at the bottom of the abyss! If the evil demon emerges, the consequences are unimaginable; in the lightest case, one-tenth of the people of Jiuzhou would survive, in the worst case, the world would turn upside down, with no one able to escape."
Marshal Duann spoke with a grave expression, looking deeply distressed:

"The ancient Human Emperor, Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, exhausted his heart and blood to suppress this evil demon, using all his life force to seal and suppress it, and even felt it was not enough, ultimately standing guard here alone! He used his own physical form as the sealing center, with a section of the dragon bone produced from his own body as the core item, resonating with the countless carvings of this Grand Array, thus thoroughly suppressing that evil demon, making it unable to rise again!"
Bullshit!
Before Marshal Duann’s words had finished, Ding Ling seemed to vaguely hear a dull angry shout!
This voice came suddenly and vanished just as quickly, ethereal to the extreme, seeming to originate from the Upper Realm, yet also seemingly from the Earth Realm.
Ding Ling even thought it was an illusion.
"Indeed."
Nie Renwang nodded, speaking with a sense of loss:
"The Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan was an Ancient Saint, the incarnation of a True Dragon, experiencing some miraculous transformation within his body in his later years, growing a section of dragon bone.
This dragon bone was transformed from Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi. It can subdue all things!
To suppress this evil demon.
The Yellow Emperor pulled out his own dragon bone, transforming it into a Dragon Vein, placing it within this Lingyun Cave."
Nie Renwang paused, glancing at Ding Ling, seeing him without any expression, continued:

"This Lingyun Cave is the most rich in Spiritual Vitality in the world. Only by nurturing the Dragon Vein here can it produce an endless stream of Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi, gradually eradicating the magical energy of the evil demon.
As time passes.
The evil demon will certainly be obliterated!
Then we can retire with our mission accomplished!"

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - 588: Yinglong’s Remains
paragraphs: Bullshit!
Another blurred, ethereal shout rang out, as if coming from beyond the heavens, yet also seeming to come from beside him.
The sound came quickly and disappeared even faster.
It flashed by in an instant!
But this time, Ding Ling was sure it wasn’t a hallucination.
How could there be a reason for two hallucinations?
He’s not an ordinary person!
Just now, he had received part of the Great Success from Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan! How could he have unfounded hallucinations?
Who is it?!
Ding Ling vigilantly scanned all directions.
Yet he did not see a fourth person besides them.
"What’s wrong?"
Nie Renwang was stunned.
Marshal Duann couldn’t help but glance sideways.
"Did you hear any other sounds?"
Ding Ling asked.
"No."
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann both shook their heads, then looked more nervously and cautiously around the earth realm than Ding Ling did:
"Is there anyone else?! Where are they?!"
Both of them were starting to doubt life now!
When Ding Ling was guarding the entrance, he quietly broke into the dimensional space where the Dragon Vein was stored and even activated the Xuanyuan Sword!
If it weren’t for the earth-shattering momentum of the activation of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword alerting them, Ding Ling might have made off with the Dragon Vein!
Thinking of this.
Both of their backs couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat!
And now?
From Ding Ling’s words, there seemed to be someone else here?!
Were they really that useless?
Couldn’t even sense someone approaching?!
"Are you sure you didn’t hear anything?"
Ding Ling asked again.
"No."
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann looked at Ding Ling dumbfounded, both instinctively placing their hands on the weapons at their waists, asking very cautiously:
"Where is he? Where?"
"Forget it."
Ding Ling said:
"Since there is no issue here, I should leave as well."
Ding Ling came here for the Ten Strong Martial Dao and such.
What he had gained now exceeded his expectations.
But what he most wanted to obtain was still the Ten Strong Martial Dao, this martial art was too powerful, he must get it!
"Wait, Young Hero."
Nie Renwang called out:
"Still don’t know Young Hero’s esteemed name."
"Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?"

Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann exchanged a look, clearly understanding the meaning in each other’s eyes: Is there a Martial Arts Family named Ding in this world’s Jianghu? Even if there is, has a powerful martial artist ever emerged from the Ding family?
Thinking this way, Marshal Duann couldn’t help but ask:
"Young Hero Ding, are you a descendant of Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan? Did your ancestors change their surname later?"
"Not sure."
Could Ding Ling say that all citizens of Jiuzhou are descendants of the dragon?
Moreover.
He indeed didn’t know much about his ancestors in this life.
He only knew about his father’s and grandfather’s generation, but not much beyond that.
"Wait."
Seeing that Ding Ling had already taken a step out, soaring into the air, Nie Renwang shouted:
"Young Hero Ding, are you just going to leave like this?"
"What?"
Ding Ling slightly turned his head to look at Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann, expressionless, speaking indifferently:
"Are you trying to stop me?"
"We wouldn’t dare."
Nie Renwang smiled bitterly:
"Young Hero Ding is now already the Sword Master of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword, equivalent to someone recognized by Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan. How dare we disrespect the Xuanyuan Sword Master?"
"Indeed."
Marshal Duann glanced at Nie Renwang, understood what Nie Renwang wanted to say, and immediately looked at Ding Ling, saying solemnly:

"Young Hero Ding, as Xuanyuan Sword Master, you ought to have the responsibility and obligation to protect the Dragon Vein and guard all living beings. We hope Young Hero Ding can stay and lend us a hand."
Ding Ling carefully examined the two of them, seeing their sincere, open-hearted looks, he couldn’t help but be dumbfounded for a moment, then was about to take off into the sky without looking back.
But just at this moment.
A shout suddenly erupted:
"Fool!"
Ding Ling’s steps paused.
This time he was 100% sure someone was speaking, and couldn’t help but look to the left and right with suspicion and uncertainty:
"Who is it speaking!"
"Hahaha..."
This person laughed, the laughter wanton, wild, and demonic:
"I, Laozi, never change my name nor my surname. The chieftain of the Jiuli Tribe, chief of the Ox Totem and Bird Totem clans! Chiyou!
"Chiyou?!"
Ding Ling’s pupils narrowed:
"The Commander Chiyou who was defeated by Yellow Emperor in the fierce battle at the Wilds?!"
"Haha, I am indeed Chiyou. But I don’t admit to being defeated by the Yellow Emperor. He used underhanded tricks to plot against me! Even if I’ve been dead for thousands of years, I won’t concede!"
It was indeed the legendary War God Chiyou.
Ding Ling was shocked and looked around:
"Where are you?"
"I’m in your heart."
Chiyou seemed to take a long breath:

"Really damn unlucky. Waited thousands of years, finally waited for a normal person. Was just thrilled! But unexpectantly came across a stinky kid like you with Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi! I have really hit the jackpot. Hey, kid, you quickly set me free! Once I’m free, I’ll definitely teach you all I’ve learned. Make you a peerless hero in the world!"
"In my heart?"
Ding Ling closed his eyes.
Carefully sensed, inspected inwardly.
As expected.
An extremely blurry and dim shadow was locked in the heart gate.
His above and below were surrounded by Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi, pressing it unable to move, only continuously shouting there:

"Kid, you see it too. Quickly set me free! Once I’m free, I’ll teach you the War God Technique. This is the unparalleled technique that made me invincible in the ancient era, forcing Yellow Emperor, Yinglong, and others to avoid! Once it reaches Great Success, invincible under heaven is simply no problem!"
He seemed to have a request, his tone softened considerably, no longer referring to himself as Laozi.
"How are you in my heart?"
Ding Ling was puzzled, but soon he realized:
"Are you the so-called Evil Demon suppressed in the coffin by Yellow Emperor?!"
"Pah pah pah."
Chiyou spat three times, said:

"Kid, I’m not an Evil Demon. I’m the Commander, the chieftain of the Jiuli Tribe, the true Human War God. That Xuanyuan Yellow Emperor, in order to seize my position as Human Emperor, exhausted all means to murder my brothers, and colluded with cronies to kill me in a pitfall! But even if he called in more cronies, he couldn’t kill me!
So he finally let Yinglong transform into a true dragon to suppress me here!
The remains you saw isn’t the Yellow Emperor’s, it’s Yinglong’s!
The piece of Dragon Vein is indeed dragon bone, as it’s a part from Yinglong’s dragon bones!"
Ding Ling was suspicious, somewhat unbelieving.
Chiyou was very anxious:

"Kid, you’re so young, your skills so high, already reaching the Grandmaster level, in the ancient era, that age of extremely abundant Spiritual Vitality, reaching Grandmaster at your age was extremely remarkable.
The most remarkable is that your heart actually contains two strands of Vast Righteous Qi.
Such pure Qi is extremely rare. Without these two strands of Qi, relying on these Buddha Qi, you couldn’t have kept me trapped!
You are so brilliant.
Why are you so foolish?!
Can’t you even distinguish between true and false words?!
I’m now trapped in your heart by you, unable to advance or retreat, how would I have reason to deceive you? You don’t believe me? Yet believe those two idiots outside?!"

We hope Young Hero Ding can stay and lend us a hand."
Ding Ling carefully examined the two of them, seeing their sincere, open-hearted looks, he couldn’t help but be dumbfounded for a moment, then was about to take off into the sky without looking back.
But just at this moment.
A shout suddenly erupted:
"Fool!"
Ding Ling’s steps paused.
This time he was 100% sure someone was speaking, and couldn’t help but look to the left and right with suspicion and uncertainty:
"Who is it speaking!"
"Hahaha..."
This person laughed, the laughter wanton, wild, and demonic:
"I, Laozi, never change my name nor my surname.
The chieftain of the Jiuli Tribe, chief of the Ox Totem and Bird Totem clans!
Chiyou!
"Chiyou?!"
Ding Ling’s pupils narrowed:
"The Commander Chiyou who was defeated by Yellow Emperor in the fierce battle at the Wilds?!"
"Haha, I am indeed Chiyou.
But I don’t admit to being defeated by the Yellow Emperor.
He used underhanded tricks to plot against me!
Even if I’ve been dead for thousands of years, I won’t concede!"
It was indeed the legendary War God Chiyou.
Ding Ling was shocked and looked around:
"Where are you?"
"I’m in your heart."
Chiyou seemed to take a long breath:
"Really damn unlucky.
Waited thousands of years, finally waited for a normal person.
Was just thrilled!
But unexpectantly came across a stinky kid like you with Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi!
I have really hit the jackpot.
Hey, kid, you quickly set me free!
Once I’m free, I’ll definitely teach you all I’ve learned.
Make you a peerless hero in the world!"
"In my heart?"
Ding Ling closed his eyes.
Carefully sensed, inspected inwardly.
As expected.
An extremely blurry and dim shadow was locked in the heart gate.
His above and below were surrounded by Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi, pressing it unable to move, only continuously shouting there:
"Kid, you see it too.
Quickly set me free!
Once I’m free, I’ll teach you the War God Technique.
This is the unparalleled technique that made me invincible in the ancient era, forcing Yellow Emperor, Yinglong, and others to avoid!
Once it reaches Great Success, invincible under heaven is simply no problem!"
He seemed to have a request, his tone softened considerably, no longer referring to himself as Laozi.
"How are you in my heart?"
Ding Ling was puzzled, but soon he realized:
"Are you the so-called Evil Demon suppressed in the coffin by Yellow Emperor?!"
"Pah pah pah."
Chiyou spat three times, said:
"Kid, I’m not an Evil Demon.
I’m the Commander, the chieftain of the Jiuli Tribe, the true Human War God.
That Xuanyuan Yellow Emperor, in order to seize my position as Human Emperor, exhausted all means to murder my brothers, and colluded with cronies to kill me in a pitfall!
But even if he called in more cronies, he couldn’t kill me!
So he finally let Yinglong transform into a true dragon to suppress me here!
The remains you saw isn’t the Yellow Emperor’s, it’s Yinglong’s!
The piece of Dragon Vein is indeed dragon bone, as it’s a part from Yinglong’s dragon bones!"
Ding Ling was suspicious, somewhat unbelieving.
Chiyou was very anxious:

"Kid, you’re so young, your skills so high, already reaching the Grandmaster level, in the ancient era, that age of extremely abundant Spiritual Vitality, reaching Grandmaster at your age was extremely remarkable.
The most remarkable is that your heart actually contains two strands of Vast Righteous Qi.
Such pure Qi is extremely rare.
Without these two strands of Qi, relying on these Buddha Qi, you couldn’t have kept me trapped!
You are so brilliant.
Why are you so foolish?!
Can’t you even distinguish between true and false words?!
I’m now trapped in your heart by you, unable to advance or retreat, how would I have reason to deceive you?
You don’t believe me?
Yet believe those two idiots outside?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - 589: Chiyou
paragraphs: Ding Ling didn’t pay attention to what Chiyou said.
Only because after obtaining the Xuanyuan Sword,
he clearly felt the pure, vast, and righteous Human Dao Sword Qi!
If the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan was truly despicable, how could he cultivate such a Qi!
This proves...
Chiyou must be lying.
Yet, Ding Ling didn’t expose Chiyou.
Though Chiyou had been trapped alone for thousands of years, his wisdom in various aspects must be exceedingly high. Competing in wits with him?
Ding Ling didn’t intend to.
He would only choose to compete in acting skills with Chiyou!
His acting skill was full-level.
Hence, Ding Ling quickly returned to the previous topic:
"You haven’t answered me yet, how did you enter my heart?!"
"That’s simple enough."
Chiyou laughed heartily:
"I am the Human War God, capable of anything, knowing everything! How could I not know the technique to sneak into someone’s heart gate?"
After laughing, his voice suddenly sank:

"Only, I now deeply regret rushing into your heart gate so hastily. If I had been a bit slower, using normal means, maybe I would have already gained my freedom and wouldn’t need to plead with you, boy!"
"I don’t believe you."
Ding Ling said:
"Unless you tell me the technique for sneaking into someone’s heart gate, and I confirm that such a method exists in the world, then I might consider whether to release you."
Chiyou was momentarily stunned and then furious. Ding Ling clearly intended to gain benefits without paying, how would Chiyou agree, he only said:

"This technique requires cultivating the ’Demon Scripture’ to have a chance of successful execution. And the Demon Scripture, one of my fundamental techniques besides the War God Technique, I absolutely cannot casually pass on to others. Unless..."
"Unless what?"
"Unless you acknowledge me as your master and become my disciple. Then I will pass the Demon Scripture to you."
"Alright."
Ding Ling said smoothly and naturally, without a change in expression:
"I acknowledge you as my master. Master, please teach me the secret technique."
Speak to people words suited for them.
Speak to ghosts words suited for them.
This is Ding Ling’s principle for handling matters. He had this inkling long ago.
Several worlds have passed.
He has experienced a lot, becoming not only more confident but also more tactful.
He had evolved from blushing when others praised him as a genius to being able to lie with utmost sincerity!
Of course.
He still treats genuine gentlemen, self-recognized individuals sincerely.
But towards suspected villains and vicious people.
Naturally, Ding Ling treats others the way they treat him.
He doesn’t believe Chiyou entered his heart gate with good intentions!
The heart gate is the most vulnerable place for a person, if occupied by others, the consequences are imaginable!
Chiyou brazenly barging in.
If Ding Ling didn’t have the foresight, allowing Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi to guard the heart gate, this time, he wouldn’t have foiled Chiyou!
If the heart gate was breached, just imagining it makes Ding Ling’s heart palpitate, it’s why he remains vigilant against Chiyou.
"Haha, good disciple."
Chiyou laughed heartily, very satisfied:
"From you obtaining mastery of the Divine Sword of Xuanyuan, it is clear that your talent must be extraordinary! And for thousands of years, you are the first to unlock that secret place!
If not for your arrival, I do not know how many more years I would have had to wait!
Just for that, I have no reason not to accept you as a disciple!
Now that we are master and disciple, relax your heart and let me out. Once I am out, I will immediately impart the technique to you."
"How do I relax my heart?"
With full-level acting activated, Ding Ling appeared very sincere and fitting.
"Just move your Buddha Qi and Vast Righteous Qi away from the heart gate."
Chiyou seemed somewhat impatient, his words carried a hint of urgency:
"Good disciple, quickly do as I say. Master has been trapped for thousands of years, unable to contain the excitement and joy of returning to the world!"

Ding Ling thought: ’If I truly relax my heart gate and you were to infiltrate deep inside my heart gate, gaining control of my consciousness, wouldn’t I fall into eternal hell, unable to help but obey you?’
Ding Ling wasn’t inexperienced.
He had read too many books.
Truly an All-Purpose King.
He is naturally very clear on the importance of the heart gate.
In the Martial World, heart gate defense techniques are few, only knowing Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, Buddhist Scripture, Dao Scripture can ease inner demons.
And the so-called inner demons.
Actually, it’s the heart gate breaching, invaded by Demon Qi, Evil Qi, Blood Evil Qi, and other negative Qi.
Ding Ling nearly fell into inner demons several times, feeling deeply.
He knows his weakness.
His constitution is weak.
Very weak resistance against Blood Evil Qi!
He couldn’t even resist Blood Evil Qi.
How to withstand Chiyou’s Demon Qi assault?
If he truly relaxes his heart gate, the consequences are imaginable!
"I can open Vast Righteous Qi, you can directly exit through the heart gate."
Ding Ling thought of a compromise.
"Alright!"
Chiyou said loudly:
"Open it."
His voice contained a peculiar tone.
Ding Ling understood but still opened a small gap in the heart gate.
Chiyou’s figure immediately rushed out of the heart gate, laughing twice, suddenly dashed towards Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness like a streamer.
Ding Ling hurriedly said:
"What are you doing?"

"Brat, I already said. My escape is all because of you. Naturally, we share honor and loss together! Relax your Sea of Consciousness, so I can pass on the secret technique. Then you and I, master and disciple, will be one. This world will be ours!"
Ding Ling’s heart moved.
Dragon Form and Elephant Form transformed into streamers, blocking Chiyou.
Chiyou’s face greatly changed:
"Brat, I am your master, do you want to defy your master?! Or want to commit patricide?!"
"Master, please pass on the Demon Scripture."
Ding Ling said sincerely:
"You clearly promised before, once out the heart gate, you would pass on the Demon Scripture to me. How could you go back on your word?"
He internally examined his organs.
Watched closely.
Chiyou appeared extremely robust, with a rugged, overbearing middle-aged man’s image.
He was surrounded by black Qi.
His form was very vague.
Most of the time, his features were unclear, only occasionally could his appearance be captured.
"Hmph."
Chiyou coldly snorted, looked up as if confronting Ding Ling’s internal-view ’eye’:
"I, Chiyou, fight the heavens and earth, could I not keep my word. Fine, open your Sea of Consciousness, and I will pass on the Demon Scripture to you now."
Saying so.
He scanned the Dragon Form and Elephant Form divine shapes subtly, revealing a hint of surprise and amazement in his eyes.
He truly didn’t expect Ding Ling had also perfected these two divine forms.
If otherwise.
He wouldn’t have rushed to break through the heart gate.
Being here, what’s different from being at the heart gate?
If the two divine forms were in the juvenile stage, Chiyou wouldn’t be so cautious, but these two divine forms had clearly matured partly, already featuring remarkable combat power.
Now at his weakest period, with limited combat power, it’s hard to win against these two divine forms, afraid it’s another suppression result.
Upon thinking this.
Chiyou’s face turned gloomy as water, he really didn’t expect the youthful intruder of a secret place, his body would harbor so many ’Divine Objects.’
Vast Righteous Qi is particularly hard to produce, this young man not only has it...
